verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਊਤਮ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਗਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har jan karanee uootam hai har keerat jag bisathaar ||3||
verses.translation: The lifestyle of the Lord's humble servant is exalted and sublime. He spreads the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises throughout the world. ||3||

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kirapaa kar Thaakur mere har har har ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, please be merciful, merciful to me, that I may enshrine the Lord, Har, Har, Har, within my heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur pooraa paiaa man japiaa naam muraar ||4||9||
verses.translation: Nanak has found the Perfect True Guru; in his mind, he chants the Name of the Lord. ||4||9||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa teejaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Malaar, Third Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: eih man girahee k ih man udhaasee ||
verses.translation: Is this mind a householder, or is this mind a detached renunciate?

verses.original: ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਵਰਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: k ih man avaran sadhaa avinaasee ||
verses.translation: Is this mind beyond social class, eternal and unchanging?

verses.original: ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਕਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: k ih man cha(n)chal k ih man bairaagee ||
verses.translation: Is this mind fickle, or is this mind detached?

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਮਤਾ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eis man kau mamataa kithahu laagee ||1||
verses.translation: How has this mind been gripped by possessiveness? ||1||

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit is man kaa karahu beechaar ||
verses.translation: O Pandit, O religious scholar, reflect on this in your mind.

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਉਠਾਵਹਿ ਭਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: avar k bahutaa paReh uThaaveh bhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Why do you read so many other things, and carry such a heavy load? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa mamataa karatai laiee ||
verses.translation: The Creator has attached it to Maya and possessiveness.

verses.original: ਏਹੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eh hukam kar sirasaT upaiee ||
verses.translation: Enforcing His Order, He created the world.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee boojhahu bhaiee ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, understand this, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sadhaa rahahu har kee saranaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Remain forever in the Sanctuary of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਜੋ ਤਿਹਾਂ ਗੁਣਾ ਕੀ ਪੰਡ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: so pa(n)ddit jo tihaa(n) gunaa kee pa(n)dd utaarai ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Pandit, who sheds the load of the three qualities.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin eko naam vakhaanai ||
verses.translation: Night and day, he chants the Name of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਓਹੁ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee oh dheekhiaa lei ||
verses.translation: He accepts the Teachings of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਸੀਸੁ ਧਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur aagai sees dharei ||
verses.translation: He offers his head to the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਲਗੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa alag rahai nirabaan ||
verses.translation: He remains forever unattached in the state of Nirvaanaa.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: so pa(n)ddit dharageh paravaan ||3||
verses.translation: Such a Pandit is accepted in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾਂ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa(n) meh eko ek vakhaanai ||
verses.translation: He preaches that the One Lord is within all beings.

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਏਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਾਂ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) eko vekhai taa(n) eko jaanai ||
verses.translation: As he sees the One Lord, he knows the One Lord.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau bakhase mele soi ||
verses.translation: That person, whom the Lord forgives, is united with Him.

verses.original: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aaithai othai sadhaa sukh hoi ||4||
verses.translation: He finds eternal peace, here and hereafter. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kahat naanak kavan bidh kare kiaa koi ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, what can anyone do?

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: soiee mukat jaa kau kirapaa hoi ||
verses.translation: He alone is liberated, whom the Lord blesses with His Grace.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin har gun gaavai soi ||
verses.translation: Night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਦ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥੧॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: saasatr bedh kee fir kook na hoi ||5||1||10||
verses.translation: Then, he no longer bothers with the proclamations of the Shaastras or the Vedas. ||5||1||10||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhram bhram jon manmukh bharamaiee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs wander lost in reincarnation, confused and deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jamakaal maare nit pat gavaiee ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death constantly beats them and disgraces them.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sevaa jam kee kaan chukaiee ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, the mortal's subservience to Death is ended.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਹਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har prabh miliaa mahal ghar paiee ||1||
verses.translation: He meets the Lord God, and enters the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: praanee gurmukh naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: O mortal, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਖੋਇਆ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath dhubidhaa khoiaa kauddee badhalai jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In duality, you are ruining and wasting this priceless human life. You trade it away in exchange for a shell. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa gurmukh lagai piaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh falls in love with the Lord, by His Grace.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar bhagat har har ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: He enshrines loving devotion to the Lord, Har, Har, deep within his heart.

verses.original: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਲੰਘਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhavajal sabadh la(n)ghaavanahaar ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Shabad carries him across the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhar saachai dhisai sachiaar ||2||
verses.translation: He appears true in the True Court of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bahu karam kare satigur nahee paiaa ||
verses.translation: Performing all sorts of rituals, they do not find the True Guru.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur bharam bhoole bahu maiaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, so many wander lost and confused in Maya.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਬਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: haumai mamataa bahu moh vadhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Egotism, possessiveness and attachment rise up and increase within them.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai manmukh dhukh paiaa ||3||
verses.translation: In the love of dualty, the self-willed manmukhs suffer in pain. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: aape karataa agam athaahaa ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself is Inaccessible and Infinite.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee japeeaai sach laahaa ||
verses.translation: Chant the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and earn the true profit.

verses.original: ਹਾਜਰੁ ਹਜੂਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: haajar hajoor har veparavaahaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is Independent, Ever-present, here and now.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh naam samaahaa ||4||2||11||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh merges in the Naam. ||4||2||11||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਮੁਕਤ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat mukat gurmatee laage ||
verses.translation: Those who are attached to the Guru's Teachings, are Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: har kee bhagat anadhin sadh jaage ||
verses.translation: They remain forever awake and aware night and day, in devotional worship of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seveh aap gavai ||
verses.translation: They serve the True Guru, and eradicate their self-conceit.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਦ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hau tin jan ke sadh laagau pai ||1||
verses.translation: I fall at the feet of such humble beings. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: hau jeevaa(n) sadhaa har ke gun gaiee ||
verses.translation: Constantly singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I live.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh mahaa ras meeThaa har kai naam mukat gat paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is such totally sweet elixir. Through the Name of the Lord, I have attained the state of liberation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh agiaan gubaar ||
verses.translation: Attachment to Maya leads to the darkness of ignorance.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੋਹੇ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mohe mugadh gavaar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manukhs are attached, foolish and ignorant.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin dha(n)dhaa karat vihai ||
verses.translation: Night and day, their lives pass away in worldly entanglements.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mar mar ja(n)meh milai sajai ||2||
verses.translation: They die and die again and again, only to be reborn and receive their punishment. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh raam naam liv laiee ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is lovingly attuned to the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਨਾ ਲਪਟਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kooRai laalach naa lapaTaiee ||
verses.translation: He does not cling to false greed.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh hovai sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: Whatever he does, he does with intuitive poise.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har ras peevai rasan rasai ||3||
verses.translation: He drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord; his tongue delights in its flavor. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: koT madhe kiseh bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: Among millions, hardly any understand.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape bakhase dhe vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself forgives, and bestows His glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhur miliaa su vichhuR na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Whoever meets with the Primal Lord God, shall never be separated again.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak har har naam samaiee ||4||3||12||
verses.translation: Nanak is absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||3||12||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa naam sabh koiee kahai ||
verses.translation: Everyone speaks the Name of the Lord with the tongue.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seve taa naam lahai ||
verses.translation: But only by serving the True Guru does the mortal receive the Name.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਘਰਿ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan toRe mukat ghar rahai ||
verses.translation: His bonds are shattered, and he stays in the house of liberation.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਘਰਿ ਬਹੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee asathir ghar bahai ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he sits in the eternal, unchanging house. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾਹੇ ਰੋਸੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: mere man kaahe ros kareejai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, why are you angry?

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: laahaa kalajug raam naam hai gurmat anadhin hiradhai raveejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the source of profit. Contemplate and appreciate the Guru's Teachings within your heart, night and day. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: baabeehaa khin khin bilalai ||
verses.translation: Each and every instant, the rainbird cries and calls.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਦੇਖੇ ਨਂੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin pir dhekhe na(n)eedh na pai ||
verses.translation: Without seeing her Beloved, she does not sleep at all.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਸਹਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih vechhoRaa sahiaa na jai ||
verses.translation: She cannot endure this separation.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur milai taa(n) milai subhai ||2||
verses.translation: When she meets the True Guru, then she intuitively meets her Beloved. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮਹੀਣੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naamaheen binasai dhukh pai ||
verses.translation: Lacking the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal suffers and dies.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਿਆ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa jaliaa bhookh na jai ||
verses.translation: He is burnt in the fire of desire, and his hunger does not depart.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vin bhaagaa naam na paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: Without good destiny, he cannot find the Naam.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਥਾਕਾ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bahu bidh thaakaa karam kamai ||3||
verses.translation: He performs all sorts of rituals until he is exhausted. ||3||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun baanee bedh beechaar ||
verses.translation: The mortal thinks about the Vedic teachings of the three gunas, the three dispositions.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa mail bikhiaa vaapaar ||
verses.translation: He deals in corruption, filth and vice.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mar janameh fir hoh khuaar ||
verses.translation: He dies, only to be reborn; he is ruined over and over again.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤੁਰੀਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gurmukh tureeaa gun ur dhaar ||4||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh enshrines the glory of the supreme state of celestial peace. ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਮਾਨੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur maanai maanai sabh koi ||
verses.translation: One who has faith in the Guru - everyone has faith in him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur bachanee man seetal hoi ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Word, the mind is cooled and soothed.

verses.original: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: chahu jug sobhaa niramal jan soi ||
verses.translation: Throughout the four ages, that humble being is known to be pure.

verses.translit: naanak gurmukh viralaa koi ||5||4||13||9||13||22||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that Gurmukh is so rare. ||5||4||13||9||13||22||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ
verses.translit: raag malaar mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe
verses.translation: Raag Malaar, Fourth Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin har har dhiaaio hiradhai mat gurmat dhookh visaaree ||
verses.translation: Night and day, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, within my heart; through the Guru's Teachings, my pain is forgotten.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੂਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh aasaa manasaa ba(n)dhan tooTe har har prabh kirapaa dhaaree ||1||
verses.translation: The chains of all my hopes and desires have been snapped; my Lord God has showered me with His Mercy. ||1||

verses.original: ਨੈਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: nainee har har laagee taaree ||
verses.translation: My eyes gaze eternally on the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸਿਓ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dhekh meraa man bigasio jan har bheTio banavaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Gazing on the True Guru, my mind blossoms forth. I have met with the Lord, the Lord of the World. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਕੁਲਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਗਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin aaisaa naam visaariaa meraa har har tis kai kul laagee gaaree ||
verses.translation: One who forgets such a Name of the Lord, Har, Har - his family is dishonored.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਕੁਲਿ ਪਰਸੂਤਿ ਨ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਧਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har tis kai kul parasoot na kareeahu tis bidhavaa kar mahataaree ||2||
verses.translation: His family is sterile and barren, and his mother is made a widow. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har aan milaavahu gur saadhoo jis ahinis har ur dhaaree ||
verses.translation: O Lord, let me meet the Holy Guru, who night and day keep the Lord enshrined in his heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਡੀਠੈ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਹਤਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur ddeeThai gur kaa sikh bigasai jiau baarik dhekh mahataaree ||3||
verses.translation: Seeing the Guru, the GurSikh blossoms forth, like the child seeing his mother. ||3||

verses.original: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਕਾ ਇਕ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਭੀਤਿ ਕਰਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhan pir kaa ik hee sa(n)g vaasaa vich haumai bheet karaaree ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride and the Husband Lord live together as one, but the hard wall of egotism has come between them.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਭੀਤਿ ਤੋਰੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur poorai haumai bheet toree jan naanak mile banavaaree ||4||1||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru demolishes the wall of egotism; servant Nanak has met the Lord, the Lord of the World. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੰਗਾ ਜਮੁਨਾ ਗੋਦਾਵਰੀ ਸਰਸੁਤੀ ਤੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ga(n)gaa jamunaa godhaavaree sarasutee te kareh udham dhoor saadhoo kee taiee ||
verses.translation: The Ganges, the Jamunaa, the Godaavari and the Saraswati - these rivers strive for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੇ ਪਰੇ ਹਮਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਮਰੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kilavikh mail bhare pare hamarai vich hamaree mail saadhoo kee dhoor gavaiee ||1||
verses.translation: Overflowing with their filthy sins, the mortals take cleansing baths in them; the rivers' pollution is washed away by the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਨਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: teerath aThasaTh majan naiee ||
verses.translation: Instead of bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, take your cleansing bath in the Name.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਰੀ ਉਡਿ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਸਭ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat kee dhoor paree udd netree sabh dhuramat mail gavaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When the dust of the feet of the Sat Sangat rises up into the eyes, all filthy evil-mindedness is removed. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾਹਰਨਵੀ ਤਪੈ ਭਾਗੀਰਥਿ ਆਣੀ ਕੇਦਾਰੁ ਥਾਪਿਓ ਮਹਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaaharanavee tapai bhaageerath aanee kedhaar thaapio mahasaiee ||
verses.translation: Bhaageerat'h the penitent brought the Ganges down, and Shiva established Kaydaar.

verses.original: ਕਾਂਸੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਚਰਾਵਤ ਗਾਊ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaa(n)see kirasan charaavat gaauoo mil har jan sobhaa paiee ||2||
verses.translation: Krishna grazed cows in Kaashi; through the humble servant of the Lord, these places became famous. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਵੀ ਥਾਪੇ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਤਨੇ ਲੋਚਹਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jitane teerath dhevee thaape sabh titane locheh dhoor saadhoo kee taiee ||
verses.translation: And all the sacred shrines of pilgrimage established by the gods, long for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਲੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har kaa sa(n)t milai gur saadhoo lai tis kee dhoor mukh laiee ||3||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Lord's Saint, the Holy Guru, I apply the dust of His feet to my face. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਤਨੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਤਿਤਨੀ ਲੋਚੈ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jitanee sirasaT tumaree mere suaamee sabh titanee lochai dhoor saadhoo kee taiee ||
verses.translation: And all the creatures of Your Universe, O my Lord and Master, long for the dust of the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak lilaaT hovai jis likhiaa tis saadhoo dhoor dhe har paar la(n)ghaiee ||4||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who has such destiny inscribed on his forehead, is blessed with the dust of the feet of the Holy; the Lord carries him across. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: tis jan kau har meeTh lagaanaa jis har har kirapaa karai ||
verses.translation: The Lord seems sweet to that humble being who is blessed by the Grace of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ਦੂਖ ਸਭਿ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis kee bhookh dhookh sabh utarai jo har gun har ucharai ||1||
verses.translation: His hunger and pain are totally taken away; he chants the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jap man har har har nisatarai ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, Har, the mortal is emancipated.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਬਚਨ ਕਰਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke bachan karan sun dhiaavai bhav saagar paar parai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who listens to the Guru's Teachings and meditates on them, is carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਹਾਟਿ ਬਿਹਾਝੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: tis jan ke ham haaT bihaajhe jis har har kirapaa karai ||
verses.translation: I am the slave of that humble being, who is blessed by the Grace of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਭ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har jan kau miliaa(n) sukh paieeaai sabh dhuramat mail harai ||2||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Lord's humble servant, peace is obtained; all the pollution and filth of evil-mindedness is washed away. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਭੂਖ ਲਗਾਨੀ ਜਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਬਿਚਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: har jan kau har bhookh lagaanee jan tirapatai jaa har gun bicharai ||
verses.translation: The humble servant of the Lord feels hunger only for the Lord. He is satisfied only when he chants the Lord's Glories.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਲ ਕਾ ਮੀਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har kaa jan har jal kaa meenaa har bisarat fooT marai ||3||
verses.translation: The humble servant of the Lord is a fish in the Water of the Lord. Forgetting the Lord, he would dry up and die. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਸੋ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਧਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin eh preet laiee so jaanai kai jaanai jis man dharai ||
verses.translation: He alone knows this love, who enshrines it within his mind.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਭੂਖ ਟਰੈ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har dhekh sukh paavai sabh tan kee bhookh Tarai ||4||3||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak gazes upon the Lord and is at peace; The hunger of his body is totally satisfied. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਤਿਤਨੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਲਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jitane jeea ja(n)t prabh keene titane sir kaar likhaavai ||
verses.translation: All the beings and creatures which God has created - on their foreheds, He has written their destiny.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨੑ ਵਡਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har jan kau har dheen(h) vaddaiee har jan har kaarai laavai ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord blesses His humble servant with glorious greatness. The Lord enjoins him to his tasks. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur har har naam dhiraRaavai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਿਖ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bolahu gur ke sikh mere bhaiee har bhaujal jagat taraavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, O Sikhs of the Guru, O my Siblings of Destiny. Only the Lord will carry you across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਨੁ ਪੂਜੇ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jo gur kau jan pooje seve so jan mere har prabh bhaavai ||
verses.translation: That humble being who worships, adores and serves the Guru is pleasing to my Lord God.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har kee sevaa satigur poojahu kar kirapaa aap taraavai ||2||
verses.translation: To worship and adore the True Guru is to serve the Lord. In His Mercy, He saves us and carries us across. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਫੂਲ ਤੋਰਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: bharam bhoole agiaanee a(n)dhule bhram bhram fool toraavai ||
verses.translation: The ignorant and the blind wander deluded by doubt; deluded and confused, they pick flowers to offer to their idols.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਜੀਉ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਮੜਾ ਸਰੇਵਹਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਘਾਲ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nirajeeau poojeh maRaa sareveh sabh birathee ghaal gavaavai ||3||
verses.translation: They worship lifeless stones and serve the tombs of the dead; all their efforts are useless. ||3||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦੇ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: braham bi(n)dhe so satigur kaheeaai har har kathaa sunaavai ||
verses.translation: He alone is said to be the True Guru, who realizes God, and proclaims the Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਛਾਦਨ ਭੋਜਨ ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: tis gur kau chhaadhan bhojan paaT paTa(n)bar bahu bidh sat kar mukh sa(n)chahu tis pu(n)n kee fir toT na aavai ||4||
verses.translation: Offer the Guru sacred foods, clothes, silk and satin robes of all sorts; know that He is True. The merits of this shall never leave you lacking. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਉ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜੋ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਚਨ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dheau paratakh har moorat jo a(n)mirat bachan sunaavai ||
verses.translation: The Divine True Guru is the Embodiment, the Image of the Lord; He utters the Ambrosial Word.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਗ ਭਲੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੫॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak bhaag bhale tis jan ke jo har charanee chit laavai ||5||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, blessed and good is the destiny of that humble being, who focuses his consciousness on the Feet of the Lord. ||5||4||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਬਸਿਓ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਭਲ ਭਾਂਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h) kai heearai basio meraa satigur te sa(n)t bhale bhal bhaa(n)t ||
verses.translation: Those whose hearts are filled with my True Guru - those Saints are good and noble in every way.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਦੇਖੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin(h) dhekhe meraa man bigasai hau tin kai sadh bal jaa(n)t ||1||
verses.translation: Seeing them, my mind blossoms forth in bliss; I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: giaanee har bolahu dhin raat ||
verses.translation: O spiritual teacher, chant the Name of the Lord, day and night.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਸਭ ਉਤਰੀ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tin(h) kee tirasanaa bhookh sabh utaree jo gurmat raam ras khaa(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: All hunger and thirst are satisfied, for those who partake of the sublime essence of the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਸਾਧ ਸਖਾ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਭਰਾਂਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: har ke dhaas saadh sakhaa jan jin miliaa leh jai bharaa(n)t ||
verses.translation: The slaves of the Lord are our Holy companions. Meeting with them, doubt is taken away.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਦੁਧ ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਕਾਢੈ ਚੁਣਿ ਹੰਸੁਲਾ ਤਿਉ ਦੇਹੀ ਤੇ ਚੁਣਿ ਕਾਢੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau jal dhudh bhi(n)n bhi(n)n kaaddai chun ha(n)sulaa tiau dhehee te chun kaaddai saadhoo haumai taat ||2||
verses.translation: As the swan separates the milk from the water, the Holy Saint removes the fire of egotism from the body. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤੇ ਕਪਟੀ ਨਰ ਨਿਤ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਂਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin kai preet naahee har hiradhai te kapaTee nar nit kapaT kamaa(n)t ||
verses.translation: Those who do not love the Lord in their hearts are deceitful; they continually practice deception.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ਦੇਇ ਖਵਾਲੈ ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਂਤਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tin kau kiaa koiee dhei khavaalai oi aap beej aape hee khaa(n)t ||3||
verses.translation: What can anyone give them to eat? Whatever they themselves plant, they must eat. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਚਿਹਨੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਰਖਾਂਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa chihan soiee har jan kaa har aape jan meh aap rakhaa(n)t ||
verses.translation: This is the Quality of the Lord, and of the Lord's humble servants as well; the Lord places His Own Essence within them.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਤਰੀ ਤਰਾਂਤਿ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)n guroo naanak samadharasee jin ni(n)dhaa usatat taree taraa(n)t ||4||5||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed, is Guru Nanak, who looks impartially on all; He crosses over and transcends both slander and praise. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਪਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar naam har uootam har kirapaa te jap liaa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is inaccessible, unfathomable, exalted and sublime. It is chanted by the Lord's Grace.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਾਈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat saadh paiee vaddabhaagee sa(n)g saadhoo paar piaa ||1||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I have found the True Congregation, and in the Company of the Holy, I am carried across. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: merai man anadhin anadh bhiaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is in ecstasy, night and day.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh naam har japiaa mere man kaa bhram bhau giaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, I chant the Name of the Lord. Doubt and fear are gone from my mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin har gaiaa jin har japiaa tin sa(n)gat har melahu kar miaa ||
verses.translation: Those who chant and meditate on the Lord - O Lord, in Your Mercy, please unite me with them.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin kaa dharas dhekh sukh paiaa dhukh haumai rog giaa ||2||
verses.translation: Gazing upon them, I am at peace; the pain and disease of egotism are gone. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo anadhin hiradhai naam dhiaaveh sabh janam tinaa kaa safal bhiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord in their hearts - their lives become totally fruitful.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਤਾਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਭੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: oi aap tare sirasaT sabh taaree sabh kul bhee paar piaa ||3||
verses.translation: They themselves swim across, and carry the world across with them. Their ancestors and family cross over as well. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਲਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape aap upaiaa sabh jag tudh aape vas kar liaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself created the whole world, and You Yourself keep it under Your control.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau prabh kirapaa dhaaree bikh ddubadhaa kaadd liaa ||4||6||
verses.translation: God has showered His Mercy on servant Nanak; He has lifted him up, and rescued him from the ocean of poison. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੀਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੂਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee a(n)mrit nahee peeaa tirasanaa bhookh na jaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who do not drink in the Ambrosial Nectar by Guru's Grace - their thirst and hunger are not relieved.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂੜੑ ਜਲਤ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mooR(h) jalat aha(n)kaaree haumai vich dhukh paiee ||
verses.translation: The foolish self-willed manmukh burns in the fire of egotistical pride; he suffers painfully in egotism.

verses.original: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਦੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aavat jaat birathaa janam gavaiaa dhukh laagai pachhutaiee ||
verses.translation: Coming and going, he wastes his life uselessly; afflicted with pain, he regrets and repents.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੇ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis te upaje tiseh na cheteh dhirag jeevan dhirag khaiee ||1||
verses.translation: He does not even think of the One, from whom he originated. Cursed is his life, and cursed is his food. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: praanee gurmukh naam dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: O mortal, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaa kare gur mele har har naam samaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, in His Mercy leads the mortal to meet the Guru; he is absorbed in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਲਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh janam bhiaa hai birathaa aavat jaat lajaiee ||
verses.translation: The life of the self-willed manmukh is useless; he comes and goes in shame.

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਡੂਬੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh ddoobe abhimaanee haumai vich jal jaiee ||
verses.translation: In sexual desire and anger, the proud ones are drowned. They are burnt in their egotism.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਸਿਧਿ ਨ ਬੁਧਿ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਮਧਿਮ ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tin sidh na budh bhiee mat madhim lobh lahar dhukh paiee ||
verses.translation: They do not attain perfection or understanding; their intellect is dimmed. Tossed by the waves of greed, they suffer in pain.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਹੂਨ ਮਹਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਮ ਪਕਰੇ ਬਿਲਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur bihoon mahaa dhukh paiaa jam pakare bilalaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, they suffer in terrible pain. Seized by Death, they weep and wail. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam agochar paiaa gurmukh sahaj subhaiee ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I have attained the Unfathomable Name of the Lord, with intuitive peace and poise.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan vasiaa ghaT a(n)tar rasanaa har gun gaiee ||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Naam abides deep within my heart. My tongue sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh rahai dhin raatee ek sabadh liv laiee ||
verses.translation: I am forever in bliss, day and night, lovingly attuned to the One Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਇਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam padhaarath sahaje paiaa ieh satigur kee vaddiaaiee ||3||
verses.translation: I have obtained the treasure of the Naam with intuitive ease; this is the glorious greatness of the True Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te har har man vasiaa satigur kau sadh bal jaiee ||
verses.translation: Through the True Guru, the Lord, Har, Har, comes to dwell within my mind. I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਰਖਉ ਸਭੁ ਆਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man tan arap rakhau sabh aagai gur charanee chit laiee ||
verses.translation: I have dedicated my mind and body to Him, and placed everything before Him in offering. I focus my consciousness on His Feet.

verses.original: ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਆਪੇ ਲੈਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: apanee kirapaa karahu gur poore aape laih milaiee ||
verses.translation: Please be merciful to me, O my Perfect Guru, and unite me with Yourself.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਲੋਹ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਵ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: ham loh gur naav bohithaa naanak paar la(n)ghaiee ||4||7||
verses.translation: I am just iron; the Guru is the boat, to carry me across. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa chauthhaa paRataal ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Malaar, Fourth Mehla, Partaal, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਬੋਲਤ ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੋਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jan bolat sreeraam naamaa mil saadhasa(n)gat har tor ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The humble servant of the Lord chants the Name of the Supreme Lord; he joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Lord's Holy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਬਨਜਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਾਗਤ ਹੈ ਨਹੀ ਚੋਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har dhan banajahu har dhan sa(n)chahu jis laagat hai nahee chor ||1||
verses.translation: Deal only in the wealth of the Lord, and gather only the wealth of the Lord. No thief can ever steal it. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੋਰ ਬੋਲਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸੁਨਿ ਘਨਿਹਰ ਕੀ ਘੋਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: chaatirak mor bolat dhin raatee sun ghanihar kee ghor ||2||
verses.translation: The rainbirds and the peacocks sing day and night, hearing the thunder in the clouds. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਬੋਲਤ ਹੈ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਮੀਨ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਤ ਹੈ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo bolat hai mirag meen pa(n)kheroo su bin har jaapat hai nahee hor ||3||
verses.translation: Whatever the deer, the fish and the birds sing, they chant to the Lord, and no other. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗਾਈ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਇਓ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਸਭ ਸੋਰ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak jan har keerat gaiee chhooT gio jam kaa sabh sor ||4||1||8||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; the sound and fury of Death has totally gone away. ||4||1||8||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਖੋਜਤੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: raam raam bol bol khojate baddabhaagee ||
verses.translation: They speak and chant the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam; the very fortunate ones seek Him.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਕੋਊ ਬਤਾਵੈ ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਪਾਇ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa pa(n)th kouoo bataavai hau taa kai pai laagee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whoever shows me the Way of the Lord - I fall at his feet. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਮਾਰੋ ਮੀਤੁ ਸਖਾਈ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: har hamaaro meet sakhaiee ham har siau preet laagee ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my Friend and Compansion; I am in love with the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅਉਰੁ ਦੁਤੀਆ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਮ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har ham gaaveh har ham boleh aaur dhuteeaa preet ham tiaagee ||1||
verses.translation: I sing of the Lord, and I speak of the Lord; I have discarded all other loves. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਮੋਰੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: manmohan moro preetam raam har paramaana(n)dh bairaagee ||
verses.translation: My Beloved is the Enticer of the mind; The Detached Lord God is the Embodiment of Supreme bliss.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਖੇ ਜੀਵਤ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਲੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੯॥੯॥੧੩॥੯॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: har dhekhe jeevat hai naanak ik nimakh palo mukh laagee ||2||2||9||9||13||9||31||
verses.translation: Nanak lives by gazing upon the Lord; may I see Him for a moment, for even just an instant. ||2||2||9||9||13||9||31||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag malaar mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਸੋਚਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਤੂ ਚਿਤਵਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa too socheh kiaa too chitaveh kiaa too(n) kareh upaae ||
verses.translation: What are you so worried about? What are you thinking? What have you tried?

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਜਿਹ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਸਹਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taa kau kahahu paravaeh kaahoo kee jeh gopaal sahaae ||1||
verses.translation: Tell me - the Lord of the Universe - who controls Him? ||1||

verses.original: ਬਰਸੈ ਮੇਘੁ ਸਖੀ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: barasai megh sakhee ghar paahun aae ||
verses.translation: The rain showers down from the clouds, O companion. The Guest has come into my home.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੀਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: moh dheen kirapaa nidh Thaakur nav nidh naam samaae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am meek; my Lord and Master is the Ocean of Mercy. I am absorbed in the nine treasures of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਭੋਜਨ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਏ ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਮਿਸਟਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: anik prakaar bhojan bahu ke'ee bahu bi(n)jan misaTaae ||
verses.translation: I have prepared all sorts of foods in various ways, and all sorts of sweet deserts.

verses.original: ਕਰੀ ਪਾਕਸਾਲ ਸੋਚ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਹੁਣਿ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਭੋਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: karee paakasaal soch pavitraa hun laavahu bhog har raae ||2||
verses.translation: I have made my kitchen pure and sacred. Now, O my Sovereign Lord King, please sample my food. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੁਸਟ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਰਹਸੇ ਇਹਿ ਮੰਦਿਰ ਘਰ ਅਪਨਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhusaT bidhaare saajan rahase ieh ma(n)dhir ghar apanaae ||
verses.translation: The villains have been destroyed, and my friends are delighted. This is Your Own Mansion and Temple, O Lord.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਰੰਗੀਓ ਆਇਆ ਤਉ ਮੈ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jau gireh laal ra(n)geeo aaiaa tau mai sabh sukh paae ||3||
verses.translation: When my Playful Beloved came into my household, then I found total peace. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਓਟ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sabhaa oT gur poore dhur masatak lekh likhaae ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, I have the Support and Protection of the Perfect Guru; this is the pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon my forehead.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਤੁ ਰੰਗੀਲਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ka(n)t ra(n)geelaa paiaa fir dhookh na laagai aae ||4||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has found his Playful Husband Lord. He shall never suffer in sorrow again. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਖੀਰ ਅਧਾਰਿ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਜਬ ਹੋਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਖੀਰੈ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kheer adhaar baarik jab hotaa bin kheerai rahan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: When the baby's only food is milk, it cannot survive without its milk.

verses.original: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨੀਰੈ ਤਬ ਓਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saar sam(h)aal maataa mukh neerai tab oh tirapat aghaiee ||1||
verses.translation: The mother takes care of it, and pours milk into its mouth; then, it is satisfied and fulfilled. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham baarik pitaa prabh dhaataa ||
verses.translation: I am just a baby; God, the Great Giver, is my Father.

verses.original: ਭੂਲਹਿ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਅਨਿਕ ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ ਅਨ ਠਉਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਹ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhooleh baarik anik lakh bareeaa an Thaur naahee jeh jaataa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The child is so foolish; it makes so many mistakes. But it has nowhere else to go. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚੰਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਪ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਰ ਮੇਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)chal mat baarik bapure kee sarap agan kar melai ||
verses.translation: The mind of the poor child is fickle; he touches even snakes and fire.

verses.original: ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਨਦ ਸਹਜਿ ਤਬ ਖੇਲੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maataa pitaa ka(n)Th lai raakhai anadh sahaj tab khelai ||2||
verses.translation: His mother and father hug him close in their embrace, and so he plays in joy and bliss. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਭੂਖ ਕੈਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jis kaa pitaa too hai mere suaamee tis baarik bhookh kaisee ||
verses.translation: What hunger can the child ever have, O my Lord and Master, when You are his Father?

verses.original: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਸੋ ਲੈਸੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nav nidh naam nidhaan gireh terai man baa(n)chhai so laisee ||3||
verses.translation: The treasure of the Naam and the nine treasures are in Your celestial household. You fulfill the desires of the mind. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਿਤਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਇਹ ਦੀਨੀ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਸੋ ਦੇਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: pitaa kirapaal aagiaa ieh dheenee baarik mukh maa(n)gai so dhenaa ||
verses.translation: My Merciful Father has issued this Command: whatever the child asks for, is put into his mouth.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਾਹੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak baarik dharas prabh chaahai moh hiradhai baseh nit charanaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: Nanak, the child, longs for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan. May His Feet always dwell within my heart. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧੀ ਜੁਰਿ ਆਹਰੁ ਕਰਿਆ ਤਜਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: sagal bidhee jur aahar kariaa tajio sagal a(n)dhesaa ||
verses.translation: I tried everything, and gathered all devices together; I have discarded all my anxieties.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਜੁ ਸਗਲ ਅਰੰਭਿਓ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਰੋਸਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaaraj sagal ara(n)bhio ghar kaa Thaakur kaa bhaarosaa ||1||
verses.translation: I have begun to set all my household affairs right; I have placed my faith in my Lord and Master. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਨੀਐ ਬਾਜੈ ਬਾਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ॥
verses.translit: suneeaai baajai baaj suhaavee ||
verses.translation: I listen to the celestial vibrations resonating and resounding.

verses.original: ਭੋਰੁ ਭਇਆ ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਮੁਖ ਪੇਖੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਹਲਾਵੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhor bhiaa mai pria mukh pekhe gireh ma(n)gal suhalaavee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Sunrise has come, and I gaze upon the Face of my Beloved. My household is filled with peace and pleasure. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨੂਆ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਥਾਨਾਂ ਪੂਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: manooaa lai savaare thaanaa(n) poochhau sa(n)taa jaae ||
verses.translation: I focus my mind, and embellish and adorn the place within; then I go out to speak with the Saints.

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੈ ਪਾਹੁਨ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਵਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat mai paahun milio bhagat karau niv paae ||2||
verses.translation: Seeking and searching, I have found my Husband Lord; I bow at His Feet and worship Him with devotion. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਆਇ ਬਸੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਸਨਿ ਤਬ ਹਮ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jab pria aai base gireh aasan tab ham ma(n)gal gaiaa ||
verses.translation: When my Beloved came to live in my house, I began to sing the songs of bliss.

verses.original: ਮੀਤ ਸਾਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਏ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: meet saajan mere bhe suhele prabh pooraa guroo milaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: My friends and companions are happy; God leads me to meet the Perfect Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਰਜ ਹਮਰੇ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sakhee sahelee bhe ana(n)dhaa gur kaaraj hamare poore ||
verses.translation: My friends and companions are in ecstasy; the Guru has completed all my projects.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਦੂਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak var miliaa sukhadhaataa chhodd na jaiee dhoore ||4||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have met my Husband, the Giver of peace; He shall never leave me and go away. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਕੀਟ ਕੀਟ ਤੇ ਸੁਰਪਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੋਖ ਜਠਰ ਕਉ ਭਰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: raaj te keeT keeT te surapat kar dhokh jaThar kau bharate ||
verses.translation: From a king to a worm, and from a worm to the lord of gods, they engage in evil to fill their bellies.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਆਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਜਹਿ ਆਤਮ ਘਾਤੀ ਹਰਤੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kirapaa nidh chhodd aan kau poojeh aatam ghaatee harate ||1||
verses.translation: They renounce the Lord, the Ocean of Mercy, and worship some other; they are thieves and killers of the soul. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇ ਦੁਖਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: har bisarat te dhukh dhukh marate ||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Lord, they suffer in sorrow and die.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਭ੍ਰਮਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਟੇਕ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਧਰਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anik baar bhrameh bahu jonee Tek na kaahoo dharate ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They wander lost in reincarnation through all sorts of species; they do not find shelter anywhere. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਨ ਕਉ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਖਲ ਖਰ ਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: tiaag suaamee aan kau chitavat mooR mugadh khal khar te ||
verses.translation: Those who abandon their Lord and Master and think of some other, are foolish, stupid, idiotic donkeys.

verses.original: ਕਾਗਰ ਨਾਵ ਲੰਘਹਿ ਕਤ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਕਥਤ ਹਮ ਤਰਤੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaagar naav la(n)gheh kat saagar birathaa kathat ham tarate ||2||
verses.translation: How can they cross over the ocean in a paper boat? Their eogtistical boasts that they will cross over are meaningless. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਿਵ ਬਿਰੰਚਿ ਅਸੁਰ ਸੁਰ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਾਲ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਰਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: siv bira(n)ch asur sur jete kaal agan meh jarate ||
verses.translation: Shiva, Brahma, angels and demons, all burn in the fire of death.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਨ ਕੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਨ ਡਾਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਤੇ ॥੩॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak saran charan kamalan kee tum(h) na ddaarahu prabh karate ||3||4||
verses.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord's Lotus Feet; O God, Creator, please do not send me into exile. ||3||4||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag malaar mahalaa panjavaa dhupadhe ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehla, Dho-Padhay, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਓਇ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh mere oi bairaagee tiaagee ||
verses.translation: My God is detached and free of desire.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau ik khin tis bin reh na sakau preet hamaaree laagee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I cannot survive without Him, even for an instant. I am so in love with Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਉਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: aun kai sa(n)g moh prabh chit aavai sa(n)t prasaadh moh jaagee ||
verses.translation: Associating with the Saints, God has come into my consciousness. By their Grace, I have been awakened.

verses.original: ਸੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਂਗੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sun upadhes bhe man niramal gun gaae ra(n)g raa(n)gee ||1||
verses.translation: Hearing the Teachings, my mind has become immaculate. Imbued with the Lord's Love, I sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਕੀਏ ਸੰਤ ਮੀਤਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਭਏ ਬਡਭਾਗਂੀ ॥
verses.translit: eih man dhei ke'ee sa(n)t meetaa kirapaal bhe baddabhaaga(n)ee ||
verses.translation: Dedicating this mind, I have made friends with the Saints. They have become merciful to me; I am very fortunate.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਰੇਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਪਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੫॥
verses.translit: mahaa sukh paiaa baran na saakau ren naanak jan paagee ||2||1||5||
verses.translation: I have found absolute peace - I cannot describe it. Nanak has obtained the dust of the feet of the humble. ||2||1||5||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: maiee moh preetam dheh milaiee ||
verses.translation: O mother, please lead me to union with my Beloved.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਸੁਖ ਭਰਿ ਸੂਤੀ ਜਿਹ ਘਰਿ ਲਾਲੁ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal sahelee sukh bhar sootee jeh ghar laal basaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: All my friends and companions sleep totally in peace; their Beloved Lord has come into the homes of their hearts. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਵਗਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨਿ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: moh avagan prabh sadhaa dhiaalaa moh niragun kiaa chaturaiee ||
verses.translation: I am worthless; God is forever Merciful. I am unworthy; what clever tricks could I try?

verses.original: ਕਰਉ ਬਰਾਬਰਿ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਂੀ ਇਹ ਹਉਮੈ ਕੀ ਢੀਠਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: karau baraabar jo pria sa(n)g raata(n)ee ieh haumai kee ddeeThaiee ||1||
verses.translation: I claim to be on a par with those who are imbued with the Love of their Beloved. This is my stubborn egotism. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਈ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਇਕ ਤਾਕੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhiee nimaanee saran ik taakee gur satigur purakh sukhadhaiee ||
verses.translation: I am dishonored - I seek the Sanctuary of the One, the Guru, the True Guru, the Primal Being, the Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਹਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਰੈਨਿ ਬਿਹਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੬॥
verses.translit: ek nimakh meh meraa sabh dhukh kaaTiaa naanak sukh rain bihaiee ||2||2||6||
verses.translation: In an instant, all my pains have been taken away; Nanak passes the night of his life in peace. ||2||2||6||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਰਸੁ ਮੇਘ ਜੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਲਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: baras megh jee til bilam na laau ||
verses.translation: Rain down, O cloud; do not delay.

verses.original: ਬਰਸੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਧਾਰੇ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: baras piaare maneh sadhaare hoi anadh sadhaa man chaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O beloved cloud, O support of the mind, you bring lasting bliss and joy to the mind. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਤੇਰੀ ਧਰ ਸੁਆਮੀਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਕਿਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ham teree dhar suaameeaa mere too kiau manahu bisaare ||
verses.translation: I take to Your Support, O my Lord and Master; how could You forget me?

verses.original: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਰੂਪ ਚੇਰੀ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਸੋਭ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eisatree roop cheree kee niaaiee sobh nahee bin bharataare ||1||
verses.translation: I am Your beautiful bride, Your servant and slave. I have no nobility without my Husband Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਿਓ ਜਬ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੈ ਬੇਗਿ ਆਇਓ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: binau sunio jab Thaakur merai beg aaio kirapaa dhaare ||
verses.translation: When my Lord and Master listened to my prayer, He hurried to shower me with His Mercy.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੋ ਬਨਿਓ ਸੁਹਾਗੋ ਪਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਭਲੇ ਅਚਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੭॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak mero banio suhaago pat sobhaa bhale achaare ||2||3||7||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have become just like my Husband Lord; I am blessed with honor, nobility and the lifestyle of goodness. ||2||3||7||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: preetam saachaa naam dhiaai ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the True Name of your Beloved.

verses.original: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhookh dharadh binasai bhav saagar gur kee moorat ridhai basai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The pains and sorrows of the terrifying world-ocean are dispelled, by enshrining the Image of the Guru within your heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਹਤੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਸਭਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhusaman hate dhokhee sabh viaape har saranaiee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Your enemies shall be destroyed, and all the evil-doers shall perish, when you come to the Sanctuary of the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raakhanahaarai haath dhe raakhio naam padhaarath paiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Savior Lord has given me His Hand and saved me; I have obtained the wealth of the Naam. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਟੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਨਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa kilavikh sabh kaaTe naam niramal man dheeaa ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, He has eradicated all my sins; He has placed the Immaculate Naam within my mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਥੀਆ ॥੨॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan naanak man vasiaa baahuR dhookh na theeaa ||2||4||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Treasure of Virtue fills my mind; I shall never again suffer in pain. ||2||4||8||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh mere preetam praan piaare ||
verses.translation: My Beloved God is the Lover of my breath of life.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਅਪਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: prem bhagat apano naam dheejai dhiaal anugrahu dhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with the loving devotional worship of the Naam, O Kind and Compassionate Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਚਰਨ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਿਦੈ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: simarau charan tuhaare preetam ridhai tuhaaree aasaa ||
verses.translation: I meditate in remembrance on Your Feet, O my Beloved; my heart is filled with hope.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa peh karau benatee man dharasan kee piaasaa ||1||
verses.translation: I offer my prayer to the humble Saints; my mind thirsts for the Blssed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਮਰਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਤੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: bichhurat maran jeevan har milate jan kau dharasan dheejai ||
verses.translation: Separation is death, and Union with the Lord is life. Please bless Your humble servant with Your Darshan.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਜੀਵਨ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੫॥੯॥
verses.translit: naam adhaar jeevan dhan naanak prabh mere kirapaa keejai ||2||5||9||
verses.translation: O my God, please be Merciful, and bless Nanak with the support, the life and wealth of the Naam. ||2||5||9||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਬ ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: ab apane preetam siau ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: Now, I have become just like my Beloved.

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਰਸੁ ਮੇਘ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raajaa raam ramat sukh paio baras megh sukhadhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Dwelling on my Sovereign Lord King, I have found peace. Rain down, O peace-giving cloud. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਪਲੁ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: eik pal bisarat nahee sukh saagar naam navai nidh paiee ||
verses.translation: I cannot forget Him, even for an instant; He is the Ocean of peace. Through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I have obtained the nine treasures.

verses.original: ਉਦੌਤੁ ਭਇਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਾਵੀ ਕੋ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: audhauat bhio pooran bhaavee ko bheTe sa(n)t sahaiee ||1||
verses.translation: My perfect destiny has been activated, meeting with the Saints, my help and support. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਉਪਜੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sukh upaje dhukh sagal binaase paarabraham liv laiee ||
verses.translation: Peace has welled up, and all pain has been dispelled, lovingly attuned to the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਤਰਿਓ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕਠਿਨ ਭੈ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਈ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: tario sa(n)saar kaThin bhai saagar har naanak charan dhiaaiee ||2||6||10||
verses.translation: The arduous and terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, O Nanak, by meditating on the Feet of the Lord. ||2||6||10||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਘਨਿਹਰ ਬਰਸਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਗੁ ਛਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ghanihar baras sagal jag chhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The clouds have rained down all over the world.

verses.original: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhe kirapaal preetam prabh mere anadh ma(n)gal sukh paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My Beloved Lord God has become merciful to me; I am blessed with ecstasy, bliss and peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਿਟੇ ਕਲੇਸ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਸਭ ਬੂਝੀ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: miTe kales tirasan sabh boojhee paarabraham man dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: My sorrows are erased, and all my thirsts are quenched, meditating on the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g janam maran nivaare bahur na katahoo dhaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, death and birth come to an end, and the mortal does not wander anywhere, ever again. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਰਾਤਉ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man tan naam nira(n)jan raatau charan kamal liv laiaa ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are imbued with the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord; I am lovingly attuned to His Lotus Feet.

verses.original: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਰਣਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)geekaar keeo prabh apanai naanak dhaas saranaiaa ||2||7||11||
verses.translation: God has made Nanak His Own; slave Nanak seeks His Sanctuary. ||2||7||11||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਕਿਉ ਜੀਵੇ ਓਇ ਜੀਵਨ ॥
verses.translit: bichhurat kiau jeeve oi jeevan ||
verses.translation: Separated from the Lord, how can any living being live?

verses.original: ਚਿਤਹਿ ਉਲਾਸ ਆਸ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਸ ਪੀਵਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chiteh ulaas aas milabe kee charan kamal ras peevan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My consciousness is filled with yearning and hope to meet my Lord, and drink in the sublime essence of His Lotus Feet. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਿਆਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau piaas tumaaree preetam tin kau a(n)tar naahee ||
verses.translation: Those who are thirsty for You, O my Beloved, are not separated from You.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਮੇਰੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਸੇ ਮੂਏ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਂਹੀਂ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin kau bisarai mero raam piaaraa se mooe mar jaa(n)hee(n) ||1||
verses.translation: Those who forget my Beloved Lord are dead and dying. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਪੇਖਤ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan rav rahiaa jagadheesur pekhat sadhaa hajoore ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is permeating and pervading my mind and body; I see Him Ever-present, here and now

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak rav rahio sabh a(n)tar sarab rahiaa bharapoore ||2||8||12||
verses.translation: . O Nanak, He is permeating the inner being of all; He is all-pervading everywhere. ||2||8||12||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਨਿ ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਨ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har kai bhajan kaun kaun na taare ||
verses.translation: Vibrating and meditating on the Lord, who has not been carried across?

verses.original: ਖਗ ਤਨ ਮੀਨ ਤਨ ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤਨ ਬਰਾਹ ਤਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: khag tan meen tan mirag tan baraeh tan saadhoo sa(n)g udhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those reborn into the body of a bird, the body of a fish, the body of a deer, and the body of a bull - in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, they are saved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੇਵ ਕੁਲ ਦੈਤ ਕੁਲ ਜਖੵ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਨਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhev kul dhait kul jakhaye ki(n)nar nar saagar utare paare ||
verses.translation: The families of gods, the families of demons, titans, celestial singers and human beings are carried across the ocean.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo jo bhajan karai saadhoo sa(n)g taa ke dhookh bidhaare ||1||
verses.translation: Whoever meditates and vibrates on the Lord in the Saadh Sangat - his pains are taken away. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਇਨ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh mahaa bikhiaa ras in te bhe niraare ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger and the pleasures of terrible corruption - he keeps away from these.

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਜਪਹਿ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal japeh karunaa mai naanak sadh balihaare ||2||9||13||
verses.translation: He meditates on the Lord, Merciful to the meek, the Embodiment of Compassion; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||9||13||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਜੁ ਮੈ ਬੈਸਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: aaj mai baisio har haaT ||
verses.translation: Today, I am seated in the Lord's store.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਸਾਝੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਂਉ ਨ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਘਾਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam raas saajhee kar jan siau jaa(n)au na jam kai ghaaT ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: With the wealth of the Lord, I have entered into partnership with the humble; I shall not have take the Highway of Death. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਖੁਲੇੑ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: dhaar anugrahu paarabraham raakhe bhram ke khule(h) kapaaT ||
verses.translation: Showering me with His Kindness, the Supreme Lord God has saved me; the doors of doubt have been opened wide.

verses.original: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਸਾਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਲਾਹਾ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਧਿ ਖਾਟ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: besumaar saahu prabh paiaa laahaa charan nidh khaaT ||1||
verses.translation: I have found God, the Banker of Infinity; I have earned the profit of the wealth of His Feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਢੇ ਹੈ ਛਾਂਟਿ ॥
verses.translit: saran gahee achut abinaasee kilabikh kaadde hai chhaa(n)T ||
verses.translation: I have grasped the protection of the Sanctuary of the Unchanging, Unmoving, Imperishable Lord; He has picked up my sins and thrown them out.

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਜੋਨੀ ਮਾਟ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: kal kales miTe dhaas naanak bahur na jonee maaT ||2||10||14||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak's sorrow and suffering has ended. He shall never again be squeezed into the mold of reincarnation. ||2||10||14||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਹਿਰਾਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: bahu bidh maiaa moh hiraano ||
verses.translation: In so many ways, attachment to Maya leads to ruin.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋਊ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਗਤੁ ਚਿਰਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT madhe kouoo biralaa sevak pooran bhagat chiraano ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Among millions, it is very rare to find a selfless servant who remains a perfect devotee for very long. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਡੋਲਿ ਡੋਲਿ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਤ ਬਿਰਾਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: eit ut ddol ddol sram paio tan dhan hot biraano ||
verses.translation: Roaming and wandering here and there, the mortal finds only trouble; his body and wealth become strangers to himself.

verses.original: ਲੋਗ ਦੁਰਾਇ ਕਰਤ ਠਗਿਆਈ ਹੋਤੌ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: log dhurai karat Thagiaaiee hotau sa(n)g na jaano ||1||
verses.translation: Hiding from people, he practices deception; he does not know the One who is always with him. ||1||

verses.original: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਪੰਖੀ ਮੀਨ ਦੀਨ ਨੀਚ ਇਹ ਸੰਕਟ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: mirag pa(n)khee meen dheen neech ieh sa(n)kaT fir aano ||
verses.translation: He wanders through troubled incarnations of low and wretched species as a deer, a bird and a fish.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਹਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak paahan prabh taarahu saadhasa(n)gat sukh maano ||2||11||15||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, O God, I am a stone - please carry me across, that I may enjoy peace in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||11||15||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੁਸਟ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhusaT mue bikh khaiee ree maiee ||
verses.translation: The cruel and evil ones died after taking poison, O mother.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis ke jeea tin hee rakh leene mere prabh kau kirapaa aaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: And the One, to whom all creatures belong, has saved us. God has granted His Grace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤੈ ਤਾਂ ਭਉ ਕੈਸਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tarajaamee sabh meh varatai taa(n) bhau kaisaa bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is contained within all; why should I be afraid, O Siblings of Destiny?

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭਨੀ ਠਾੲਂੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g sahaiee chhodd na jaiee prabh dheesai sabhanee Thaae(n)ee ||1||
verses.translation: God, my Help and Support, is always with me. He shall never leave; I see Him everywhere. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: anaathaa naath dheen dhukh bha(n)jan aap le'ee laR laiee ||
verses.translation: He is the Master of the masterless, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor; He has attached me to the hem of His robe.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: har kee oT jeeveh dhaas tere naanak prabh saranaiee ||2||12||16||
verses.translation: O Lord, Your slaves live by Your Support; Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of God. ||2||12||16||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: man mere har ke charan raveejai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, dwell on the Feet of the Lord.

verses.original: ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਪੰਖ ਲਗਾਇ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharas piaas mero man mohio har pa(n)kh lagai mileejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind is enticed by thirst for the Blessed Vision of the Lord; I would take wings and fly out to meet Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat maarag paio saadhoo sev kareejai ||
verses.translation: Searching and seeking, I have found the Path, and now I serve the Holy.

verses.original: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhaar anugrahu suaamee mere naam mahaa ras peejai ||1||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, please be kind to me, that I may drink in Your most sublime essence. ||1||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਰਨੀ ਆਏ ਜਲਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: traeh traeh kar saranee aae jalatau kirapaa keejai ||
verses.translation: Begging and pleading, I have come to Your Sanctuary; I am on fire - please shower me with Your Mercy!

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: kar geh leh dhaas apune kau naanak apuno keejai ||2||13||17||
verses.translation: Please give me Your Hand - I am Your slave, O Lord. Please make Nanak Your Own. ||2||13||17||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੋ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲੁ ਬਿਰਦਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: prabh ko bhagat bachhal biradhaio ||
verses.translation: It is God's Nature to love His devotees.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਮਾਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਤਲ ਦੀਨੇ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਜਸੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak maar charan tal dheene apuno jas varataio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He destroys the slanderers, crushing them beneath His Feet. His Glory is manifest everywhere. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਦਇਆ ਜੀਅਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: jai jai kaar keeno sabh jag meh dhiaa jeean meh paio ||
verses.translation: His Victory is celebrated all throughout the world. He blesses all creatures with compassion.

verses.original: ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਦਾਸੁ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਤਾਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ka(n)Th lai apuno dhaas raakhio taatee vaau na laio ||1||
verses.translation: Hugging him close in His Embrace, the Lord saves and protects His slave. The hot winds cannot even touch him. ||1||

verses.original: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮੇਟਿ ਸੁਖਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)geekaar keeo mere suaamee bhram bhau meT sukhaio ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master has made me His Own; dispelling my doubts and fears, He has made me happy.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਸ੍ਵਾਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਆਇਓ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: mahaa ana(n)dh karahu dhaas har ke naanak bisavaiaas man aaio ||2||14||18||
verses.translation: The Lord's slaves enjoy ultimate ecstasy; O Nanak, faith has welled up in my mind. ||2||14||18||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: raag malaar mahalaa panjavaa chaupadhe ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehla, Chau-Padhay, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਸੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh dheesai braham pasaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh sees God pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣੀਆਂ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh trai guneeaa(n) bisathaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh knows that the universe is the extension of the three gunas, the three dispositions.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦ ਬੇਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naadh bedh beechaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh reflects on the Sound-current of the Naad, and the wisdom of the Vedas.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin gur poore ghor a(n)dhaar ||1||
verses.translation: Without the Perfect Guru, there is only pitch-black darkness. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: mere man gur gur karat sadhaa sukh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, calling on the Guru, eternal peace is found.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਿਓ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur upadhes har hiradhai vasio saas giraas apanaa khasam dhiaaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord comes to dwell within the heart; I meditate on my Lord and Master with every breath and morsel of food. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan viTahu bal jaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Guru's Feet.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke gun anadhin nit gaau ||
verses.translation: Night and day, I continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਧੂੜਿ ਕਰਉ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee dhooR karau isanaan ||
verses.translation: I take my cleansing bath in the dust of the Guru's Feet.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saachee dharageh paieeaai maan ||2||
verses.translation: I am honored in the True Court of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur bohith bhavajal taaranahaar ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the boat, to carry me across the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਜੋਨਿ ਅਉਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur bheTiaai na hoi jon aautaar ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, I shall not be reincarnated ever again.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee sevaa so jan paae ||
verses.translation: That humble being serves the Guru,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਆਏ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa kau karam likhiaa dhur aae ||3||
verses.translation: who has such karma inscribed on his forehead by the Primal Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਜੀਵਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur meree jeevan gur aadhaar ||
verses.translation: The Guru is my life; the Guru is my support.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur meree varatan gur paravaar ||
verses.translation: The Guru is my way of life; the Guru is my family.
