verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur meraa khasam satigur saranaiee ||
verses.translation: The Guru is my Lord and Master; I seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: naanak gur paarabraham jaa kee keem na paiee ||4||1||19||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Guru is the Supreme Lord God; His value cannot be estimated. ||4||1||19||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke charan hiradhai vasaae ||
verses.translation: I enshrine the Lord's Feet within my heart;

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh aap milaae ||
verses.translation: in His Mercy, God has united me with Himself.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: apane sevak kau le prabh lai ||
verses.translation: God enjoins His servant to his tasks.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taa kee keemat kahee na jai ||1||
verses.translation: His worth cannot be expressed. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa pooran sukhadhaate ||
verses.translation: Please be merciful to me, O Perfect Giver of peace.

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਤੂੰ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ree kirapaa te too(n) chit aaveh aaTh pahar terai ra(n)g raate ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, You come to mind; I am imbued with Your Love, twenty-four hours a day. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗਾਵਣੁ ਸੁਨਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: gaavan sunan sabh teraa bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Singing and listening, it is all by Your Will.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: hukam boojhai so saach samaanaa ||
verses.translation: One who understands the Hukam of Your Command is absorbed in Truth.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਂਉ ॥
verses.translit: jap jap jeeveh teraa naa(n)au ||
verses.translation: Chanting and meditating on Your Name, I live.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tujh bin dhoojaa naahee thaau ||2||
verses.translation: Without You, there is no place at all. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਤੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh karate hukam rajai ||
verses.translation: Pain and pleasure come by Your Command, O Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਭਾਣੈ ਬਖਸ ਭਾਣੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhaanai bakhas bhaanai dhei sajai ||
verses.translation: By the Pleasure of Your Will You forgive, and by the Pleasure of Your Will You award punishment.

verses.original: ਦੁਹਾਂ ਸਿਰਿਆਂ ਕਾ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhuhaa(n) siriaa(n) kaa karataa aap ||
verses.translation: You are the Creator of both realms.

verses.original: ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ਜਾਂਈ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kurabaan jaa(n)iee tere parataap ||3||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to Your Glorious Grandeur. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: teree keemat toohai jaaneh ||
verses.translation: You alone know Your value.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: too aape boojheh sun aap vakhaaneh ||
verses.translation: You alone understand, You Yourself speak and listen.

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: seiee bhagat jo tudh bhaane ||
verses.translation: They alone are devotees, who are pleasing to Your Will.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: naanak tin kai sadh kurabaane ||4||2||20||
verses.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||2||20||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: paramesar hoaa dhiaal ||
verses.translation: The Transcendent Lord God has become merciful;

verses.original: ਮੇਘੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: megh varasai a(n)mirat dhaar ||
verses.translation: Ambrosial Nectar is raining down from the clouds.

verses.original: ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: sagale jeea ja(n)t tirapataase ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures are satisfied;

verses.original: ਕਾਰਜ ਆਏ ਪੂਰੇ ਰਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaaraj aae poore raase ||1||
verses.translation: their affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa man naam sam(h)aal ||
verses.translation: O my mind, dwell on the Lord, forever and ever.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore kee sevaa paiaa aaithai othai nibahai naal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Serving the Perfect Guru, I have obtained it. It shall stay with me both here and hereafter. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਭੰਨਾ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh bha(n)naa bhai bha(n)janahaar ||
verses.translation: He is the Destroyer of pain, the Eradicator of fear.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਿਆ ਜੀਆ ਕੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aapaniaa jeeaa kee keetee saar ||
verses.translation: He takes care of His beings.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਸਦਾ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: raakhanahaar sadhaa miharavaan ||
verses.translation: The Savior Lord is kind and compassionate forever.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਈਐ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa jaieeaai kurabaan ||2||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to Him, forever and ever. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaal gavaiaa karatai aap ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself has eliminated death.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa man tis no jaap ||
verses.translation: Meditate on Him forever and ever, O my mind.

verses.original: ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸਭਿ ਜੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: dhirasaT dhaar raakhe sabh ja(n)t ||
verses.translation: He watches all with His Glance of Grace and protects them.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gun gaavahu nit nit bhagava(n)t ||3||
verses.translation: Continually and continuously, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord God. ||3||

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਆਪ ॥
verses.translit: eko karataa aape aap ||
verses.translation: The One and Only Creator Lord is Himself by Himself.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਪਰਤਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: har ke bhagat jaaneh parataap ||
verses.translation: The Lord's devotees know His Glorious Grandeur.

verses.original: ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naavai kee paij rakhadhaa aaiaa ||
verses.translation: He preserves the Honor of His Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਬੋਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bolai tis kaa bolaiaa ||4||3||21||
verses.translation: Nanak speaks as the Lord inspires him to speak. ||4||3||21||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: gur saranaiee sagal nidhaan ||
verses.translation: All treasures are found in the Sanctuary of the Guru.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: saachee dharageh paieeaai maan ||
verses.translation: Honor is obtained in the True Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhram bhau dhookh dharadh sabh jai ||
verses.translation: Doubt, fear, pain and suffering are taken away,

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਦ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g sadh har gun gai ||1||
verses.translation: forever singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: man mere gur pooraa saalaeh ||
verses.translation: O my mind, praise the Perfect Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam nidhaan japahu dhin raatee man chi(n)dhe fal pai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chant the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night. You shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur jevadd avar na koi ||
verses.translation: No one else is as great as the True Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur paarabraham paramesar soi ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੂਖ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhookh te raakhai ||
verses.translation: He saves us from the pains of death and birth,

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maiaa bikh fir bahuR na chaakhai ||2||
verses.translation: and we will not have to taste the poison of Maya ever again. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee mahimaa kathan na jai ||
verses.translation: The Guru's glorious grandeur cannot be described.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur paramesar saachai nai ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, in the True Name.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਚੀ ॥
verses.translit: sach sa(n)jam karanee sabh saachee ||
verses.translation: True is His self-discipline, and True are all His actions.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: so man niramal jo gur sa(n)g raachee ||3||
verses.translation: Immaculate and pure is that mind, which is imbued with love for the Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡ ਭਾਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa paieeaai vadd bhaag ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru is obtained by great good fortune.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh man te tiaag ||
verses.translation: Drive out sexual desire, anger and greed from your mind.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਵਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa gur charan nivaas ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, the Guru's Feet are enshrined within.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਚੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kee prabh sach aradhaas ||4||4||22||
verses.translation: Nanak offers his prayer to the True Lord God. ||4||4||22||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: raag malaar mahalaa panjavaa paRataal ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Raag Malaar, Fifth Mehla, Partaal, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਨਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਦਇਆਰ ਸਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur manaar pria dhiaar siau ra(n)g keeaa ||
verses.translation: Pleasing the Guru, I have fallen in love with my Merciful Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਕੀਨੋ ਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਸਂੀਗਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: keeno ree sagal sa(n)eegaar ||
verses.translation: I have made all my decorations,

verses.original: ਤਜਿਓ ਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: tajio ree sagal bikaar ||
verses.translation: and renounced all corruption;

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤੋ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhaavato asathir theeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: my wandering mind has become steady and stable. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਨ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: aaise re man pai kai aap gavai kai kar saadhan siau sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: O my mind, lose your self-conceit by associating with the Holy, and you shall find Him.

verses.original: ਬਾਜੇ ਬਜਹਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਕੋਕਿਲ ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਮਧੁਰ ਬੈਨ ਅਤਿ ਸੁਹੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: baaje bajeh miradha(n)g anaahadh kokil ree raam naam bolai madhur bain at suheeaa ||1||
verses.translation: The unstruck celestial melody vibrates and resounds; like a song-bird, chant the Lord's Name, with words of sweetness and utter beauty. ||1||

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਅਮੋਘ ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਤ ਬਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee tere dharasan kee sobh at apaar pria amogh taise hee sa(n)g sa(n)t bane ||
verses.translation: Such is the glory of Your Darshan, so utterly inifinte and fruitful, O my Love; so do we become by associating with the Saints.

verses.original: ਭਵ ਉਤਾਰ ਨਾਮ ਭਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhav utaar naam bhane ||
verses.translation: Vibrating, chanting Your Name, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਰਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਮਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: ram raam raam maal ||
verses.translation: They dwell on the Lord, Raam, Raam, chanting on their malas;

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਫੇਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੰਗੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: man ferate har sa(n)g sa(n)geeaa ||
verses.translation: their minds are turned towards the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਥੀਆ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak priau preetam theeaa ||2||1||23||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, their Beloved Lord seems so sweet to them. ||2||1||23||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਘਨੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੈ ਬਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: man ghanai bhramai banai ||
verses.translation: My mind wanders through the dense forest.

verses.original: ਉਮਕਿ ਤਰਸਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: aumak taras chaalai ||
verses.translation: It walks with eagerness and love,

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਕੀ ਚਾਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabh milabe kee chaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: hoping to meet God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨ ਮਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਈ ਕਹੰਉ ਬੇਦਨ ਕਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: trai gun maiee moh aaiee kaha(n)au bedhan kaeh ||1||
verses.translation: Maya with her three gunas - the three dispositions - has come to entice me; whom can I tell of my pain? ||1||

verses.original: ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਗਰ ਕੀਏ ਨਹਿ ਦੂਖ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: aan upaav sagar ke'ee neh dhookh saakeh laeh ||
verses.translation: I tried everything else, but nothing could rid me of my sorrow.

verses.original: ਭਜੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਿਲੁ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: bhaj saran saadhoo naanakaa mil gun gobi(n)dheh gaeh ||2||2||24||
verses.translation: So hurry to the Sanctuary of the Holy, O Nanak; joining them, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||2||2||24||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੀ ਸੋਭ ਸੁਹਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: pria kee sobh suhaavanee neekee ||
verses.translation: The glory of my Beloved is noble and sublime.

verses.original: ਹਾਹਾ ਹੂਹੂ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਅਪਸਰਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਗਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: haahaa hoohoo ga(n)dhrab apasaraa ana(n)dh ma(n)gal ras gaavanee neekee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The celestial singers and angels sing His Sublime Praises in ecstasy, happiness and joy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧੁਨਿਤ ਲਲਿਤ ਗੁਨਗੵ ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhunit lalit gunagaye anik bhaa(n)t bahu bidh roop dhikhaavanee neekee ||1||
verses.translation: The most worthy beings sing God's Praises in beautiful harmonies, in all sorts of ways, in myriads of sublime forms. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਥਲ ਜਲ ਭਵਨ ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਲਾਲਨ ਛਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥
verses.translit: gir tar thal jal bhavan bharapur ghaT ghaT laalan chhaavanee neekee ||
verses.translation: Throughout the mountains, trees, deserts, oceans and galaxies, permeating each and every heart, the sublime grandeur of my Love is totally pervading.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g raamieeaa ras paio naanak jaa kai bhaavanee neekee ||2||3||25||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Love of the Lord is found; O Nanak, sublime is that faith. ||2||3||25||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur preet piaare charan kamal ridh a(n)tar dhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: With love for the Guru, I enshrine the Lotus Feet of my Lord deep within my heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਰਸੁ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਗਏ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗਏ ॥
verses.translit: dharas safalio dharas pekhio ge kilabikh ge ||
verses.translation: I gaze on the Blessed Vision of His Fruitful Darshan; my sins are erased and taken away.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਉਜੀਆਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man niramal ujeeaare ||1||
verses.translation: My mind is immaculate and enlightened. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸਮੈ ਬਿਸਮ ਭਈ ॥
verses.translit: bisam bisamai bisam bhiee ||
verses.translation: I am wonderstruck, stunned and amazed.

verses.original: ਅਘ ਕੋਟਿ ਹਰਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਲਈ ॥
verses.translit: agh koT harate naam liee ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, millions of sins are destroyed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਡਾਰਿ ਪਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur charan masatak ddaar pahee ||
verses.translation: I fall at His Feet, and touch my forehead to them.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਏਕ ਤੂੰਹੀ ਏਕ ਤੁਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: prabh ek too(n)hee ek tuhee ||
verses.translation: You alone are, You alone are, O God.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਟੇਕ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat Tek tuhaare ||
verses.translation: Your devotees take Your Support.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak saran dhuaare ||2||4||26||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has come to the Door of Your Sanctuary. ||2||4||26||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਰਸੁ ਸਰਸੁ ਆਗਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: baras saras aagiaa ||
verses.translation: Rain down with happiness in God's Will.

verses.original: ਹੋਹਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਸਗਲ ਭਾਗ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hoh aana(n)dh sagal bhaag ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Bless me with total bliss and good fortune. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਫੜੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੇਘ ਧਰ ਸੁਹਾਗ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t sa(n)ge man parafaRai mil megh dhar suhaag ||1||
verses.translation: My mind blossoms forth in the Society of the Saints; soaking up the rain, the earth is blessed and beautified. ||1||

verses.original: ਘਨਘੋਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: ghanaghor preet mor ||
verses.translation: The peacock loves the thunder of the rain clouds.

verses.original: ਚਿਤੁ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਓਰ ॥
verses.translit: chit chaatirak boo(n)dh or ||
verses.translation: The rainbird's mind is drawn to the rain-drop

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗੇ ਮਨ ਮੋਹ ॥
verses.translit: aaiso har sa(n)ge man moh ||
verses.translation: - so is my mind enticed by the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੋਹ ॥
verses.translit: tiaag maiaa dhoh ||
verses.translation: I have renounced Maya, the deceiver.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਗਿਆ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: mil sa(n)t naanak jaagiaa ||2||5||27||
verses.translation: Joining with the Saints, Nanak is awakened. ||2||5||27||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਗਾਉ ਨੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: gun guopaal gaau neet ||
verses.translation: Sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਾਰਿ ਚੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhaar cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Enshrine the Lord's Name in your consciousness. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਜਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: chhodd maan taj gumaan mil saadhooaa kai sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: Forsake your pride, and abandon your ego; join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਦੋਖ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har simar ek ra(n)g miT jaa(n)h dhokh meet ||1||
verses.translation: Meditate in loving remembrance on the One Lord; your sorrows shall be ended, O friend. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham bhe dhiaal ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God has become merciful;

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਬਿਖੈ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: binas ge bikhai ja(n)jaal ||
verses.translation: corrupt entanglements have come to an end.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੈ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: saadh janaa(n) kai charan laag ||
verses.translation: Grasping the feet of the Holy,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨੀਤ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: naanak gaavai gobi(n)dh neet ||2||6||28||
verses.translation: Nanak sings forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World. ||2||6||28||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਘਨੁ ਗਰਜਤ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰੂਪ ॥
verses.translit: ghan garajat gobi(n)dh roop ||
verses.translation: The Embodiment of the Lord of the Universe roars like the thunder-cloud.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਸੁਖ ਚੈਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavat sukh chain ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Singing His Glorious Praises brings peace and bliss. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਸਾਗਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਤਾ ਰਸ ਬੈਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har charan saran taran saagar dhun anahataa ras bain ||1||
verses.translation: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet carries us across the world-ocean. His Sublime Word is the unstruck celestial melody. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਥਿਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਚਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਆਤਮ ਜਲੁ ਲੈਨ ॥
verses.translit: pathik piaas chit sarovar aatam jal lain ||
verses.translation: The thirsty traveller's consciousness obtains the water of the soul from the pool of nectar.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੈਨ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: har dharas prem jan naanak kar kirapaa prabh dhain ||2||7||29||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak loves the Blessed Vision of the Lord; in His Mercy, God has blessed him with it. ||2||7||29||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਹੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਲਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: he gobi(n)dh he gopaal he dhiaal laal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord of the Universe, O Lord of the World, O Dear Merciful Beloved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਸਖੇ ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: praan naath anaath sakhe dheen dharadh nivaar ||1||
verses.translation: You are the Master of the breath of life, the Companion of the lost and forsaken, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor. ||1||

verses.original: ਹੇ ਸਮ੍ਰਥ ਅਗਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: he samrath agam pooran moh miaa dhaar ||2||
verses.translation: O All-powerful, Inaccessible, Perfect Lord, please shower me with Your Mercy. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰ ॥੩॥੮॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop mahaa bhiaan naanak paar utaar ||3||8||30||
verses.translation: Please, carry Nanak across the terrible, deep dark pit of the world to the other side. ||3||8||30||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa pehilaa asaTapadheeaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Malaar, First Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਚਕਵੀ ਨੈਨ ਨਂੀਦ ਨਹਿ ਚਾਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਨਂੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: chakavee nain na(n)eedh neh chaahai bin pir na(n)eedh na paiee ||
verses.translation: The chakvi bird does not long for sleepy eyes; without her beloved, she does not sleep.

verses.original: ਸੂਰੁ ਚਰ੍ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਨੈਨੀ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਾਂਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: soor charhai priau dhekhai nainee niv niv laagai paa(n)iee ||1||
verses.translation: When the sun rises, she sees her beloved with her eyes; she bows and touches his feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: pir bhaavai prem sakhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Love of my Beloved is pleasing; it is my Companion and Support.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ ਨਹੀ ਜਗਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਐਸੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਤਿਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin ghaRee nahee jag jeevaa aaisee piaas tisaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without Him, I cannot live in this world even for an instant; such is my hunger and thirst. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਰਵਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: saravar kamal kiran aakaasee bigasai sahaj subhaiee ||
verses.translation: The lotus in the pool blossoms forth intuitively and naturally, with the rays of the sun in the sky.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਅਭ ਐਸੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: preetam preet banee abh aaisee jotee jot milaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Such is the love for my Beloved which imbues me; my light has merged into the Light. ||2||

verses.original: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਟੇਰੈ ਬਿਲਪ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: chaatirak jal bin priau priau Terai bilap karai bilalaiee ||
verses.translation: Without water, the rainbird cries out, ""Pri-o! Pri-o! - Beloved! Beloved!"" It cries and wails and laments.

verses.original: ਘਨਹਰ ਘੋਰ ਦਸੌ ਦਿਸਿ ਬਰਸੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ghanahar ghor dhasau dhis barasai bin jal piaas na jaiee ||3||
verses.translation: The thundering clouds rain down in the ten directions; its thirst is not quenched until it catches the rain-drop in its mouth. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੀਨ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: meen nivaas upajai jal hee te sukh dhukh purab kamaiee ||
verses.translation: The fish lives in water, from which it was born. It finds peace and pleasure according to its past actions.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਪਲੁ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਾਂਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: khin til reh na sakai pal jal bin maran jeevan tis taa(n)iee ||4||
verses.translation: It cannot survive without water for a moment, even for an instant. Life and death depend on it. ||4||

verses.original: ਧਨ ਵਾਂਢੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਸ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਠਾੲਂੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhan vaa(n)ddee pir dhes nivaasee sache gur peh sabadh paThaae(n)ee ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride is separated from her Husband Lord, who lives in His Own Country. He sends the Shabad, His Word, through the True Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੀ ਹਰਖਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gun sa(n)greh prabh ridhai nivaasee bhagat ratee harakhaiee ||5||
verses.translation: She gathers virtues, and enshrines God within her heart. Imbued with devotion, she is happy. ||5||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੈ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪਾੲਂੀ ॥
verses.translit: priau priau karai sabhai hai jetee gur bhaavai priau paae(n)ee ||
verses.translation: Everyone cries out, ""Beloved! Beloved!"" But she alone finds her Beloved, who is pleasing to the Guru.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਨਾਲੇ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਸੰਗੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: priau naale sadh hee sach sa(n)ge nadharee mel milaiee ||6||
verses.translation: Our Beloved is always with us; through the Truth, He blesses us with His Grace, and unites us in His Union. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜੀਉ ਜੀਉ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh jeeau jeeau hai soiee ghaT ghaT rahiaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: He is the life of the soul in each and every soul; He permeates and pervades each and every heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh ghar hee paragaasiaa sahaje sahaj samaiee ||7||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, He is revealed within the home of my heart; I am intuitively, naturally, absorbed into Him. ||7||

verses.original: ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਜੁ ਸਵਾਰਹੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਗੋਸਾਂੲਂੀ ॥
verses.translit: apanaa kaaj savaarahu aape sukhadhaate gosaa(n)e(n)ee ||
verses.translation: He Himself shall resolve all your affairs, when you meet with the Giver of peace, the Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh ghar hee pir paiaa tau naanak tapat bujhaiee ||8||1||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, you shall find your Husband Lord within your own home; then, O Nanak, the fire within you shall be quenched. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾਗਤੁ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੈ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaagat jaag rahai gur sevaa bin har mai ko naahee ||
verses.translation: Remain awake and aware, serving the Guru; except for the Lord, no one is mine.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਚੁ ਕਾਚੁ ਢਰਿ ਪਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anik jatan kar rahan na paavai aach kaach ddar paa(n)hee ||1||
verses.translation: Even by making all sorts of efforts, you shall not remain here; it shall melt like glass in the fire. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਕੈਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: eis tan dhan kaa kahahu garab kaisaa ||
verses.translation: Tell me - why are you so proud of your body and wealth?

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਵਰੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬਿ ਖਪੈ ਜਗੁ ਐਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: binasat baar na laagai bavare haumai garab khapai jag aaisaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They shall vanish in an instant; O madman, this is how the world is wasting away, in egotism and pride. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਪਰਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jai jagadhees prabhoo rakhavaare raakhai parakhai soiee ||
verses.translation: Hail to the Lord of the Universe, God, our Saving Grace; He judges and saves the mortal beings.

verses.original: ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jetee hai tetee tujh hee te tum(h) sar avar na koiee ||2||
verses.translation: All that is, belongs to You. No one else is equal to You. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਜਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeea upai jugat vas keenee aape gurmukh a(n)jan ||
verses.translation: Creating all beings and creatures, their ways and means are under Your control; You bless the Gurmukhs with the ointment of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਅਮਰੁ ਅਨਾਥ ਸਰਬ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੋਰਾ ਕਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਲ ਭਰਮ ਭੈ ਖੰਜਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: amar anaath sarab sir moraa kaal bikaal bharam bhai kha(n)jan ||3||
verses.translation: My Eternal, Unmastered Lord is over the heads of all. He is the Destroyer of death and rebirth, doubt and fear. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਗਦ ਕੋਟੁ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਬਪੁਰੋ ਰੰਗਨਿ ਚਿਹਨ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaagadh koT ih jag hai bapuro ra(n)gan chihan chaturaiee ||
verses.translation: This wretched world is a fortress of paper, of color and form and clever tricks.

verses.original: ਨਾਨੑੀ ਸੀ ਬੂੰਦ ਪਵਨੁ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਵੈ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਾੲਂੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naan(h)ee see boo(n)dh pavan pat khovai janam marai khin taae(n)ee ||4||
verses.translation: A tiny drop of water or a little puff of wind destroys its glory; in an instant, its life is ended. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਦੀ ਉਪਕੰਠਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਘਰੁ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: nadhee upaka(n)Th jaise ghar taravar sarapan ghar ghar maahee ||
verses.translation: It is like a tree-house near the bank of a river, with a serpent's den in that house.

verses.original: ਉਲਟੀ ਨਦੀ ਕਹਾਂ ਘਰੁ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਸਰਪਨਿ ਡਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: aulaTee nadhee kahaa(n) ghar taravar sarapan ddasai dhoojaa man maa(n)hee ||5||
verses.translation: When the river overflows, what happens to the tree house? The snake bites, like duality in the mind. ||5||

verses.original: ਗਾਰੁੜ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: gaaruR gur giaan dhiaan gur bachanee bikhiaa gurmat jaaree ||
verses.translation: Through the magic spell of the Guru's spiritual wisdom, and meditation on the Word of the Guru's Teachings, vice and corruption are burnt away.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤਨ ਹੇਂਵ ਭਏ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: man tan he(n)v bhe sach paiaa har kee bhagat niraaree ||6||
verses.translation: The mind and body are cooled and soothed and Truth is obtained, through the wondrous and unique devotional worship of the Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ ਤੇਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆਂ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jetee hai tetee tudh jaachai too sarab jeeaa(n) dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: All that exists begs of You; You are merciful to all beings.

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ree saran pare pat raakhahu saach milai gopaalaa ||7||
verses.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary; please save my honor, O Lord of the World, and bless me with Truth. ||7||

verses.original: ਬਾਧੀ ਧੰਧਿ ਅੰਧ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ਬਧਿਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: baadhee dha(n)dh a(n)dh nahee soojhai badhik karam kamaavai ||
verses.translation: Bound in worldly affairs and entanglements, the blind one does not understand; he acts like a murderous butcher.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਬੂਝਸਿ ਸਚ ਮਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta soojhas boojhas sach man giaan samaavai ||8||
verses.translation: But if he meets with the True Guru, then he comprehends and understands, and his mind is imbued with true spiritual wisdom. ||8||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਦੇਹ ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਾਚੀ ਮੈ ਪੂਛਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: niragun dheh saach bin kaachee mai poochhau gur apanaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Truth, this worthless body is false; I have consulted my Guru on this.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੯॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak so prabh prabhoo dhikhaavai bin saache jag supanaa ||9||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that God has revealed God to me; without the Truth, all the world is just a dream. ||9||2||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੀਨ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chaatirak meen jal hee te sukh paaveh saari(n)g sabadh suhaiee ||1||
verses.translation: The rainbird and the fish find peace in water; the deer is pleased by the sound of the bell. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੈਨਿ ਬਬੀਹਾ ਬੋਲਿਓ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rain babeehaa bolio meree maiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The rainbird chirps in the night, O my mother. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਉਲਟੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਜੋ ਤੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pria siau preet na ulaTai kabahoo jo tai bhaavai saiee ||2||
verses.translation: O my Beloved, my love for You shall never end, if it is Your Will. ||2||

verses.original: ਨੀਦ ਗਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਥਾਕੀ ਸਚ ਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: needh giee haumai tan thaakee sach mat ridhai samaiee ||3||
verses.translation: Sleep is gone, and egotism is exhausted from my body; my heart is permeated with the Teachings of Truth. ||3||

verses.original: ਰੂਖਂੀ ਬਿਰਖਂੀ ਊਡਉ ਭੂਖਾ ਪੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: rookha(n)ee birakha(n)ee uooddau bhookhaa peevaa naam subhaiee ||4||
verses.translation: Flying among the trees and plants, I remain hungry; lovingly drinking in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I am satisfied. ||4||

verses.original: ਲੋਚਨ ਤਾਰ ਲਲਤਾ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: lochan taar lalataa bilalaatee dharasan piaas rajaiee ||5||
verses.translation: I stare at You, and my tongue cries out to You; I am so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||5||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੀ ਤੇਤਾ ਤਨੁ ਤਾਪੈ ਕਾਪਰੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਨ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: pria bin seegaar karee tetaa tan taapai kaapar a(n)g na suhaiee ||6||
verses.translation: Without my Beloved, the more I decorate myself, the more my body burns; these clothes do not look good on my body. ||6||

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਂਉ ਬਿਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਂੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: apane piaare bin ik khin reh na saka(n)au bin mile na(n)eedh na paiee ||7||
verses.translation: Without my Beloved, I cannot survive even for an instant; without meeting Him, I cannot sleep. ||7||

verses.original: ਪਿਰੁ ਨਜੀਕਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਪੁੜੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: pir najeek na boojhai bapuRee satigur dheeaa dhikhaiee ||8||
verses.translation: Her Husband Lord is nearby, but the wretched bride does not know it. The True Guru reveals Him to her. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: sahaj miliaa tab hee sukh paiaa tirasanaa sabadh bujhaiee ||9||
verses.translation: When she meets Him with intuitive ease, she finds peace; the Word of the Shabad quenches the fire of desire. ||9||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੦॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tujh te man maaniaa keemat kahan na jaiee ||10||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, through You, O Lord, my mind is pleased and appeased; I cannot express Your worth. ||10||3||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa pehilaa asaTapadheeaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Malaar, First Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਅਖਲੀ ਊਂਡੀ ਜਲੁ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: akhalee uoo(n)ddee jal bhar naal ||
verses.translation: The earth bends under the weight of the water,

verses.original: ਡੂਗਰੁ ਊਚਉ ਗੜੁ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: ddoogar uoochau gaR paataal ||
verses.translation: the lofty mountains and the caverns of the underworld.

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saagar seetal gur sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: Contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the oceans become calm.

verses.original: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maarag mukataa haumai maar ||1||
verses.translation: The path of liberation is found by subduing the ego. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: mai a(n)dhule naavai kee jot ||
verses.translation: I am blind; I seek the Light of the Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ਚਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਭੇਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam adhaar chalaa gur kai bhai bhet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I walk on the path of mystery of the Guru's Fear. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਜਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sabadhee paadhar jaan ||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, the Path is known.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਤਕੀਐ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai takeeaai saachai taan ||
verses.translation: With the Guru's Support, one is blessed with the strength of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਸਿ ਰੂੜੑੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: naam sam(h)aalas rooR(h)ee baan ||
verses.translation: Dwell on the Naam, and realize the Beauteous Word of His Bani.

verses.original: ਥੈਂ ਭਾਵੈ ਦਰੁ ਲਹਸਿ ਪਿਰਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: thai(n) bhaavai dhar lahas piraan ||2||
verses.translation: If it is Your Will, Lord, You lead me to find Your Door. ||2||

verses.original: ਊਡਾਂ ਬੈਸਾ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: uooddaa(n) baisaa ek liv taar ||
verses.translation: Flying high or sitting down, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh naam aadhaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I take the Naam as my Suppport.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਡੂੰਗਰੁ ਨ ਊਚੀ ਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: naa jal ddoo(n)gar na uoochee dhaar ||
verses.translation: There is no ocean of water, no mountain ranges rising up.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਤਹ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਚਾਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nij ghar vaasaa teh mag na chaalanahaar ||3||
verses.translation: I dwell within the home of my own inner being, where there is no path and no one travelling on it. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬੀਜਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: jit ghar vaseh toohai bidh jaaneh beejau mahal na jaapai ||
verses.translation: You alone know the way to that House in which You dwell. No one else knows the Mansion of Your Presence.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਦਬਿਆ ਛਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur baajhahu samajh na hovee sabh jag dhabiaa chhaapai ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, there is no understanding. The whole world is buried under its nightmare.

verses.original: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਤਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: karan palaav karai bilalaatau bin gur naam na jaapai ||
verses.translation: The mortal tries all sorts of things, and weeps and wails, but without the Guru, he does not know the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਲ ਪੰਕਜ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਏ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: pal pa(n)kaj meh naam chhaddaae je gur sabadh sin(j)aapai ||4||
verses.translation: In the twinkling of an eye, the Naam saves him, if he realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: eik moorakh a(n)dhe mugadh gavaar ||
verses.translation: Some are foolish, blind, stupid and ignorant.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: eik satigur kai bhai naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: Some, through fear of the True Guru, take the Support of the Naam.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੀਠੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: saachee baanee meeThee a(n)mirat dhaar ||
verses.translation: The True Word of His Bani is sweet, the source of ambrosial nectar.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਤੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jin peetee tis mokh dhuaar ||5||
verses.translation: Whoever drinks it in, finds the Door of Salvation. ||5||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: naam bhai bhai ridhai vasaahee gur karanee sach baanee ||
verses.translation: One who, through the love and fear of God, enshrines the Naam within his heart, acts according to the Guru's Instructions and knows the True Bani.

verses.original: ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: ei(n)dh varasai dharat suhaavee ghaT ghaT jot samaanee ||
verses.translation: When the clouds release their rain, the earth becomes beautiful; God's Light permeates each and every heart.

verses.original: ਕਾਲਰਿ ਬੀਜਸਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਐਸੀ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕੀ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaalar beejas dhuramat aaisee nigure kee neesaanee ||
verses.translation: The evil-minded ones plant their seed in the barren soil; such is the sign of those who have no Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: satigur baajhahu ghor a(n)dhaaraa ddoob mue bin paanee ||6||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, there is utter darkness; they drown there, even without water. ||6||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh keeno su prabhoo rajai ||
verses.translation: Whatever God does, is by His Own Will.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhur likhiaa su meTanaa na jai ||
verses.translation: That which is pre-ordained cannot be erased.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਬਾਧਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hukame baadhaa kaar kamai ||
verses.translation: Bound to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the mortal does his deeds.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਾਚੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: ek sabadh raachai sach samai ||7||
verses.translation: Permeated by the One Word of the Shabad, the mortal is immersed in Truth. ||7||

verses.original: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਤਾਲੰ ॥
verses.translit: chahu dhis hukam varatai prabh teraa chahu dhis naam pataala(n) ||
verses.translation: Your Command, O God, rules in the four directions; Your Name pervades the four corners of the nether regions as well.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਬੈਆਲੰ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh sabadh varatai prabh saachaa karam milai baiaala(n) ||
verses.translation: The True Word of the Shabad is pervading amongst all. By His Grace, the Eternal One unites us with Himself.

verses.original: ਜਾਂਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਊਭੌ ਖੁਧਿਆ ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਾਲੰ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n)man maranaa dheesai sir uoobhau khudhiaa nidhraa kaala(n) ||
verses.translation: Birth and death hang over the heads of all beings, along with hunger, sleep and dying.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਰਸਾਲੰ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai man bhaavai saachee nadhar rasaala(n) ||8||1||4||
verses.translation: The Naam is pleasing to Nanak's mind; O True Lord, Source of bliss, please bless me with Your Grace. ||8||1||4||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਰਣ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: maran mukat gat saar na jaanai ||
verses.translation: You do not understand the nature of death and liberation.

verses.original: ਕੰਠੇ ਬੈਠੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ka(n)The baiThee gur sabadh pachhaanai ||1||
verses.translation: You are sitting on the river-bank; realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕੈਸੇ ਆੜਿ ਫਾਥੀ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: too kaise aaR faathee jaal ||
verses.translation: You stork! - how were you caught in the net?

verses.original: ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: alakh na jaacheh ridhai sam(h)aal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You do not remember in your heart the Unseen Lord God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਜੀਆ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: ek jeea kai jeeaa khaahee ||
verses.translation: For your one life, you consume many lives.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਤਰਤੀ ਬੂਡੀ ਜਲ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jal taratee booddee jal maahee ||2||
verses.translation: You were supposed to swim in the water, but you are drowning in it instead. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਕੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਤਪਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: sarab jeea ke'ee pratapaanee ||
verses.translation: You have tormented all beings.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਪਕੜੀ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jab pakaRee tab hee pachhutaanee ||3||
verses.translation: When Death seizes you, then you shall regret and repent. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਸ ਪੜੀ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jab gal faas paRee at bhaaree ||
verses.translation: When the heavy noose is placed around your neck,

verses.original: ਊਡਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਪੰਖ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: uoodd na saakai pa(n)kh pasaaree ||4||
verses.translation: you may spread your wings, but you shall not be able to fly. ||4||

verses.original: ਰਸਿ ਚੂਗਹਿ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ras choogeh manmukh gaavaar ||
verses.translation: You enjoy the tastes and flavors, you foolish self-willed manmukh.

verses.original: ਫਾਥੀ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: faathee chhooTeh gun giaan beechaar ||5||
verses.translation: You are trapped. You can only be saved by virtuous conduct, spiritual wisdom and contemplation. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂਟੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sev tooTai jamakaal ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, you will shatter the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: hiradhai saachaa sabadh sam(h)aal ||6||
verses.translation: In your heart, dwell on the True Word of the Shabad. ||6||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat saachee sabadh hai saar ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Teachings, the True Word of the Shabad, is excellent and sublime.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam rakhai ur dhaar ||7||
verses.translation: Keep the Name of the Lord enshrined in your heart. ||7||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਦੁਖ ਆਗੈ ਜਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸੇ ॥
verses.translit: se dhukh aagai j bhog bilaase ||
verses.translation: One who is obsessed with enjoying pleasures here, shall suffer in pain hereafter.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੇ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak mukat nahee bin naavai saache ||8||2||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, there is no liberation without the True Name. ||8||2||5||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa teejaa asaTapadheeaa ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Third Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: karam hovai taa satigur paieeaai vin karamai paiaa na jai ||
verses.translation: If it is in his karma, then he finds the True Guru; without such karma, He cannot be found.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਈਐ ਜਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai ka(n)chan hoieeaai jaa(n) har kee hoi rajai ||1||
verses.translation: He meets the True Guru, and he is transformed into gold, if it is the Lord's Will. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man mere har har naam chit lai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te har paieeaai saachaa har siau rahai samai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord is found through the True Guru, and then he remains merged with the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਾਂ ਇਹ ਸੰਸਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te giaan uoopajai taa(n) ieh sa(n)saa jai ||
verses.translation: Spiritual wisdom wells up through the True Guru, and then this cynicism is dispelled.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ ਨਹ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur te har bujheeaai garabh jonee neh pai ||2||
verses.translation: Through the True Guru, the Lord is realized, and then, he is not consigned to the womb of reincarnation ever again. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee jeevat marai mar jeevai sabadh kamai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the mortal dies in life, and by so dying, lives to practice the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ ਜਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mukat dhuaaraa soiee paae j vichahu aap gavai ||3||
verses.translation: He alone finds the Door of Salvation, who eradicates self-conceit from within himself. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਸਕਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee siv ghar ja(n)mai vichahu sakat gavai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the mortal is reincarnated into the Home of the Lord, having eradicated Maya from within.

verses.original: ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਏ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: achar charai bibek budh paae purakhai purakh milai ||4||
verses.translation: He eats the uneatable, and is blessed with a discriminating intellect; he meets the Supreme Person, the Primal Lord God. ||4||

verses.original: ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਚਲੈ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaatur baajee sa(n)saar achet hai chalai mool gavai ||
verses.translation: The world is unconscious, like a passing show; the mortal departs, having lost his capital.

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: laahaa har satasa(n)gat paieeaai karamee palai pai ||5||
verses.translation: The profit of the Lord is obtained in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; by good karma, it is found. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur vin kinai na paiaa man vekhahu ridhai beechaar ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, no one finds it; see this in your mind, and consider this in your heart.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee gur paiaa bhavajal utare paar ||6||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, the mortal finds the Guru, and crosses over the terrifying world-ocean. ||6||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har naamaa(n) har Tek hai har har naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is my Anchor and Support. I take only the Support of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਾਵਉ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: kirapaa karahu gur melahu har jeeau paavau mokh dhuaar ||7||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, please be kind and lead me to meet the Guru, that I may find the Door of Salvation. ||7||

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: masatak lilaaT likhiaa dhur Thaakur meTanaa na jai ||
verses.translation: The pre-ordained destiny inscribed on the mortal's forehead by our Lord and Master cannot be erased.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak se jan pooran hoe jin har bhaanaa bhai ||8||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those humble beings are perfect, who are pleased by the Lord's Will. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bedh baanee jag varatadhaa trai gun kare beechaar ||
verses.translation: The world is involved with the words of the Vedas, thinking about the three gunas - the three dispositions.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai jam dda(n)dd sahai mar janamai vaaro vaar ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, it suffers punishment by the Messenger of Death; it comes and goes in reincarnation, over and over again.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur bheTe mukat hoi paae mokh dhuaar ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, the world is liberated, and finds the Door of Salvation. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man re satigur sev samai ||
verses.translation: O mortal, immerse yourself in service to the True Guru.

verses.original: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaddai bhaag gur pooraa paiaa har har naam dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, the mortal finds the Perfect Guru, and meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har aapanai bhaanai sirasaT upaiee har aape dhei adhaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord, by the Pleasure of His Own Will, created the Universe, and the Lord Himself gives it sustenance and support.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har aapanai bhaanai man niramal keeaa har siau laagaa piaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord, by His Own Will, makes the mortal's mind immaculate, and lovingly attunes him to the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har kai bhaanai satigur bheTiaa sabh janam savaaranahaar ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord, by His Own Will, leads the mortal to meet the True Guru, the Embellisher of all his lives. ||2||

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu baanee sat hai gurmukh boojhai koi ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Blessed and Great is the True Word of His Bani. Only a few, as Gurmukh, understand.

verses.original: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: vaahu vaahu kar prabh saalaaheeaai tis jevadd avar na koi ||
verses.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Praise God as Great! No one else is as Great as He.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aape bakhase mel le karam paraapat hoi ||3||
verses.translation: When God's Grace is received, He Himself forgives the mortal, and unites him with Himself. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਾਹਰੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa saahib maaharo satigur dheeaa dhikhai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has revealed our True, Supreme Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit varasai man sa(n)tokheeaai sach rahai liv lai ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down and the mind is satisfied, remaining lovingly attuned to the True Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਸੁਕੈ ਨਾ ਕੁਮਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: har kai nai sadhaa hareeaavalee fir sukai naa kumalai ||4||
verses.translation: In the Lord's Name, it is forever rejuvenated; it shall never wither and dry up again. ||4||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur kinai na paio man vekhahu ko pateeaai ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Lord; anyone can try and see.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਭੇਟੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa te satigur paieeaai bheTai sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: By the Lord's Grace, the True Guru is found, and then the Lord is met with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: manmukh bharam bhulaiaa bin bhaagaa har dhan na pai ||5||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is deluded by doubt; without good destiny, the Lord's wealth is not obtained. ||5||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਭਾ ਧਾਤੁ ਹੈ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun sabhaa dhaat hai paR paR kareh veechaar ||
verses.translation: The three dispositions are completely distracting; people read and study and contemplate them.

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਹੁ ਪਾਇਨਿੑ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mukat kadhe na hoviee nahu paini(h) mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: Those people are never liberated; they do not find the Door of Salvation.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੰਧਨ ਨ ਤੁਟਹੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bin satigur ba(n)dhan na tuTahee naam na lagai piaar ||6||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, they are never released from bondage; they do not embrace love for the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੋਨੀ ਥਕੇ ਬੇਦਾਂ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਆਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: paR paR pa(n)ddit monee thake bedhaa(n) kaa abhiaas ||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages, reading and studying the Vedas, have grown weary.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਨਹ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: har naam chit na aaviee neh nij ghar hovai vaas ||
verses.translation: They do not even think of the Lord's Name; they do not dwell in the home of their own inner being.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਹੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jamakaal sirahu na utarai a(n)tar kapaT vinaas ||7||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death hovers over their heads; they are ruined by the deceit within themselves. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਪਰਤਾਪਦਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਭਾਗਾਂ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har naavai no sabh ko parataapadhaa vin bhaagaa(n) paiaa na jai ||
verses.translation: Everyone longs for the Name of the Lord; without good destiny, it is not obtained.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare gur bheTeeaai har naam vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, the mortal meets the True Guru, and the Lord's Name comes to dwell within the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹਾਂ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naame hee pat uoopajai har siau rahaa(n) samai ||8||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Name, honor wells up, and the mortal remains immersed in the Lord. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਅਸਟਪਦੀ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: malaar mahalaa teejaa asaTapadhee ghar doojaa ||
verses.translation: Malaar, Third Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaa kare gur kee kaarai laae ||
verses.translation: When the Lord shows His Mercy, He enjoins the mortal to work for the Guru.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਪਲੑਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh pal(h)r har naam vasaae ||
verses.translation: His pains are taken away, and the Lord's Name comes to dwell within.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਗਤਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saachee gat saachai chit laae ||
verses.translation: True deliverance comes by focusing one's consciousness on the True Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur kee baanee sabadh sunaae ||1||
verses.translation: Listen to the Shabad, and the Word of the Guru's Bani. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: man mere har har sev nidhaan ||
verses.translation: O my mind, serve the Lord, Har, Har, the true treasure.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te har dhan paieeaai anadhin laagai sahaj dhiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the wealth of the Lord is obtained. Night and day, focus your meditation on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਂੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin pir kaaman kare sa(n)eegaar ||
verses.translation: The soul-bride who adorns herself without her Husband Lord,

verses.original: ਦੁਹਚਾਰਣੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhuhachaaranee kaheeaai nit hoi khuaar ||
verses.translation: is ill-mannered and vile, wasted away into ruin.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾ ਇਹੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh kaa ih baadh aachaar ||
verses.translation: This is the useless way of life of the self-willed manmukh.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bahu karam dhiraRaaveh naam visaar ||2||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he performs all sorts of empty rituals. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਬਣਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh kaaman baniaa seegaar ||
verses.translation: The bride who is Gurmukh is beautifully embellished.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabadhe pir raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Shabad, she enshrines her Husband Lord within her heart.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: ek pachhaanai haumai maar ||
verses.translation: She realizes the One Lord, and subdues her ego.

verses.original: ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sobhaava(n)tee kaheeaai naar ||3||
verses.translation: That soul-bride is virtuous and noble. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦਾਤੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur dhaate kinai na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the Giver, no one finds the Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਲੋਭਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਲੋਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh lobh dhoojai lobhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The greedy self-willed manmukh is attracted and engrossed in duality.

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aaise giaanee boojhahu koi ||
verses.translation: Only a few spiritual teachers realize this,

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bin gur bheTe mukat na hoi ||4||
verses.translation: that without meeting the Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: keh keh kahan kahai sabh koi ||
verses.translation: Everyone tells the stories told by others.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਨ ਮੂਏ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin man mooe bhagat na hoi ||
verses.translation: Without subduing the mind, devotional worship does not come.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਕਮਲ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: giaan matee kamal paragaas ||
verses.translation: When the intellect achieves spiritual wisdom, the heart-lotus blossoms forth.

verses.original: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: tit ghaT naamai naam nivaas ||5||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide in that heart. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai bhagat kare sabh koi ||
verses.translation: In egotism, everyone can pretend to worship God with devotion.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naa man bheejai naa sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: But this does not soften the mind, and it does not bring peace.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਹਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਆਪੁ ਜਾਣਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: keh keh kahan aap jaanaae ||
verses.translation: By speaking and preaching, the mortal only shows off his self-conceit.

verses.original: ਬਿਰਥੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: birathee bhagat sabh janam gavaae ||6||
verses.translation: His devotional worship is useless, and his life is a total waste. ||6||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: se bhagat satigur man bhaae ||
verses.translation: They alone are devotees, who are pleasing to the Mind of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin naam rahe liv laae ||
verses.translation: Night and day, they remain lovingly attuned to the Name.

verses.original: ਸਦ ਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵੇਖਹਿ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sadh hee naam vekheh hajoor ||
verses.translation: They behold the Naam, the Name of the Lord, ever-present, near at hand.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh rahiaa bharapoor ||7||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is pervading and permeating everywhere. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape bakhase dhei piaar ||
verses.translation: God Himself forgives, and bestows His Love.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਡਾ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: haumai rog vaddaa sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: The world is suffering from the terrible disease of egotism.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਏਹੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kirapaa te eh rog jai ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, this disease is cured.

verses.translit: naanak saache saach samai ||8||1||3||5||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Truth, the mortal remains immersed in the True Lord. ||8||1||3||5||8||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: raag malaar chha(n)t mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Malaar, Chhant, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: preetam prem bhagat ke dhaate ||
verses.translation: My Beloved Lord is the Giver of loving devotional worship.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: apane jan sa(n)g raate ||
verses.translation: His humble servants are imbued with His Love.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jan sa(n)g raate dhinas raate ik nimakh manahu na veesarai ||
verses.translation: He is imbued with His servants, day and night; He does not forget them from His Mind, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: gopaal gun nidh sadhaa sa(n)ge sarab gun jagadheesarai ||
verses.translation: He is the Lord of the World, the Treasure of virtue; He is always with me. All glorious virtues belong to the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਗੇ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਜਨ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: man moh leenaa charan sa(n)ge naam ras jan maate ||
verses.translation: With His Feet, He has fascinated my mind; as His humble servant, I am intoxicated with love for His Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸਦਹੂੰ ਕਿਨੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak preetam kirapaal sadhahoo(n) kinai koT madhe jaate ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, my Beloved is forever Merciful; out of millions, hardly anyone realizes Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: preetam teree gat agam apaare ||
verses.translation: O Beloved, Your state is inaccessible and infinite.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਤੁਮੑ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa patit tum(h) taare ||
verses.translation: You save even the worst sinners.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਸੁਆਮੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan bhagat vachhal kirapaa si(n)dh suaameeaa ||
verses.translation: He is the Purifier of sinners, the Lover of His devotees, the Ocean of mercy, our Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਸੰਤਸੰਗੇ ਭਜੁ ਨਿਸੰਗੇ ਰਂਉ ਸਦਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tasa(n)ge bhaj nisa(n)ge ra(n)au sadhaa a(n)tarajaameeaa ||
verses.translation: In the Society of the Saints, vibrate and meditate on Him with commitment forever; He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤ ਜੋਨੀ ਤੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: koT janam bhrama(n)t jonee te naam simarat taare ||
verses.translation: Those who wander in reincarnation through millions of births, are saved and carried across, by meditating in remembrance on the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dharas piaas har jeeau aap leh sam(h)aare ||2||
verses.translation: Nanak is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Dear Lord; please take care of him. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har charan kamal man leenaa ||
verses.translation: My mind is absorbed in the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਲ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਮੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jal jan tere meenaa ||
verses.translation: O God, You are the water; Your humble servants are fish.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਏਕ ਤੂਹੈ ਭਿੰਨ ਆਨ ਨ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: jal meen prabh jeeau ek toohai bhi(n)n aan na jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: O Dear God, You alone are the water and the fish. I know that there is no difference between the two.

verses.original: ਗਹਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਤਉ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦੀ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: geh bhujaa levahu naam dhevahu tau prasaadhee maaneeaai ||
verses.translation: Please take hold of my arm and bless me with Your Name. I am honored only by Your Grace.

verses.original: ਭਜੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੇ ਏਕ ਰੰਗੇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhaj saadhasa(n)ge ek ra(n)ge kirapaal gobidh dheenaa ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, vibrate and meditate with love on the One Lord of the Universe, who is Merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥ ਨੀਚ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਮਇਆ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਕੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: anaath neech saranai naanak kar miaa apunaa keenaa ||3||
verses.translation: Nanak, the lowly and helpless, seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, who in His Kindness has made him His Own. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapas kau aap milaiaa ||
verses.translation: He unites us with Himself.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੰਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bhram bha(n)jan har raiaa ||
verses.translation: Our Sovereign Lord King is the Destroyer of fear.

verses.original: ਆਚਰਜ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aacharaj suaamee a(n)tarajaamee mile gun nidh piaariaa ||
verses.translation: My Wondrous Lord and Master is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. My Beloved, the Treasure of virtue, has met me.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੂਖ ਉਪਜੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa ma(n)gal sookh upaje gobi(n)dh gun nit saariaa ||
verses.translation: Supreme happiness and peace well up, as I cherish the Glorious Virtues of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੋਹੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mil sa(n)g sohe dhekh mohe purab likhiaa paiaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting with Him, I am embellished and exalted; gazing on Him, I am fascinated, and I realize my pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak saran tin kee jin(h)ee har har dhiaaiaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I seek the Sanctuary of those who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਵਾਰ ਮਲਾਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਰਾਣੇ ਕੈਲਾਸ ਤਥਾ ਮਾਲਦੇ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: vaar malaar kee mahalaa pehilaa raane kailaas tathaa maaladhe kee dhun ||
verses.translation: Vaar Of Malaar, First Mehla, Sung To The Tune Of Rana Kailaash And Malda:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਵੁਠੈ ਧਰਣਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur miliaai man rahaseeaai jiau vuThai dharan seegaar ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, the mind is delighted, like the earth embellished by the rain.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਦਿਸੈ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ ਸਰ ਭਰੇ ਸੁਭਰ ਤਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sabh dhisai hareeaavalee sar bhare subhar taal ||
verses.translation: Everything becomes green and lush; the pools and ponds are filled to overflowing.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਰਚੈ ਸਚ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਿਉ ਮੰਜੀਠੈ ਲਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar rachai sach ra(n)g jiau ma(n)jeeThai laal ||
verses.translation: The inner self is imbued with the deep crimson color of love for the True Lord.

verses.original: ਕਮਲੁ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: kamal vigasai sach man gur kai sabadh nihaal ||
verses.translation: The heart-lotus blossoms forth and the mind becomes true; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is ecstatic and exalted.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੂਜੀ ਤਰਫ ਹੈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh dhoojee taraf hai vekhahu nadhar nihaal ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is on the wrong side. You can see this with your own eyes.

verses.original: ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਿਰਗ ਜਿਉ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੀਸੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: faahee faathe mirag jiau sir dheesai jamakaal ||
verses.translation: He is caught in the trap like the deer; the Messenger of Death hovers over his head.

verses.original: ਖੁਧਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬੁਰੀ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਵਿਕਰਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: khudhiaa tirasanaa ni(n)dhaa buree kaam karodh vikaraal ||
verses.translation: Hunger, thirst and slander are evil; sexual desire and anger are horrible.

verses.original: ਏਨੀ ਅਖੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: enee akhee nadhar na aaviee jichar sabadh na kare beechaar ||
verses.translation: These cannot be seen with your eyes, until you contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ ਚੂਕੈ ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bhaavai sa(n)tokheeaa(n) chookai aal ja(n)jaal ||
verses.translation: Whoever is pleasing to You is content; all his entanglements are gone.

verses.original: ਮੂਲੁ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਉੜੀ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: mool rahai gur seviaai gur pauRee bohith ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, his capital is preserved. The Guru is the ladder and the boat.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਗੀ ਤਤੁ ਲੈ ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak lagee tat lai too(n) sachaa man sach ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, whoever is attached to the Lord receives the essence; O True Lord, You are found when the mind is true. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੇਕੋ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਹੇਕੁ ਦਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਉੜੀ ਨਿਜ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: heko paadhar hek dhar gur pauRee nij thaan ||
verses.translation: There is one path and one door. The Guru is the ladder to reach one's own place.

verses.original: ਰੂੜਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਚਉ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: rooRau Thaakur naanakaa sabh sukh saachau naam ||2||
verses.translation: Our Lord and Master is so beautiful, O Nanak; all comfort and peace are in the Name of the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਆਪੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapeen(h)ai aap saaj aap pachhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself created Himself; He Himself understands Himself.

verses.original: ਅੰਬਰੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿ ਚੰਦੋਆ ਤਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)bar dharat vichhoR cha(n)dhoaa taaniaa ||
verses.translation: Separating the sky and the earth, He has spread out His canopy.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਥੰਮੑਾ ਗਗਨੁ ਰਹਾਇ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: vin tha(n)m(h)aa gagan rahai sabadh neesaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Without any pillars, He supports the sky, through the insignia of His Shabad.

verses.original: ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sooraj cha(n)dh upai jot samaaniaa ||
verses.translation: Creating the sun and the moon, He infused His Light into them.

verses.original: ਕੀਏ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨੰਤੁ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: ke'ee raat dhina(n)t choj viddaaniaa ||
verses.translation: He created the night and the day; Wondrous are His miraculous plays.

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥ ਧਰਮ ਵੀਚਾਰ ਨਾਵਣ ਪੁਰਬਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: teerath dharam veechaar naavan purabaaniaa ||
verses.translation: He created the sacred shrines of pilgrimage, where people contemplate righteousness and Dharma, and take cleansing baths on special occasions.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh sar avar na koi k aakh vakhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: There is no other equal to You; how can we speak and describe You?

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਹੋਰ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sachai takhat nivaas hor aavan jaaniaa ||1||
verses.translation: You are seated on the throne of Truth; all others come and go in reincarnation. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਵਣਿ ਜੇ ਵਸੈ ਚਹੁ ਓਮਾਹਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak saavan je vasai chahu omaahaa hoi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when it rains in the month of Saawan, four are delighted:

verses.original: ਨਾਗਾਂ ਮਿਰਗਾਂ ਮਛੀਆਂ ਰਸੀਆਂ ਘਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naagaa(n) miragaa(n) machheeaa(n) raseeaa(n) ghar dhan hoi ||1||
verses.translation: the snake, the deer, the fish and the wealthy people who seek pleasure. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਵਣਿ ਜੇ ਵਸੈ ਚਹੁ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak saavan je vasai chahu vechhoRaa hoi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when it rains in the month of Saawan, four suffer the pains of separation:

verses.original: ਗਾਈ ਪੁਤਾ ਨਿਰਧਨਾ ਪੰਥੀ ਚਾਕਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gaiee putaa niradhanaa pa(n)thee chaakar hoi ||2||
verses.translation: the cow's calves, the poor, the travellers and the servants. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: too sachaa sachiaar jin sach varataiaa ||
verses.translation: You are True, O True Lord; You dispense True Justice.

verses.original: ਬੈਠਾ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਇ ਕਵਲੁ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: baiThaa taaRee lai kaval chhapaiaa ||
verses.translation: Like a lotus, You sit in the primal celestial trance; You are hidden from view.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਕਹਾਇ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: brahamai vaddaa kahai a(n)t na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Brahma is called great, but even he does not know Your limits.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਇ ਕਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naa tis baap na mai kin too jaiaa ||
verses.translation: You have no father or mother; who gave birth to You?

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਵਰਨ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naa tis roop na rekh varan sabaiaa ||
verses.translation: You have no form or feature; You transcend all social classes.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੁਖ ਪਿਆਸ ਰਜਾ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naa tis bhukh piaas rajaa dhaiaa ||
verses.translation: You have no hunger or thirst; You are satisfied and satiated.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਸਮੋਇ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur meh aap samoi sabadh varataiaa ||
verses.translation: You have merged Yourself into the Guru; You are pervading through the Word of Your Shabad.

verses.original: ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਪਤੀਆਇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sache hee pateeaai sach samaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: When he is pleasing to the True Lord, the mortal merges in Truth. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਵੈਦੁ ਬੁਲਾਇਆ ਵੈਦਗੀ ਪਕੜਿ ਢੰਢੋਲੇ ਬਾਂਹ ॥
verses.translit: vaidh bulaiaa vaidhagee pakaR dda(n)ddole baa(n)h ||
verses.translation: The physician was called in; he touched my arm and felt my pulse.

verses.original: ਭੋਲਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਕਰਕ ਕਲੇਜੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bholaa vaidh na jaaniee karak kaleje maeh ||1||
