verses.translation: The foolish physician did not know that the pain was in the mind. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਵੈਦਾ ਵੈਦੁ ਸੁਵੈਦੁ ਤੂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਰੋਗੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaidhaa vaidh suvaidh too pahilaa(n) rog pachhaan ||
verses.translation: O physician, you are a competent physician, if you first diagnose the disease.

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਦਾਰੂ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਵੰਞੈ ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa dhaaroo loR lahu jit va(n)n(j)ai rogaa ghaan ||
verses.translation: Prescribe such a remedy, by which all sorts of illnesses may be cured.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਰੋਗ ਉਠਿਅਹਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jit dhaaroo rog uThieh tan sukh vasai aai ||
verses.translation: Administer that medicine, which will cure the disease, and allow peace to come and dwell in the body.

verses.original: ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਵੈਦੁ ਸਦਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: rog gavaieh aapanaa ta naanak vaidh sadhai ||2||
verses.translation: Only when you are rid of your own disease, O Nanak, will you be known as a physician. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹੇਸੁ ਦੇਵ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: brahamaa bisan mahes dhev upaiaa ||
verses.translation: Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva and the deities were created.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਦਿਤੇ ਬੇਦ ਪੂਜਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: brahame dhite bedh poojaa laiaa ||
verses.translation: Brahma was given the Vedas, and enjoined to worship God.

verses.original: ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhas avataaree raam raajaa aaiaa ||
verses.translation: The ten incarnations, and Rama the king, came into being.

verses.original: ਦੈਤਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਧਾਇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhaitaa maare dhai hukam sabaiaa ||
verses.translation: According to His Will, they quickly killed all the demons.

verses.original: ਈਸ ਮਹੇਸੁਰੁ ਸੇਵ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: e'ees mahesur sev tin(h)ee a(n)t na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Shiva serves Him, but cannot find His limits.

verses.original: ਸਚੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਤਖਤੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachee keemat pai takhat rachaiaa ||
verses.translation: He established His throne on the principles of Truth.

verses.original: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇ ਆਪੁ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhuneeaa dha(n)dhai lai aap chhapaiaa ||
verses.translation: He enjoined all the world to its tasks, while He keeps Himself hidden from view.

verses.original: ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਮ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dharam karaae karam dhurahu furamaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Primal Lord has ordained that mortals must practice righteousness. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਕੰਤੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: saavan aaiaa he sakhee ka(n)tai chit kareh ||
verses.translation: The month of Saawan has come, O my companions; think of your Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਝੂਰਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਦੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਅਵਰੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jhoor mareh dhohaaganee jin(h) avaree laagaa neh ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the discarded bride is in love with another; now she weeps and wails, and dies. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਵਣੁ ਆਇਆ ਹੇ ਸਖੀ ਜਲਹਰੁ ਬਰਸਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saavan aaiaa he sakhee jalahar barasanahaar ||
verses.translation: The month of Saawan has come, O my companions; the clouds have burst forth with rain.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਵਨੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਸਹ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sukh savan sohaaganee jin(h) seh naal piaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the blessed soul-brides sleep in peace; they are in love with their Husband Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਛਿੰਝ ਪਵਾਇ ਮਲਾਖਾੜਾ ਰਚਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape chhi(n)jh pavai malaakhaaRaa rachiaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself has staged the tournament, and arranged the arena for the wrestlers.

verses.original: ਲਥੇ ਭੜਥੂ ਪਾਇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਚਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: lathe bhaRathoo pai gurmukh machiaa ||
verses.translation: They have entered the arena with pomp and ceremony; the Gurmukhs are joyful.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਰੇ ਪਛਾੜਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਚਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh maare pachhaaR moorakh kachiaa ||
verses.translation: The false and foolish self-willed manmukhs are defeated and overcome.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਭਿੜੈ ਮਾਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਰਚਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aap bhiRai maare aap aap kaaraj rachiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself wrestles, and He Himself defeats them. He Himself staged this play.

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa khasam ek hai gurmukh jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: The One God is the Lord and Master of all; this is known by the Gurmukhs.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਲਿਖੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਲਮ ਮਸਵਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee likhai sir lekh vin kalam masavaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: He writes the inscription of His Hukam on the foreheads of all, without pen or ink.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਪੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਦਾ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat melaap jithai har gun sadhaa vakhaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: In the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, Union with Him is obtained; there, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are chanted forever.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak sachaa sabadh salaeh sach pachhaaneeaai ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praising the True Word of His Shabad, one comes to realize the Truth. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਊਂਨਵਿ ਊਂਨਵਿ ਆਇਆ ਅਵਰਿ ਕਰੇਂਦਾ ਵੰਨ ॥
verses.translit: uoo(n)nav uoo(n)nav aaiaa avar kare(n)dhaa va(n)n ||
verses.translation: Hanging low, low and thick in the sky, the clouds are changing color.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਹ ਸਿਉ ਕੇਵ ਰਹਸੀ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa jaanaa tis saeh siau kev rahasee ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: How do I know whether my love for my Husband Lord shall endure?

verses.original: ਰੰਗੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g rahiaa tin(h) kaamanee jin(h) man bhau bhaau hoi ||
verses.translation: The love of those soul-brides endures, if their minds are filled with the Love and the Fear of God.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bhai bhai baaharee tin tan sukh na hoi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she who has no Love and Fear of God - her body shall never find peace. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਊਂਨਵਿ ਊਂਨਵਿ ਆਇਆ ਵਰਸੈ ਨੀਰੁ ਨਿਪੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: uoo(n)nav uoo(n)nav aaiaa varasai neer nipa(n)g ||
verses.translation: Hanging low, low and thick in the sky, the clouds come, and pure water rains down.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੰਤੈ ਸਿਉ ਮਨਿ ਭੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak dhukh laagaa tin(h) kaamanee jin(h) ka(n)tai siau man bha(n)g ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, that soul-bride suffers in pain, whose mind is torn away from her Husband Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਦੋਵੈ ਤਰਫਾ ਉਪਾਇ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhovai tarafaa upai ik varatiaa ||
verses.translation: The One Lord created both sides and pervades the expanse.

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਰਤਾਇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਘਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bedh baanee varatai a(n)dhar vaadh ghatiaa ||
verses.translation: The words of the Vedas became pervasive, with arguments and divisions.

verses.original: ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਨਿਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਹਾਠਾ ਦੋਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਰੈਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: paravirat niravirat haaThaa dhovai vich dharam firai raibaariaa ||
verses.translation: Attachment and detachment are the two sides of it; Dharma, true religion, is the guide between the two.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਚੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh kache kooRiaar tin(h)ee nihachau dharageh haariaa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are worthless and false. Without a doubt, they lose in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੂਰ ਹੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmatee sabadh soor hai kaam karodh jin(h)ee maariaa ||
verses.translation: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings are the true spiritual warriors; they have conquered sexual desire and anger.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachai a(n)dhar mahal sabadh savaariaa ||
verses.translation: They enter into the True Mansion of the Lord's Presence, embellished and exalted by the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਦੇ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: se bhagat tudh bhaavadhe sachai nai piaariaa ||
verses.translation: Those devotees are pleasing to Your Will, O Lord; they dearly love the True Name.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: satigur sevan aapanaa tin(h)aa viTahu hau vaariaa ||5||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who serve their True Guru. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਊਂਨਵਿ ਊਂਨਵਿ ਆਇਆ ਵਰਸੈ ਲਾਇ ਝੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: uoo(n)nav uoo(n)nav aaiaa varasai lai jhaRee ||
verses.translation: Hanging low, low and thick in the sky, the clouds come, and water rains down in torrents.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਕੰਤ ਕੈ ਸੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਸਦਾ ਰਲੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bhaanai chalai ka(n)t kai su maane sadhaa ralee ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she walks in harmony with the Will of her Husband Lord; she enjoys peace and pleasure forever. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬਪੁੜੇਂ ਇਸੁ ਮੇਘੈ ਹਥਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa uTh uTh dhekhahu bapuRe(n) is meghai hath kichh naeh ||
verses.translation: Why are you standing up, standing up to look? You poor wretch, this cloud has nothing in its hands.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਮੇਘੁ ਪਠਾਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਂਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin eh megh paThaiaa tis raakhahu man maa(n)h ||
verses.translation: The One who sent this cloud - cherish Him in your mind.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਸੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis no ma(n)n vasaisee jaa kau nadhar karei ||
verses.translation: He alone enshrines the Lord in his mind, upon whom the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਸਭ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee baaharee sabh karan palaeh karei ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, all those who lack this Grace, cry and weep and wail. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੇਵੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: so har sadhaa sareveeaai jis karat na laagai vaar ||
verses.translation: Serve the Lord forever; He acts in no time at all.

verses.original: ਆਡਾਣੇ ਆਕਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aaddaane aakaas kar khin meh ddaeh usaaranahaar ||
verses.translation: He stretched the sky across the heavens; in an instant, He creates and destroys.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aape jagat upai kai kudharat kare veechaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself created the world; He contemplates His Creative Omnipotence.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh agai lekhaa ma(n)geeaai bahutee hovai maar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh will be called to account hereafter; he will be severely punished.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਲੇਖਾ ਨਿਬੜੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh pat siau lekhaa nibaRai bakhase sifat bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh's account is settled with honor; the Lord blesses him with the treasure of His Praise.

verses.original: ਓਥੈ ਹਥੁ ਨ ਅਪੜੈ ਕੂਕ ਨ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: othai hath na apaRai kook na suneeaai pukaar ||
verses.translation: No one's hands can reach there; no one will hear anyone's cries.

verses.original: ਓਥੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਢਿ ਲਏ ਅੰਤੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: othai satigur belee hovai kadd le a(n)tee vaar ||
verses.translation: The True Guru will be your best friend there; at the very last instant, He will save you.

verses.original: ਏਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ ਨੋ ਹੋਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰਤਾਰ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: enaa ja(n)taa no hor sevaa nahee satigur sir karataar ||6||
verses.translation: These beings should serve no other than the True Guru or the Creator Lord above the heads of all. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਪੂਕਾਰਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: baabeehaa jis no too pookaaradhaa tis no lochai sabh koi ||
verses.translation: O rainbird, the One unto whom you call - everyone longs for that Lord.

verses.original: ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਸੀ ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: apanee kirapaa kar kai vasasee van tiran hariaa hoi ||
verses.translation: When He grants His Grace, it rains, and the forests and fields blossom forth in their greenery.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee paieeaai viralaa boojhai koi ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, He is found; only a rare few understand this.

verses.original: ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bahadhiaa uThadhiaa nit dhiaaieeaai sadhaa sadhaa sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: Sitting down and standing up, meditate continually on Him, and be at peace forever and ever.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak a(n)mrit sadh hee varasadhaa gurmukh dhevai har soi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Nectar rains down forever; the Lord gives it to the Gurmukh. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਲਮਲਿ ਹੋਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kalamal hoiee medhanee aradhaas kare liv lai ||
verses.translation: When the people of the world are suffering in pain, they call upon the Lord in loving prayer.

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਕੰਨੁ ਦੇ ਧੀਰਕ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachai suniaa ka(n)n dhe dheerak dhevai sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: The True Lord naturally listens and hears and gives comfort.

verses.original: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੈ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਵੁਠਾ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ei(n)dhrai no furamaiaa vuThaa chhahabar lai ||
verses.translation: He commands the god of rain, and the rain pours down in torrents.

verses.original: ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: an dhan upajai bahu ghanaa keemat kahan na jai ||
verses.translation: Corn and wealth are produced in great abundance and prosperity; their value cannot be estimated.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਦੇਦਾ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak naam salaeh too sabhanaa jeeaa dhedhaa rijak sa(n)baeh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He reaches out and gives sustenance to all beings.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jit khaadhai sukh uoopajai fir dhookh na laagai aai ||2||
verses.translation: Eating this, peace is produced, and the mortal never again suffers in pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਸਚੇ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau sachaa sach too sache laih milai ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, You are the Truest of the True. You blend those who are truthful into Your Own Being.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਦੂਜੀ ਤਰਫ ਹੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai dhoojee taraf hai kooR milai na miliaa jai ||
verses.translation: Those caught in duality are on the side of duality; entrenched in falsehood, they cannot merge into the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜੋੜਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਿਐ ਆਪੇ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape joR vichhoRiaai aape kudharat dhei dhikhai ||
verses.translation: You Yourself unite, and You Yourself separate; You display Your Creative Omnipotence.

verses.original: ਮੋਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: moh sog vijog hai poorab likhiaa kamai ||
verses.translation: Attachment brings the sorrow of separation; the mortal acts in accordance with pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree tin kau jo har charanee rahai liv lai ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who remain lovingly attached to the Lord's Feet.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਐਸੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jal meh kamal alipat hai aaisee banat banai ||
verses.translation: They are like the lotus which remains detached, floating upon the water.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜਿਨੑ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: se sukhe'ee sadhaa sohane jin(h) vichahu aap gavai ||
verses.translation: They are peaceful and beautiful forever; they eradicate self-conceit from within.

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨਹੀ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: tin(h) sog vijog kadhe nahee jo har kai a(n)k samai ||7||
verses.translation: They never suffer sorrow or separation; they are merged in the Being of the Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਸਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak so saalaaheeaai jis vas sabh kichh hoi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praise the Lord; everything is in His power.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਿਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਹੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tisai sarevih praaneeho tis bin avar na koi ||
verses.translation: Serve Him, O mortal beings; there is none other than Him.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har prabh man vasai taa(n) sadhaa sadhaa sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: The Lord God abides within the mind of the Gurmukh, and then he is at peace, forever and ever.

verses.original: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਸਭ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sahasaa mool na hoviee sabh chi(n)taa vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: He is never cynical; all anxiety has been taken out from within him.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh hoi su sahaje hoi kahanaa kichhoo na jai ||
verses.translation: Whatever happens, happens naturally; no one has any say about it.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa saahib man vasai taa(n) man chi(n)dhiaa fal pai ||
verses.translation: When the True Lord abides in the mind, then the mind's desires are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣੇ ਜਿ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tin kaa aakhiaa aap sune j lian pa(n)nai pai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, He Himself hears the words of those, whose accounts are in His Hands. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਬੂਝਨਿ ਬੂਝਣਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit sadhaa varasadhaa boojhan boojhanahaar ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down continually; realize this through realization.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jin(h)ee bujhiaa har a(n)mrit rakhiaa ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Those who, as Gurmukh, realize this, keep the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar enshrined within their hearts.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har a(n)mrit peeveh sadhaa ra(n)g raate haumai tirasanaa maar ||
verses.translation: They drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar, and remain forever imbued with the Lord; they conquer egotism and thirsty desires.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਰਸੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit har kaa naam hai varasai kirapaa dhaar ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar; the Lord showers His Grace, and it rains down.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh nadharee aaiaa har aatam raam muraar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh comes to behold the Lord, the Supreme Soul. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਅਤੁਲੁ ਕਿਉ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਵਿਣੁ ਤੋਲੇ ਪਾਇਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: atul kiau toleeaai vin tole paiaa na jai ||
verses.translation: How can the unweighable be weighed? Without weighing Him, He cannot be obtained.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh veechaareeaai gun meh rahai samai ||
verses.translation: Reflect on the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and immerse yourself in His Glorious Virtues.

verses.original: ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਿ ਤੋਲਸੀ ਆਪੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: apanaa aap aap tolasee aape milai milai ||
verses.translation: He Himself weighs Himself; He unites in Union with Himself.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee keemat naa pavai kahanaa kichhoo na jai ||
verses.translation: His value cannot be estimated; nothing can be said about this.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੀ ਬੂਝ ਦਿਤੀ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hau balihaaree gur aapane jin sachee boojh dhitee bujhai ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru; He has made me realize this true realization.

verses.original: ਜਗਤੁ ਮੁਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੁਟੀਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jagat musai a(n)mrit luTeeaai manmukh boojh na pai ||
verses.translation: The world has been deceived, and the Ambrosial Nectar is being plundered. The self-willed manmukh does not realize this.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਸੀ ਜਾਸੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai naal na chalasee jaasee janam gavai ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, nothing will go along with him; he wastes his life, and departs.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਜਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਘਰੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਦੂਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਵਸਾਇ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: gurmatee jaage tin(h)ee ghar rakhiaa dhootaa kaa kichh na vasai ||8||
verses.translation: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings and remain awake and aware, preserve and protect the home of their heart; demons have no power against them. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਨਾ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ਨਾ ਤਰਸਾਇ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: baabeehaa naa bilalai naa tarasai eh man khasam kaa hukam ma(n)n ||
verses.translation: O rainbird, do not cry out. Do not let this mind of yours be so thirsty for a drop of water. Obey the Hukam, the Command of your Lord and Master,

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਤਿਖ ਉਤਰੈ ਚੜੈ ਚਵਗਲਿ ਵੰਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak hukam ma(n)niaai tikh utarai chaRai chavagal va(n)n ||1||
verses.translation: and your thirst shall be quenched. Your love for Him shall increase four-fold. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਫਿਰਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: baabeehaa jal meh teraa vaas hai jal hee maeh firaeh ||
verses.translation: O rainbird, your place is in the water; you move around in the water.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਤਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਕੂਕਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jal kee saar na jaanahee taa(n) too(n) kookan paeh ||
verses.translation: But you do not appreciate the water, and so you cry out.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਥਲ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋ ਥਾਉ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal chahu dhis varasadhaa khaalee ko thaau naeh ||
verses.translation: In the water and on the land, it rains down in the ten directions. No place is left dry.

verses.original: ਏਤੈ ਜਲਿ ਵਰਸਦੈ ਤਿਖ ਮਰਹਿ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: etai jal varasadhai tikh mareh bhaag tinaa ke naeh ||
verses.translation: With so much rain, those who are die of thirst are very unfortunate.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ ਜਿਨ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh tin sojhee piee jin vasiaa man maeh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs understand; the Lord abides within their minds. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਨਾਥ ਜਤੀ ਸਿਧ ਪੀਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: naath jatee sidh peer kinai a(n)t na paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Yogic Masters, celibates, Siddhas and spiritual teachers - none of them has found the limits of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੁਝੈ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam dhiaai tujhai samaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam, and merge in You, O Lord.

verses.original: ਜੁਗ ਛਤੀਹ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jug chhateeh gubaar tis hee bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: For thirty-six ages, God remained in utter darkness, as He pleased.

verses.original: ਜਲਾ ਬਿੰਬੁ ਅਸਰਾਲੁ ਤਿਨੈ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jalaa bi(n)b asaraal tinai varataiaa ||
verses.translation: The vast expanse of water swirled around.

verses.original: ਨੀਲੁ ਅਨੀਲੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਸਰਜੀਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: neel aneel aga(n)m sarajeet sabaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Creator of all is Infinite, Endless and Inaccessible.

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਵਾਦੁ ਭੁਖ ਤਿਹਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: agan upaiee vaadh bhukh tihaiaa ||
verses.translation: He formed fire and conflict, hunger and thirst.

verses.original: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhuneeaa kai sir kaal dhoojaa bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Death hangs over the heads of the people of the world, in the love of duality.

verses.original: ਰਖੈ ਰਖਣਹਾਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: rakhai rakhanahaar jin sabadh bujhaiaa ||9||
verses.translation: The Savior Lord saves those who realize the Word of the Shabad. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਲੁ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਵਰਸੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih jal sabh tai varasadhaa varasai bhai subhai ||
verses.translation: This rain pours down on all; it rains down in accordance with God's Loving Will.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਬਿਰਖਾ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: se birakhaa hareeaavale jo gurmukh rahe samai ||
verses.translation: Those trees become green and lush, which remain immersed in the Guru's Word.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਏਨਾ ਜੰਤਾ ਕਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee sukh hoi enaa ja(n)taa kaa dhukh jai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by His Grace, there is peace; the pain of these creatures is gone. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਚਮਕਿਆ ਵੁਠਾ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhi(n)nee rain chamakiaa vuThaa chhahabar lai ||
verses.translation: The night is wet with dew; lightning flashes, and the rain pours down in torrents.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਵੁਠੈ ਅਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਜਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jit vuThai an dhan bahut uoopajai jaa(n) sahu kare rajai ||
verses.translation: Food and wealth are produced in abundance when it rains, if it is the Will of God.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਖਾਧੈ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਜੀਆਂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jit khaadhai man tirapateeaai jeeaa(n) jugat samai ||
verses.translation: Consuming it, the minds of His creatures are satisfied, and they adopt the lifestyle of the way.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਹੈ ਕਦੇ ਆਵੈ ਕਦੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih dhan karate kaa khel hai kadhe aavai kadhe jai ||
verses.translation: This wealth is the play of the Creator Lord. Sometimes it comes, and sometimes it goes.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੀਆ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: giaaneeaa kaa dhan naam hai sadh hee rahai samai ||
verses.translation: The Naam is the wealth of the spiritually wise. It is permeating and pervading forever.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jin kau nadhar kare taa(n) ih dhan palai pai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are blessed with His Glance of Grace receive this wealth. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਹਉ ਕੈ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aap karaae kare aap hau kai siau karee pukaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself does, and causes all to be done. Unto whom can I complain?

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗਸੀ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aape lekhaa ma(n)gasee aap karaae kaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself calls the mortal beings to account; He Himself causes them to act.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo tis bhaavai so theeaai hukam kare gaavaar ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases Him happens. Only a fool issues commands.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aap chhaddaae chhuTeeaai aape bakhasanahaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself saves and redeems; He Himself is the Forgiver.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਸੁਣੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape vekhai sune aap sabhasai dhe aadhaar ||
verses.translation: He Himself sees, and He Himself hears; He gives His Support to all.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh ek varatadhaa sir sir kare beechaar ||
verses.translation: He alone is pervading and permeating all; He considers each and every one.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਲਗੈ ਸਚਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh aap veechaareeaai lagai sach piaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh reflects on the self, lovingly attached to the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naanak kis no aakheeaai aape dhevanahaar ||10||
verses.translation: O Nanak, whom can we ask? He Himself is the Great Giver. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਏਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਮਤ ਕੋ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: baabeehaa eh jagat hai mat ko bharam bhulai ||
verses.translation: This world is a rainbird; let no one be deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਬਾਬੀਂਹਾ ਪਸੂ ਹੈ ਇਸ ਨੋ ਬੂਝਣੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: eih baabee(n)haa pasoo hai is no boojhan naeh ||
verses.translation: This rainbird is an animal; it has no understanding at all.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit har kaa naam hai jit peetai tikh jai ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is Ambrosial Nectar; drinking it in, thirst is quenched.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੑ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੀ ਆਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh jin(h) peeaa tin(h) bahuR na laagee aai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those Gurmukhs who drink it in shall never again be afflicted by thirst. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰੁ ਸੀਤਲ ਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਐ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: malaar seetal raag hai har dhiaaiaai saa(n)t hoi ||
verses.translation: Malaar is a calming and soothing raga; meditating on the Lord brings peace and tranquility.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅਪਣੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾਂ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau apanee kirapaa kare taa(n) varatai sabh loi ||
verses.translation: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, then the rain falls on all the people of the world.

verses.original: ਵੁਠੈ ਜੀਆ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਧਰਣੀ ਨੋ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: vuThai jeeaa jugat hoi dharanee no seegaar hoi ||
verses.translation: From this rain, all creatures find the ways and means to live, and the earth is embellished.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ih jagat sabh jal hai jal hee te sabh koi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this world is all water; everything came from water.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee ko viralaa boojhai so jan mukat sadhaa hoi ||2||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, a rare few realize the Lord; such humble beings are liberated forever. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਇਕੋ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa veparavaahu iko too dhanee ||
verses.translation: O True and Independent Lord God, You alone are my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਦੂਜੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਗਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: too sabh kichh aape aap dhooje kis ganee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are everything; who else is of any account?

verses.original: ਮਾਣਸ ਕੂੜਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: maanas kooRaa garab sachee tudh manee ||
verses.translation: False is the pride of man. True is Your glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: aavaa gaun rachai upaiee medhanee ||
verses.translation: Coming and going in reincarnation, the beings and species of the world came into being.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਇਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਗਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seve aapanaa aaiaa tis ganee ||
verses.translation: But if the mortal serves his True Guru, his coming into the world is judged to be worthwhile.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਕੇਹੀ ਗਣਤ ਗਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: je haumai vichahu jai ta kehee ganat ganee ||
verses.translation: And if he eradicates eogtism from within himself, then how can he be judged?

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੋਹਿ ਗੁਬਾਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਭੁਲਾ ਮੰਝਿ ਵਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh moh gubaar jiau bhulaa ma(n)jh vanee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh is lost in the darkness of emotional attachment, like the man lost in the wilderness.

verses.original: ਕਟੇ ਪਾਪ ਅਸੰਖ ਨਾਵੈ ਇਕ ਕਣੀ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: kaTe paap asa(n)kh naavai ik kanee ||11||
verses.translation: Countless sins are erased, by even a tiny particle of the Lord's Name. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: baabeehaa khasamai kaa mahal na jaanahee mahal dhekh aradhaas pai ||
verses.translation: O rainbird, you do not know the Mansion of your Lord and Master's Presence. Offer your prayers to see this Mansion.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aapanai bhaanai bahutaa boleh boliaa thai na pai ||
verses.translation: You speak as you please, but your speech is not accepted.

verses.original: ਖਸਮੁ ਵਡਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਇਛੇ ਸੋ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khasam vaddaa dhaataar hai jo ichhe so fal pai ||
verses.translation: Your Lord and Master is the Great Giver; whatever you desire, you shall receive from Him.

verses.original: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਕਿਆ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਜਗਤੈ ਕੀ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: baabeehaa kiaa bapuRaa jagatai kee tikh jai ||1||
verses.translation: Not only the thirst of the poor rainbird, but the thirst of the whole world is quenched. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਭਿੰਨੀ ਰੈਣਿ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: baabeehaa bhi(n)nee rain boliaa sahaje sach subhai ||
verses.translation: The night is wet with dew; the rainbird sings the True Name with intuitive ease.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਲੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਜੀਉ ਹੈ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih jal meraa jeeau hai jal bin rahan na jai ||
verses.translation: This water is my very soul; without water, I cannot survive.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee jal paieeaai vichahu aap gavai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, this water is obtained, and egotism is eradicated from within.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਚਸਾ ਨ ਜੀਵਦੀ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jis bin chasaa na jeevadhee so satigur dheeaa milai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I cannot live without Him, even for a moment; the True Guru has led me to meet Him. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ ਅਸੰਖ ਮੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kha(n)dd pataal asa(n)kh mai ganat na hoiee ||
verses.translation: There are countless worlds and nether regions; I cannot calculate their number.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਗੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: too karataa govi(n)dh tudh sirajee tudhai goiee ||
verses.translation: You are the Creator, the Lord of the Universe; You create it, and You destroy it.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: lakh chauraaseeh medhanee tujh hee te hoiee ||
verses.translation: The 8.4 million species of beings issued forth from You.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਖਾਨ ਮਲੂਕ ਕਹਹਿ ਕਹਾਵਹਿ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: eik raaje khaan malook kaheh kahaaveh koiee ||
verses.translation: Some are called kings, emperors and nobles.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਸਾਹ ਸਦਾਵਹਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਧਨੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: eik saeh sadhaaveh sa(n)ch dhan dhoojai pat khoiee ||
verses.translation: Some claim to be bankers and accumulate wealth, but in duality they lose their honor.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਇਕ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhaate ik ma(n)gate sabhanaa sir soiee ||
verses.translation: Some are givers, and some are beggars; God is above the heads of all.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀਆ ਭੀਹਾਵਲਿ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai baajaareeaa bheehaaval hoiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, they are vulgar, dreadful and wretched.

verses.original: ਕੂੜ ਨਿਖੁਟੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: kooR nikhuTe naanakaa sach kare su hoiee ||12||
verses.translation: Falsehood shall not last, O Nanak; whatever the True Lord does, comes to pass. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਉਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: baabeehaa gunava(n)tee mahal paiaa aauganava(n)tee dhoor ||
verses.translation: O rainbird, the virtuous soul-bride attains the Mansion of her Lord's Presence; the unworthy, unvirtuous one is far away.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar terai har vasai gurmukh sadhaa hajoor ||
verses.translation: Deep within your inner being, the Lord abides. The Gurmukh beholds Him ever-present.

verses.original: ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: kook pukaar na hoviee nadharee nadhar nihaal ||
verses.translation: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, the mortal no longer weeps and wails.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ ਘਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate sahaje mile sabadh guroo kai ghaal ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam intuitively merge with the Lord; they practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੇਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: baabeehaa benatee kare kar kirapaa dheh jeea dhaan ||
verses.translation: The rainbird prays: O Lord, grant Your Grace, and bless me with the gift of the life of the soul.

verses.original: ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਆਸ ਨ ਊਤਰੈ ਛੁਟਕਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jal bin piaas na uootarai chhuTak jaa(n)h mere praan ||
verses.translation: Without the water, my thirst is not quenched, and my breath of life is ended and gone.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨੇਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: too sukhadhaataa bea(n)t hai gunadhaataa nedhaan ||
verses.translation: You are the Giver of peace, O Infinite Lord God; You are the Giver of the treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਅੰਤਿ ਬੇਲੀ ਹੋਇ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh bakhas le a(n)t belee hoi bhagavaan ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is forgiven; in the end, the Lord God shall be your only friend. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਣ ਅਉਗਣ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aape jagat upai kai gun aaugan kare beechaar ||
verses.translation: He created the world; He considers the merits and demerits of the mortals.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun sarab ja(n)jaal hai naam na dhare piaar ||
verses.translation: Those who are entangled in the three gunas - the three dispositions - do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਅਉਗਣ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gun chhodd aaugan kamaavadhe dharageh hoh khuaar ||
verses.translation: Forsaking virtue, they practice evil; they shall be miserable in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਕਿਤੁ ਆਏ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jooaai janam tinee haariaa kit aae sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: They lose their life in the gamble; why did they even come into the world?

verses.original: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sachai sabadh man maariaa ahinis naam piaar ||
verses.translation: But those who conquer and subdue their minds, through the True Word of the Shabad - night and day, they love the Naam.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸਚਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jinee purakhee ur dhaariaa sachaa alakh apaar ||
verses.translation: Those people enshrine the True, Invisible and Infinite Lord in their hearts.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਹਿ ਅਸੀ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: too gunadhaataa nidhaan heh asee avaganiaar ||
verses.translation: You, O Lord, are the Giver, the Treasure of virtue; I am unvirtuous and unworthy.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: jis bakhase so paisee gur sabadhee veechaar ||13||
verses.translation: He alone finds You, whom You bless and forgive, and inspire to contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਤਿ ਨ ਵਿਹਾਵੀ ਸਾਕਤਾਂ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raat na vihaavee saakataa(n) jin(h)aa visarai naau ||
verses.translation: The faithless cynics forget the Name of the Lord; the night of their lives does not pass in peace.

verses.original: ਰਾਤੀ ਦਿਨਸ ਸੁਹੇਲੀਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਂਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raatee dhinas suheleeaa naanak har gun gaa(n)au ||1||
verses.translation: Their days and nights become comfortable, O Nanak, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕਾ ਹਭੇ ਮਣੀ ਮਥੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: ratan javehar maanakaa habhe manee matha(n)n ||
verses.translation: All sorts of jewels and gems, diamonds and rubies, shine forth from their foreheads.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਣਿਆ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak jo prabh bhaaniaa sachai dhar soha(n)n ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are pleasing to God, look beautiful in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਚੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa satigur sev sach sam(h)aaliaa ||
verses.translation: Serving the True Guru, I dwell on the True Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਿ ਖਲੋਆ ਆਇ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਘਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t khaloaa aai j satigur agai ghaaliaa ||
verses.translation: The work you have done for the True Guru shall be very useful in the end.

verses.original: ਪੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਖਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: poh na sakai jamakaal sachaa rakhavaaliaa ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death cannot even touch that person who is protected by the True Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਾਇ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur saakhee jot jagai dheevaa baaliaa ||
verses.translation: Lighting the lamp of the Guru's Teachings, my awareness has been awakened.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh vin naavai kooRiaar fireh betaaliaa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are false; without the Name, they wander around like demons.

verses.original: ਪਸੂ ਮਾਣਸ ਚੰਮਿ ਪਲੇਟੇ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਕਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: pasoo maanas cha(n)m paleTe a(n)dharahu kaaliaa ||
verses.translation: They are nothing more than beasts, wrapped up in human skin; they are black-hearted within.

verses.original: ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabho varatai sach sachai sabadh nihaaliaa ||
verses.translation: The True Lord is pervading all; through the True Word of the Shabad, He is seen.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: naanak naam nidhaan hai poorai gur dhekhaaliaa ||14||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Naam is the greatest treasure. The Perfect Guru has revealed it to me. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਬੀਹੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: baabeehai hukam pachhaaniaa gur kai sahaj subhai ||
verses.translation: The rainbird realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command with intuitive ease through the Guru.

verses.original: ਮੇਘੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਗੂੜੀ ਛਹਬਰ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: megh varasai dhiaa kar gooRee chhahabar lai ||
verses.translation: The clouds mercifully burst forth, and the rain pours down in torrents.

verses.original: ਬਾਬੀਹੇ ਕੂਕ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਰਹਿ ਗਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: baabeehe kook pukaar reh giee sukh vasiaa man aai ||
verses.translation: The cries and wailings of the rainbird have ceased, and peace has come to abide in its mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਜੀਆ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak so saalaaheeaai j dhe(n)dhaa sabhanaa(n) jeeaa rijak samai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praise that Lord, who reaches out and gives sustenance to all beings and creatures. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਤੂ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਤਿਖਾ ਹੈ ਕਿਤੁ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: chaatirak too na jaanahee kiaa tudh vich tikhaa hai kit peetai tikh jai ||
verses.translation: O rainbird, you do not know what thirst is within you, or what you can drink to quench it.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਰੰਮਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai bhara(n)miaa a(n)mirat jal palai na pai ||
verses.translation: You wander in the love of duality, and you do not obtain the Ambrosial Water.

verses.original: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: nadhar kare je aapanee taa(n) satigur milai subhai ||
verses.translation: When God casts His Glance of Grace, then the mortal automatically meets the True Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak satigur te a(n)mirat jal paiaa sahaje rahiaa samai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Ambrosial Water is obtained from the True Guru, and then the mortal remains merged in the Lord with intuitive ease. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਵਣ ਖੰਡਿ ਬੈਸਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਸਦੁ ਨ ਦੇਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik van kha(n)dd baiseh jai sadh na dhevahee ||
verses.translation: Some go and sit in the forest realms, and do not answer any calls.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਪਾਲਾ ਕਕਰੁ ਭੰਨਿ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਜਲੁ ਹੇਂਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik paalaa kakar bha(n)n seetal jal he(n)vahee ||
verses.translation: Some, in the dead of winter, break the ice and immerse themselves in freezing water.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਭਸਮ ਚੜੑਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਧੋਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik bhasam chaR(h)aaveh a(n)g mail na dhovahee ||
verses.translation: Some rub ashes on their bodies, and never wash off their dirt.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਜਟਾ ਬਿਕਟ ਬਿਕਰਾਲ ਕੁਲੁ ਘਰੁ ਖੋਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik jaTaa bikaT bikaraal kul ghar khovahee ||
verses.translation: Some look hideous, with their uncut hair matted and dishevelled. They bring dishonor to their family and ancestry.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਨਗਨ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਨਂੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik nagan fireh dhin raat na(n)eedh na sovahee ||
verses.translation: Some wander naked day and night and never sleep.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਜਲਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਗੁ ਆਪੁ ਵਿਗੋਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: eik agan jalaaveh a(n)g aap vigovahee ||
verses.translation: Some burn their limbs in fire, damaging and ruining themselves.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਿ ਰੋਵਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai tan chhaar kiaa keh rovahee ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, the body is reduced to ashes; what good is it to speak and cry then?

verses.original: ਸੋਹਨਿ ਖਸਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹੀ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: sohan khasam dhuaar j satigur sevahee ||15||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru, are embellished and exalted in the Court of their Lord and Master. ||15||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲੈ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਦਰਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: baabeehaa a(n)mirat velai boliaa taa(n) dhar sunee pukaar ||
verses.translation: The rainbird chirps in the ambrosial hours of the morning before the dawn; its prayers are heard in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮੇਘੈ ਨੋ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਵਰਸਹੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: meghai no furamaan hoaa varasahu kirapaa dhaar ||
verses.translation: The order is issued to the clouds, to let the rains of mercy shower down.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: hau tin kai balihaaranai jinee sach rakhiaa ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to those who enshrine the True Lord within their hearts.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਭ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naame sabh hareeaavalee gur kai sabadh veechaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Name, all are rejuvenated, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਾਬੀਹਾ ਇਵ ਤੇਰੀ ਤਿਖਾ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: baabeehaa iv teree tikhaa na utarai je sau kareh pukaar ||
verses.translation: O rainbird, this is not the way to quench your thirst, even though you may cry out a hundred times.

verses.original: ਨਦਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਦਰੀ ਉਪਜੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: nadharee satigur paieeaai nadharee upajai piaar ||
verses.translation: By God's Grace, the True Guru is found; by His Grace, love wells up.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak saahib man vasai vichahu jaeh vikaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when the Lord and Master abides in the mind, corruption and evil leave from within. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਜੈਨੀ ਉਝੜ ਪਾਇ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਖੁਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eik jainee ujhaR pai dhurahu khuaaiaa ||
verses.translation: Some are Jains, wasting their time in the wilderness; by their pre-ordained destiny, they are ruined.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨੑਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin mukh naahee naam na teerath n(h)aiaa ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is not on their lips; they do not bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਹਥੀ ਸਿਰ ਖੋਹਾਇ ਨ ਭਦੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hathee sir khohai na bhadh karaiaa ||
verses.translation: They pull out their hair with their hands, instead of shaving.

verses.original: ਕੁਚਿਲ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kuchil raheh dhin raat sabadh na bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: They remain unclean day and night; they do not love the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਤਿ ਨ ਕਰਮੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin jaat na pat na karam janam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: They have no status, no honor, and no good karma. They waste away their lives in vain.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਜੂਠੈ ਵੇਜਾਤਿ ਜੂਠਾ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man jooThai vejaat jooThaa khaiaa ||
verses.translation: Their minds are false and impure; that which they eat is impure and defiled.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਆਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin sabadhai aachaar na kin hee paiaa ||
verses.translation: Without the Shabad, no one achieves a lifestyle of good conduct.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: gurmukh oa(n)kaar sach samaiaa ||16||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is absorbed in the True Lord God, the Universal Creator. ||16||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਸਰਸੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: saavan sarasee kaamanee gur sabadhee veechaar ||
verses.translation: In the month of Saawan, the bride is happy, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sadhaa suhaaganee gur kai het apaar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she is a happy soul-bride forever; her love for the Guru is unlimited. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਦਝੈ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: saavan dhajhai gun baaharee jis dhoojai bhai piaar ||
verses.translation: In Saawan, she who has no virtue is burned, in attachment and love of duality.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਸਭੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak pir kee saar na jaaniee sabh seegaar khuaar ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she does not appreciate the value of her Husband Lord; all her decorations are worthless. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ਹਠਿ ਨ ਪਤੀਜਈ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa alakh abheau haTh na pateejiee ||
verses.translation: The True, Unseen, Mysterious Lord is not won over by stubbornness.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਗ ਪਰੀਆ ਰਾਗਿ ਨ ਭੀਜਈ ॥
verses.translit: eik gaaveh raag pareeaa raag na bheejiee ||
verses.translation: Some sing according to traditional ragas, but the Lord is not pleased by these ragas.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਨਚਿ ਨਚਿ ਪੂਰਹਿ ਤਾਲ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਜਈ ॥
verses.translit: eik nach nach pooreh taal bhagat na keejiee ||
verses.translation: Some dance and dance and keep the beat, but they do not worship Him with devotion.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜਈ ॥
verses.translit: eik a(n)n na khaeh moorakh tinaa kiaa keejiee ||
verses.translation: Some refuse to eat; what can be done with these fools?

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਹੋਈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਕਿਵੈ ਨ ਧੀਜਈ ॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa hoiee bahut kivai na dheejiee ||
verses.translation: Thirst and desire have greatly increased; nothing brings satisfaction.

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਵਧਹਿ ਕੈ ਲੋਅ ਖਪਿ ਮਰੀਜਈ ॥
verses.translit: karam vadheh kai loa khap mareejiee ||
verses.translation: Some are tied down by rituals; they hassle themselves to death.

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜਈ ॥
verses.translit: laahaa naam sa(n)saar a(n)mrit peejiee ||
verses.translation: In this world, profit comes by drinking in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਅਸਨੇਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘੀਜਈ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: har bhagatee asaneh gurmukh gheejiee ||17||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs gather in loving devotional worship of the Lord. ||17||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਲਾਰ ਰਾਗੁ ਜੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh malaar raag jo kareh tin man tan seetal hoi ||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who sing in the Raga of Malaar - their minds and bodies become cool and calm.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee ek pachhaaniaa eko sachaa soi ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they realize the One, the One True Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan sachaa sach man sache sachee soi ||
verses.translation: Their minds and bodies are true; they obey the True Lord, and they are known as true.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar sachee bhagat hai sahaje hee pat hoi ||
verses.translation: True devotional worship is deep within them; they are automatically blessed with honor.

verses.original: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਰਾਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kalijug meh ghor a(n)dhaar hai manmukh raahu na koi ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, there is utter darkness; the self-willed manmukh cannot find the way.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: se vaddabhaagee naanakaa jin gurmukh paragaT hoi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, very blessed are those Gurmukhs, unto whom the Lord is revealed. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa teejaa ||
verses.translation: Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਉਪਜੈ ਚਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ei(n)dh varasai kar dhiaa lokaa(n) man upajai chaau ||
verses.translation: The clouds rain down mercifully, and joy wells up in the minds of the people.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸਦਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਂਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis kai hukam i(n)dh varasadhaa tis kai sadh balihaarai jaa(n)au ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to the One, by whose Command the clouds burst forth with rain.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sabadh sam(h)aaleeaai sache ke gun gaau ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs dwell on the Word of the Shabad. They sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate jan niramale sahaje sach samaau ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those humble beings who are imbued with the Naam are pure and immaculate. They are intuitively merged in the True Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: pooraa satigur sev pooraa paiaa ||
verses.translation: Serving the Perfect True Guru, I have found the Perfect Lord.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: poorai karam dhiaai pooraa sabadh ma(n)n vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Perfect Lord, by perfect karma, I have enshrined the Shabad within my mind.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: poorai giaan dhiaan mail chukaiaa ||
verses.translation: Through perfect spiritual wisdom and meditation, my filth has been washed away.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har sar teerath jaan manooaa naiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is my sacred shrine of pilgrimage and pool of purification; I wash my mind in Him.

verses.original: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabadh marai man maar dha(n)n janedhee maiaa ||
verses.translation: One who dies in the Shabad and conquers his mind - blessed is the mother who gave birth to him.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhar sachai sachiaar sachaa aaiaa ||
verses.translation: He is true in the Court of the Lord, and his coming into this world is judged to be true.

verses.original: ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ਜਾਂ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: puchh na sakai koi jaa(n) khasamai bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: No one can challenge that person, with whom our Lord and Master is pleased.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: naanak sach salaeh likhiaa paiaa ||18||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praising the True Lord, his pre-ordained destiny is activated. ||18||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੁਲਹਾਂ ਦੇਂਦੇ ਬਾਵਲੇ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਵਡੇ ਨਿਲਜ ॥
verses.translit: kulahaa(n) dhe(n)dhe baavale lai(n)dhe vadde nilaj ||
verses.translation: Those who give out ceremonial hats of recognition are fools; those who receive them have no shame.

verses.original: ਚੂਹਾ ਖਡ ਨ ਮਾਵਈ ਤਿਕਲਿ ਬੰਨੑੈ ਛਜ ॥
verses.translit: choohaa khadd na maaviee tikal ba(n)n(h)ai chhaj ||
verses.translation: The mouse cannot enter its hole with a basket tied around its waist.

verses.original: ਦੇਨਿੑ ਦੁਆਈ ਸੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਦੇਨਿ ਸਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dheni(h) dhuaaiee se mareh jin kau dhen s jaeh ||
verses.translation: Those who give out blessings shall die, and those that they bless shall also depart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak hukam na jaapiee kithai jai samaeh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, no one knows the Lord's Command, by which all must depart.

verses.original: ਫਸਲਿ ਅਹਾੜੀ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਵਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: fasal ahaaRee ek naam saavanee sach naau ||
verses.translation: The spring harvest is the Name of the One Lord; the harvest of autumn is the True Name.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮਹਦੂਦੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ਖਸਮੈ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mai mahadhoodh likhaiaa khasamai kai dhar jai ||
verses.translation: I receive a letter of pardon from my Lord and Master, when I reach His Court.

verses.original: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੇ ਦਰ ਕੇਤੜੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhuneeaa ke dhar ketaRe kete aaveh jaa(n)h ||
verses.translation: There are so many courts of the world, and so many who come and go there.

verses.original: ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਗਹਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kete ma(n)geh ma(n)gate kete ma(n)g ma(n)g jaeh ||1||
verses.translation: There are so many beggars begging; so many beg and beg until death. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਉ ਮਣੁ ਹਸਤੀ ਘਿਉ ਗੁੜੁ ਖਾਵੈ ਪੰਜਿ ਸੈ ਦਾਣਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sau man hasatee ghiau guR khaavai pa(n)j sai dhaanaa khai ||
verses.translation: The elephant eats a hundred pounds of ghee and molasses, and five hundred pounds of corn.

verses.original: ਡਕੈ ਫੂਕੈ ਖੇਹ ਉਡਾਵੈ ਸਾਹਿ ਗਇਐ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ddakai fookai kheh uddaavai saeh giaai pachhutai ||
verses.translation: He belches and grunts and scatters dust, and when the breath leaves his body, he regrets it.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੀ ਫੂਕਿ ਮੁਈ ਦੇਵਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhee fook muiee dhevaanee ||
verses.translation: The blind and arrogant die insane.

verses.original: ਖਸਮਿ ਮਿਟੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਭਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: khasam miTee fir bhaanee ||
verses.translation: Submitting to the Lord, one become pleasing to Him.

verses.original: ਅਧੁ ਗੁਲ੍ਹਾ ਚਿੜੀ ਕਾ ਚੁਗਣੁ ਗੈਣਿ ਚੜੀ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: adh gulhaa chiRee kaa chugan gain chaRee bilalai ||
verses.translation: The sparrow eats only half a grain, then it flies through the sky and chirps.

verses.original: ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਓਹਾ ਚੰਗੀ ਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khasamai bhaavai ohaa cha(n)gee j kare khudhai khudhai ||
verses.translation: The good sparrow is pleasing to her Lord and Master, if she chirps the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਕਤਾ ਸੀਹੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੈ ਮਿਰਿਆ ਸਭ ਪਿਛੈ ਪੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sakataa seeh maare sai miriaa sabh pichhai pai khai ||
verses.translation: The powerful tiger kills hundreds of deer, and all sorts of other animals eat what it leaves.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਸਤਾਣਾ ਘੁਰੈ ਨ ਮਾਵੈ ਸਾਹਿ ਗਇਐ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hoi sataanaa ghurai na maavai saeh giaai pachhutai ||
verses.translation: It becomes very strong, and cannot be contained in its den, but when it must go, it regrets.

verses.original: ਅੰਧਾ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਬੁਕਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhaa kis no buk sunaavai ||
verses.translation: So who is impressed by the roar of the blind beast?

verses.original: ਖਸਮੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: khasamai mool na bhaavai ||
verses.translation: He is not pleasing at all to his Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਅਕ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਕ ਤਿਡਾ ਅਕ ਡਾਲੀ ਬਹਿ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ak siau preet kare ak tiddaa ak ddaalee beh khai ||
verses.translation: The insect loves the milkweed plant; perched on its branch, it eats it.

verses.original: ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਓਹੋ ਚੰਗਾ ਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khasamai bhaavai oho cha(n)gaa j kare khudhai khudhai ||
verses.translation: It becomes good and pleasing to its Lord and Master, if it chirps the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਚਾਰਿ ਦਿਹਾੜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਕੀਤੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak dhuneeaa chaar dhihaaRe sukh keetai dhukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the world lasts for only a few days; indulging in pleasures, pain is produced.

verses.original: ਗਲਾ ਵਾਲੇ ਹੈਨਿ ਘਣੇਰੇ ਛਡਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: galaa vaale hain ghanere chhadd na sakai koiee ||
verses.translation: There are many who boast and brag, but none of them can remain detached from the world.

verses.original: ਮਖਂੀ ਮਿਠੈ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: makha(n)ee miThai maranaa ||
verses.translation: The fly dies for the sake of sweets.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਰਖਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਨ ਭਉ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin too rakheh tin neR na aavai tin bhau saagar taranaa ||2||
verses.translation: O Lord, death does not even approach those whom You protect. You carry them across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਤੂ ਧਣੀ ਸਚਾ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar too dhanee sachaa alakh apaar ||
verses.translation: You are Inaccessible and Unfathomable, O Invisible and Infinite True Lord Master.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਿ ਮੰਗਤੇ ਇਕੋ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: too dhaataa sabh ma(n)gate iko dhevanahaar ||
verses.translation: You are the Giver, all are beggars of You. You alone are the Great Giver.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jinee seviaa tinee sukh paiaa gurmatee veechaar ||
verses.translation: Those who serve You find peace, reflecting on the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਨੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵਦਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa no tudh evai bhaavadhaa maiaa naal piaar ||
verses.translation: Some, according to Your Will, are in love with Maya.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh salaaheeaai a(n)tar prem piaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, praise the Lord with love and affection within.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: vin preetee bhagat na hoviee vin satigur na lagai piaar ||
verses.translation: Without love, there is no devotion. Without the True Guru, love is not enshrined.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਇਕ ਢਾਢੀ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: too prabh sabh tudh sevadhe ik ddaaddee kare pukaar ||
verses.translation: You are the Lord God; everyone serves You. This is the prayer of Your humble minstrel.

verses.original: ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆ ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: dheh dhaan sa(n)tokheeaa sachaa naam milai aadhaar ||19||
verses.translation: Please bless me with the gift of contentment, that I may receive the True Name as my Support. ||19||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਤੀ ਕਾਲੁ ਘਟੈ ਦਿਨਿ ਕਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: raatee kaal ghaTai dhin kaal ||
verses.translation: Through the night the time ticks away; through the day the time ticks away.

verses.original: ਛਿਜੈ ਕਾਇਆ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: chhijai kaiaa hoi paraal ||
verses.translation: The body wears away and turns to straw.

verses.original: ਵਰਤਣਿ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: varatan varatiaa sarab ja(n)jaal ||
verses.translation: All are involved and entangled in worldly entanglements.

verses.original: ਭੁਲਿਆ ਚੁਕਿ ਗਇਆ ਤਪ ਤਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhuliaa chuk giaa tap taal ||
verses.translation: The mortal has mistakenly renounced the way of service.

verses.original: ਅੰਧਾ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਪਇਆ ਝੇਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhaa jhakh jhakh piaa jher ||
verses.translation: The blind fool is caught in conflict, bothered and bewildered.

verses.original: ਪਿਛੈ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਲਿਆਵਹਿ ਫੇਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: pichhai roveh liaaveh fer ||
verses.translation: Those who weep after someone has died - can they bring him back to life?

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin boojhe kichh soojhai naahee ||
verses.translation: Without realization, nothing can be understood.

verses.original: ਮੋਇਆ ਰੋਂਹਿ ਰੋਂਦੇ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਂਹਂੀ ॥
verses.translit: moiaa ro(n)h ro(n)dhe mar jaa(n)ha(n)ee ||
verses.translation: The weepers who weep for the dead shall themselves die as well.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੈ ਏਵੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak khasamai evai bhaavai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this is the Will of our Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਸੇਈ ਮੁਏ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: seiee mue jin chit na aavai ||1||
verses.translation: Those who do not remember the Lord, are dead. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੁਆ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮੁਈ ਮੁਆ ਵੈਰੁ ਵਾਦੀ ॥
verses.translit: muaa piaar preet muiee muaa vair vaadhee ||
verses.translation: Love dies, and affection dies; hatred and strife die.

verses.original: ਵੰਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਰੂਪੁ ਵਿਣਸਿਆ ਦੁਖੀ ਦੇਹ ਰੁਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: va(n)n giaa roop vinasiaa dhukhee dheh rulee ||
verses.translation: The color fades, and beauty vanishes; the body suffers and collapses.

verses.original: ਕਿਥਹੁ ਆਇਆ ਕਹ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਹੁ ਨ ਸੀਓ ਕਿਹੁ ਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: kithahu aaiaa keh giaa kih na seeo kih see ||
verses.translation: Where did he come from? Where is he going? Did he exist or not?

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਲਾ ਗੋਈਆ ਕੀਤਾ ਚਾਉ ਰਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: man mukh galaa goieeaa keetaa chaau ralee ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh made empty boasts, indulging in parties and pleasures.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਰ ਖੁਰ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਟੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sache naam bin sir khur pat paaTee ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, his honor is torn away, from head to foot. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam sadhaa sukhadhaataa a(n)te hoi sakhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is forever the Giver of peace. It shall be your Help and Support in the end.

verses.original: ਬਾਝੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਉਰਾਨਾ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: baajh guroo jagat bauraanaa naavai saar na paiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the world is insane. It does not appreciate the worth of the Name.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨੑ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur seveh se paravaan jin(h) jotee jot milaiee ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru are accepted and approved. Their light merges into the Light.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਤੇਹਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: so saahib so sevak tehaa jis bhaanaa ma(n)n vasaiee ||
verses.translation: That servant who enshrines the Lord's Will within his mind, becomes just like his Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅੰਧਾ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aapanai bhaanai kahu kin sukh paiaa a(n)dhaa a(n)dh kamaiee ||
verses.translation: Tell me, who has ever found peace by following his own will? The blind act in blindness.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਹੀ ਰਜੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa kadhe hee rajai naahee moorakh bhukh na jaiee ||
verses.translation: No one is ever satisfied and fulfilled by evil and corruption. The hunger of the fool is not satisfied.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਲਗਿ ਵਿਗੁਤਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai sabh ko lag vigutaa bin satigur boojh na paiee ||
verses.translation: Attached to duality, all are ruined; without the True Guru, there is no understanding.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: satigur seve so sukh paae jis no kirapaa kare rajaiee ||20||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru find peace; they are blessed with Grace by the Will of the Lord. ||20||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੇ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saram dharam dhui naanakaa je dhan palai pai ||
verses.translation: Modesty and righteousness both, O Nanak, are qualities of those who are blessed with true wealth.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਚੋਟਾਂ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: so dhan mitr na kaa(n)ddeeaai jit sir choTaa(n) khai ||
verses.translation: Do not refer to that wealth as your friend, which leads you to get your head beaten.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪਲੈ ਧਨੁ ਵਸੈ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਫਕੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: jin kai palai dhan vasai tin kaa naau fakeer ||
verses.translation: Those who possess only this worldly wealth are known as paupers.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤੂ ਵਸਹਿ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin(h) kai hiradhai too vaseh te nar gunee gaheer ||1||
verses.translation: But those, within whose hearts You dwell, O Lord - those people are oceans of virtue. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੁਖੀ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਹੇੜੀਐ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਲਗਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: dhukhee dhunee saheReeaai jai ta lageh dhukh ||
verses.translation: Worldly possessions are obtained by pain and suffering; when they are gone, they leave pain and suffering.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਲਥੀ ਭੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: naanak sache naam bin kisai na lathee bhukh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, hunger is never satisfied.

verses.original: ਰੂਪੀ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜਾਂ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਤਾਂ ਭੁਖ ॥
verses.translit: roopee bhukh na utarai jaa(n) dhekhaa(n) taa(n) bhukh ||
verses.translation: Beauty does not satisfy hunger; when the man sees beauty, he hungers even more.

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਰਸ ਸਰੀਰ ਕੇ ਤੇਤੇ ਲਗਹਿ ਦੁਖ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jete ras sareer ke tete lageh dhukh ||2||
verses.translation: As many as are the pleasures of the body, so many are the pains which afflict it. ||2||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਧੀ ਕੰਮੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਧੈ ਤਨੁ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhee ka(n)mee a(n)dh man man a(n)dhai tan a(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Acting blindly, the mind becomes blind. The blind mind makes the body blind.

verses.original: ਚਿਕੜਿ ਲਾਇਐ ਕਿਆ ਥੀਐ ਜਾਂ ਤੁਟੈ ਪਥਰ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: chikaR laiaai kiaa theeaai jaa(n) tuTai pathar ba(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Why make a dam with mud and plaster? Even a dam made of stones gives way.

verses.original: ਬੰਧੁ ਤੁਟਾ ਬੇੜੀ ਨਹੀ ਨਾ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਨਾ ਹਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dh tuTaa beRee nahee naa tulahaa naa haath ||
verses.translation: The dam has burst. There is no boat. There is no raft. The water's depth is unfathomable.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਕੇਤੇ ਡੁਬੇ ਸਾਥ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak sache naam vin kete ddube saath ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, many multitudes have drowned. ||3||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਖ ਮਣ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਲਖ ਮਣ ਰੁਪਾ ਲਖ ਸਾਹਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: lakh man suinaa lakh man rupaa lakh saahaa sir saeh ||
verses.translation: Thousands of pounds of gold, and thousands of pounds of silver; the king over the heads of thousands of kings.

verses.original: ਲਖ ਲਸਕਰ ਲਖ ਵਾਜੇ ਨੇਜੇ ਲਖੀ ਘੋੜੀ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: lakh lasakar lakh vaaje neje lakhee ghoRee paatisaeh ||
verses.translation: Thousands of armies, thousands of marching bands and spearmen; the emperor of thousands of horsemen.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਸਾਇਰੁ ਲੰਘਣਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਸਗਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: jithai sair la(n)ghanaa agan paanee asagaeh ||
verses.translation: The unfathomable ocean of fire and water must be crossed.

verses.original: ਕੰਧੀ ਦਿਸਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਧਾਹੀ ਪਵੈ ਕਹਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)dhee dhis na aaviee dhaahee pavai kahaeh ||
verses.translation: The other shore cannot be seen; only the roar of pitiful cries can be heard.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਓਥੈ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਸਾਹ ਕੇਈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak othai jaane'eeh saeh keiee paatisaeh ||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, there, it shall be known, whether anyone is a king or an emperor. ||4||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਗਲੀਂ ਜੰਜੀਰ ਬੰਦਿ ਰਬਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa galee(n) ja(n)jeer ba(n)dh rabaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: Some have chains around their necks, in bondage to the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਧੇ ਛੁਟਹਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: badhe chhuTeh sach sach pachhaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: They are released from bondage, realizing the True Lord as True.

verses.original: ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: likhiaa palai pai so sach jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: One whose pre-ordained destiny is activated, comes to know the True Lord.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee hoi nibeR giaa jaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: By God's Command, it is ordained. When the mortal goes, he knows.

verses.original: ਭਉਜਲ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: bhaujal taaranahaar sabadh pachhaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: Realize the Word of the Shabad, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਚੋਰ ਜਾਰ ਜੂਆਰ ਪੀੜੇ ਘਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: chor jaar jooaar peeRe ghaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: Thieves, adulterers and gamblers are pressed like seeds in the mill.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਹੜੑਵਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak laitabaar mile haR(h)vaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: Slanderers and gossipers are hand-cuffed.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਸੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sach samai su dharageh jaaneeaai ||21||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is absorbed in the True Lord, and is famous in the Court of the Lord. ||21||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਫਕੀਰੈ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਮੂਰਖ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naau fakeerai paatisaahu moorakh pa(n)ddit naau ||
verses.translation: The beggar is known as an emperor, and the fool is known as a religious scholar.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੇ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਏਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhe kaa naau paarakhoo evai kare guaau ||
verses.translation: The blind man is known as a seer; this is how people talk.

verses.original: ਇਲਤਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਚਉਧਰੀ ਕੂੜੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eilat kaa naau chaudharee kooRee poore thaau ||
verses.translation: The trouble-maker is called a leader, and the liar is seated with honor.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਕਲਿ ਕਾ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਆਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh jaaneeaai kal kaa eh niaau ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs know that this is justice in the Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਣਾਂ ਬਾਜਾਂ ਤੈ ਸਿਕਦਾਰਾਂ ਏਨੑਾ ਪੜਿੑਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: haranaa(n) baajaa(n) tai sikadhaaraa(n) en(h)aa paRi(h)aa naau ||
verses.translation: Deer, falcons and government officials are known to be trained and clever.

verses.original: ਫਾਂਧੀ ਲਗੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਫਹਾਇਨਿ ਅਗੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: faa(n)dhee lagee jaat fahain agai naahee thaau ||
verses.translation: When the trap is set, they trap their own kind; hereafter they will find no place of rest.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: so paRiaa so pa(n)ddit beenaa jin(h)ee kamaanaa naau ||
verses.translation: He alone is learned and wise, and he alone is a scholar, who practices the Name.

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲੋ ਦੇ ਜੜ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਤਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਛਾਂਉ ॥
verses.translit: pahilo dhe jaR a(n)dhar ja(n)mai taa upar hovai chhaa(n)au ||
verses.translation: First, the tree puts down its roots, and then it spreads out its shade above.

verses.original: ਰਾਜੇ ਸੀਹ ਮੁਕਦਮ ਕੁਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: raaje seeh mukadham kute ||
verses.translation: The kings are tigers, and their officials are dogs;

verses.original: ਜਾਇ ਜਗਾਇਨਿੑ ਬੈਠੇ ਸੁਤੇ ॥
