verses.translit: jai jagaini(h) baiThe sute ||
verses.translation: they go out and awaken the sleeping people to harass them.

verses.original: ਚਾਕਰ ਨਹਦਾ ਪਾਇਨਿੑ ਘਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chaakar nahadhaa paini(h) ghaau ||
verses.translation: The public servants inflict wounds with their nails.

verses.original: ਰਤੁ ਪਿਤੁ ਕੁਤਿਹੋ ਚਟਿ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: rat pit kutiho chaT jaahu ||
verses.translation: The dogs lick up the blood that is spilled.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਜੀਆਂ ਹੋਸੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jithai jeeaa(n) hosee saar ||
verses.translation: But there, in the Court of the Lord, all beings will be judged.

verses.original: ਨਕਂੀ ਵਢਂੀ ਲਾਇਤਬਾਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naka(n)ee vadda(n)ee laitabaar ||2||
verses.translation: Those who have violated the people's trust will be disgraced; their noses will be cut off. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਮੇਦਨੀ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਦਾ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: aap upaae medhanee aape karadhaa saar ||
verses.translation: He Himself creates the world, and He himself takes care of it.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਕਟੀਐ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bin bharam na kaTeeaai naam na lagai piaar ||
verses.translation: Without the Fear of God, doubt is not dispelled, and love for the Name is not embraced.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਭਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te bhau uoopajai paieeaai mokh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: Through the True Guru, the Fear of God wells up, and the Door of Salvation is found.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: bhai te sahaj paieeaai mil jotee jot apaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Fear of God, intuitive ease is obtained, and one's light merges into the Light of the Infinite.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਭੈਜਲੁ ਲੰਘੀਐ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhai te bhaijal la(n)gheeaai gurmatee veechaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Fear of God, the terrifying world-ocean is crossed over, reflecting on the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhai te nirabhau paieeaai jis dhaa a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
verses.translation: Through the Fear of God, the Fearless Lord is found; He has no end or limitation.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭੈ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh bhai kee saar na jaananee tirasanaa jalate kareh pukaar ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not appreciate the value of the Fear of God. Burning in desire, they weep and wail.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰ ॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naavai hee te sukh paiaa gurmatee ur dhaar ||22||
verses.translation: O Nanak, through the Name, peace is obtained, by enshrining the Guru's Teachings within the heart. ||22||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੂਪੈ ਕਾਮੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਭੁਖੈ ਸਾਦੈ ਗੰਢੁ ॥
verses.translit: roopai kaamai dhosatee bhukhai saadhai ga(n)dd ||
verses.translation: Beauty and sexual desire are friends; hunger and tasty food are tied together.

verses.original: ਲਬੈ ਮਾਲੈ ਘੁਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਿਚਲਿ ਊਂਘੈ ਸਉੜਿ ਪਲੰਘੁ ॥
verses.translit: labai maalai ghul mil michal uoo(n)ghai sauR pala(n)gh ||
verses.translation: Greed is bound up in its search for wealth, and sleep will use even a tiny space as a bed.

verses.original: ਭੰਉਕੈ ਕੋਪੁ ਖੁਆਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਫਕੜੁ ਪਿਟੇ ਅੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: bha(n)aukai kop khuaar hoi fakaR piTe a(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Anger barks and brings ruin on itself, blindly pursuing useless conflicts.

verses.original: ਚੁਪੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਗੰਧੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chupai cha(n)gaa naanakaa vin naavai muh ga(n)dh ||1||
verses.translation: It is good to be silent, O Nanak; without the Name, one's mouth spews forth only filth. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਪੰਜੇ ਠਗ ॥
verses.translit: raaj maal roop jaat joban pa(n)je Thag ||
verses.translation: Royal power, wealth, beauty, social status and youth are the five thieves.

verses.original: ਏਨੀ ਠਗੀਂ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਆ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਰਖੀ ਲਜ ॥
verses.translit: enee Thagee(n) jag Thagiaa kinai na rakhee laj ||
verses.translation: These thieves have plundered the world; no one's honor has been spared.

verses.original: ਏਨਾ ਠਗਨਿੑ ਠਗ ਸੇ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: enaa Thagani(h) Thag se j gur kee pairee paeh ||
verses.translation: But these thieves themselves are robbed, by those who fall at the Guru's Feet.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮਾ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਹੋਰਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਮੁਠੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak karamaa baahare hor kete muThe jaeh ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the multitudes who do not have good karma are plundered. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਪੜਿਆ ਲੇਖੇਦਾਰੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: paRiaa lekhedhaar lekhaa ma(n)geeaai ||
verses.translation: The learned and educated are called to account for their actions.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ਅਉਖਾ ਤੰਗੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: vin naavai kooRiaar aaukhaa ta(n)geeaai ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, they are judged false; they become miserable and suffer hardship.

verses.original: ਅਉਘਟ ਰੁਧੇ ਰਾਹ ਗਲੀਆਂ ਰੋਕੀਆਂ ॥
verses.translit: aaughaT rudhe raeh galeeaa(n) rokeeaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Their path becomes treacherous and difficult, and their way is blocked.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa veparavaahu sabadh sa(n)tokheeaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Through the Shabad, the Word of the True and Independent Lord God, one becomes content.

verses.original: ਗਹਿਰ ਗਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਹਾਥ ਨ ਲਭਈ ॥
verses.translit: gahir gabheer athaahu haath na labhiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord is deep and profound and unfathomable; His depth cannot be measured.

verses.original: ਮੁਹੇ ਮੁਹਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਹੁ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਛੁਟਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: muhe muh choTaa khaahu vin gur koi na chhuTasee ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, the mortals are beaten and punched in the face and the mouth, and no one is released.

verses.original: ਪਤਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ॥
verses.translit: pat setee ghar jaahu naam vakhaaneeaai ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one returns to his true home with honor.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਾਹ ਗਿਰਾਹ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: hukamee saeh giraeh dhe(n)dhaa jaaneeaai ||23||
verses.translation: Know that the Lord, by the Hukam of His Command, gives sustenance and the breath of life. ||23||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਉਣੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਅਗਨੀ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਆ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕਿਆ ਪੀੜ ॥
verses.translit: paunai paanee aganee jeeau tin kiaa khuseeaa kiaa peeR ||
verses.translation: Living beings are formed of air, water and fire. They are subject to pleasure and pain.

verses.original: ਧਰਤੀ ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਇਕਿ ਦਰਿ ਰਹਨਿ ਵਜੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: dharatee paataalee aakaasee ik dhar rahan vajeer ||
verses.translation: In this world, in the nether regions of the underworld, and in the Akaashic ethers of the heavens, some remain ministers in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਇਕਨਾ ਵਡੀ ਆਰਜਾ ਇਕਿ ਮਰਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਜਹੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: eikanaa vaddee aarajaa ik mar hoh jaheer ||
verses.translation: Some live long lives, while others suffer and die.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਦੇ ਖਾਹਿ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਕਿ ਸਦਾ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਫਕੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhe khaeh nikhuTai naahee ik sadhaa fireh fakeer ||
verses.translation: Some give and consume, and still their wealth is not exhausted, while others remain poor forever.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਾਜੇ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਢਾਹੇ ਏਕ ਚਸੇ ਮਹਿ ਲਖ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee saaje hukamee ddaahe ek chase meh lakh ||
verses.translation: In His Will He creates, and in His Will He destroys thousands in an instant.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਨਥੈ ਨਥਿਆ ਬਖਸੇ ਤੋੜੇ ਨਥ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko nathai nathiaa bakhase toRe nath ||
verses.translation: He has harnessed everyone with His harness; when He forgives, he breaks the harness.

verses.original: ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਲੇਖੇ ਬਾਝੁ ਅਲਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: varanaa chihanaa baaharaa lekhe baajh alakh ||
verses.translation: He has no color or features; He is invisible and beyond calculation.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਕਥੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਾਪੈ ਸਚੋ ਸਚੁ ॥
verses.translit: kiau katheeaai kiau aakheeaai jaapai sacho sach ||
verses.translation: How can He be described? He is known as the Truest of the True.

verses.original: ਕਰਣਾ ਕਥਨਾ ਕਾਰ ਸਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਅਕਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: karanaa kathanaa kaar sabh naanak aap akath ||
verses.translation: All the actions which are done and described, O Nanak, are done by the Indescribable Lord Himself.

verses.original: ਅਕਥ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: akath kee kathaa sunei ||
verses.translation: Whoever hears the description of the indescribable,

verses.original: ਰਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ridh budh sidh giaan sadhaa sukh hoi ||1||
verses.translation: is blessed with wealth, intelligence, perfection, spiritual wisdom and eternal peace. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ਤ ਨਉ ਕੁਲ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: ajar jarai ta nau kul ba(n)dh ||
verses.translation: One who bears the unbearable, controls the nine holes of the body.

verses.original: ਪੂਜੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਹੋਵੈ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੰਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: poojai praan hovai thir ka(n)dh ||
verses.translation: One who worships and adores the Lord with his breath of life, gains stability in his body-wall.

verses.original: ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਆਇਆ ਕਹਾਂ ਏਹੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa(n) te aaiaa kahaa(n) eh jaan ||
verses.translation: Where has he come from, and where will he go?

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਤ ਰਹੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat marat rahai paravaan ||
verses.translation: Remaining dead while yet alive, he is accepted and approved.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: hukamai boojhai tat pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: Whoever understands the Hukam of the Lord's Command, realizes the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਪਰਸਾਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih parasaadh guroo te jaanai ||
verses.translation: This is known by Guru's Grace.

verses.original: ਹੋਂਦਾ ਫੜੀਅਗੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: ho(n)dhaa faReeag naanak jaan ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, know this: egotism leads to bondage.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naa hau naa mai joonee paan ||2||
verses.translation: Only those who have no ego and no self-conceit, are not consigned to reincarnation. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਪੜੑੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਲਾਹ ਹੋਰਿ ਬੁਧਂੀ ਮਿਥਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: paR(h)eeaai naam saalaeh hor budha(n)ee mithiaa ||
verses.translation: Read the Praise of the Lord's Name; other intellectual pursuits are false.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਚੇ ਵਾਪਾਰ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਿਰਥਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin sache vaapaar janam birathiaa ||
verses.translation: Without dealing in Truth, life is worthless.

verses.original: ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t na paaraavaar na kin hee paiaa ||
verses.translation: No one has ever found the Lord's end or limitation.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਗਰਬਿ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਸਚੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jag garab gubaar tin sach na bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: All the world is enveloped by the darkness of egotistical pride. It does not like the Truth.

verses.original: ਚਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਤਾਵਣਿ ਤਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: chale naam visaar taavan tatiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who depart from this world, forgetting the Naam, shall be roasted in the frying pan.

verses.original: ਬਲਦੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੇਲੁ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਘਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: baladhee a(n)dhar tel dhubidhaa ghatiaa ||
verses.translation: They pour the oil of duality within, and burn.

verses.original: ਆਇਆ ਉਠੀ ਖੇਲੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਉਵਤਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aaiaa uThee khel firai uvatiaa ||
verses.translation: They come into the world and wander around aimlessly; they depart when the play is finished.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੈ ਮੇਲੁ ਸਚੈ ਰਤਿਆ ॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: naanak sachai mel sachai ratiaa ||24||
verses.translation: O Nanak, imbued with Truth, the mortals merge in Truth. ||24||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਨਿੰਮਿਆ ਮਾਸੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: pahilaa(n) maasahu ni(n)miaa maasai a(n)dhar vaas ||
verses.translation: First, the mortal is conceived in the flesh, and then he dwells in the flesh.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ ਮਾਸੁ ਮੁਹਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਡੁ ਚੰਮੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pai maas muh miliaa hadd cha(n)m tan maas ||
verses.translation: When he comes alive, his mouth takes flesh; his bones, skin and body are flesh.

verses.original: ਮਾਸਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਢਿਆ ਮੰਮਾ ਮਾਸੁ ਗਿਰਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: maasahu baahar kaddiaa ma(n)maa maas giraas ||
verses.translation: He comes out of the womb of flesh, and takes a mouthful of flesh at the breast.

verses.original: ਮੁਹੁ ਮਾਸੈ ਕਾ ਜੀਭ ਮਾਸੈ ਕੀ ਮਾਸੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: muh maasai kaa jeebh maasai kee maasai a(n)dhar saas ||
verses.translation: His mouth is flesh, his tongue is flesh; his breath is in the flesh.

verses.original: ਵਡਾ ਹੋਆ ਵੀਆਹਿਆ ਘਰਿ ਲੈ ਆਇਆ ਮਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaddaa hoaa veeaahiaa ghar lai aaiaa maas ||
verses.translation: He grows up and is married, and brings his wife of flesh into his home.

verses.original: ਮਾਸਹੁ ਹੀ ਮਾਸੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਸਭੋ ਸਾਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: maasahu hee maas uoopajai maasahu sabho saak ||
verses.translation: Flesh is produced from flesh; all relatives are made of flesh.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਤਾਂ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai hukam bujheeaai taa(n) ko aavai raas ||
verses.translation: When the mortal meets the True Guru, and realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, then he comes to be reformed.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਛੁਟੇ ਨਹ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਚਨਿ ਬਿਣਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aap chhuTe neh chhooTeeaai naanak bachan binaas ||1||
verses.translation: Releasing himself, the mortal does not find release; O Nanak, through empty words, one is ruined. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਸੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਝਗੜੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: maas maas kar moorakh jhagaRe giaan dhiaan nahee jaanai ||
verses.translation: The fools argue about flesh and meat, but they know nothing about meditation and spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਕਉਣੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਕਉਣੁ ਸਾਗੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਕਿਸੁ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਪ ਸਮਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: kaun maas kaun saag kahaavai kis meh paap samaane ||
verses.translation: What is called meat, and what is called green vegetables? What leads to sin?

verses.original: ਗੈਂਡਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਕੀਏ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: gai(n)ddaa maar hom jag ke'ee dhevatiaa kee baane ||
verses.translation: It was the habit of the gods to kill the rhinoceros, and make a feast of the burnt offering.

verses.original: ਮਾਸੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਬੈਸਿ ਨਕੁ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਾਣਸ ਖਾਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: maas chhodd bais nak pakaReh raatee maanas khaane ||
verses.translation: Those who renounce meat, and hold their noses when sitting near it, devour men at night.

verses.original: ਫੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੋ ਦਿਖਲਾਵਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: faR kar lokaa(n) no dhikhalaaveh giaan dhiaan nahee soojhai ||
verses.translation: They practice hypocrisy, and make a show before other people, but they do not understand anything about meditation or spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਧੇ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕਹਿਆ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak a(n)dhe siau kiaa kaheeaai kahai na kahiaa boojhai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, what can be said to the blind people? They cannot answer, or even understand what is said.

verses.original: ਅੰਧਾ ਸੋਇ ਜਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਿ ਲੋਚਨ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhaa soi j a(n)dh kamaavai tis ridhai s lochan naahee ||
verses.translation: They alone are blind, who act blindly. They have no eyes in their hearts.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਕਤੁ ਨਿਪੰਨੇ ਮਛੀ ਮਾਸੁ ਨ ਖਾਂਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa kee rakat nipa(n)ne machhee maas na khaa(n)hee ||
verses.translation: They are produced from the blood of their mothers and fathers, but they do not eat fish or meat.

verses.original: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਜਾਂ ਨਿਸਿ ਮੇਲਾ ਓਥੈ ਮੰਧੁ ਕਮਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: eisatree purakhai jaa(n) nis melaa othai ma(n)dh kamaahee ||
verses.translation: But when men and women meet in the night, they come together in the flesh.

verses.original: ਮਾਸਹੁ ਨਿੰਮੇ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਜੰਮੇ ਹਮ ਮਾਸੈ ਕੇ ਭਾਂਡੇ ॥
verses.translit: maasahu ni(n)me maasahu ja(n)me ham maasai ke bhaa(n)dde ||
verses.translation: In the flesh we are conceived, and in the flesh we are born; we are vessels of flesh.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਪਾਂਡੇ ॥
verses.translit: giaan dhiaan kachh soojhai naahee chatur kahaavai paa(n)dde ||
verses.translation: You know nothing of spiritual wisdom and meditation, even though you call yourself clever, O religious scholar.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰ ਕਾ ਮਾਸੁ ਮੰਦਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਮਾਸੁ ਚੰਗੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: baahar kaa maas ma(n)dhaa suaamee ghar kaa maas cha(n)geraa ||
verses.translation: O master, you believe that flesh on the outside is bad, but the flesh of those in your own home is good.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਹੋਏ ਜੀਇ ਲਇਆ ਵਾਸੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh maasahu hoe jeei liaa vaaseraa ||
verses.translation: All beings and creatures are flesh; the soul has taken up its home in the flesh.

verses.original: ਅਭਖੁ ਭਖਹਿ ਭਖੁ ਤਜਿ ਛੋਡਹਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨ ਕੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: abhakh bhakheh bhakh taj chhoddeh a(n)dh guroo jin keraa ||
verses.translation: They eat the uneatable; they reject and abandon what they could eat. They have a teacher who is blind.

verses.original: ਮਾਸਹੁ ਨਿੰਮੇ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਜੰਮੇ ਹਮ ਮਾਸੈ ਕੇ ਭਾਂਡੇ ॥
verses.translit: maasahu ni(n)me maasahu ja(n)me ham maasai ke bhaa(n)dde ||
verses.translation: In the flesh we are conceived, and in the flesh we are born; we are vessels of flesh.

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਛੁ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਤੁਰੁ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਪਾਂਡੇ ॥
verses.translit: giaan dhiaan kachh soojhai naahee chatur kahaavai paa(n)dde ||
verses.translation: You know nothing of spiritual wisdom and meditation, even though you call yourself clever, O religious scholar.

verses.original: ਮਾਸੁ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਮਾਸੁ ਕਤੇਬਂੀ ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਿ ਮਾਸੁ ਕਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: maas puraanee maas kateba(n)ee chahu jug maas kamaanaa ||
verses.translation: Meat is allowed in the Puraanas, meat is allowed in the Bible and the Koran. Throughout the four ages, meat has been used.

verses.original: ਜਜਿ ਕਾਜਿ ਵੀਆਹਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ਓਥੈ ਮਾਸੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaj kaaj veeaaeh suhaavai othai maas samaanaa ||
verses.translation: It is featured in sacred feasts and marriage festivities; meat is used in them.

verses.original: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਪਜਹਿ ਮਾਸਹੁ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਸੁਲਤਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: eisatree purakh nipajeh maasahu paatisaeh sulataanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Women, men, kings and emperors originate from meat.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਓਇ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਨਰਕਿ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਤਾਂ ਉਨੑ ਕਾ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਲੈਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: je oi dhiseh narak jaa(n)dhe taa(n) un(h) kaa dhaan na lainaa ||
verses.translation: If you see them going to hell, then do not accept charitable gifts from them.

verses.original: ਦੇਂਦਾ ਨਰਕਿ ਸੁਰਗਿ ਲੈਦੇ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਿਙਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhe(n)dhaa narak surag laidhe dhekhahu eh dhin(g)aanaa ||
verses.translation: The giver goes to hell, while the receiver goes to heaven - look at this injustice.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਲੋਕ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਪਾਂਡੇ ਖਰਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap na boojhai lok bujhaae paa(n)dde kharaa siaanaa ||
verses.translation: You do not understand your own self, but you preach to other people. O Pandit, you are very wise indeed.

verses.original: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੂ ਜਾਣੈ ਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਥਹੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਉਪੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: paa(n)dde too jaanai hee naahee kithahu maas upa(n)naa ||
verses.translation: O Pandit, you do not know where meat originated.

verses.original: ਤੋਇਅਹੁ ਅੰਨੁ ਕਮਾਦੁ ਕਪਾਹਾਂ ਤੋਇਅਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਗੰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: toiahu a(n)n kamaadh kapaahaa(n) toiahu tirabhavan ga(n)naa ||
verses.translation: Corn, sugar cane and cotton are produced from water. The three worlds came from water.

verses.original: ਤੋਆ ਆਖੈ ਹਉ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਹਛਾ ਤੋਐ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: toaa aakhai hau bahu bidh hachhaa toaai bahut bikaaraa ||
verses.translation: Water says, ""I am good in many ways."" But water takes many forms.

verses.original: ਏਤੇ ਰਸ ਛੋਡਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ete ras chhodd hovai sa(n)niaasee naanak kahai vichaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: Forsaking these delicacies, one becomes a true Sannyaasee, a detached hermit. Nanak reflects and speaks. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਆਖਾ ਇਕ ਜੀਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: hau kiaa aakhaa ik jeebh teraa a(n)t na kin hee paiaa ||
verses.translation: What can I say with only one tongue? I cannot find your limits.

verses.original: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਸੇ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sachaa sabadh veechaar se tujh hee maeh samaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who contemplate the True Word of the Shabad are absorbed into You, O Lord.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਭਗਵਾ ਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਰਮਦੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eik bhagavaa ves kar bharamadhe vin satigur kinai na paiaa ||
verses.translation: Some wander around in saffron robes, but without the True Guru, no one finds the Lord.

verses.original: ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰਤਰ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਲੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhes dhisa(n)tar bhav thake tudh a(n)dhar aap lukaiaa ||
verses.translation: They wander in foreign lands and countries until they grow weary, but You hide Yourself within them.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਤੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh rata(n)n hai kar chaanan aap dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is a jewel, through which the Lord shines forth and reveals Himself.

verses.original: ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapanaa aap pachhaaniaa gurmatee sach samaiaa ||
verses.translation: Realizing one's own self, following the Guru's Teachings, the mortal is absorbed into Truth.

verses.original: ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਬਜਾਰੀਆ ਬਾਜਾਰੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aavaa gaun bajaareeaa baajaar jinee rachaiaa ||
verses.translation: Coming and going, the tricksters and magicians put on their magic show.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਭਾਇਆ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: eik thir sachaa saalaahanaa jin man sachaa bhaiaa ||25||
verses.translation: But those whose minds are pleased by the True Lord, praise the True One, the Ever-stable Lord. ||25||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਫਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਵਿਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak maiaa karam birakh fal a(n)mirat fal vis ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the tree of actions done in Maya yields ambrosial fruit and poisonous fruit.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਖਵਾਲੇ ਤਿਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh kaaran karataa kare jis khavaale tis ||1||
verses.translation: The Creator does all deeds; we eat the fruits as He ordains. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa doojaa ||
verses.translation: Second Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੀਆਂ ਵਡਿਆਈਆਂ ਅਗੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: naanak dhuneeaa keeaa(n) vaddiaaieeaa(n) agee setee jaal ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, burn worldly greatness and glory in the fire.

verses.original: ਏਨੀ ਜਲੀਈਂ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਇਕ ਨ ਚਲੀਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: enee jaleeiee(n) naam visaariaa ik na chaleeaa naal ||2||
verses.translation: These burnt offerings have caused mortals to forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Not even one of them will go along with you in the end. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sir sir hoi nibeR hukam chalaiaa ||
verses.translation: He judges each and every being; by the Hukam of His Command, He leads us on.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੈ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: terai hath nibeR toohai man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Justice is in Your Hands, O Lord; You are pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਬੰਨਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਖਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaal chalaae ba(n)n koi na rakhasee ||
verses.translation: The mortal is bound and gagged by Death and lead away; no one can rescue him.

verses.original: ਜਰੁ ਜਰਵਾਣਾ ਕੰਨਿੑ ਚੜਿਆ ਨਚਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: jar jaravaanaa ka(n)ni(h) chaRiaa nachasee ||
verses.translation: Old age, the tyrant, dances on the mortal's shoulders.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਬੇੜੁ ਸਚਾ ਰਖਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bohith beR sachaa rakhasee ||
verses.translation: So climb aboard the boat of the True Guru, and the True Lord will rescue you.

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਭਖੈ ਭੜਹਾੜੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਖਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: agan bhakhai bhaRahaaR anadhin bhakhasee ||
verses.translation: The fire of desire burns like an oven, consuming mortals night and day.

verses.original: ਫਾਥਾ ਚੁਗੈ ਚੋਗ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਛੁਟਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: faathaa chugai chog hukamee chhuTasee ||
verses.translation: Like trapped birds, the mortals peck at the corn; only through the Lord's Command will they find release.

verses.original: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਨਿਖੁਟਸੀ ॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: karataa kare su hog kooR nikhuTasee ||26||
verses.translation: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass; falsehood shall fail in the end. ||26||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਦੇਖਾਇ ਦੇਇ ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: ghar meh ghar dhekhai dhei so satigur purakh sujaan ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the All-knowing Primal Being; He shows us our true home within the home of the self.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦ ਧੁਨਿਕਾਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਤਹ ਬਾਜੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch sabadh dhunikaar dhun teh baajai sabadh neesaan ||
verses.translation: The Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, resonate and resound within; the insignia of the Shabad is revealed there, vibrating gloriously.

verses.original: ਦੀਪ ਲੋਅ ਪਾਤਾਲ ਤਹ ਖੰਡ ਮੰਡਲ ਹੈਰਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: dheep loa paataal teh kha(n)dd ma(n)ddal hairaan ||
verses.translation: Worlds and realms, nether regions, solar systems and galaxies are wondrously revealed.

verses.original: ਤਾਰ ਘੋਰ ਬਾਜਿੰਤ੍ਰ ਤਹ ਸਾਚਿ ਤਖਤਿ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: taar ghor baaji(n)tr teh saach takhat sulataan ||
verses.translation: The strings and the harps vibrate and resound; the true throne of the Lord is there.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਮਨ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਗੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sukhaman kai ghar raag sun su(n)n ma(n)ddal liv lai ||
verses.translation: Listen to the music of the home of the heart - Sukhmani, peace of mind. Lovingly tune in to His state of celestial ecstasy.

verses.original: ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: akath kathaa beechaareeaai manasaa maneh samai ||
verses.translation: Contemplate the Unspoken Speech, and the desires of the mind are dissolved.

verses.original: ਉਲਟਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਭਰਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਕਤਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aulaT kamal a(n)mirat bhariaa ih man katahu na jai ||
verses.translation: The heart-lotus is turned upside-down, and is filled with Ambrosial Nectar. This mind does not go out; it does not get distracted.

verses.original: ਅਜਪਾ ਜਾਪੁ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ajapaa jaap na veesarai aadh jugaadh samai ||
verses.translation: It does not forget the Chant which is chanted without chanting; it is immersed in the Primal Lord God of the ages.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਪੰਚੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sakheeaa pa(n)che mile gurmukh nij ghar vaas ||
verses.translation: All the sister-companions are blessed with the five virtues. The Gurmukhs dwell in the home of the self deep within.

verses.original: ਸਬਦੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਇਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਲਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabadh khoj ih ghar lahai naanak taa kaa dhaas ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak is the slave of that one who seeks the Shabad and finds this home within. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਿਲਿਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਸੀਆਰ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਫਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: chilimil biseeaar dhuneeaa faanee ||
verses.translation: The extravagant glamor of the world is a passing show.

verses.original: ਕਾਲੂਬਿ ਅਕਲ ਮਨ ਗੋਰ ਨ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: kaaloob akal man gor na maanee ||
verses.translation: My twisted mind does not believe that it will end up in a grave.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਮੀਨ ਕਮਤਰੀਨ ਤੂ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਖੁਦਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man kameen kamatareen too dhareeaau khudhaiaa ||
verses.translation: I am meek and lowly; You are the great river.

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਚੀਜੁ ਮੁਝੈ ਦੇਹਿ ਅਵਰ ਜਹਰ ਚੀਜ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ek cheej mujhai dheh avar jahar cheej na bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Please, bless me with the one thing; everything else is poison, and does not tempt me.

verses.original: ਪੁਰਾਬ ਖਾਮ ਕੂਜੈ ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਖੁਦਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: puraab khaam koojai hikamat khudhaiaa ||
verses.translation: You filled this fragile body with the water of life, O Lord, by Your Creative Power.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤੁਆਨਾ ਤੂ ਕੁਦਰਤੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: man tuaanaa too kudharatee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: By Your Omnipotence, I have become powerful.

verses.original: ਸਗ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਬਾਨ ਮਸਤਾਨਾ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sag naanak dheebaan masataanaa nit chaRai savaiaa ||
verses.translation: Nanak is a dog in the Court of the Lord, intoxicated more and more, all the time.

verses.original: ਆਤਸ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਖੁਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੁਦਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aatas dhuneeaa khunak naam khudhaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: The world is on fire; the Name of the Lord is cooling and soothing. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ਨਵੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee navee mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: New Pauree, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਚਲਤੁ ਚਲਤੁ ਵਖਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: sabho varatai chalat chalat vakhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: His wonderful play is all-pervading; it is wonderful and amazing!

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham paramesar gurmukh jaaniaa ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I know the the Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਲਥੇ ਸਭਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: lathe sabh vikaar sabadh neesaaniaa ||
verses.translation: All my sins and corruption are washed away, through the insignia of the Shabad, the Word of God.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਭਏ ਨਿਕਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)g udhaar bhe nikaaniaa ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved, and becomes free.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar dhaataar sabh ra(n)g maaniaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Great Giver, I enjoy all comforts and pleasures.

verses.original: ਪਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ਮਿਹਰ ਛਾਵਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: paragaT bhiaa sa(n)saar mihar chhaavaaniaa ||
verses.translation: I have become famous throughout the world, under the canopy of His kindness and grace.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aape bakhas milaae sadh kurabaaniaa ||
verses.translation: He Himself has forgiven me, and united me with Himself; I am forever a sacrifice to Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: naanak le milai khasamai bhaaniaa ||27||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by the Pleasure of His Will, my Lord and Master has blended me with Himself. ||27||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਕਲਮ ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਂਡਾ ਧਨੁ ਮਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: dha(n)nu su kaagadh kalam dha(n)n dhan bhaa(n)ddaa dhan mas ||
verses.translation: Blessed is the paper, blessed is the pen, blessed is the inkwell, and blessed is the ink.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhan lekhaaree naanakaa jin naam likhaiaa sach ||1||
verses.translation: Blessed is the writer, O Nanak, who writes the True Name. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: First Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਟੀ ਕਲਮ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਭਿ ਤੂੰ ॥
verses.translit: aape paTee kalam aap upar lekh bh too(n) ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the writing tablet, and You Yourself are the pen. You are also what is written on it.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਾਹੇ ਕੂ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: eko kaheeaai naanakaa dhoojaa kaahe koo ||2||
verses.translation: Speak of the One Lord, O Nanak; how could there be any other? ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪਿ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape aap varatadhaa aap banat banaiee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are all-pervading; You Yourself made the making.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਤੂ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: tudh bin dhoojaa ko nahee too rahiaa samaiee ||
verses.translation: Without You, there is no other at all; You are permeating and pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: teree gat mit toohai jaanadhaa tudh keemat paiee ||
verses.translation: You alone know Your state and extent. Only You can estimate Your worth.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਲਖ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: too alakh agochar agam hai gurmat dhikhaiee ||
verses.translation: You are invisible, imperceptible and inaccessible. You are revealed through the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar agiaan dhukh bharam hai gur giaan gavaiee ||
verses.translation: Deep within, there is ignorance, suffering and doubt; through the spiritual wisdom of the Guru, they are eradicated.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਸੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis kirapaa kareh tis mel laih so naam dhiaaiee ||
verses.translation: He alone meditates on the Naam, whom You unite with Yourself, in Your Mercy.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: too karataa purakh aga(n)m hai raviaa sabh Thaiee ||
verses.translation: You are the Creator, the Inaccessible Primal Lord God; You are all-pervading everywhere.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੂ ਲਾਇਹਿ ਸਚਿਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਗੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥੨੮॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
verses.translit: jit too laieh sachiaa tit ko lagai naanak gun gaiee ||28||1|| sudhu
verses.translation: To whatever You link the mortal, O True Lord, to that he is linked. Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises. ||28||1|| Sudh||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਲਾਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ॥
verses.translit: raag malaar baanee bhagat naamadhev jeeau kee||
verses.translation: Raag Malaar, The Word Of The Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੇਵੀਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ॥
verses.translit: seveele gopaal rai akul nira(n)jan ||
verses.translation: Serve the King, the Sovereign Lord of the World. He has no ancestry; He is immaculate and pure.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat dhaan dheejai jaacheh sa(n)t jan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with the gift of devotion, which the humble Saints beg for. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਦਿਗ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਰਾਇਚਾ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਭਵਨ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਸਾਲਾ ਸਪਤ ਲੋਕ ਸਾਮਾਨਿ ਪੂਰੀਅਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) chai ghar dhig dhisai saraichaa baiku(n)Th bhavan chitrasaalaa sapat lok saamaan pooreeale ||
verses.translation: His Home is the pavilion seen in all directions; His ornamental heavenly realms fill the seven worlds alike.

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਲਛਿਮੀ ਕੁਆਰੀ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੀਵੜੇ ਕਉਤਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ ਕੋਟਵਾਲੁ ਸੁ ਕਰਾ ਸਿਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) chai ghar lachhimee kuaaree cha(n)dh sooraj dheevaRe kautak kaal bapuRaa koTavaalu su karaa siree ||
verses.translation: In His Home, the virgin Lakshmi dwells. The moon and the sun are His two lamps; the wretched Messenger of Death stages his dramas, and levies taxes on all.

verses.original: ਸੁ ਐਸਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਰਹਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: s aaisaa raajaa sree naraharee ||1||
verses.translation: Such is my Sovereign Lord King, the Supreme Lord of all. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੁਲਾਲੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਚਤੁਰ ਮੁਖੁ ਡਾਂਵੜਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਰਾਚੀਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) chai ghar kulaal brahamaa chatur mukh ddaa(n)vaRaa jin bisavai sa(n)saar raacheele ||
verses.translation: In His House, the four-faced Brahma, the cosmic potter lives. He created the entire universe.

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਈਸਰੁ ਬਾਵਲਾ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰੂ ਤਤ ਸਾਰਖਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਾਖੀਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) kai ghar ieesar baavalaa jagat guroo tat saarakhaa giaan bhaakheele ||
verses.translation: In His House, the insane Shiva, the Guru of the World, lives; he imparts spiritual wisdom to explain the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਡਾਂਗੀਆ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਲੇਖੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: paap pu(n)n jaa(n) chai ddaa(n)geeaa dhuaarai chitr gupat lekheeaa ||
verses.translation: Sin and virtue are the standard-bearers at His Door; Chitr and Gupt are the recording angels of the conscious and subconscious.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਪਰੁਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dharam rai parulee pratihaar ||
verses.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma, the Lord of Destruction, is the door-man.

verses.original: ਸੋੁ ਐਸਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: suo aaisaa raajaa sree gopaal ||2||
verses.translation: Such is the Supreme Sovereign Lord of the World. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਰਿਖੀ ਬਪੁੜੇ ਢਾਢੀਆ ਗਾਵੰਤ ਆਛੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) chai ghar gan ga(n)dharab rikhee bapuRe ddaaddeeaa gaava(n)t aachhai ||
verses.translation: In His Home are the heavenly heralds, celestial singers, Rishis and poor minstrels, who sing so sweetly.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਹੁ ਰੂਪੀਆ ਅਨਗਰੂਆ ਆਖਾੜਾ ਮੰਡਲੀਕ ਬੋਲ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਕਾਛੇ ॥
verses.translit: sarab saasatr bahu roopeeaa anagarooaa aakhaaRaa ma(n)ddaleek bol boleh kaachhe ||
verses.translation: All the Shaastras take various forms in His theater, singing beautiful songs.

verses.original: ਚਉਰ ਢੂਲ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਹੈ ਪਵਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: chaur ddool jaa(n) chai hai pavan ||
verses.translation: The wind waves the fly-brush over Him;

verses.original: ਚੇਰੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਲੇ ਭਵਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: cheree sakat jeet le bhavan ||
verses.translation: His hand-maiden is Maya, who has conquered the world.

verses.original: ਅੰਡ ਟੂਕ ਜਾ ਚੈ ਭਸਮਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dd Took jaa chai bhasamatee ||
verses.translation: The shell of the earth is His fireplace.

verses.original: ਸੋੁ ਐਸਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਪਤੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: suo aaisaa raajaa tirabhavan patee ||3||
verses.translation: Such is the Sovereign Lord of the three worlds. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਕੂਰਮਾ ਪਾਲੁ ਸਹਸ੍ਰ ਫਨੀ ਬਾਸਕੁ ਸੇਜ ਵਾਲੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) chai ghar kooramaa paal sahasr fanee baasak sej vaalooaa ||
verses.translation: In His Home, the celestial turtle is the bed-frame, woven with the strings of the thousand-headed snake.

verses.original: ਅਠਾਰਹ ਭਾਰ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਮਾਲਣੀ ਛਿਨਵੈ ਕਰੋੜੀ ਮੇਘ ਮਾਲਾ ਪਾਣੀਹਾਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: aThaareh bhaar banaasapatee maalanee chhinavai karoRee megh maalaa paaneehaareeaa ||
verses.translation: His flower-girls are the eighteen loads of vegetation; His water-carriers are the nine hundred sixty million clouds.

verses.original: ਨਖ ਪ੍ਰਸੇਵ ਜਾ ਚੈ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: nakh prasev jaa chai surasaree ||
verses.translation: His sweat is the Ganges River.

verses.original: ਸਪਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘੜਥਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: sapat samu(n)dh jaa(n) chai ghaRathalee ||
verses.translation: The seven seas are His water-pitchers.

verses.original: ਏਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਵਰਤਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: ete jeea jaa(n) chai varatanee ||
verses.translation: The creatures of the world are His household utensils.

verses.original: ਸੋੁ ਐਸਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਣੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: suo aaisaa raajaa tirabhavan dhanee ||4||
verses.translation: Such is the Sovereign Lord King of the three worlds. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਕਟ ਵਰਤੀ ਅਰਜਨੁ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਅੰਬਰੀਕੁ ਨਾਰਦੁ ਨੇਜੈ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਬਾਨਵੈ ਹੇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) chai ghar nikaT varatee arajan dhraoo prahalaadh a(n)bareek naaradh nejai sidh budh gan ga(n)dharab baanavai helaa ||
verses.translation: In His home are Arjuna, Dhroo, Prahlaad, Ambreek, Naarad, Nayjaa, the Siddhas and Buddhas, the ninety-two heavenly heralds and celestial singers in their wondrous play.

verses.original: ਏਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਂ ਚੈ ਹਹਿ ਘਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ete jeea jaa(n) chai heh gharee ||
verses.translation: All the creatures of the world are in His House.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਬਿਆਪਿਕ ਅੰਤਰ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sarab biaapik a(n)tar haree ||
verses.translation: The Lord is diffused in the inner beings of all.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਤਾਂ ਚੀ ਆਣਿ ॥
verses.translit: pranavai naamadheau taa(n) chee aan ||
verses.translation: Prays Naam Dayv, seek His Protection.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਜਾ ਚੈ ਨੀਸਾਣਿ ॥੫॥੧॥
verses.translit: sagal bhagat jaa chai neesaan ||5||1||
verses.translation: All the devotees are His banner and insignia. ||5||1||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: malaar ||
verses.translation: Malaar:

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਤੂੰ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਤੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: mo kau too(n) na bisaar too na bisaar ||
verses.translation: Please do not forget me; please do not forget me,

verses.original: ਤੂ ਨ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too na bisaare raamieeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: please do not forget me, O Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਲਾਵੰਤੀ ਇਹੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਜੋ ਹੈ ਮੁਝ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋਪਿਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: aalaava(n)tee ih bhram jo hai mujh uoopar sabh kopilaa ||
verses.translation: The temple priests have doubts about this, and everyone is furious with me.

verses.original: ਸੂਦੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਉਠਾਇਓ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਬਾਪ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: soodh soodh kar maar uThaio kahaa karau baap beeThulaa ||1||
verses.translation: Calling me low-caste and untouchable, they beat me and drove me out; what should I do now, O Beloved Father Lord? ||1||

verses.original: ਮੂਏ ਹੂਏ ਜਉ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੇਹੁਗੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: mooe hooe jau mukat dhehuge mukat na jaanai koilaa ||
verses.translation: If You liberate me after I am dead, no one will know that I am liberated.

verses.original: ਏ ਪੰਡੀਆ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਢੇਢ ਕਹਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਪੈਜ ਪਿਛੰਉਡੀ ਹੋਇਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: e pa(n)ddeeaa mo kau ddedd kahat teree paij pichha(n)auddee hoilaa ||2||
verses.translation: These Pandits, these religious scholars, call me low-born; when they say this, they tarnish Your honor as well. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਜੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈਂ ਅਤਿਭੁਜ ਭਇਓ ਅਪਾਰਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: too ju dhiaal kirapaal kaheeat hai(n) atibhuj bhio apaaralaa ||
verses.translation: You are called kind and compassionate; the power of Your Arm is absolutely unrivalled.

verses.original: ਫੇਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਨਾਮੇ ਕਉ ਪੰਡੀਅਨ ਕਉ ਪਿਛਵਾਰਲਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
verses.translit: fer dheeaa dhehuraa naame kau pa(n)ddeean kau pichhavaaralaa ||3||2||
verses.translation: The Lord turned the temple around to face Naam Dayv; He turned His back on the Brahmins. ||3||2||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: malaar baanee bhagat ravidhaas jee kee
verses.translation: Malaar, The Word Of The Devotee Ravi Daas Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਨਾਗਰ ਜਨਾਂ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆਤ ਚੰਮਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: naagar janaa(n) meree jaat bikhiaat cha(n)maara(n) ||
verses.translation: O humble townspeople, I am obviously just a shoemaker.

verses.original: ਰਿਦੈ ਰਾਮ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਸਾਰੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ridhai raam gobi(n)dh gun saara(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In my heart I cherish the Glories of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਸਲਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਰੁਨੀ ਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਕਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਨੰ ॥
verses.translit: surasaree salal kirat baarunee re sa(n)t jan karat nahee paana(n) ||
verses.translation: Even if wine is made from the water of the Ganges, O Saints, do not drink it.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਾ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਤ ਅਵਰ ਜਲ ਰੇ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਮਿਲਤ ਨਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਆਨੰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: suraa apavitr nat avar jal re surasaree milat neh hoi aana(n) ||1||
verses.translation: This wine, and any other polluted water which mixes with the Ganges, is not separate from it. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਰ ਤਾਰਿ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਰੇ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਗਰਾ ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੰ ॥
verses.translit: tar taar apavitr kar maaneeaai re jaise kaagaraa karat beechaara(n) ||
verses.translation: The palmyra palm tree is considered impure, and so its leaves are considered impure as well.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਗਉਤੁ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਤਿਹ ਊਪਰੇ ਪੂਜੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhagat bhaagaut likheeaai teh uoopare poojeeaai kar namasakaara(n) ||2||
verses.translation: But if devotional prayers are written on paper made from its leaves, then people bow in reverence and worship before it. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਟ ਬਾਂਢਲਾ ਢੋਰ ਢੋਵੰਤਾ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਬਾਨਾਰਸੀ ਆਸ ਪਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: meree jaat kuT baa(n)ddalaa ddor ddova(n)taa niteh baanaarasee aas paasaa ||
verses.translation: It is my occupation to prepare and cut leather; each day, I carry the carcasses out of the city.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਤਿਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
verses.translit: ab bipr paradhaan teh kareh dda(n)ddaut tere naam saranai ravidhaas dhaasaa ||3||1||
verses.translation: Now, the important Brahmins of the city bow down before me; Ravi Daas, Your slave, seeks the Sanctuary of Your Name. ||3||1||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: malaar ||
verses.translation: Malaar:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਤੇਊ ਜਨਾ ਪਦਮ ਕਵਲਾਸ ਪਤਿ ਤਾਸ ਸਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਨਹੀ ਆਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
verses.translit: har japat teuoo janaa padham kavalaas pat taas sam tul nahee aan kouoo ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who meditate on the Lord's Lotus Feet - none are equal to them.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਹੀ ਏਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਸਥਰਿਓ ਆਨ ਰੇ ਆਨ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ਸੋਊ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ek hee ek anek hoi bisathario aan re aan bharapoor souoo || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord is One, but He is diffused in many forms. Bring in, bring in, that All-pervading Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਾਗਵਤੁ ਲੇਖੀਐ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੇਖੀਐ ਤਾਸ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਆਛੋਪ ਛੀਪਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai bhaagavat lekheeaai avar nahee pekheeaai taas kee jaat aachhop chheepaa ||
verses.translation: He who writes the Praises of the Lord God, and sees nothing else at all, is a low-class, untouchable fabric-dyer by trade.

verses.original: ਬਿਆਸ ਮਹਿ ਲੇਖੀਐ ਸਨਕ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖੀਐ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਨਾਮਨਾ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: biaas meh lekheeaai sanak meh pekheeaai naam kee naamanaa sapat dheepaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Glory of the Name is seen in the writings of Vyaas and Sanak, throughout the seven continents. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਈਦਿ ਬਕਰੀਦਿ ਕੁਲ ਗਊ ਰੇ ਬਧੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਾਨੀਅਹਿ ਸੇਖ ਸਹੀਦ ਪੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai ieedh bakareedh kul guoo re badh kareh maane'eeh sekh saheedh peeraa ||
verses.translation: And he whose family used to kill cows at the festivals of Eed and Bakareed, who worshipped Shayks, martyrs and spiritual teachers,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਬਾਪ ਵੈਸੀ ਕਰੀ ਪੂਤ ਐਸੀ ਸਰੀ ਤਿਹੂ ਰੇ ਲੋਕ ਪਰਸਿਧ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa kai baap vaisee karee poot aaisee saree tihoo re lok parasidh kabeeraa ||2||
verses.translation: whose father used to do such things - his son Kabeer became so successful that he is now famous throughout the three worlds. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਕੇ ਢੇਢ ਸਭ ਢੋਰ ਢੋਵੰਤ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਅਜਹੁ ਬੰਨਾਰਸੀ ਆਸ ਪਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ke kuTa(n)b ke ddedd sabh ddor ddova(n)t fireh ajahu ba(n)naarasee aas paasaa ||
verses.translation: And all the leather-workers in those families still go around Benares removing the dead cattle

verses.original: ਆਚਾਰ ਸਹਿਤ ਬਿਪ੍ਰ ਕਰਹਿ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਤਨੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਾਨ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੩॥੨॥
verses.translit: aachaar sahit bipr kareh dda(n)ddaut tin tanai ravidhaas dhaasaan dhaasaa ||3||2||
verses.translation: - the ritualistic Brahmins bow in reverence before their son Ravi Daas, the slave of the Lord's slaves. ||3||2||

verses.original: ਮਲਾਰ
verses.translit: malaar
verses.translation: Malaar:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਿਲਤ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨਾਥੁ ਕਵਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: milat piaaro praan naath kavan bhagat te ||
verses.translation: What sort of devotional worship will lead me to meet my Beloved, the Lord of my breath of life?

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat paiee param gate || rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have obtained the supreme status. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੈਲੇ ਕਪਰੇ ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਧੋਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: maile kapare kahaa lau dhovau ||
verses.translation: How long shall I wash these dirty clothes?

verses.original: ਆਵੈਗੀ ਨੀਦ ਕਹਾ ਲਗੁ ਸੋਵਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aavaigee needh kahaa lag sovau ||1||
verses.translation: How long shall I remain asleep? ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋਈ ਜੋਈ ਜੋਰਿਓ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਫਾਟਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: joiee joiee jorio soiee soiee faaTio ||
verses.translation: Whatever I was attached to, has perished.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੈ ਬਨਜਿ ਉਠਿ ਹੀ ਗਈ ਹਾਟਿਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jhooThai banaj uTh hee giee haaTio ||2||
verses.translation: The shop of false merchandise has closed down. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਭਇਓ ਜਬ ਲੇਖੋ ॥
verses.translit: kahu ravidhaas bhio jab lekho ||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, when the account is called for and given,

verses.original: ਜੋਈ ਜੋਈ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਦੇਖਿਓ ॥੩॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: joiee joiee keeno soiee soiee dhekhio ||3||1||3||
verses.translation: whatever the mortal has done, he shall see. ||3||1||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਕਾਨੜਾ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag kaanaRaa chaupadhe mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Kaanraa, Chau-Padhay, Fourth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾਂ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man saadh janaa(n) mil hariaa ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Holy people, my mind blossoms forth.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾਂ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau bal bal bal bal saadh janaa(n) kau mil sa(n)gat paar utariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to those Holy beings; joining the Sangat, the Congregation, I am carried across to the other side. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ਹਮ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾਂ ਪਗ ਪਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaa karahu prabh apanee ham saadh janaa(n) pag pariaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, please bless me with Your Mercy, God, that I may fall at the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan saadh jin har prabh jaaniaa mil saadhoo patit udhariaa ||1||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are the Holy, who know the Lord God. Meeting with the Holy, even sinners are saved. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨੂਆ ਚਲੈ ਚਲੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: manooaa chalai chalai bahu bahu bidh mil saadhoo vasagat kariaa ||
verses.translation: The mind roams and rambles all around in all directions. Meeting with the Holy, it is overpowered and brought under control,

verses.original: ਜਿਉਂ ਜਲ ਤੰਤੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਓ ਬਧਕਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿ ਮੀਨਾ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਖਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau(n) jal ta(n)t pasaario badhak gras meenaa vasagat khariaa ||2||
verses.translation: just as when the fisherman spreads his net over the water, he catches and overpowers the fish. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਤ ਭਲ ਨੀਕੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਲੁ ਲਹੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t sa(n)t bhal neeke mil sa(n)t janaa mal laheeaa ||
verses.translation: The Saints, the Saints of the Lord, are noble and good. Meeting with the humble Saints, filth is washed away.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਨੀਕਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਸਾਬੁਨਿ ਕਾਪਰੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: haumai dhurat giaa sabh neekar jiau saabun kaapar kariaa ||3||
verses.translation: All the sins and egotism are washed away, like soap washing dirty clothes. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਉਰ ਧਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: masatak lilaaT likhiaa dhur Thaakur gur satigur charan ur dhariaa ||
verses.translation: According to that pre-ordained destiny inscribed on my forehead by my Lord and Master, I have enshrined the Feet of the Guru, the True Guru, within my heart.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੂਖ ਭੰਜ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh dhaaladh dhookh bha(n)j prabh paiaa jan naanak naam udhariaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: I have found God, the Destroyer of all poverty and pain; servant Nanak is saved through the Naam. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ ਰੇਨ ॥
verses.translit: meraa man sa(n)t janaa pag ren ||
verses.translation: My mind is the dust of the feet of the Saints.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਕੋਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੇਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har kathaa sunee mil sa(n)gat man koraa har ra(n)g bhen ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Joining the Sangat, the Congregation, I listen to the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har. My crude and uncultured mind is drenched with the Love of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਅਚਿਤ ਅਚੇਤ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਸੁਚਿਤ ਚਿਤੇਨ ॥
verses.translit: ham achit achet na jaaneh gat mit gur ke'ee suchit chiten ||
verses.translation: I am thoughtless and unconscious; I do not know God's state and extent. The Guru has made me thoughtful and conscious.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਕੀਓ ਅੰਗੀਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh dheen dhiaal keeo a(n)geekirat man har har naam japen ||1||
verses.translation: God is Merciful to the meek; He has made me His Own. My mind chants and meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਟਿ ਦੇਵਉ ਹੀਅਰਾ ਤੇਨ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t mileh man preetam kaT dhevau heearaa ten ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Lord's Saints, the Beloveds of the mind, I would cut out my heart, and offer it to them.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵੇਨ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t mile har miliaa ham ke'ee patit paven ||2||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Lord's Saints, I meet with the Lord; this sinner has been sanctified. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਜਗਿ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਜਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪਾਥਰ ਸੇਨ ॥
verses.translit: har ke jan uootam jag kahe'eeh jin miliaa paathar sen ||
verses.translation: The humble servants of the Lord are said to be exalted in this world; meeting with them, even stones are softened.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਓਇ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਨ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan kee mahimaa baran na saakau oi uootam har har ken ||3||
verses.translation: I cannot even describe the noble grandeur of such humble beings; the Lord, Har, Har, has made them sublime and exalted. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਹ ਵਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਰਾਸਿ ਦੇਨ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h) har saeh vadde prabh suaamee ham vanajaare raas dhen ||
verses.translation: You, Lord are the Great Merchant-Banker; O God, my Lord and Master, I am just a poor peddler; please bless me with the wealth.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਲਦਿ ਵਾਖਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੇਨ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau dhiaa prabh dhaarahu ladh vaakhar har har len ||4||2||
verses.translation: Please bestow Your Kindness and Mercy upon servant Nanak, God, so that he may load up the merchandise of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: jap man raam naam paragaas ||
verses.translation: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord, and be enlightened.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ ਵਿਚੇ ਗਿਰਹ ਉਦਾਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t mil preet lagaanee viche gireh udhaas ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meet with the Saints of the Lord, and focus your love; remain balanced and detached within your own household. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਪਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: ham har hiradhai japio naam narahar prabh kirapaa karee kirapaas ||
verses.translation: I chant the Name of the Lord, Nar-Har, within my heart; God the Merciful has shown His Mercy.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸਿਆ ਉਦਮ ਭਏ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anadhin anadh bhiaa man bigasiaa udham bhe milan kee aas ||1||
verses.translation: Night and day, I am in ecstasy; my mind has blossomed forth, rejuvenated. I am trying - I hope to meet my Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਜਿਤਨੇ ਸਾਸ ਲੀਏ ਹਮ ਗ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: ham har suaamee preet lagaiee jitane saas le'ee ham graas ||
verses.translation: I am in love with the Lord, my Lord and Master; I love Him with every breath and morsel of food I take.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦਹਨ ਭਏ ਖਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੂਟਿ ਗਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਫਾਸ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kilabikh dhahan bhe khin a(n)tar tooT ge maiaa ke faas ||2||
verses.translation: My sins were burnt away in an instant; the noose of the bondage of Maya was loosened. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਕਿਰਮ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਰਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa ham kiram kiaa karam kamaaveh moorakh mugadh rakhe prabh taas ||
verses.translation: I am such a worm! What karma am I creating? What can I do? I am a fool, a total idiot, but God has saved me.

verses.original: ਅਵਗਨੀਆਰੇ ਪਾਥਰ ਭਾਰੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਰੇ ਤਰਾਸ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: avaganeeaare paathar bhaare satasa(n)gat mil tare taraas ||3||
verses.translation: I am unworthy, heavy as stone, but joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I am carried across to the other side. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੇਤੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸਰਿ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਊਚ ਹਮ ਨੀਚ ਬਿਖਿਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: jetee sirasaT karee jagadheesar te sabh uooch ham neech bikhiaas ||
verses.translation: The Universe which God created is all above me; I am the lowest, engrossed in corruption.

verses.original: ਹਮਰੇ ਅਵਗੁਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਟੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: hamare avagun sa(n)g gur meTe jan naanak mel le'ee prabh paas ||4||3||
verses.translation: With the Guru, my faults and demerits have been erased. Servant Nanak has been united with God Himself. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕ ॥
verses.translit: merai man raam naam japio gur vaak ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Name of the Lord, through the Guru's Word.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸਰਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਗਇਓ ਸਭ ਝਾਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaa karee jagadheesar dhuramat dhoojaa bhaau gio sabh jhaak ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, has shown me His Mercy, and my evil-mindedness, love of duality and sense of alienation are totally gone, thanks to the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਓ ਗੁਪਲਾਕ ॥
verses.translit: naanaa roop ra(n)g har kere ghaT ghaT raam ravio gupalaak ||
verses.translation: There are so many forms and colors of the Lord. The Lord is pervading each and every heart, and yet He is hidden from view.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਉਘਰਿ ਗਏ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੇ ਤਾਕ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t mile har pragaTe ughar ge bikhiaa ke taak ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Lord's Saints, the Lord is revealed, and the doors of corruption are shattered. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਿਨ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸਾਕ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee bahut bahu sobhaa jin ur dhaario har rasik rasaak ||
verses.translation: The glory of the Saintly beings is absolutely great; they lovingly enshrine the Lord of Bliss and Delight within their hearts.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜੈਸੇ ਗਊ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਛਰਾਕ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t mile har miliaa jaise guoo dhekh bachharaak ||2||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Lord's Saints, I meet with the Lord, just as when the calf is seen - the cow is there as well. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਜਨਕ ਜਨਾਕ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t janaa meh har har te jan uootam janak janaak ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is within the humble Saints of the Lord; they are exalted - they know, and they inspire others to know as well.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸਾਨੀ ਛੂਟਿ ਗਈ ਮੁਸਕੀ ਮੁਸਕਾਕ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tin har hiradhai baas basaanee chhooT giee musakee musakaak ||3||
verses.translation: The fragrance of the Lord permeates their hearts; they have abandoned the foul stench. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਜਨ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਅਪਨਾਕ ॥
verses.translit: tumare jan tum(h) hee prabh ke'ee har raakh leh aapan apanaak ||
verses.translation: You make those humble beings Your Own, God; You protect Your Own, O Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਈ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਬੰਧਪ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਕ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ke sakhaa har bhaiee maat pitaa ba(n)dhap har saak ||4||4||
verses.translation: The Lord is servant Nanak's companion; the Lord is his sibling, mother, father, relative and relation. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: mere man har har raam naam jap cheet ||
verses.translation: O my mind, consciously chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਗੜਿੑ ਵੇੜੑੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲੀਓ ਗੜੁ ਜੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har vasat maiaa gaRi(h) veR(h)ee gur kai sabadh leeo gaR jeet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The commodity of the Lord, Har, Har, is locked in the fortress of Maya; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have conquered the fortress. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਬਹੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ ਲੁਬਧੋ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਮੋਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: mithiaa bharam bharam bahu bhramiaa lubadho putr kalatr moh preet ||
verses.translation: In false doubt and superstition, people wander all around, lured by love and emotional attachment to their children and families.

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਰਵਰ ਕੀ ਤੁਛ ਛਾਇਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਦੇਹ ਭੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaise taravar kee tuchh chhaiaa khin meh binas jai dheh bheet ||1||
verses.translation: But just like the passing shade of the tree, your body-wall shall crumble in an instant. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਜਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: hamare praan preetam jan uootam jin miliaa man hoi prateet ||
verses.translation: The humble beings are exalted; they are my breath of life and my beloveds; meeting them, my mind is filled with faith.

verses.original: ਪਰਚੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: parachai raam raviaa ghaT a(n)tar asathir raam raviaa ra(n)g preet ||2||
verses.translation: Deep within the heart, I am happy with the Pervading Lord; with love and joy, I dwell upon the Steady and Stable Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਜਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆਂ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sa(n)t sa(n)t jan neeke jin miliaa(n) man ra(n)g ra(n)geet ||
verses.translation: The humble Saints, the Saints of the Lord, are noble and sublime; meeting them, the mind is tinged with love and joy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)g lahai na utarai kabahoo har har jai milai har preet ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord's Love never fades away, and it never wears off. Through the Lord's Love, one goes and meets the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਹੁ ਪਾਪ ਕੀਏ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਟੇ ਕਟਿਤ ਕਟੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: ham bahu paap ke'ee aparaadhee gur kaaTe kaTit kaTeet ||
verses.translation: I am a sinner; I have committed so many sins. The Guru has cut them, cut them, and hacked them off.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਮੁਖਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਿ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: har har naam dheeo mukh aaukhadh jan naanak patit puneet ||4||5||
verses.translation: The Guru has placed the healing remedy of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, into my mouth. Servant Nanak, the sinner, has been purified and sanctified. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: jap man raam naam jaga(n)naath ||
verses.translation: Chant, O my mind, the Name of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਘੂਮਨ ਘੇਰ ਪਰੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਦੇ ਹਾਥ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ghooman gher pare bikh bikhiaa satigur kaadd le'ee dhe haath ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I was caught in the whirlpool of poisonous sin and corruption. The True Guru gave me His Hand; He lifted me up and pulled me out. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਭੈ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: suaamee abhai nira(n)jan narahar tum(h) raakh leh ham paapee paath ||
verses.translation: O my Fearless, Immaculate Lord and Master, please save me - I am a sinner, a sinking stone.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਲੋਭਿ ਲੁਭਤੇ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਹ ਤਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਥ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh bikhiaa lobh lubhate kaasaT loh tare sa(n)g saath ||1||
verses.translation: I am lured and enticed by sexual desire, anger, greed and corruption, but associating with You, I am carried across, like iron in the wooden boat. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਹਮ ਢੂਢਿ ਰਹੇ ਪਾਈ ਨਹੀ ਹਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h) vadd purakh badd agam agochar ham ddoodd rahe paiee nahee haath ||
verses.translation: You are the Great Primal Being, the most Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord God; I search for You, but cannot find Your depth.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੂ ਆਪਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too parai parai apara(n)par suaamee too aapan jaaneh aap jaga(n)naath ||2||
verses.translation: You are the farthest of the far, beyond the beyond, O my Lord and Master; You alone know Yourself, O Lord of the Universe. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: adhirasaT agochar naam dhiaae satasa(n)gat mil saadhoo paath ||
verses.translation: I meditate on the Name of the Unseen and Unfathomable Lord; joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I have found the Path of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਅਕਥ ਕਥ ਕਾਥ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har kathaa sunee mil sa(n)gat har har japio akath kath kaath ||3||
verses.translation: Joining the congregation, I listen to the Gospel of the Lord, Har, Har; I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, and speak the Unspoken Speech. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਹਮ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: hamare prabh jagadhees gusaiee ham raakh leh jaga(n)naath ||
verses.translation: My God is the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe; please save me, O Lord of all Creation.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਜਨ ਸਾਥ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak dhaas dhaas dhaasan ko prabh karahu kirapaa raakhahu jan saath ||4||6||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is the slave of the slave of Your slaves. O God, please bless me with Your Grace; please protect me and keep me with Your humble servants. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa paRataal ghar panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla, Partaal, Fifth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਜਾਪਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: man jaapahu raam gupaal ||
verses.translation: O mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: har ratan javehar laal ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Jewel, the Diamond, the Ruby.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਘੜਿ ਟਕਸਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: har gurmukh ghaR Takasaal ||
verses.translation: The Lord fashions the Gurmukhs in His Mint.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ho ho kirapaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord, please, please, be Merciful to me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਏਕ ਜੀਹ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੈ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਲਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: tumare gun agam agochar ek jeeh kiaa kathai bichaaree raam raam raam raam laal ||
verses.translation: Your Glorious Virtues are inaccessible and unfathomable; how can my one poor tongue describe them? O my Beloved Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, Raam.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਜੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਹੀ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tumaree jee akath kathaa too too too hee jaaneh hau har jap bhiee nihaal nihaal nihaal ||1||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, You, You, You alone know Your Unspoken Speech. I have become enraptured, enraptured, enraptured, meditating on the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਖਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜੀਹ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: hamare har praan sakhaa suaamee har meetaa mere man tan jeeh har hare hare raam naam dhan maal ||
verses.translation: The Lord, my Lord and Master, is my Companion and my Breath of Life; the Lord is my Best Friend. My mind, body and tongue are attuned to the Lord, Har, Haray, Haray. The Lord is my Wealth and Property.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਭਾਗੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੀਓ ਰੀ ਸੁਹਾਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲੇ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਭਈ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
verses.translit: jaa ko bhaag tin leeo ree suhaag har har hare hare gun gaavai gurmat hau bal bale hau bal bale jan naanak har jap bhiee nihaal nihaal nihaal ||2||1||7||
verses.translation: She alone obtains her Husband Lord, who is so pre-destined. Through the Guru's Teachings, she sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord Har. am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Lord, O servant Nanak. Meditating on the Lord, I have become enraptured.

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: har gun gaavahu jagadhees ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਏਕਾ ਜੀਹ ਕੀਚੈ ਲਖ ਬੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: ekaa jeeh keechai lakh bees ||
verses.translation: Let my one tongue become two hundred thousand

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਪੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: jap har har sabadh japees ||
verses.translation: with them all, I will meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, and chant the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਕਿਰਪੀਸ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ho ho kirapees ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Lord, please, please, be Merciful to me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਲਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪੇ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਉ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa kar suaamee ham lai har sevaa har jap jape har jap jape jap jaapau jagadhees ||
verses.translation: O Lord, my Lord and Master, please be Merciful to me; please enjoin me to serve You. I chant and meditate on the Lord, I chant and meditate on the Lord, I chant and meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਜਨ ਰਾਮੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਤੇ ਊਤਮ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਘੁਮਿ ਘੁਮੇ ਘੁਮਿ ਘੁਮਿ ਜੀਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tumare jan raam japeh te uootam tin kau hau ghum ghume ghum ghum jees ||1||
verses.translation: Your humble servants chant and meditate on You, O Lord; they are sublime and exalted. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to them. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਸੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੀਸ ॥
verses.translit: har tum vadd vadde vadde vadd uooche so kareh j tudh bhaavees ||
verses.translation: O Lord, You are the Greatest of the Great, the Greatest of the Great, the most Lofty and High. You do whatever You please.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਬੀਸ ॥੨॥੨॥੮॥
verses.translit: jan naanak a(n)mrit peeaa gurmatee dhan dha(n)n dhan dha(n)n dha(n)n guroo saabees ||2||2||8||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar through the Guru's Teachings. Blessed, blessed, blessed, blessed, blessed and praised is the Guru. ||2||2||8||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮੋ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bhaj raamo man raam ||
verses.translation: O mind, meditate and vibrate on the Lord, Raam, Raam.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਵਡਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jis roop na rekh vaddaam ||
verses.translation: He has no form or feature - He is Great!

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੁ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat mil bhaj raam ||
verses.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, vibrate and meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਡ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਭਾਗ ਮਥਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: badd ho ho bhaag mathaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This is the high destiny written on your forehead. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਤੁ ਜਾਸੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਨਦੋ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: jit gireh ma(n)dhar har hot jaas tit ghar aanadho aana(n)dh bhaj raam raam raam ||
verses.translation: That household, that mansion, in which the Lord's Praises are sung - that home is filled with ecstasy and joy; so vibrate and meditate on the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰੇ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam gun gaavahu har preetam upadhes guroo gur satiguraa sukh hot har hare har hare hare bhaj raam raam raam ||1||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Name of the Lord, the Beloved Lord. Through the Teachings of the Guru, the Guru, the True Guru, you shall find peace. So vibrate and meditate on the Lord, Har, Haray, the Lord, Raam |1|

verses.original: ਸਭ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਧਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sisaT dhaar har tum kirapaal karataa sabh too too too raam raam raam ||
verses.translation: You are the Support of the whole universe, Lord; O Merciful Lord, You, You, You are the Creator of all, Raam, Raam, Raam.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੋ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥੩॥੯॥
verses.translit: jan naanako saranaagatee dheh gurmatee bhaj raam raam raam ||2||3||9||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary; please bless him with the Guru's Teachings, that he may vibrate and meditate on the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam. ||2||3||9||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਾਟਉ ਪਗ ਚਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: satigur chaaTau pag chaaT ||
verses.translation: I eagerly kiss the Feet of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਧਰ ਬਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: jit mil har paadhar baaT ||
verses.translation: Meeting Him, the Path to the Lord becomes smooth and easy.

verses.original: ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: bhaj har ras ras har gaaT ||
verses.translation: I lovingly vibrate and meditate on the Lord, and gulp down His Sublime Essence.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਲਿਖੇ ਲਿਲਾਟ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ho ho likhe lilaaT ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord has written this destiny on my forehead. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਖਟ ਕਰਮ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਜੋਗੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਜਟ ਜਟਾ ਜਟ ਜਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: khaT karam kiriaa kar bahu bahu bisathaar sidh saadhik jogeeaa kar jaT jaTaa jaT jaaT ||
verses.translation: Some perform the six rituals and rites; the Siddhas, seekers and Yogis put on all sorts of pompous shows, with their hair all tangled and matted.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜੋਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਖੋਲਿ ਖੋਲਿ ਕਪਾਟ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar bhekh na paieeaai har braham jog har paieeaai satasa(n)gatee upadhes guroo gur sa(n)t janaa khol khol kapaaT ||1||
verses.translation: Yoga - Union with the Lord God - is not obtained by wearing religious robes; the Lord is found in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and the Guru's Teachings. The humble Saints throw the doors wide open. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਾਹੁ ਤੂ ਭਰਪੁਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਲ ਥਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਇਕੋ ਇਕ ਏਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: too apara(n)par suaamee at agaahu too bharapur rahiaa jal thale har ik iko ik ekai har thaaT ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, You are the farthest of the far, utterly unfathomable. You are totally pervading the water and the land. You alone are the One and Only Unique Lord of all creation.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟੇ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਘਾਟ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: too jaaneh sabh bidh boojheh aape jan naanak ke prabh ghaT ghaTe ghaT ghaTe ghaT har ghaaT ||2||4||10||
verses.translation: You alone know all Your ways and means. You alone understand Yourself. Servant Nanak's Lord God is in each heart, in every heart, in the home of each and every heart. ||2||4||10||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਮਾਧੋ ॥
verses.translit: jap man gobidh maadho ||
verses.translation: O mind, chant and meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧੋ ॥
verses.translit: har har agam agaadho ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is inaccessible and unfathomable.

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲਾਧੋ ॥
verses.translit: mat gurmat har prabh laadho ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, my intellect attains the Lord God.

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਲਿਖੇ ਲਿਲਾਧੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhur ho ho likhe lilaadho ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This is the pre-ordained destiny written on my forehead. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਚਿ ਬਹੁ ਚਿਤੈ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੋ ॥
verses.translit: bikh maiaa sa(n)ch bahu chitai bikaar sukh paieeaai har bhaj sa(n)t sa(n)t sa(n)gatee mil satiguroo gur saadho ||
verses.translation: Collecting the poison of Maya, people think of all sorts of evil. But peace is found only by vibrating and meditating on the Lord; with the Saints, in the Sangat, the Society of the Saints, meet the True Guru, the Holy Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਛੁਹਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਮਨੂਰ ਭਏ ਕੰਚਨ ਤਿਉ ਪਤਿਤ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਸੁਧ ਹੋਵਤ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੁਧ ਹਾਧੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau chhuh paaras manoor bhe ka(n)chan tiau patit jan mil sa(n)gatee sudh hovat gurmatee sudh haadho ||1||
verses.translation: Just as when the iron slag is transmuted into gold by touching the Philosopher's Stone - when the sinner joins the Sangat, he becomes pure, through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਕਾਸਟ ਸੰਗਿ ਲੋਹਾ ਬਹੁ ਤਰਤਾ ਤਿਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੇ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੋ ॥
