verses.translit: jiau kaasaT sa(n)g lohaa bahu tarataa tiau paapee sa(n)g tare saadh saadh sa(n)gatee gur satiguroo gur saadho ||
verses.translation: Just like the heavy iron which is carried across on the wooden raft, sinners are carried across in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and the Guru, the True Guru, the Holy Guru.

verses.original: ਚਾਰਿ ਬਰਨ ਚਾਰਿ ਆਸ੍ਰਮ ਹੈ ਕੋਈ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਕੁਲ ਸਗਲ ਤਰਾਧੋ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: chaar baran chaar aasram hai koiee milai guroo gur naanak so aap tarai kul sagal taraadho ||2||5||11||
verses.translation: There are four castes, four social classes, and four stages of life. Whoever meets the Guru, Guru Nanak, is himself carried across, and he carries all his ancestors and generations across as well. ||2||5||11||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: har jas gaavahu bhagavaan ||
verses.translation: Sing the Praises of the Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਪਾਪ ਲਹਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jas gaavat paap lahaan ||
verses.translation: Singing His Praises, sins are washed away.

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਜਸੁ ਕਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: mat gurmat sun jas kaan ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, listen to His Praises with your ears.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਕਿਰਪਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har ho ho kirapaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord shall be Merciful to you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਤੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: tere jan dhiaaveh ik man ik chit te saadhoo sukh paaveh jap har har naam nidhaan ||
verses.translation: Your humble servants focus their consciousness and meditate on You with one-pointed mind; those Holy beings find peace, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Treasure of Bliss.

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ausatat kareh prabh tereeaa mil saadhoo saadh janaa gur satiguroo bhagavaan ||1||
verses.translation: They sing Your Praises, God, meeting with the Holy, the Holy people, and the Guru, the True Guru, O Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੇ ਤਰੇ ਭਵ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਤੇ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jin kai hiradhai too suaamee te sukh fal paaveh te tare bhav si(n)dh te bhagat har jaan ||
verses.translation: They alone obtain the fruit of peace, within whose hearts You, O my Lord and Master, abide. They cross over the terrifying world-ocean - they are known as the Lord's devotees.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਮ ਲਾਇ ਹਰੇ ਹਮ ਲਾਇ ਹਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਤੂ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: tin sevaa ham lai hare ham lai hare jan naanak ke har too too too too too bhagavaan ||2||6||12||
verses.translation: Please enjoin me to their service, Lord, please enjoin me to their service. O Lord God, You, You, You, You, You are the Lord of servant Nanak. ||2||6||12||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਗਾਈਐ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: gaieeaai gun gopaal kirapaa nidh ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World, the Treasure of Mercy.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਬਿਦਾਰਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲ ਸਿਧਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh bidhaaran sukhadhaate satigur jaa kau bheTat hoi sagal sidh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Destroyer of pain, the Giver of peace; meeting Him, one is totally fulfilled. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਾਧਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: simarat naam maneh saadhaarai ||
verses.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Naam, the Support of the mind.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: koT paraadhee khin meh taarai ||1||
verses.translation: Millions of sinners are carried across in an instant. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau cheet aavai gur apanaa ||
verses.translation: Whoever remembers his Guru,

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa kau dhookh nahee til supanaa ||2||
verses.translation: shall not suffer sorrow, even in dreams. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau satigur apanaa raakhai ||
verses.translation: Whoever keeps his Guru enshrined within

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: so jan har ras rasanaa chaakhai ||3||
verses.translation: - that humble being tastes the sublime essence of the Lord with his tongue. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਮਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gur keenee miaa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has been Kind to me;

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਭਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: halat palat mukh uoojal bhiaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: here and herafter, my face is radiant. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਰਾਧਉ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaraadhau tujheh suaamee apane ||
verses.translation: I worship and adore You, my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਤ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: uooThat baiThat sovat jaagat saas saas saas har japane ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Standing up and sitting down, while sleeping and awake, with each and every breath, I meditate on the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਬਸਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: taa kai hiradhai basio naam ||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides within the hearts of those,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕੀਨੋ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jaa kau suaamee keeno dhaan ||1||
verses.translation: whose Lord and Master blesses them with this gift. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਆਈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: taa kai hiradhai aaiee saa(n)t ||
verses.translation: Peace and tranquility come into the hearts of those

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਾਂਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: Thaakur bheTe gur bachanaa(n)t ||2||
verses.translation: who meet their Lord and Master, through the Word of the Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਸੋਈ ਪਰਬੀਨ ॥ ਨਾਮ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sarab kalaa soiee parabeen || naam ma(n)tr jaa kau gur dheen ||3||
verses.translation: Those whom the Guru blesses with the Mantra of the Naam are wise, and blessed with all powers,. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak taa kai bal jaau ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those

verses.original: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: kalijug meh paiaa jin naau ||4||2||
verses.translation: who are blessed with the Name in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਗਾਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਸਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: keerat prabh kee gaau meree rasanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Sing the Praises of God, O my tongue.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਊਹਾਂ ਚਰਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਬਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anik baar kar ba(n)dhan sa(n)tan uoohaa(n) charan gobi(n)dh jee ke basanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Humbly bow to the Saints, over and over again; through them, the Feet of the Lord of the Universe shall come to abide within you. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: anik bhaa(n)t kar dhuaar na paavau ||
verses.translation: The Door to the Lord cannot be found by any other means.

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: hoi kirapaal ta har har dhiaavau ||1||
verses.translation: When He becomes Merciful, we come to meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਹ ਨ ਸੋਧਾ ॥
verses.translit: koT karam kar dheh na sodhaa ||
verses.translation: The body is not purified by millions of rituals.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਬੋਧਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat meh man parabodhaa ||2||
verses.translation: The mind is awakened and enlightened only in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨ ਬੂਝੀ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tirasan na boojhee bahu ra(n)g maiaa ||
verses.translation: Thirst and desire are not quenched by enjoying the many pleasures of Maya.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam lait sarab sukh paiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, total peace is found. ||3||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜਬ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham jab bhe dhiaal ||
verses.translation: When the Supreme Lord God becomes Merciful,

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਉ ਛੂਟੇ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tau chhooTe ja(n)jaal ||4||3||
verses.translation: says Nanak, then one is rid of worldly entanglements. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਮਾਂਗੁ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee maa(n)g gobidh te ||
verses.translation: Beg for such blessings from the Lord of the Universe:

verses.original: ਟਹਲ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾਂ ਜਪਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: Tahal sa(n)tan kee sa(n)g saadhoo kaa har naamaa(n) jap param gate ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: to work for the Saints, and the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Chanting the Name of the Lord, the supreme status is obtained. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾ ਚਰਨਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: poojaa charanaa Thaakur saranaa ||
verses.translation: Worship the Feet of Your Lord and Master, and seek His Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਕੁਸਲੁ ਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: soiee kusalu ju prabh jeeau karanaa ||1||
verses.translation: Take joy in whatever God does. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਹੋਤ ਇਹ ਦੁਰਲਭ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: safal hot ieh dhuralabh dhehee ||
verses.translation: This precious human body becomes fruitful,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਇਆ ਕਰੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaa kau satigur miaa karehee ||2||
verses.translation: when the True Guru shows His Kindness. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭਰਮੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: agiaan bharam binasai dhukh dderaa ||
verses.translation: The house of ignorance, doubt and pain is destroyed,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਪੈਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa kai hiradhai baseh gur pairaa ||3||
verses.translation: for those within whose hearts the Guru's Feet abide. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g ra(n)g prabh dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, lovingly meditate on God.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tin pooraa paiaa ||4||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, you shall obtain the Perfect Lord. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਤਨ ਹੂੰ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat bhagatan hoo(n) ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: Devotion is the natural quality of God's devotees.

verses.original: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਗਲਤ ਭਏ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਆਪਨ ਲੀਏ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tan man galat bhe Thaakur siau aapan le'ee milaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Their bodies and minds are blended with their Lord and Master; He unites them with Himself. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗਾਵਨਹਾਰੀ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੀਤ ॥
verses.translit: gaavanahaaree gaavai geet ||
verses.translation: The singer sings the songs,

verses.original: ਤੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਬਸੇ ਜਿਹ ਚੀਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: te udhare base jeh cheet ||1||
verses.translation: but she alone is saved, within whose consciousness the Lord abides. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੇਖੇ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਪਰੋਸਨਹਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: pekhe bi(n)jan parosanahaarai ||
verses.translation: The one who sets the table sees the food,

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਰੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jeh bhojan keeno te tirapataarai ||2||
verses.translation: but only one who eats the food is satisfied. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਗ ਕਾਛੇ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: anik savaiaa(n)g kaachhe bhekhadhaaree ||
verses.translation: People disguise themselves with all sorts of costumes,

verses.original: ਜੈਸੋ ਸਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaiso saa taiso dhirasaTaaree ||3||
verses.translation: but in the end, they are seen as they truly are. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: kahan kahaavan sagal ja(n)jaar ||
verses.translation: Speaking and talking are all just entanglements.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਚੁ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas sach karanee saar ||4||5||
verses.translation: O slave Nanak, the true way of life is excellent. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਤ ਉਮਾਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tero jan har jas sunat umaahio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your humble servant listens to Your Praises with delight. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਆਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maneh pragaas pekh prabh kee sobhaa jat kat pekhau aahio ||1||
verses.translation: My mind is enlightened, gazing upon the Glory of God. Wherever I look, there He is. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹਿਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabh te parai parai te uoochaa gahir ga(n)bheer athaahio ||2||
verses.translation: You are the farthest of all, the highest of the far, profound, unfathomable and unreachable. ||2||

verses.original: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਪਰਦਾ ਲਾਹਿਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ot pot milio bhagatan kau jan siau paradhaa laahio ||3||
verses.translation: You are united with Your devotees, through and through; You have removed Your veil for Your humble servants. ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਹਿਓ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh gaavai gun naanak sahaj samaadh samaahio ||4||6||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, Nanak sings Your Glorious Praises; he is intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੰਤਨ ਪਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tan peh aap udhaaran aaio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have come to the Saints to save myself. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dharasan bheTat hot puneetaa har har ma(n)tr dhiraRaio ||1||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of their Darshan, I am sanctified; they have implanted the Mantra of the Lord, Har, Har, within me. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਟੇ ਰੋਗ ਭਏ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਖਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaaTe rog bhe man niramal har har aaukhadh khaio ||2||
verses.translation: The disease has been eradicated, and my mind has become immaculate. I have taken the healing medicine of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਸਥਿਤ ਭਏ ਬਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਥਾਨਾ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: asathit bhe base sukh thaanaa bahur na katahoo dhaio ||3||
verses.translation: I have become steady and stable, and I dwell in the home of peace. I shall never again wander anywhere. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਤਰੇ ਕੁਲ ਲੋਗਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਪਤ ਨ ਮਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh tare kul logaa naanak lipat na maio ||4||7||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, the people and all their generations are saved; O Nanak, they are not engrossed in Maya. ||4||7||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਸਰਿ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਤਾਤਿ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bisar giee sabh taat paraiee ||
verses.translation: I have totally forgotten my jealousy of others,

verses.original: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab te saadhasa(n)gat moh paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: since I found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਬੈਰੀ ਨਹੀ ਬਿਗਾਨਾ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naa ko bairee nahee bigaanaa sagal sa(n)g ham kau ban aaiee ||1||
verses.translation: No one is my enemy, and no one is a stranger. I get along with everyone. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੋ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਿਓ ਏਹ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jo prabh keeno so bhal maanio eh sumat saadhoo te paiee ||2||
verses.translation: Whatever God does, I accept that as good. This is the sublime wisdom I have obtained from the Holy. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੈ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾਈ ॥੩॥੮॥
verses.translit: sabh meh rav rahiaa prabh ekai pekh pekh naanak bigasaiee ||3||8||
verses.translation: The One God is pervading in all. Gazing upon Him, beholding Him, Nanak blossoms forth in happiness. ||3||8||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਪਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: Thaakur jeeau tuhaaro paranaa ||
verses.translation: O my Dear Lord and Master, You alone are my Support.

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਹਤੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੈ ਊਪਰਿ ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਓਟ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maan mahat tum(h)aarai uoopar tum(h)ree oT tum(h)aaree saranaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are my Honor and Glory; I seek Your Support, and Your Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਆਸ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਲੈ ਧਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h)ree aas bharosaa tum(h)raa tumaraa naam ridhai lai dharanaa ||
verses.translation: You are my Hope, and You are my Faith. I take Your Name and enshrine it within my heart.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੋ ਬਲੁ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tumaro bal tum sa(n)g suhele jo jo kahahu soiee soiee karanaa ||1||
verses.translation: You are my Power; associating with You, I am embellished and exalted. I do whatever You say. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਹੋਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਤ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tumaree dhiaa miaa sukh paavau hoh kirapaal ta bhaujal taranaa ||
verses.translation: Through Your Kindness and Compassion, I find peace; when You are Merciful, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਅਭੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਿਰੁ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨਾ ॥੨॥੯॥
verses.translit: abhai dhaan naam har paio sir ddaario naanak sa(n)t charanaa ||2||9||
verses.translation: Through the Name of the Lord, I obtain the gift of fearlessness; Nanak places his head on the feet of the Saints. ||2||9||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਸਰਨਿ ਚਰਨ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saadh saran charan chit laiaa ||
verses.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Holy, I focus my consciousness on the Lord's Feet.

verses.original: ਸੁਪਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਨੀ ਪੇਖੀ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਨਾਮ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: supan kee baat sunee pekhee supanaa naam ma(n)tr satiguroo dhiraRaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When I was dreaming, I heard and saw only dream-objects. The True Guru has implanted the Mantra of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੋ ਰਾਜ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: neh tirapataano raaj joban dhan bahur bahur fir dhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Power, youth and wealth do not bring satisfaction; people chase after them again and again.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਭ ਬੁਝੀ ਹੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sukh paiaa tirasanaa sabh bujhee hai saa(n)t paiee gun gaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: I have found peace and tranquility, and all my thirsty desires have been quenched, singing His Glorious Praises. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਪਸੂ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bin boojhe pasoo kee niaaiee bhram moh biaapio maiaa ||
verses.translation: Without understanding, they are like beasts, engrossed in doubt, emotional attachment and Maya.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਮ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਕਾਟੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g jam jevaree kaaTee naanak sahaj samaiaa ||2||10||
verses.translation: But in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the noose of Death is cut, O Nanak, and one intuitively merges in celestial peace. ||2||10||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har ke charan hiradhai gai ||
verses.translation: Sing of the Lord's Feet within your heart.

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: seetalaa sukh saa(n)t moorat simar simar nit dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditate, meditate in constant remembrance on God, the Embodiment of soothing peace and cooling tranquility. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਆਸ ਹੋਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sagal aas hot pooran koT janam dhukh jai ||1||
verses.translation: All your hopes shall be fulfilled, and the pain of millions of deaths and births shall be gone. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: pu(n)n dhaan anek kiriaa saadhoo sa(n)g samai ||
verses.translation: Immerse yourself in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and you shall obtain the benefits of giving charitable gifts, and all sorts of good deeds.

verses.original: ਤਾਪ ਸੰਤਾਪ ਮਿਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: taap sa(n)taap miTe naanak baahuR kaal na khai ||2||11||
verses.translation: Sorrow and suffering shall be erased, O Nanak, and you shall never again be devoured by death. ||2||11||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੩
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Third House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਥੀਐ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: katheeaai sa(n)tasa(n)g prabh giaan ||
verses.translation: Speak of God's Wisdom in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pooran param jot paramesur simarat paieeaai maan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Perfect Supreme Divine Light, the Transcendent Lord God, honor and glory are obtained. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਰਹੇ ਸ੍ਰਮ ਨਾਸੇ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: aavat jaat rahe sram naase simarat saadhoo sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: One's comings and goings in reincarnation cease, and suffering is dispelled, meditating in remembrance in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਹੋਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: patit puneet hoh khin bheetar paarabraham kai ra(n)g ||1||
verses.translation: Sinners are sanctified in an instant, in the love of the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਥੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo kathai sunai har keeratan taa kee dhuramat naas ||
verses.translation: Whoever speaks and listens to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is rid of evil-mindedness.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਸ ॥੨॥੧॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: sagal manorath paavai naanak pooran hovai aas ||2||1||12||
verses.translation: All hopes and desires, O Nanak, are fulfilled. ||2||1||12||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat nidh har ko naam ||
verses.translation: The Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g sahaiee jeea kai kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It is the Companion of the soul, its Helper and Support. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨੁ ਨਿਤਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ren nit majan karai ||
verses.translation: Continually bathing in the dust of the feet of the Saints,

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਹਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kilabikh harai ||1||
verses.translation: the sins of countless incarnations are washed away. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਊਚੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee uoochee baanee ||
verses.translation: The words of the humble Saints are lofty and exalted.

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤਰੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: simar simar tare naanak praanee ||2||2||13||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance, O Nanak, mortal beings are carried across and saved. ||2||2||13||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo har hare gun gai ||
verses.translation: O Holy people, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Haray.

verses.original: ਮਾਨ ਤਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maan tan dhan praan prabh ke simarat dhukh jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Mind, body, wealth and the breath of life - all come from God; remembering Him in meditation, pain is taken away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਕਹਾ ਲੋੁਭਾਵਹਿ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: e'eet uoot kahaa luobhaaveh ek siau man lai ||1||
verses.translation: Why are you entangled in this and that? Let your mind be attuned to the One. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੰਤ ਆਸਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mahaa pavitr sa(n)t aasan mil sa(n)g gobidh dhiaai ||2||
verses.translation: The place of the Saints is utterly sacred; meet with them, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥੩॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: sagal tiaag saran aaio naanak leh milai ||3||3||14||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I have abandoned everything and come to Your Sanctuary. Please let me merge with You. ||3||3||14||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਉ ਸਾਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਨਾ ਇਕਾਂਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pekh pekh bigasaau saajan prabh aapanaa ikaa(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon and beholding my Best Friend, I blossom forth in bliss; my God is the One and Only. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਨਦਾ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਾਂਤਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aanadhaa sukh sahaj moorat tis aan naahee bhaa(n)t ||1||
verses.translation: He is the Image of Ecstasy, Intuitive Peace and Poise. There is no other like Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਇਕ ਬਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਸਮਲ ਜਾਂਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: simarat ik baar har har miT koT kasamal jaa(n)t ||2||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Har, Har, even once, millions of sins are erased. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਰਮੰਤ ਦੂਖ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਰਿਦ ਭਇਅੰਤ ਸਾਂਤਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gun rama(n)t dhookh naaseh ridh bhia(n)t saa(n)t ||3||
verses.translation: Uttering His Glorious Praises, suffering is eradicated, and the heart becomes tranquil and calm. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: a(n)mritaa ras peeau rasanaa naanak har ra(n)g raat ||4||4||15||
verses.translation: Drink in the Sweet, Sublime Ambrosial Nectar, O Nanak, and be imbued with the Love of the Lord. ||4||4||15||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਆਉ ਮੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saajanaa sa(n)t aau merai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O friends, O Saints, come to me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਨਦਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਸਮਲਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਪਰੇਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aanadhaa gun gai ma(n)gal kasamalaa miT jaeh parerai ||1||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with pleasure and joy, the sins will be erased and thrown away. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨ ਧਰਉ ਮਾਥੈ ਚਾਂਦਨਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਧੇਰੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t charan dharau maathai chaa(n)dhanaa gireh hoi a(n)dherai ||2||
verses.translation: Touch your forehead to the feet of the Saints, and your dark household shall be illumined. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਜਉ ਪੇਖਿ ਨੇਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh kamal bigasai gobi(n)dh bhajau pekh nerai ||3||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, the heart-lotus blossoms forth. Vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the Universe, and see Him near at hand. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਏ ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਹ ਬੇਰੈ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬॥
verses.translit: prabh kirapaa te sa(n)t paae vaar vaar naanak uh berai ||4||5||16||
verses.translation: By the Grace of God, I have found the Saints. Over and over again, Nanak is a sacrifice to that moment. ||4||5||16||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: charan saran gopaal teree ||
verses.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of Your Lotus Feet, O Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਧੋਹ ਭਰਮ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਜੈ ਕਾਟਿ ਬੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: moh maan dhoh bharam raakh leejai kaaT beree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Save me from emotional attachment, pride, deception and doubt; please cut away these ropes which bind me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬੂਡਤ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ॥
verses.translit: booddat sa(n)saar saagar ||
verses.translation: I am drowning in the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਉਧਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਤਨਾਗਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: audhare har simar ratanaagar ||1||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the Source of Jewels, I am saved. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੀਤਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: seetalaa har naam teraa ||
verses.translation: Your Name, Lord, is cooling and soothing.

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: poorano Thaakur prabh meraa ||2||
verses.translation: God, my Lord and Master, is Perfect. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਤਾਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dharadh nivaar taaran ||
verses.translation: You are the Deliverer, the Destroyer of the sufferings of the meek and the poor.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa nidh patit udhaaran ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Treasure of Mercy, the Saving Grace of sinners. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਦੂਖ ਕਰਿ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: koT janam dhookh kar paio ||
verses.translation: I have suffered the pains of millions of incarnations.

verses.original: ਸੁਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: sukhee naanak gur naam dhiraRaio ||4||6||17||
verses.translation: Nanak is at peace; the Guru has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me. ||4||6||17||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਧਨਿ ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhan uh preet charan sa(n)g laagee ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that love, which is attuned to the Lord's Feet.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: koT jaap taap sukh paae aai mile pooran baddabhaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The peace which comes from millions of chants and deep meditations is obtained by perfect good fortune and destiny. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਵਰ ਓਟ ਸਗਲੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: moh anaath dhaas jan teraa avar oT sagalee moh tiaagee ||
verses.translation: I am Your helpless servant and slave; I have given up all other support.

verses.original: ਭੋਰ ਭਰਮ ਕਾਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhor bharam kaaTe prabh simarat giaan a(n)jan mil sovat jaagee ||1||
verses.translation: Every trace of doubt has been eradicated, remembering God in meditation. I have applied the ointment of spiritual wisdom, and awakened from my sleep. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਬਡੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਰਤਨਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: too athaahu at baddo suaamee kirapaa si(n)dh pooran ratanaagee ||
verses.translation: You are Unfathomably Great and Utterly Vast, O my Lord and Master, Ocean of Mercy, Source of Jewels.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਮਸਤਕੁ ਆਨਿ ਧਰਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਗੀ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: naanak jaachak har har naam maa(n)gai masatak aan dhario prabh paagee ||2||7||18||
verses.translation: Nanak, the beggar, begs for the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; he rests his forehead upon God's Feet. ||2||7||18||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੁਚਿਲ ਕਠੋਰ ਕਪਟ ਕਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: kuchil kaThor kapaT kaamee ||
verses.translation: I am filthy, hard-hearted, deceitful and obsessed with sexual desire.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਤਿਉ ਤਾਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jaaneh tiau taar suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please carry me across, as You wish, O my Lord and Master. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too samarath saran jog too raakheh apanee kal dhaar ||1||
verses.translation: You are All-powerful and Potent to grant Sanctuary. Exerting Your Power, You protect us. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਨੇਮ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਇਨ ਬਿਧੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jaap taap nem such sa(n)jam naahee in bidhe chhuTakaar ||
verses.translation: Chanting and deep meditation, penance and austere self-discipline, fasting and purification - salvation does not come by any of these means.

verses.original: ਗਰਤ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: garat ghor a(n)dh te kaaddahu prabh naanak nadhar nihaar ||2||8||19||
verses.translation: Please lift me up and out of this deep, dark ditch; O God, please bless Nanak with Your Glance of Grace. ||2||8||19||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੪
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar chauthhaa
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Fourth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: naarain narapat namasakaarai ||
verses.translation: The one who bows in humble reverence to the Primal Lord, the Lord of all beings

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaise gur kau bal bal jaieeaai aap mukat moh taarai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: - I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to such a Guru; He Himself is liberated, and He carries me across as well. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਕਹੀਐ ਅੰਤੁ ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kavan kavan kavan gun kaheeaai a(n)t nahee kachh paarai ||
verses.translation: Which, which, which of Your Glorious Virtues should I chant? There is no end or limitation to them.

verses.original: ਲਾਖ ਲਾਖ ਲਾਖ ਕਈ ਕੋਰੈ ਕੋ ਹੈ ਐਸੋ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: laakh laakh laakh kiee korai ko hai aaiso beechaarai ||1||
verses.translation: There are thousands, tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands, many millions of them, but those who contemplate them are very rare. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸਮ ਬਿਸਮ ਹੀ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਲਾਲ ਗੁਲਾਲ ਰੰਗਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: bisam bisam bisam hee bhiee hai laal gulaal ra(n)gaarai ||
verses.translation: I am wonder-struck, wonder-struck, wonder-struck and amazed, dyed in the deep crimson color of my Beloved.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਰਸੁ ਆਈ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਚਾਖਿ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਮੁਸਕਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sa(n)tan ras aaiee hai jiau chaakh goo(n)gaa musakaarai ||2||1||20||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Saints savor this sublime essence, like the mute, who tastes the sweet candy, but only smiles. ||2||1||20||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ॥
verses.translit: n jaanee sa(n)tan prabh bin aan ||
verses.translation: The Saints do not know any other except God.

verses.original: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਸਭ ਪੇਖਿ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਬਕਨੋ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: uooch neech sabh pekh samaano mukh bakano man maan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They look upon all equally, the high and the low; they speak of Him with their mouths, and honor Him in their minds. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT poor rahe sukh saagar bhai bha(n)jan mere praan ||
verses.translation: He is pervading and permeating each and every heart; He is the Ocean of Peace, the Destroyer of fear. He is my praanaa - the Breath of Life.

verses.original: ਮਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਨਾਸਿਓ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਓ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maneh pragaas bhio bhram naasio ma(n)tr dheeo gur kaan ||1||
verses.translation: My mind was enlightened, and my doubt was dispelled, when the Guru whispered His Mantra into my ears. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਤ ਰਹੇ ਕ੍ਰਤਗੵ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਮੈ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਗੵਿਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: karat rahe karatagaye karunaa mai a(n)tarajaamee giyeaan ||
verses.translation: He is All-powerful, the Ocean of Mercy, the All-knowing Searcher of Hearts.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਾਂਗਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar naanak jas gaavai maa(n)gan kau har dhaan ||2||2||21||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day Nanak sings His Praises, and begs for the Gift of the Lord. ||2||2||21||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਹਨ ਕਹਾਵਨ ਕਉ ਕਈ ਕੇਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahan kahaavan kau kiee ketai ||
verses.translation: Many speak and talk about God.

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਹੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜੋ ਤਤ ਜੋਗ ਕਉ ਬੇਤੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaiso jan biralo hai sevak jo tat jog kau betai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: But one who understands the essence of Yoga - such a humble servant is very rare||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੀ ਨੇਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh naahee sabh sukh hee hai re ekai ekee netai ||
verses.translation: He has no pain - he is totally at peace. With his eyes, he sees only the One Lord.

verses.original: ਬੁਰਾ ਨਹੀ ਸਭੁ ਭਲਾ ਹੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਹਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਸਭ ਜੇਤੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: buraa nahee sabh bhalaa hee hai re haar nahee sabh jetai ||1||
verses.translation: No one seems evil to him - all are good. There is no defeat - he is totally victorious. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਖੀ ਹੈ ਰੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੇਤੈ ॥
verses.translit: sog naahee sadhaa harakhee hai re chhodd naahee kichh letai ||
verses.translation: He is never in sorrow - he is always happy; but he gives this up, and does not take anything.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹੈ ਕਤ ਆਵੈ ਕਤ ਰਮਤੈ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੨॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jan har har har hai kat aavai kat ramatai ||2||3||22||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the humble servant of the Lord is himself the Lord, Har, Har; he does not come and go in reincarnation. ||2||3||22||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹੀਏ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: he'ee ko preetam bisar na jai ||
verses.translation: I pray that my heart may never forget my Beloved.

verses.original: ਤਨ ਮਨ ਗਲਤ ਭਏ ਤਿਹ ਸੰਗੇ ਮੋਹਨੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਹੀ ਮੋਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tan man galat bhe teh sa(n)ge mohanee moh rahee moree mai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My body and mind are blended with Him, but the Enticer, Maya, is enticing me, O my mother. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਪਹਿ ਕਹਉ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਹਉ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਤੇਊ ਤੇਊ ਗਹੇ ਰਹੇ ਅਟਕਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jai jai peh kahau birathaa hau apunee teuoo teuoo gahe rahe aTakai ||
verses.translation: Those unto whom I tell my pain and frustration - they themselves are caught and stuck.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਕੀ ਏਕੈ ਜਾਲੀ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗੰਠਿ ਨਹੀ ਛੋਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anik bhaa(n)t kee ekai jaalee taa kee ga(n)Th nahee chhorai ||1||
verses.translation: In all sorts of ways, Maya has cast the net; the knots cannot be loosened. ||1||

verses.original: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਆਇਓ ਸੰਤਨ ਹੀ ਸਰਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: firat firat naanak dhaas aaio sa(n)tan hee saranai ||
verses.translation: Wandering and roaming, slave Nanak has come to the Sanctuary of the Saints.

verses.original: ਕਾਟੇ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਭਰਮ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਲੀਓ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ॥੨॥੪॥੨੩॥
verses.translit: kaaTe agiaan bharam moh maiaa leeo ka(n)Th lagai ||2||4||23||
verses.translation: The bonds of ignorance, doubt, emotional attachment and the love of Maya have been cut; God hugs me close in His Embrace. ||2||4||23||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਨਦ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਹਮਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: aanadh ra(n)g binodh hamaarai ||
verses.translation: My home is filled with ecstasy, pleasure and joy.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੋ ਗਾਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naamo gaavan naam dhiaavan naam hamaare praan adhaarai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I sing the Naam, and I meditate on the Naam. The Naam is the Support of my breath of life. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੋ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: naamo giaan naam isanaanaa har naam hamaare kaaraj savaarai ||
verses.translation: The Naam is spiritual wisdom, the Naam is my purifying bath. The Naam resolves all my affairs.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਡਾਈ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har naamo sobhaa naam baddaiee bhaujal bikham naam har taarai ||1||
verses.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glorious grandeur; the Naam is glorious greatness. The Name of the Lord carries me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਗਮ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲਾਲ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਭਇਓ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: agam padhaarath laal amolaa bhio paraapat gur charanaarai ||
verses.translation: The Unfathomable Treasure, the Priceless Gem - I have received it, through the Guru's Feet.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਾ ਮਗਨ ਭਏ ਹੀਅਰੈ ਦਰਸਾਰੈ ॥੨॥੫॥੨੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak prabh bhe kirapaalaa magan bhe heearai dharasaarai ||2||5||24||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, God has become Merciful; my heart is intoxicated by the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||2||5||24||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨ ਮੀਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨੇਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: saajan meet suaamee nero ||
verses.translation: My Friend, my Best Friend, my Lord and Master, is near.

verses.original: ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਭਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਥੋਰੈ ਕਾਜ ਬੁਰੋ ਕਹ ਫੇਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pekhat sunat sabhan kai sa(n)ge thorai kaaj buro keh fero ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He sees and hears everything; He is with everyone. You are here for such short time - why do you do evil? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਜੇਤੋ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ਕਛੂ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਤੇਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: naam binaa jeto lapaTaio kachhoo nahee naahee kachh tero ||
verses.translation: Except for the Naam, whatever you are involved with is nothing - nothing is yours.

verses.original: ਆਗੈ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਆਵਤ ਸਭ ਪਰਗਟ ਈਹਾ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਭਰਮ ਅੰਧੇਰੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aagai dhirasaT aavat sabh paragaT ieehaa mohio bharam a(n)dhero ||1||
verses.translation: Hereafter, everything is revealed to your gaze; but in this world, all are enticed by the darkness of doubt. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਟਕਿਓ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੰਗ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਬਿਸੇਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: aTakio sut banitaa sa(n)g maiaa dhevanahaar dhaataar bisero ||
verses.translation: People are caught in Maya, attached to their children and spouses. They have forgotten the Great and Generous Giver.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੈ ਭਾਰੋਸਉ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਨਹਾਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੋ ॥੨॥੬॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ekai bhaarosau ba(n)dhan kaaTanahaar gur mero ||2||6||25||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have one article of faith; my Guru is the One who releases me from bondage. ||2||6||25||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਖੈ ਦਲੁ ਸੰਤਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਗਾਹਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: bikhai dhal sa(n)tan tum(h)rai gaahio ||
verses.translation: Your Saints have overwhelmed the wicked army of corruption.

verses.original: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਟੇਕ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਆਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tumaree Tek bharosaa Thaakur saran tum(h)aaree aahio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They take Your Support and place their faith in You, O my Lord and Master; they seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਮਹਾ ਪਰਾਛਤ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਮਿਟਾਹਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke mahaa paraachhat dharasan bheT miTaahio ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, the terrible sins of countless lifetimes are erased.

verses.original: ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਅਨਦ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਹਿਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhio pragaas anadh ujeeaaraa sahaj samaadh samaahio ||1||
verses.translation: I am illumined, enlightened and filled with ecstasy. I am intuitively absorbed in Samaadhi. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਉਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੁਮ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਥਾਹਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: kaun kahai tum te kachh naahee tum samarath athaahio ||
verses.translation: Who says that You cannot do everything? You are Infinitely All-powerful.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਰੰਗ ਰੂਪ ਰਸ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੈ ਲਾਹਿਓ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੬॥
verses.translit: kirapaa nidhaan ra(n)g roop ras naam naanak lai laahio ||2||7||26||
verses.translation: O Treasure of Mercy, Nanak savors Your Love and Your Blissful Form, earning the Profit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||7||26||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਬੂਡਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਧੀਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: booddat praanee har jap dheerai ||
verses.translation: The drowning mortal is comforted and consoled, meditating on the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪੀਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: binasai moh bharam dhukh peerai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is rid of emotional attachment, doubt, pain and suffering. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: simarau dhin rain gur ke charanaa ||
verses.translation: I meditate in remembrance, day and night, on the Guru's Feet.

verses.original: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jat kat pekhau tumaree saranaa ||1||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see Your Sanctuary. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prasaadh har ke gun gaiaa ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Saints, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥੮॥੨੭॥
verses.translit: gur bheTat naanak sukh paiaa ||2||8||27||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak has found peace. ||2||8||27||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: simarat naam maneh sukh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Naam, peace of mind is found.

verses.original: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadh janaa mil har jas gaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meeting the Holy Saint, sing the Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸੇਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh ridhai basero ||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, God has come to dwell within my heart.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਮਾਥਾ ਮੇਰੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: charan sa(n)tan kai maathaa mero ||1||
verses.translation: I touch my forehead to the feet of the Saints. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਉ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਮਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham kau simarahu manaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Meditate, O my mind, on the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਾਂ ॥੨॥੯॥੨੮॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naanak har jas sunaa(n) ||2||9||28||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, Nanak listens to the Praises of the Lord. ||2||9||28||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਚਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਰਸਨ ॥
verses.translit: mere man preet charan prabh parasan ||
verses.translation: My mind loves to touch the Feet of God.

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭੋਜਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ਅਖੀਅਨ ਕਉ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa har har bhojan tirapataanee akheean kau sa(n)tokh prabh dharasan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My tongue is satisfied with the Food of the Lord, Har, Har. My eyes are contented with the Blessed Vision of God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਨਨਿ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਜਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਲਮਲ ਦੋਖ ਸਗਲ ਮਲ ਹਰਸਨ ॥
verses.translit: karanan poor rahio jas preetam kalamal dhokh sagal mal harasan ||
verses.translation: My ears are filled with the Praise of my Beloved; all my foul sins and faults are erased.

verses.original: ਪਾਵਨ ਧਾਵਨ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖ ਪੰਥਾ ਅੰਗ ਸੰਗ ਕਾਇਆ ਸੰਤ ਸਰਸਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: paavan dhaavan suaamee sukh pa(n)thaa a(n)g sa(n)g kaiaa sa(n)t sarasan ||1||
verses.translation: My feet follow the Path of Peace to my Lord and Master; my body and limbs joyfully blossom forth in the Society of the Saints. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਥਕਿਤ ਨਹੀ ਕਰਸਨ ॥
verses.translit: saran gahee pooran abinaasee aan upaav thakit nahee karasan ||
verses.translation: I have taken Sanctuary in my Perfect, Eternal, Imperishable Lord. I do not bother trying anything else.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਏ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਅੰਧ ਘੋਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਸਨ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੨੯॥
verses.translit: kar geh le'ee naanak jan apane a(n)dh ghor saagar nahee marasan ||2||10||29||
verses.translation: Taking them by the hand, O Nanak, God saves His humble servants; they shall not perish in the deep, dark world-ocean. ||2||10||29||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੁਹਕਤ ਕਪਟ ਖਪਟ ਖਲ ਗਰਜਤ ਮਰਜਤ ਮੀਚੁ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kuhakat kapaT khapaT khal garajat marajat meech anik bareeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Those fools who bellow with rage and destructive deceit, are crushed and killed innumerable times. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਹੰ ਮਤ ਅਨ ਰਤ ਕੁਮਿਤ ਹਿਤ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪੇਖਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਲਾਖ ਗਰੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aha(n) mat an rat kumit hit preetam pekhat bhramat laakh gareeaa ||1||
verses.translation: Intoxicated with egotism and imbued with other tastes, I am in love with my evil enemies. My Beloved watches over me as I wander through thousands of incarnations. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਤ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਅਚਾਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਹੀਨਤ ਮਮ ਮਦ ਮਾਤ ਕੋਪ ਜਰੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: anit biauhaar achaar bidh heenat mam madh maat kop jareeaa ||
verses.translation: My dealings are false, and my lifestyle is chaotic. Intoxicated with the wine of emotion, I am burning in the fire of anger.

verses.original: ਕਰੁਣ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ਦੀਨ ਬੰਧੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: karun kirapaal guopaal dheen ba(n)dh naanak udhar saran pareeaa ||2||11||30||
verses.translation: O Merciful Lord of the World, Embodiment of Compassion, Relative of the meek and the poor, please save Nanak; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||11||30||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeea praan maan dhaataa ||
verses.translation: The Giver of the soul, the breath of life and honor

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤੇ ਹੀ ਹਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bisarate hee haan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: - forgetting the Lord, all is lost. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਆਨ ਲਾਗਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੋ ਡਾਰਿ ਭੂਮਿ ਪਾਗਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh tiaag aan laageh a(n)mrito ddaar bhoom paageh ||
verses.translation: You have forsaken the Lord of the Universe, and become attached to another - you are throwing away the Ambrosial Nectar, to take dust.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਸਿਉ ਆਸਕਤ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bikhai ras siau aasakat mooRe kaahe sukh maan ||1||
verses.translation: What do you expect from corrupt pleasures? You fool! What makes you think that they will bring peace? ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਜਨਮ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਖਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh biaapio janam hee kee khaan ||
verses.translation: Engrossed in unfulfilled sexual desire, unresolved anger and greed, you shall be consigned to reincarnation.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇਓ ਉਧਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾਨਿ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੩੧॥
verses.translit: patit paavan saran aaio udhar naanak jaan ||2||12||31||
verses.translation: But I have entered the Sanctuary of the Purifier of sinners. O Nanak, I know that I shall be saved. ||2||12||31||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਵਿਲੋਕਉ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਮੁਖਾਰਬਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: avilokau raam ko mukhaarabi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: I gaze on the Lotus-like Face of the Lord.

verses.original: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਰਤਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਸਭ ਚਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: khojat khojat ratan paio bisaree sabh chi(n)dh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Searching and seeking, I have found the Jewel. I am totally rid of all anxiety. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal ridhai dhaar ||
verses.translation: Enshrining His Lotus Feet within my heart,

verses.original: ਉਤਰਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਮੰਦ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: autariaa dhukh ma(n)dh ||1||
verses.translation: pain and wickedness have been dispelled. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਜ ਧਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਰਬਸੋ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: raaj dhan paravaar merai sarabaso gobi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The Lord of all the Universe is my kingdom, wealth and family.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮਿ ਲਾਭੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਨਾਨਕ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਮਰੰਦ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੩੨॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gam laabh paio naanak fir na mara(n)dh ||2||13||32||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak has earned the Profit; he shall never die again. ||2||13||32||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar panjavaa
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Fifth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਜਹੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh poojaho naam araadh ||
verses.translation: Worship God, and adore His Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur satigur charanee laag ||
verses.translation: Grasp the Feet of the Guru, the True Guru.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਗਾਧਿ ॥
verses.translit: har paavahu man agaadh ||
verses.translation: The Unfathomable Lord shall come into your mind,

verses.original: ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤੋ ਹੋ ਹੋ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾਧਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jag jeeto ho ho gur kirapaadh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and by Guru's Grace, you shall be victorious in this world. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਪੂਜਾ ਮੈ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਖੋਜੀ ਸਾ ਪੂਜਾ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: anik poojaa mai bahu bidh khojee saa poojaa j har bhaavaas ||
verses.translation: I have studied countless ways of worship in all sorts of ways, but that alone is worship, which is pleasing to the Lord's Will.

verses.original: ਮਾਟੀ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਪੁਤਰੀ ਜੋਰੀ ਕਿਆ ਏਹ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: maaTee kee ieh putaree joree kiaa eh karam kamaas ||
verses.translation: This body-puppet is made of clay - what can it do by itself?

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh baeh pakar jis maarag paavahu so tudh ja(n)t milaas ||1||
verses.translation: O God, those humble beings meet You, whom You grasp by the arm, and place on the Path. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਇਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: avar oT mai koi na soojhai ik har kee oT mai aas ||
verses.translation: I do not know of any other support; O Lord, You are my only Hope and Support.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਦੀਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa dheen kare aradhaas ||
verses.translation: I am meek and poor - what prayer can I offer?

verses.original: ਜਉ ਸਭ ਘਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: jau sabh ghaT prabhoo nivaas ||
verses.translation: God abides in every heart.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਚਰਨਨ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: prabh charanan kee man piaas ||
verses.translation: My mind is thirsty for the Feet of God.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਹੀਅਤੁ ਹੈ ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੩॥
verses.translit: jan naanak dhaas kaheeat hai tum(h)raa hau bal bal sadh bal jaas ||2||1||33||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak, Your slave, speaks: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever a sacrifice to You. ||2||1||33||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੬
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar chhayvaa
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Sixth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਤੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jagat udhaaran naam pria terai ||
verses.translation: Your Name, O my Beloved, is the Saving Grace of the world.

verses.original: ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: nav nidh naam nidhaan har kerai ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the wealth of the nine treasures.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗ ਅਨੂਪੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)g ra(n)g ra(n)g anooperai ||
verses.translation: One who is imbued with the Love of the Incomparably Beautiful Lord is joyful.

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਗਨੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe re man moh maganerai ||
verses.translation: O mind, why do you cling to emotional attachments?

verses.original: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਦੇਖੁ ਸਾਧ ਦਰਸੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: nainahu dhekh saadh dharaserai ||
verses.translation: With your eyes, gaze upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of the Holy.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਲੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: so paavai jis likhat lilerai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: They alone find it, who have such destiny inscribed upon their foreheads. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੇਵਉ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਚਰਨੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: sevau saadh sa(n)t charanerai ||
verses.translation: I serve at the feet of the Holy Saints.

verses.original: ਬਾਂਛਉ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: baa(n)chhau dhoor pavitr karerai ||
verses.translation: I long for the dust of their feet, which purifies and sanctifies.

verses.original: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਮੈਲੁ ਕਟੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: aThasaTh majan mail kaTerai ||
verses.translation: Just like the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, it washes away filth and pollution.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੋਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: saas saas dhiaavahu mukh nahee morai ||
verses.translation: With each and every breath I meditate on Him, and never turn my face away.

verses.original: ਕਿਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kichh sa(n)g na chaalai laakh karorai ||
verses.translation: Of your thousands and millions, nothing shall go along with you.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਪੁਕਰੋਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh jee ko naam a(n)t pukarorai ||1||
verses.translation: Only the Name of God will call to you in the end. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਨਿ ਏਕ ਨਿਰੰਕੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: manasaa maan ek nira(n)kerai ||
verses.translation: Let it be your wish to honor and obey the One Formless Lord.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: sagal tiaagahu bhaau dhoojerai ||
verses.translation: Abandon the love of everything else.

verses.original: ਕਵਨ ਕਹਾਂ ਹਉ ਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਤੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: kavan kahaa(n) hau gun pria terai ||
verses.translation: What Glorious Praises of Yours can I utter, O my Beloved?

verses.original: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਏਕ ਟੁਲੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: baran na saakau ek Tulerai ||
verses.translation: I cannot describe even one of Your Virtues.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan piaas bahut man merai ||
verses.translation: My mind is so thirsty for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵ ਜਗਤ ਗੁਰ ਕੇਰੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੪॥
verses.translit: mil naanak dhev jagat gur kerai ||2||1||34||
verses.translation: Please come and meet Nanak, O Divine Guru of the World. ||2||1||34||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਕਉਨ ਬਿਧੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਪਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaisee kaun bidhe dharasan parasanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: How may I obtain the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਸ ਪਿਆਸ ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਉਮਗਿ ਹੀਉ ਤਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aas piaas safal moorat umag heeau tarasanaa ||1||
verses.translation: I hope and thirst for Your wish-fulfilling image; my heart yearns and longs for You. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਲੀਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੀਨ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: dheen leen piaas meen sa(n)tanaa har sa(n)tanaa ||
verses.translation: The meek and humble Saints are like thirsty fish; the Saints of the Lord are absorbed in Him.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)tanaa kee ren ||
verses.translation: I am the dust of the feet of the Lord's Saints.

verses.original: ਹੀਉ ਅਰਪਿ ਦੇਨ ॥
verses.translit: heeau arap dhen ||
verses.translation: I dedicate my heart to them.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਕਿਰਪੇਨ ॥
verses.translit: prabh bhe hai kirapen ||
verses.translation: God has become Merciful to me.

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਛੋਡਿਓ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭੇਟਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੫॥
verses.translit: maan moh tiaag chhoddio tau naanak har jeeau bheTanaa ||2||2||35||
verses.translation: Renouncing pride and leaving behind emotional attachment, O Nanak, one meets with the Dear Lord. ||2||2||35||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰੰਗਾ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਨ ਕੇ ਰੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)gaa ra(n)g ra(n)gan ke ra(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: The Playful Lord imbues all with the Color of His Love.

verses.original: ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਸੰਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: keeT hasat pooran sabh sa(n)gaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: From the ant to the elephant, He is permeating and pervading all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਤੀਰਥ ਸਹਿਤ ਗੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: barat nem teerath sahit ga(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: Some go on fasts, make vows, and take pilgrimages to sacred shrines on the Ganges.

verses.original: ਜਲੁ ਹੇਵਤ ਭੂਖ ਅਰੁ ਨੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: jal hevat bhookh ar na(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: They stand naked in the water, enduring hunger and poverty.

verses.original: ਪੂਜਾਚਾਰ ਕਰਤ ਮੇਲੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: poojaachaar karat mela(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: They sit cross-legged, perform worship services and do good deeds.

verses.original: ਚਕ੍ਰ ਕਰਮ ਤਿਲਕ ਖਾਟੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: chakar karam tilak khaaTa(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: They apply religious symbols to their bodies, and ceremonial marks to their limbs.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dharasan bheTe bin satasa(n)gaa ||1||
verses.translation: They read through the Shaastras, but they do not join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਠਿ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਅਤਿ ਰਹਤ ਬਿਟੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: haTh nigreh at rahat biTa(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: They stubbornly practice ritualistic postures, standing on their heads.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਚੁਕੈ ਨ ਭੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: hau rog biaapai chukai na bha(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: They are afflicted with the disease of egotism, and their faults are not covered up.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਤਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਜਰੰਗਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh at tirasan jara(n)gaa ||
verses.translation: They burn in the fire of sexual frustration, unresolved anger and compulsive desire.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਚੰਗਾ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੬॥
verses.translit: so mukat naanak jis satigur cha(n)gaa ||2||3||36||
verses.translation: He alone is liberated, O Nanak, whose True Guru is Good. ||2||3||36||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੭
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar satvaa
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Seventh House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਤਿਖ ਬੂਝਿ ਗਈ ਗਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tikh boojh giee giee mil saadh janaa ||
verses.translation: My thirst has been quenched, meeting with the Holy.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਭਾਗੇ ਚੋਰ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖੈਨੋ ਹਰੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤੀ ਗਾਵਤੀ ਗਾਵਤੀ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch bhaage chor sahaje sukhaino hare gun gaavatee gaavatee gaavatee dharas piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The five thieves have run away, and I am in peace and poise; singing, singing, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I obtain the Blessed Vision of my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੀ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੋ ਸਿਉ ਮੋ ਸਿਉ ਐਸੀ ਹਉ ਕੈਸੇ ਕਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaisee karee prabh mo siau mo siau aaisee hau kaise karau ||
verses.translation: That which God has done for me - how can I do that for Him in return?

verses.original: ਹੀਉ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਬਲਿ ਬਲੇ ਬਲਿ ਬਲੇ ਬਲਿ ਗਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: heeau tum(h)aare bal bale bal bale bal giee ||1||
verses.translation: I make my heart a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਪੈ ਸੰਤ ਪਾਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਧਿਆਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: pahile pai sa(n)t pai dhiaai dhiaai preet lai ||
verses.translation: First, I fall at the feet of the Saints; I meditate, meditate, lovingly attuned to You.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਥਾਨੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਕੇਹਰੋ ਜਿਤੁ ਜੰਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: prabh thaan tero keharo jit ja(n)tan kar beechaar ||
verses.translation: O God, where is that Place, where You contemplate all Your beings?

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਦਾਸ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: anik dhaas keerat kareh tuhaaree ||
verses.translation: Countless slaves sing Your Praises.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜੋ ਭਾਵਤੋ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: soiee milio jo bhaavato jan naanak Thaakur rahio samai ||
verses.translation: He alone meets You, who is pleasing to Your Will. Servant Nanak remains absorbed in his Lord and Master.

verses.translit: ek toohee toohee toohee ||2||1||37||
verses.translation: You, You, You alone, Lord. ||2||1||37||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੮
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar atthvaa
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Eighth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਤਿਆਗੀਐ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਪੇਖਤਾ ਦਇਆਲ ਲਾਲ ਹਾਂ ਹਾਂ ਮਨ ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tiaageeaai gumaan maan pekhataa dhiaal laal haa(n) haa(n) man charan ren ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Give up your pride and your self-conceit; the Loving, Merciful Lord is watching over all. O mind, become the dust of His Feet. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਤ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har sa(n)t ma(n)t gupaal giaan dhiaan ||1||
verses.translation: Through the Mantra of the Lord's Saints, experience the spiritual wisdom and meditation of the Lord of the World. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗਾਇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਮੋਹਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai gobi(n)dh gai charan kamal preet lai dheen dhiaal mohanaa ||
verses.translation: Within your heart, sing the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and be lovingly attuned to His Lotus Feet. He is the Fascinating Lord, Merciful to the meek and the humble.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaal dhiaa miaa dhaar ||
verses.translation: O Merciful Lord, please bless me with Your Kindness and Compassion.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak maagai naam dhaan ||
verses.translation: Nanak begs for the Gift of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਸਗਲ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥੧॥੩੮॥
verses.translit: taj moh bharam sagal abhimaan ||2||1||38||
verses.translation: I have abandoned emotional attachment, doubt and all egotistical pride. ||2||1||38||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਹਨ ਮਲਨ ਦਹਨ ਲਹਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਉਪਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kahan malan dhahan lahan gur mile aan nahee upaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Speaking of God, filth and pollution are burnt away; This comes by meeting with the Guru, and not by any other efforts. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਟਨ ਖਟਨ ਜਟਨ ਹੋਮਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਡੰਡਧਾਰ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taTan khaTan jaTan homan naahee dda(n)ddadhaar suaau ||1||
verses.translation: Making pilgrimages to sacred rivers, observing the six rituals, wearing matted and tangled hair, performing fire sacrifices and carrying ceremonial walking sticks - none of these are of any use. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਤਨ ਭਾਂਤਨ ਤਪਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਕਥਨ ਕਥਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਥਾਹ ਪਾਈ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jatan bhaa(n)tan tapan bhraman anik kathan kathate nahee thaeh paiee Thaau ||
verses.translation: All sorts of efforts, austerities, wanderings and various speeches - none of these will lead you to find the Lord's Place.

verses.original: ਸੋਧਿ ਸਗਰ ਸੋਧਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੯॥
verses.translit: sodh sagar sodhanaa sukh naanakaa bhaj naau ||2||2||39||
verses.translation: I have considered all considerations, O Nanak, but peace comes only by vibrating and meditating on the Name. ||2||2||39||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੯
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar nauvaa
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Ninth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਛਲੁ ਭੈ ਹਰਨ ਤਾਰਨ ਤਰਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan bhagat bachhal bhai haran taaran taran ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Purifier of sinners, the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear - He carries us across to the other side. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨੈਨ ਤਿਪਤੇ ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਜਸੁ ਤੋਖਿ ਸੁਨਤ ਕਰਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nain tipate dharas pekh jas tokh sunat karan ||1||
verses.translation: My eyes are satisfied, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; my ears are satisfied, hearing His Praise. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਦਾਤੇ ਦੀਨ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: praan naath anaath dhaate dheen gobidh saran ||
verses.translation: He is the Master of the praanaa, the breath of life; He is the Giver of Support to the unsupported. I am meek and poor - I seek the Sanctuary of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਆਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਗਹੀ ਓਟ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੪੦॥
verses.translit: aas pooran dhukh binaasan gahee oT naanak har charan ||2||1||40||
verses.translation: He is the Fulfiller of hope, the Destroyer of pain. Nanak grasps the Support of the Feet of the Lord. ||2||1||40||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਆਨ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: charan saran dhiaal Thaakur aan naahee jai ||
verses.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of the Feet of my Merciful Lord and Master; I do not go anywhere else.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਉਧਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan biradh suaamee udharate har dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It is the Inherent Nature of our Lord and Master to purify sinners. Those who meditate on the Lord are saved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੈਸਾਰ ਗਾਰ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਪਤਿਤ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਨ ਅੰਧ ॥
verses.translit: saisaar gaar bikaar saagar patit moh maan a(n)dh ||
verses.translation: The world is a swamp of wickedness and corruption. The blind sinner has fallen into the ocean of emotional attachment and pride,

verses.original: ਬਿਕਲ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਧੰਧ ॥
verses.translit: bikal maiaa sa(n)g dha(n)dh ||
verses.translation: bewildered by the entanglements of Maya.

verses.original: ਕਰੁ ਗਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਿ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar gahe prabh aap kaaddahu raakh leh gobi(n)dh rai ||1||
verses.translation: God Himself has taken me by the hand and lifted me up and out of it; save me, O Sovereign Lord of the Universe. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥ ਨਾਥ ਸਨਾਥ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਾਪ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: anaath naath sanaath sa(n)tan koT paap binaas ||
verses.translation: He is the Master of the masterless, the Supporting Lord of the Saints, the Neutralizer of millions of sins.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਦਰਸਨੈ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: man dharasanai kee piaas ||
verses.translation: My mind thirsts for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਨਤਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: prabh pooran gunataas ||
verses.translation: God is the Perfect Treasure of Virtue.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥੨॥੪੧॥
verses.translit: kirapaal dhiaal gupaal naanak har rasanaa gun gai ||2||2||41||
verses.translation: O Nanak, sing and savor the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Kind and Compassionate Lord of the World. ||2||2||41||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਵਾਰਿ ਵਾਰਉ ਅਨਿਕ ਡਾਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaar vaarau anik ddaarau ||
verses.translation: Countless times, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice

verses.original: ਸੁਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੁਹਾਗ ਪਲਕ ਰਾਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sukh pria suhaag palak raat ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: to that moment of peace, on that night when I was joined with my Beloved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਨਿਕ ਮੰਦਰ ਪਾਟ ਸੇਜ ਸਖੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਤਾਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kanik ma(n)dhar paaT sej sakhee moh naeh in siau taat ||1||
verses.translation: Mansions of gold, and beds of silk sheets - O sisters, I have no love for these. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤ ਲਾਲ ਅਨਿਕ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: mukat laal anik bhog bin naam naanak haat ||
verses.translation: Pearls, jewels and countless pleasures, O Nanak, are useless and destructive without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਰੂਖੋ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਭੂਮਿ ਸੈਨ ਸਖੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਸੂਖਿ ਬਿਹਾਤ ॥੨॥੩॥੪੨॥
verses.translit: rookho bhojan bhoom sain sakhee pria sa(n)g sookh bihaat ||2||3||42||
verses.translation: Even with only dry crusts of bread, and a hard floor on which to sleep, my life passes in peace and pleasure with my Beloved, O sisters. ||2||3||42||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਹੰ ਤੋਰੋ ਮੁਖੁ ਜੋਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: aha(n) toro mukh joro ||
verses.translation: Give up your ego, and turn your face to God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤ ਮਨੁ ਲੋਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: gur gur karat man loro ||
verses.translation: Let your yearning mind call out, ""Guru, Guru"".

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਮੋਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pria preet piaaro moro ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My Beloved is the Lover of Love. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਆਗਨਿ ਚੈਨਾ ਤੋਰੋ ਰੀ ਤੋਰੋ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਤੋਰੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gireh sej suhaavee aagan chainaa toro ree toro pa(n)ch dhootan siau sa(n)g toro ||1||
verses.translation: The bed of your household shall be cozy, and your courtyard shall be comfortable; shatter and break the bonds which tie you to the five thieves. ||1||

verses.original: ਆਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਬਸੇ ਨਿਜ ਆਸਨਿ ਊਂਧ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਸੋਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: aai na jai base nij aasan uoo(n)dh kamal bigasoro ||
verses.translation: You shall not come and go in reincarnation; you shall dwell in your own home deep within, and your inverted heart-lotus shall blossom forth.

verses.original: ਛੁਟਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਸੋਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: chhuTakee haumai soro ||
verses.translation: The turmoil of egotism shall be silenced.

verses.original: ਗਾਇਓ ਰੀ ਗਾਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰੋ ॥੨॥੪॥੪੩॥
verses.translit: gaio ree gaio prabh naanak gunee gahero ||2||4||43||
verses.translation: Nanak sings - he sings the Praises of God, the Ocean of Virtue. ||2||4||43||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਃ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੯ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar nauvaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Ninth House:

verses.original: ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਜਾਪਿ ਮਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: taa(n) te jaap manaa har jaap ||
verses.translation: This is why you should chant and meditate on the Lord, O mind.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਸੰਤ ਬੇਦ ਕਹਤ ਪੰਥੁ ਗਾਖਰੋ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਅਹੰ ਤਾਪ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo sa(n)t bedh kahat pa(n)th gaakharo moh magan aha(n) taap || rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Vedas and the Saints say that the path is treacherous and difficult. You are intoxicated with emotional attachment and the fever of egotism. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਪੁਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jo raate maate sa(n)g bapuree maiaa moh sa(n)taap ||1||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued and intoxicated with the wretched Maya, suffer the pains of emotional attachment. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੋਊ ਜਨੁ ਉਧਰੈ ਜਿਸਹਿ ਉਧਾਰਹੁ ਆਪ ॥
verses.translit: naam japat souoo jan udharai jiseh udhaarahu aap ||
verses.translation: That humble being is saved, who chants the Naam; You Yourself save him.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਮੋਹ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ॥੨॥੫॥੪੪॥
verses.translit: binas jai moh bhai bharamaa naanak sa(n)t prataap ||2||5||44||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment, fear and doubt are dispelled, O Nanak, by the Grace of the Saints. ||2||5||44||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੦
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar dasvaa
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Tenth House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਜੀ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਾਤ ਜੀਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aaiso dhaan dheh jee sa(n)tahu jaat jeeau balihaar ||
verses.translation: Give me that blessing, O Dear Saints, for which my soul would be a sacrifice.

verses.original: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹੀ ਪੰਚ ਦੋਹੀ ਉਰਝਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬਸਿਓ ਤਾਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਾਧੂਆ ਦੂਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maan mohee pa(n)ch dhohee urajh nikaT basio taakee saran saadhooaa dhoot sa(n)g nivaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Enticed by pride, entrapped and plundered by the five thieves, still, you live near them. I have come to the Sanctuary of the Holy, and I have been rescued from my association with those demons. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਓ ਹਾਰਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: koT janam jon bhramio haar pario dhuaar ||1||
verses.translation: I wandered through millions of lifetimes and incarnations. I am so very tired - I have fallen at God's Door. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਈ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa gobi(n)dh bhiee milio naam adhaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe has become Kind to me; He has blessed me with the Support of the Naam.

verses.original: ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਵ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧॥੪੫॥
