verses.translit: dhulabh janam safal naanak bhav utaar paar ||2||1||45||
verses.translation: This precious human life has become fruitful and prosperous; O Nanak, I am carried across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||1||45||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧੧
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ghar gayaarvaa
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla, Eleventh House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਏ ਆਪਨ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: sahaj subhaae aapan aae ||
verses.translation: He Himself has come to me, in His Natural Way.

verses.original: ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨੌ ਕਛੂ ਦਿਖਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kachhoo na jaanau kachhoo dhikhaae ||
verses.translation: I know nothing, and I show nothing.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਖ ਬਾਲੇ ਭੋਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabh milio sukh baale bhole ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have met God through innocent faith, and He has blessed me with peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)jog milaae saadh sa(n)gaae ||
verses.translation: By the good fortune of my destiny, I have joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਏ ਘਰਹਿ ਬਸਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: katahoo na jaae ghareh basaae ||
verses.translation: I do not go out anywhere; I dwell in my own home.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਇਹ ਚੋਲੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gun nidhaan pragaTio ieh cholai ||1||
verses.translation: God, the Treasure of Virtue, has been revealed in this body-robe. ||1||

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਲੁਭਾਏ ਆਨ ਤਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: charan lubhaae aan tajaae ||
verses.translation: I have fallen in love with His Feet; I have abandoned everything else.

verses.original: ਥਾਨ ਥਨਾਏ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: thaan thanaae sarab samaae ||
verses.translation: In the places and interspaces, He is All-pervading.

verses.original: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਗੁਨ ਬੋਲੈ ॥੨॥੧॥੪੬॥
verses.translit: rasak rasak naanak gun bolai ||2||1||46||
verses.translation: With loving joy and excitement, Nanak speaks His Praises. ||2||1||46||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਿਲਨ ਦੁਰਾੲਂੀ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh Thaakur milan dhuraae(n)ee ||
verses.translation: It is so hard to meet the Lord of the Universe, my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paramit roop aga(n)m agochar rahio sarab samaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: His Form is Immeasurable, Inaccessible and Unfathomable; He is All-pervading everywhere. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਹਨਿ ਭਵਨਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਕਤਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahan bhavan naahee paio paio anik ukat chaturaiee ||1||
verses.translation: By speaking and wandering, nothing is gained; nothing is obtained by clever tricks and devices. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਤਨ ਜਤਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਰੇ ਤਉ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜਉ ਕਿਰਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jatan jatan anik upaav re tau milio jau kirapaiee ||
verses.translation: People try all sorts of things, but the Lord is only met when He shows His Mercy.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੪੭॥
verses.translit: prabhoo dhiaar kirapaar kirapaa nidh jan naanak sa(n)t renaiee ||2||2||47||
verses.translation: God is Kind and Compassionate, the Treasure of Mercy; servant Nanak is the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||2||2||47||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: maiee simarat raam raam raam ||
verses.translation: O mother, I meditate on the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: prabh binaa naahee hor ||
verses.translation: Without God, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਚਿਤਵਉ ਚਰਨਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਸਾਸਨ ਨਿਸਿ ਭੋਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chitavau charanaarabi(n)dh saasan nis bhor ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I remember His Lotus Feet with every breath, night and day. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਲਾਇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀਨ ਆਪਨ ਤੂਟਤ ਨਹੀ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: lai preet keen aapan tooTat nahee jor ||
verses.translation: He loves me and makes me His Own; my union with Him shall never be broken.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਰਬਸੋੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧੇ ਸੁਖ ਮੋਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: praan man dhan sarabasuo har gun nidhe sukh mor ||1||
verses.translation: He is my breath of life, mind, wealth and everything. The Lord is the Treasure of Virtue and Peace. ||1||

verses.original: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਰਾਮ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਰਿਦ ਖੋਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: e'eet uoot raam pooran nirakhat ridh khor ||
verses.translation: Here and hereafter, the Lord is perfectly pervading; He is seen deep within the heart.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨ ਤਰਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਦੁਖੁ ਘੋਰ ॥੨॥੩॥੪੮॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t saran taran naanak binasio dhukh ghor ||2||3||48||
verses.translation: In the Sanctuary of the Saints, I am carried across; O Nanak, the terrible pain has been taken away. ||2||3||48||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗੇ ਅਸਨੇਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: jan ko prabh sa(n)ge asaneh ||
verses.translation: God's humble servant is in love with Him.

verses.original: ਸਾਜਨੋ ਤੂ ਮੀਤੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੇਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saajano too meet meraa gireh terai sabh keh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are my Friend, my very best Friend; everything is in Your Home. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਤਾਨੁ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਧਨੁ ਲਖਮੀ ਸੁਤ ਦੇਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maan maa(n)gau taan maa(n)gau dhan lakhamee sut dheh ||1||
verses.translation: I beg for honor, I beg for strength; please bless me with wealth, property and children. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: mukat jugat bhugat pooran paramaana(n)dh param nidhaan ||
verses.translation: You are the Technology of liberation, the Way to worldly success, the Perfect Lord of Supreme Bliss, the Transcendent Treasure.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੪॥੪੯॥
verses.translit: bhai bhai bhagat nihaal naanak sadhaa sadhaa kurabaan ||2||4||49||
verses.translation: In the Fear of God and loving devotion, Nanak is exalted and enraptured, forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||4||49||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਚਰਚ ਚਰਚ ਚਰਚਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: karat karat charach charach characharee ||
verses.translation: The debaters debate and argue their arguments.

verses.original: ਜੋਗ ਧਿਆਨ ਭੇਖ ਗਿਆਨ ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਧਰਤ ਧਰਤ ਧਰਚਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jog dhiaan bhekh giaan firat firat dharat dharat dharacharee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Yogis and meditators, religious and spiritual teachers roam and ramble, wandering endlessly all over the earth. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਹੰ ਅਹੰ ਅਹੈ ਅਵਰ ਮੂੜ ਮੂੜ ਮੂੜ ਬਵਰਈ ॥
verses.translit: aha(n) aha(n) ahai avar mooR mooR mooR bavariee ||
verses.translation: They are egotistical, self-centered and conceited, foolish, stupid, idiotic and insane.

verses.original: ਜਤਿ ਜਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਜਾਤ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਲ ਹਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jat jaat jaat jaat sadhaa sadhaa sadhaa sadhaa kaal hiee ||1||
verses.translation: Wherever they go and wander, death is always with them, forever and ever and ever and ever. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਈ ॥
verses.translit: maan maan maan tiaag mrit mrit nikaT nikaT sadhaa hiee ||
verses.translation: Give up your pride and stubborn self-conceit; death, yes, death, is always close and near at hand.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰੇ ਭਾਜੁ ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਮੂੜ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਜਨ ਭਜਨ ਭਜਨ ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੫੦॥੧੨॥੬੨॥
verses.translit: har hare hare bhaaj kahat naanak sunahu re mooR bin bhajan bhajan bhajan ahilaa janam giee ||2||5||50||12||62||
verses.translation: Vibrate and meditate on the Lord, Har, Haray, Haray. Says Nanak, listen you fool: without vibrating, and meditating, and dwelling on Him, your life is uselessly wasting away. ||2||5||50||12||62||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: kaanaRaa asaTapadheeaa mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Ashtpadheeyaa, Fourth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: jap man raam naam sukh paavaigo ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, O mind, and find peace.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਜਪੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jiau japai tivai sukh paavai satigur sev samaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The more you chant and meditate, the more you will be at peace; serve the True Guru, and merge in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕੀ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਲੋਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa(n) kee khin khin lochaa naam japat sukh paavaigo ||
verses.translation: Each and every instant, the humble devotees long for Him; chanting the Naam, they find peace.

verses.original: ਅਨ ਰਸ ਸਾਦ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: an ras saadh ge sabh neekar bin naavai kichh na sukhaavaigo ||1||
verses.translation: The taste of other pleasures is totally eradicated; nothing pleases them, except the Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੀਠੇ ਬਚਨ ਕਢਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat har har meeThaa laagaa gur meeThe bachan kaddaavaigo ||
verses.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, the Lord seems sweet to them; the Guru inspires them to speak sweet words.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur baanee purakh purakhotam baanee siau chit laavaigo ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the True Guru's Bani, the Primal Lord God is revealed; so focus your consciousness on His Bani. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਸੁਨਤ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਵਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਨਾ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: gurbaanee sunat meraa man dhraviaa man bheenaa nij ghar aavaigo ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Word of the Guru's Bani, my mind has been softened and saturated with it; my mind has returned to its own home deep within.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਅਨਹਤ ਧੁਨੀ ਬਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਬਾਜੇ ਨੀਝਰ ਧਾਰ ਚੁਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: teh anahat dhunee baajeh nit baaje neejhar dhaar chuaavaigo ||3||
verses.translation: The Unstruck Melody resonates and resounds there continuously; the stream of nectar trickles down constantly. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲ ਤਿਲ ਗਾਵੈ ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam ik til til gaavai man gurmat naam samaavaigo ||
verses.translation: Singing the Name of the One Lord each and every instant, and following the Guru's Teachings, the mind is absorbed in the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: naam sunai naamo man bhaavai naame hee tirapataavaigo ||4||
verses.translation: Listening to the Naam, the mind is pleased with the Naam, and satisfied with the Naam. ||4||

verses.original: ਕਨਿਕ ਕਨਿਕ ਪਹਿਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਕੰਗਨਾ ਕਾਪਰੁ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਬਨਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: kanik kanik pahire bahu ka(n)ganaa kaapar bhaa(n)t banaavaigo ||
verses.translation: People wear lots of bracelets, glittering with gold; they wear all sorts of fine clothes.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭਿ ਫੀਕ ਫਿਕਾਨੇ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: naam binaa sabh feek fikaane janam marai fir aavaigo ||5||
verses.translation: But without the Naam, they are all bland and insipid. They are born, only to die again, in the cycle of reincarnation. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਪਟਲ ਪਟਲ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ਘਰੁ ਘੂਮਨਿ ਘੇਰਿ ਘੁਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa paTal paTal hai bhaaree ghar ghooman gher ghulaavaigo ||
verses.translation: The veil of Maya is a thick and heavy veil, a whirlpool which destroys one's home.

verses.original: ਪਾਪ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਨੂਰ ਸਭਿ ਭਾਰੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: paap bikaar manoor sabh bhaare bikh dhutar tario na jaavaigo ||6||
verses.translation: Sins and corrupt vices are totally heavy, like rusted slag. They will not let you cross over the poisonous and treacherous world-ocean. ||6||

verses.original: ਭਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਖੇਵਟੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: bhau bairaag bhiaa hai bohith gur khevaT sabadh taraavaigo ||
verses.translation: Let the Fear of God and neutral detachment be the boat; the Guru is the Boatman, who carries us across in the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: raam naam har bheTeeaai har raamai naam samaavaigo ||7||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Lord, the Name of the Lord, merge in the Lord, the Name of the Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਲਾਇ ਸਵਾਲਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੈ ਲਾਇ ਜਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: agiaan lai savaaliaa gur giaanai lai jagaavaigo ||
verses.translation: Attached to ignorance, people are falling asleep; attached to the Guru's spiritual wisdom, they awaken.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bhaanai aapanai jiau bhaavai tivai chalaavaigo ||8||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by His Will, He makes us walk as He pleases. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: jap man har har naam taraavaigo ||
verses.translation: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and be carried across.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ ਸੋਈ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਉ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo japai soiee gat paavai jiau dhraoo prahilaadh samaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whoever chants and meditates on it is emancipated. Like Dhroo and Prahlaad, they merge in the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kirapaa kirapaa kar har jeeau kar kirapaa naam lagaavaigo ||
verses.translation: Mercy, mercy, mercy - O Dear Lord, please shower Your Mercy on me, and attach me to Your Name.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa satiguroo milaavahu mil satigur naam dhiaavaigo ||1||
verses.translation: Please be Merciful, and lead me to meet the True Guru; meeting the True Guru, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam kee haumai mal laagee mil sa(n)gat mal leh jaavaigo ||
verses.translation: The filth of egotism from countless incarnations sticks to me; joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, this filth is washed away.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਲੋਹਾ ਤਰਿਓ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਲਗਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau lohaa tario sa(n)g kaasaT lag sabadh guroo har paavaigo ||2||
verses.translation: As iron is carried across if it is attached to wood, one who is attached to the Word of the Guru's Shabad finds the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)gat sa(n)t milahu satasa(n)gat mil sa(n)gat har ras aavaigo ||
verses.translation: Joining the Society of the Saints, joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, you shall come to receive the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ਕਢਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਚੀਕੜੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin sa(n)gat karam karai abhimaanee kadd paanee cheekaR paavaigo ||3||
verses.translation: But not joining the Sangat, and committing actions in egotistical pride, is like drawing out clean water, and throwing it in the mud. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa ke har rakhavaare jan har ras meeTh lagaavaigo ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Protector and Saving Grace of His humble devotees. The Lord's Sublime Essence seems so sweet to these humble beings.

verses.original: ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: khin khin naam dhei vaddiaaiee satigur upadhes samaavaigo ||4||
verses.translation: Each and every instant, they are blessed with the Glorious Greatness of the Naam; through the Teachings of the True Guru, they are absorbed in Him. ||4||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਵਿ ਰਹੀਐ ਜਨ ਨਿਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਫਲ ਗੁਨ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kau sadhaa niv raheeaai jan niveh taa fal gun paavaigo ||
verses.translation: Bow forever in deep respect to the humble devotees; if you bow to those humble beings, you shall obtain the fruit of virtue.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੁਸਟ ਕਰਹਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਨਾਖਸ ਜਿਉ ਪਚਿ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jo ni(n)dhaa dhusaT kareh bhagataa kee haranaakhas jiau pach jaavaigo ||5||
verses.translation: Those wicked enemies who slander the devotees are destroyed, like Harnaakhash. ||5||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਮਲ ਪੁਤੁ ਮੀਨ ਬਿਆਸਾ ਤਪੁ ਤਾਪਨ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: braham kamal put meen biaasaa tap taapan pooj karaavaigo ||
verses.translation: Brahma, the son of the lotus, and Vyaas, the son of the fish, practiced austere penance and were worshipped.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਭਰਮਨ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jo jo bhagat hoi so poojahu bharaman bharam chukaavaigo ||6||
verses.translation: Whoever is a devotee - worship and adore that person. Get rid of your doubts and superstitions. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਾਤ ਨਜਾਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਤ ਭਰਮਹੁ ਸੁਕ ਜਨਕ ਪਗੀਂ ਲਗਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: jaat najaat dhekh mat bharamahu suk janak pagee(n) lag dhiaavaigo ||
verses.translation: Do not be fooled by appearances of high and low social class. Suk Dayv bowed at the feet of Janak, and meditated.

verses.original: ਜੂਠਨ ਜੂਠਿ ਪਈ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਡੁਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jooThan jooTh piee sir uoopar khin manooaa til na ddulaavaigo ||7||
verses.translation: Even though Janak threw his left-overs and garbage on Suk Dayv's head, his mind did not waver, even for an instant. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਨਕ ਜਨਕ ਬੈਠੇ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨਿ ਨਉ ਮੁਨੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਲੈ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: janak janak baiThe si(n)ghaasan nau munee dhoor lai laavaigo ||
verses.translation: Janak sat upon his regal throne, and applied the dust of the nine sages to his forehead.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੈ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਕਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak kirapaa kirapaa kar Thaakur mai dhaasan dhaas karaavaigo ||8||2||
verses.translation: Please shower Nanak with your Mercy, O my Lord and Master; make him the slave of Your slaves. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਸਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: man gurmat ras gun gaavaigo ||
verses.translation: O mind, follow the Guru's Teachings, and joyfully sing God's Praises.

verses.original: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਏਕ ਹੋਇ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਲਖ ਕੋਟੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jihavaa ek hoi lakh koTee lakh koTee koT dhiaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If my one tongue became hundreds of thousands and millions, I would meditate on Him millions and millions of times. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਹਸ ਫਨੀ ਜਪਿਓ ਸੇਖਨਾਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤਿਆ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: sahas fanee japio sekhanaagai har japatiaa a(n)t na paavaigo ||
verses.translation: The serpent king chants and meditates on the Lord with his thousands of heads, but even by these chants, he cannot find the Lord's limits.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹੈ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too athaahu at agam agam hai mat gurmat man Thaharaavaigo ||1||
verses.translation: You are Utterly Unfathomable, Inaccessible and Infinite. Through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, the mind becomes steady and balanced. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਤੂ ਜਪਿਓ ਤੇਈ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤਿਅਹੁ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: jin too japio teiee jan neeke har japatiahu kau sukh paavaigo ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who meditate on You are noble and exalted. Meditating on the Lord, they are at peace.

verses.original: ਬਿਦਰ ਦਾਸੀ ਸੁਤੁ ਛੋਕ ਛੋਹਰਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਅੰਕਿ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bidhar dhaasee sut chhok chhoharaa kirasan a(n)k gal laavaigo ||2||
verses.translation: Bidur, the son of a slave-girl, was an untouchable, but Krishna hugged him close in His Embrace. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਲ ਤੇ ਓਪਤਿ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਕਾਸਟ ਕਾਸਟ ਅੰਗਿ ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: jal te opat bhiee hai kaasaT kaasaT a(n)g taraavaigo ||
verses.translation: Wood is produced from water, but by holding onto wood, one is saved from drowning.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raam janaa har aap savaare apanaa biradh rakhaavaigo ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself embellishes and exalts His humble servants; He confirms His Innate Nature. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਲੋਹ ਲੋਹ ਬਡ ਪਾਥਰ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਵ ਤਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: ham paathar loh loh badd paathar gur sa(n)gat naav taraavaigo ||
verses.translation: I am like a stone, or a piece of iron, heavy stone and iron; in the Boat of the Guru's Congregation, I am carried across,

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jiau satasa(n)gat tario julaaho sa(n)t janaa man bhaavaigo ||4||
verses.translation: like Kabeer the weaver, who was saved in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation. He became pleasing to the minds of the humble Saints. ||4||

verses.original: ਖਰੇ ਖਰੋਏ ਬੈਠਤ ਊਠਤ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: khare kharoe baiThat uooThat maarag pa(n)th dhiaavaigo ||
verses.translation: Standing up, sitting down, rising up and walking on the path, I meditate.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨ ਬਚਨ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਨਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: satigur bachan bachan hai satigur paadhar mukat janaavaigo ||5||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Word, and the Word is the True Guru, who teaches the Path of Liberation. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਾਸਨਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਬਲੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ਨਿਹਸਾਸਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: saasan saas saas bal paiee hai nihasaasan naam dhiaavaigo ||
verses.translation: By His Training, I find strength with each and every breath; now that I am trained and tamed, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਤੌ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee haumai boojhai tau gurmat naam samaavaigo ||6||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, egotism is extinguished, and then, through the Guru's Teachings, I merge in the Naam. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਜੀਅ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: satigur dhaataa jeea jeean ko bhaagaheen nahee bhaavaigo ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is the Giver of the life of the soul, but the unfortunate ones do not love Him.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਏਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: fir eh velaa haath na aavai parataapai pachhutaavaigo ||7||
verses.translation: This opportunity shall not come into their hands again; in the end, they will suffer in torment and regret. ||7||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਭਲਾ ਲੋੜੈ ਭਲ ਅਪਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਢਹਿ ਢਹਿ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: je ko bhalaa loRai bhal apanaa gur aagai ddeh ddeh paavaigo ||
verses.translation: If a good person seeks goodness for himself, he should bow low in humble surrender to the Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਸਮ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak dhiaa dhiaa kar Thaakur mai satigur bhasam lagaavaigo ||8||3||
verses.translation: Nanak prays: please show kindness and compassion to me, O my Lord and Master, that I may apply the dust of the True Guru to my forehead. ||8||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: man har ra(n)g raataa gaavaigo ||
verses.translation: O mind, be attuned to His Love, and sing.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭੈ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bhai traas bhe hai niramal gurmat laag lagaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Fear of God makes me fearless and immaculate; I am dyed in the color of the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: har ra(n)g raataa sadh bairaagee har nikaT tinaa ghar aavaigo ||
verses.translation: Those who are attuned to the Lord's Love remain balanced and detached forever; they live near the Lord, who comes into their house.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਪੰਕ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾਂ ਜੀਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਦਿਵਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tin kee pa(n)k milai taa(n) jeevaa kar kirapaa aap dhivaavaigo ||1||
verses.translation: If I am blessed with the dust of their feet, then I live. Granting His Grace, He Himself bestows it. ||1||

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਲੋਭਿ ਲਗੇ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਕੋਰੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa lobh lage hai praanee man korai ra(n)g na aavaigo ||
verses.translation: Mortal beings are attached to greed and duality. Their minds are unripe and unfit, and will not accept the Dye of His Love.

verses.original: ਫਿਰਿ ਉਲਟਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: fir ulaTio janam hovai gur bachanee gur purakh milai ra(n)g laavaigo ||2||
verses.translation: But their lives are transformed through the Word of the Guru's Teachings. Meeting with the Guru, the Primal Being, they are dyed in the color of His Love. ||2||

verses.original: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਦਸੇ ਦਸੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਧਾਵਤ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣੀਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਟਿਕਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: ei(n)dhree dhase dhase fun dhaavat trai guneeaa khin na Tikaavaigo ||
verses.translation: There are ten organs of sense and action; the ten wander unrestrained. Under the influence of the three dispositions, they are not stable, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਮੋਖ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur parachai vasagat aavai mokh mukat so paavaigo ||3||
verses.translation: Coming in contact with the True Guru, they are brought under control; then, salvation and liberation are attained. ||3||

verses.original: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਏਕਸ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: oa(n)kaar eko rav rahiaa sabh ekas maeh samaavaigo ||
verses.translation: The One and Only Creator of the Universe is All-pervading everywhere. All shall once again merge into the One.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਏਕੋ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਭੁ ਏਕਤੁ ਬਚਨਿ ਚਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: eko roop eko bahu ra(n)gee sabh ekat bachan chalaavaigo ||4||
verses.translation: His One Form has one, and many colors; He leads all according to His One Word. ||4||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੋ ਏਕੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh eko ek pachhaataa gurmukh hoi lakhaavaigo ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh realizes the One and Only Lord; He is revealed to the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਜ ਮਹਲੀ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦੁ ਬਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jai milai nij mahalee anahadh sabadh bajaavaigo ||5||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh goes and meets the Lord in His Mansion deep within; the Unstruck Word of the Shabad vibrates there. ||5||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh sisaT upaiee gurmukh sobhaa paavaigo ||
verses.translation: God created all the beings and creatures of the universe; He blesses the Gurmukh with glory.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਕੋ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bin gur bheTe ko mahal na paavai aai jai dhukh paavaigo ||6||
verses.translation: Without meeting the Guru, no one obtains the Mansion of His Presence. They suffer the agony of coming and going in reincarnation. ||6||

verses.original: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨਮ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: anek janam vichhuRe mere preetam kar kirapaa guroo milaavaigo ||
verses.translation: For countless lifetimes, I have been separated from my Beloved; in His Mercy, the Guru has united me with Him.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਤਿ ਮਲੀਨ ਬਿਗਸਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: satigur milat mahaa sukh paiaa mat maleen bigasaavaigo ||7||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, I have found absolute peace, and my polluted intellect blossoms forth. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਮੈ ਸਰਧਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaa karahu jagajeevan mai saradhaa naam lagaavaigo ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Har, Har, please grant Your Grace; O Life of the World, instill faith in the Naam within me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak guroo guroo hai satigur mai satigur saran milaavaigo ||8||4||
verses.translation: Nanak is the Guru, the Guru, the True Guru; I am immersed in the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||8||4||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਾਲ ਚਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: man gurmat chaal chalaavaigo ||
verses.translation: O mind, walk on the Path of the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਮਸਤੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਤਲਿ ਕੁੰਡੇ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jiau maigal masat dheejai tal ku(n)dde gur a(n)kas sabadh dhiraRaavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Just as the wild elephant is subdued by the prod, the mind is disciplined by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚਲਤੌ ਚਲੈ ਚਲੈ ਦਹ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: chalatau chalai chalai dheh dheh dhis gur raakhai har liv laavaigo ||
verses.translation: The wandering mind wanders, roams and rambles in the ten directions; but the Guru holds it, and lovingly attunes it to the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦੇਇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੁਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur sabadh dhei ridh a(n)tar mukh a(n)mrit naam chuaavaigo ||1||
verses.translation: The True Guru implants the Word of the Shabad deep within the heart; the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, trickles into the mouth. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਬਿਸੂ ਭਰੇ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਰੁੜ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: biseear bisoo bhare hai pooran gur garuR sabadh mukh paavaigo ||
verses.translation: The snakes are filled with poisonous venom; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the antidote - place it in your mouth.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਭੁਇਅੰਗ ਤਿਸੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਝਾਰਿ ਝਾਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maiaa bhuia(n)g tis neR na aavai bikh jhaar jhaar liv laavaigo ||2||
verses.translation: Maya, the serpent, does not even approach one who is rid of the poison, and lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੁਆਨੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਲਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: suaan lobh nagar meh sabalaa gur khin meh maar kaddaavaigo ||
verses.translation: The dog of greed is very powerful in the village of the body; the Guru strikes it and drives it out in an instant.

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਆਨਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਗਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokh dharam aan raakhe har nagaree har gun gaavaigo ||3||
verses.translation: Truth, contentment, righteousness and Dharma have settled there; in the village of the Lord, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੰਕਜ ਮੋਹ ਨਿਘਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਿਘਰਤ ਕਾਢਿ ਕਢਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)kaj moh nigharat hai praanee gur nigharat kaadd kaddaavaigo ||
verses.translation: The mortal beings are sinking in the swamp of emotional attachment; the Guru lifts them up, and saves them from sinking.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਜਨ ਆਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਹਾਥੀ ਦੇ ਨਿਕਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: traeh traeh saran jan aae gur haathee dhe nikalaavaigo ||4||
verses.translation: Crying, ""Save me! Save me!"", the humble come to His Sanctuary; the Guru reaches out His Hand, and lifts them up. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੁਪਨੰਤਰੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਖੇਲੁ ਖਿਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: supana(n)tar sa(n)saar sabh baajee sabh baajee khel khilaavaigo ||
verses.translation: The whole world is like a game in a dream, all a game. God plays and causes the game to be played.

verses.original: ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੈ ਚਾਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: laahaa naam gurmat lai chaalahu har dharageh paidhaa jaavaigo ||5||
verses.translation: So earn the Profit of the Naam by following the Guru's Teachings; you shall go to the Court of the Lord in robes of honor. ||5||

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਪ ਕੋਇਲੇ ਆਨਿ ਜਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: haumai karai karaavai haumai paap koile aan jamaavaigo ||
verses.translation: They act in egotism, and make others act in egotism; they collect and gather up the blackness of sin.

verses.original: ਆਇਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ਹੋਏ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੇ ਸੋ ਖਵਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aaiaa kaal dhukhadhaiee hoe jo beeje so khavalaavaigo ||6||
verses.translation: And when death comes, they suffer in agony; they must eat what they have planted. ||6||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਹੁ ਲੈ ਖਰਚੁ ਚਲੇ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu raam naam dhan sa(n)chahu lai kharach chale pat paavaigo ||
verses.translation: O Saints, gather the Wealth of the Lord's Name; if you depart after packing these provisions, you shall be honored.

verses.original: ਖਾਇ ਖਰਚਿ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਦੇ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: khai kharach dheveh bahuteraa har dhedhe toT na aavaigo ||7||
verses.translation: So eat, spend, consume and give abundantly; the Lord will give - there will be no deficiency. ||7||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹੈ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam dhan hai ridh a(n)tar dhan gur saranaiee paavaigo ||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Lord's Name is deep within the heart. In the Sanctuary of the Guru, this wealth is found.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak dhiaa dhiaa kar dheenee dhukh dhaaladh bha(n)j samaavaigo ||8||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, God has been kind and compassionate; He has blessed me. Removing pain and poverty, He has blended me with Himself. ||8||5||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaanaRaa mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: man satigur saran dhiaavaigo ||
verses.translation: O mind, seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru, and meditate.

verses.original: ਲੋਹਾ ਹਿਰਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਗੁਨੁ ਪਾਰਸ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: lohaa hiran hovai sa(n)g paaras gun paaras ko hoi aavaigo ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Iron is transformed into gold by touching the philosopher's stone; it takes on its qualities. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਜੋ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: satigur mahaa purakh hai paaras jo laagai so fal paavaigo ||
verses.translation: The True Guru, the Great Primal Being, is the philosopher's stone. Whoever is attached to Him receives fruitful rewards.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਤਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau gur upadhes tare prahilaadhaa gur sevak paij rakhaavaigo ||1||
verses.translation: Just as Prahlaad was saved by the Guru's Teachings, the Guru protects the honor of His servant. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੁ ਬਚਨੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: satigur bachan bachan hai neeko gur bachanee a(n)mrit paavaigo ||
verses.translation: The Word of the True Guru is the most Sublime and Noble Word. Through the Guru's Word, the Ambrosial Nectar is obtained.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਅੰਬਰੀਕਿ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਖ ਬਚਨ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau a(n)bareek amaraa padh paae satigur mukh bachan dhiaavaigo ||2||
verses.translation: Ambreek the king was blessed with the status of immortality, meditating on the Word of the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਧਾ ਸੁਧਾ ਕਰਿ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: satigur saran saran man bhaiee sudhaa sudhaa kar dhiaavaigo ||
verses.translation: The Sanctuary, the Protection and Sanctuary of the True Guru is pleasing to the mind. It is sacred and pure - meditate on it.

verses.original: ਦਇਆਲ ਦੀਨ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhiaal dheen bhe hai satigur har maarag pa(n)th dhikhaavaigo ||3||
verses.translation: The True Guru has become Merciful to the meek and the poor; He has shown me the Path, the Way to the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਏ ਸੇ ਥਾਪੇ ਤਿਨ ਰਾਖਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: satigur saran pe se thaape tin raakhan kau prabh aavaigo ||
verses.translation: Those who enter the Sanctuary of the True Guru are firmly established; God comes to protect them.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਸਰੁ ਸੰਧੈ ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਉਲਟੋ ਤਿਸੈ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: je ko sar sa(n)dhai jan uoopar fir ulaTo tisai lagaavaigo ||4||
verses.translation: If someone aims an arrow at the Lord's humble servant, it will turn around and hit him instead. ||4||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੁ ਦਿਵਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: har har har har har sar seveh tin dharageh maan dhivaavaigo ||
verses.translation: Those who bathe in the Sacred Pool of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, are blessed with honor in His Court.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਲਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: gurmat gurmat gurmat dhiaaveh har gal mil mel milaavaigo ||5||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Guru's Teachings, the Guru's Instructions, the Guru's Wisdom, are united in the Lord's Union; He hugs them close in His Embrace. ||5||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਦੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naadh bedh hai gurmukh gur parachai naam dhiaavaigo ||
verses.translation: The Guru's Word is the Sound-current of the Naad, The Guru's Word is the wisdom of the Vedas; coming in contact with the Guru, meditate on the Naam.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੂਪੋ ਹੋਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: har har roop har roopo hovai har jan kau pooj karaavaigo ||6||
verses.translation: In the Image of the Lord, Har, Har, one becomes the Embodiment of the Lord. The Lord makes His humble servant worthy of worship. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਤੇ ਬੇਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਭਰਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: saakat nar satigur nahee keeaa te bemukh har bharamaavaigo ||
verses.translation: The faithless cynic does not submit to the True Guru; the Lord makes the non-believer wander in confusion.

verses.original: ਲੋਭ ਲਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਨ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਰੰਗਿ ਲਗਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: lobh lahar suaan kee sa(n)gat bikh maiaa kara(n)g lagaavaigo ||7||
verses.translation: The waves of greed are like packs of dogs. The poison of Maya sticks to the body-skeleton. ||7||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਕਾ ਤਾਰਕੁ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈਗੋ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam sabh jag kaa taarak lag sa(n)gat naam dhiaavaigo ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the Saving Grace of the whole world; join the Sangat, and meditate on the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਸਮਾਵੈਗੋ ॥੮॥੬॥
verses.translit: naanak raakh raakh prabh mere satasa(n)gat raakh samaavaigo ||8||6||
verses.translation: O my God, please protect and preserve Nanak in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; save him, and let him merge in You. ||8||6||

verses.original: ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: chhakaa 1 ||
verses.translation: First Set of Six||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੫
verses.translit: kaanaRaa chha(n)t mahalaa panjavaa
verses.translation: Kaanraa, Chhant, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਰਾਮ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: se udhare jin raam dhiaae ||
verses.translation: They alone are saved, who meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਤਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: jatan maiaa ke kaam na aae ||
verses.translation: Working for Maya is useless.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਧਿਆਏ ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: raam dhiaae sabh fal paae dhan dha(n)n te baddabhaageeaa ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, all fruits and rewards are obtained. They are blessed, blessed and very fortunate.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਜਾਗੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਏਕ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)g jaage naam laage ek siau liv laageeaa ||
verses.translation: They are awake and aware in the True Congregation; attached to the Naam, they are lovingly attuned to the One.

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: taj maan moh bikaar saadhoo lag tarau tin kai paae ||
verses.translation: I have renounced pride, emotional attachment, wickedness and corruption; attached to the Holy, I am carried across at their feet.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਡਭਾਗਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak saran suaamee baddabhaag dharasan paae ||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I have come to the Sanctuary of my Lord and Master; by great good fortune, I obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਿਤ ਭਜਹ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: mil saadhoo nit bhajeh naarain ||
verses.translation: The Holy meet together, and continually vibrate and meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: rasak rasak suaamee gun gain ||
verses.translation: With love and excitement, they sing the Glorious Praises of their Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਜੀਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਪੀਵਹ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣਾ ਭਾਗਏ ॥
verses.translit: gun gai jeeveh har amiau peeveh janam maranaa bhaage ||
verses.translation: Singing His Praises they live, drinking in the Lord's Nectar; the cycle of birth and death is over for them.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗਏ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)g paieeaai har dhiaaieeaai bahuR dhookh na laage ||
verses.translation: Finding the True Congregation and meditating on the Lord, one is never again afflicted with pain.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਦਾਤੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਇਣ ॥
verses.translit: kar dhiaa dhaate purakh bidhaate sa(n)t sev kamain ||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Great Giver, the Architect of Destiny, we work to serve the Saints.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਂਛਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਣ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak jan dhoor baa(n)chheh har dharas sahaj samain ||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I long for the dust of the feet of the humble; I am intuitively absorbed in the Blessed Vision of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਗਲੇ ਜੰਤ ਭਜਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: sagale ja(n)t bhajahu gopaalai ||
verses.translation: All beings vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam pooran ghaalai ||
verses.translation: This brings the merits of chanting and meditation, austere self-discipline and perfect service.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਭਜਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: nit bhajahu suaamee a(n)tarajaamee safal janam sabaiaa ||
verses.translation: Vibrating and meditating continuously on our Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, one's life becomes totally fruitful.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਸੋਈ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gobidh gaieeaai nit dhiaaieeaai paravaan soiee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who sing and meditate continually on the Lord of the Universe - their coming into the world is blessed and approved.

verses.original: ਜਪ ਤਾਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: jap taap sa(n)jam har har nira(n)jan gobi(n)dh dhan sa(n)g chaalai ||
verses.translation: The Immaculate Lord, Har, Har, is meditation and chanting, and austere self-discipline; only the Wealth of the Lord of the Universe shall go along with you in the end.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆ ਦੀਜੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਾਧਉ ਪਾਲੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak kar dhiaa dheejai har ratan baadhau paalai ||3||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, please grant Your Grace, O Lord, and bless me with the Jewel, that I may carry it in my pocket. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੰਗਲਚਾਰ ਚੋਜ ਆਨੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)galachaar choj aana(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: His Wondrous and Amazing Plays are blissful

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa mile paramaana(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: granting His Grace, He bestows supreme ecstasy.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੁਖਹਗਾਮੀ ਇਛ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: prabh mile suaamee sukhahagaamee ichh man kee pu(n)neeaa ||
verses.translation: God, my Lord and Master, the Bringer of peace, has met me, and the desires of my mind are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਬਜੀ ਬਧਾਈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਮਾਈ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖਿ ਨ ਰੁੰਨੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: bajee badhaiee sahaje samaiee bahuR dhookh na ru(n)neeaa ||
verses.translation: Congratulations pour in; I am intuitively absorbed in the Lord. I shall never again cry out in pain.

verses.original: ਲੇ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਏ ਸੁਖ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: le ka(n)Th laae sukh dhikhaae bikaar binase ma(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: He hugs me close in His Embrace, and blesses me with peace; the evil of sin and corruption is gone.

verses.original: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: binava(n)t naanak mile suaamee purakh paramaana(n)dhaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, I have met my Lord and Master, the Primal Lord, the Embodiment of Bliss. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਨੜੇ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਮੂਸੇ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਕੀ ਧੁਨੀ
verses.translit: kaanaRe kee vaar mahalaa chauthhaa moose kee vaar kee dhunee
verses.translation: Vaar Of Kaanraa, Fourth Mehla, Sung To The Tune Of The Ballad Of Musa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਰਖੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam nidhaan har gurmat rakh ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: Follow the Guru's Teachings, and enshrine the Treasure of the Lord's Name within your heart.

verses.original: ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: dhaasan dhaasaa hoi rahu haumai bikhiaa maar ||
verses.translation: Become the slave of the Lord's slaves, and conquer egotism and corruption.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath jeetiaa kadhe na aavai haar ||
verses.translation: You shall win this treasure of life; you shall never lose.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan vaddabhaagee naanakaa jin gurmat har ras saar ||1||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed and very fortunate are those, O Nanak, who savor the Sublime Essence of the Lord through the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: govi(n)dh govidh govidh har govidh gunee nidhaan ||
verses.translation: Govind, Govind, Govind - the Lord God, the Lord of the Universe is the Treasure of Virtue.

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਤਾਂ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: govidh govidh gurmat dhiaaieeaai taa(n) dharageh paieeaai maan ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Govind, Govind, the Lord of the Universe, through the Guru's Teachings, you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਜਪਿ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲਾ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: govidh govidh govidh jap mukh uoojalaa paradhaan ||
verses.translation: Meditating on God, chanting Govind, Govind, Govind, your face shall be radiant; you shall be famous and exalted.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gur govi(n)dh har jit mil har paiaa naam ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Guru is the Lord God, the Lord of the Universe; meeting Him, you shall obtain the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕੋ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਜੁਗ ਜੋਗੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aape hee sidh saadhiko too aape hee jug jogeeaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Siddha and the seeker; You Yourself are the Yoga and the Yogi.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਰਸ ਰਸੀਅੜਾ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: too aape hee ras raseeaRaa too aape hee bhog bhogeeaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are the Taster of tastes; You Yourself are the Enjoyer of pleasures.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: too aape aap varatadhaa too aape kareh su hogeeaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are All-pervading; whatever You do comes to pass.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੋੁ ਧੰਨ ਧੰਨ ਧਨੋ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੁਲਗ ਬੁਲੋਗੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat satigur dha(n)n dhanuo dha(n)n dha(n)n dhano jit mil har bulag bulogeeaa ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed, blessed, blessed, blessed is the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the True Guru. Join them - speak and chant the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਤ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਲਹੋਗੀਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh kahahu mukhahu har har hare har har hare har bolat sabh paap lahogeeaa ||1||
verses.translation: Let everyone chant together the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Haray, Har, Har, Haray; chanting Har, all sins are washed away. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har har har har naam hai gurmukh paavai koi ||
verses.translation: Har, Har, Har, Har is the Name of the Lord; rare are those who, as Gurmukh, obtain it.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਨਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai mamataa naas hoi dhuramat kaddai dhoi ||
verses.translation: Egotism and possessiveness are eradicated, and evil-mindedness is washed away.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak anadhin gun ucharai jin kau dhur likhiaa hoi ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who is blessed with such pre-ordained destiny chants the Lord's Praises, night and day. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har aape aap dhiaal har aape kare su hoi ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is Merciful; whatever the Lord Himself does, comes to pass.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har aape aap varatadhaa har jevadd avar na koi ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is All-pervading. There is no other as Great as the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਥੀਐ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo har prabh bhaavai so theeaai jo har prabh kare su hoi ||
verses.translation: Whatever pleases the Lord God's Will comes to pass; whatever the Lord God does is done.

verses.original: ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: keemat kinai na paieeaa bea(n)t prabhoo har soi ||
verses.translation: No one can appraise His Value; the Lord God is Endless.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh har saalaahiaa tan man seetal hoi ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, praise the Lord; your body and mind shall be cooled and soothed. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਭ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਤੂ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jot teree jagajeevanaa too ghaT ghaT har ra(n)g ra(n)ganaa ||
verses.translation: You are the Light of all, the Life of the World; You imbue each and every heart with Your Love.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਤੂ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh dhiaaveh tudh mere preetamaa too sat sat purakh nira(n)janaa ||
verses.translation: All meditate on You, O my Beloved; You are the True, True Primal Being, the Immaculate Lord.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਿਖਾਰੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਸਭ ਮੰਗ ਮੰਗਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik dhaataa sabh jagat bhikhaareeaa har jaacheh sabh ma(n)g ma(n)ganaa ||
verses.translation: The One is the Giver; the whole world is the beggar. All the beggars beg for His Gifts.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੂਹੈ ਤੂਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਚੰਗ ਚੰਗਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: sevak Thaakur sabh toohai toohai gurmatee har cha(n)g cha(n)ganaa ||
verses.translation: You are the servant, and You are the Lord and Master of all. Through the Guru's Teachings, we are ennobled and uplifted.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਰਿਖੀਕੇਸੁ ਹਰੇ ਰਿਖੀਕੇਸੁ ਹਰੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਫਲਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabh kahahu mukhahu rikheekes hare rikheekes hare jit paaveh sabh fal falanaa ||2||
verses.translation: Let everyone say that the Lord is the Master of the senses, the Master of all faculties; through Him, we obtain all fruits and rewards. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam dhiaai man har dharageh paaveh maan ||
verses.translation: O mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; you shall be honored in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਲਗੈ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo ichheh so fal paisee gur sabadhee lagai dhiaan ||
verses.translation: You shall obtain the fruits that you desire, focusing your meditation on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਚੁਕੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: kilavikh paap sabh kaTe'eeh haumai chukai gumaan ||
verses.translation: All your sins and mistakes shall be wiped away, and you shall be rid of egotism and pride.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh kamal vigasiaa sabh aatam braham pachhaan ||
verses.translation: The heart-lotus of the Gurmukh blossoms forth, recognizing God within every soul.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaa dhaar prabh jan naanak jap har naam ||1||
verses.translation: O Lord God, please shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, that he may chant the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam pavit hai naam japat dhukh jai ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Sacred and Immaculate. Chanting the Naam, pain is dispelled.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau poorab likhiaa tin man vasiaa aai ||
verses.translation: God comes to abide in the minds of those who have such pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਜੋ ਚਲੈ ਤਿਨ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kai bhaanai jo chalai tin dhaaladh dhukh leh jai ||
verses.translation: Those who walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru are rid of pain and poverty.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਨ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: aapanai bhaanai kinai na paio jan vekhahu man pateeaai ||
verses.translation: No one finds the Lord by his own will; see this, and satisfy your mind.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗੇ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak dhaasan dhaas hai jo satigur laage pai ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is the slave of the slave of those who fall at the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਹਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਵਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) thaan thana(n)tar bharapoor heh karate sabh teree banat banaavanee ||
verses.translation: You are pervading and permeating all places and interspaces, O Creator. You made all that has been made.

verses.original: ਰੰਗ ਪਰੰਗ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਂਤਿ ਉਪਾਵਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g para(n)g sisaT sabh saajee bahu bahu bidh bhaa(n)t upaavanee ||
verses.translation: You created the entire universe, with all its colors and shades; in so many ways and means and forms You formed it.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਲਾਵਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: sabh teree jot jotee vich varateh gurmatee tudhai laavanee ||
verses.translation: O Lord of Light, Your Light is infused within all; You link us to the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: jin hoh dhiaal tin satigur meleh mukh gurmukh har samajhaavanee ||
verses.translation: They alone meet the True Guru, unto whom You are Merciful; O Lord, You instruct them in the Guru's Word.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਮੋ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਾਮ ਰਮੋ ਜਿਤੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਵਣੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh bolahu raam ramo sree raam ramo jit dhaaladh dhukh bhukh sabh leh jaavanee ||3||
verses.translation: Let everyone chant the Name of the Lord, chant the Name of the Great Lord; all poverty, pain and hunger shall be taken away. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har har a(n)mrit naam ras har a(n)mrit har ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is sweet; enshrine this Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord within your heart.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਬੁਝਹੁ ਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: vich sa(n)gat har prabh varatadhaa bujhahu sabadh veechaar ||
verses.translation: The Lord God prevails in the Sangat, the Holy Congregation; reflect upon the Shabad and understand.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੀ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: man har har naam dhiaaiaa bikh haumai kaddee maar ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within the mind, the poison of egotism is eradicated.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin har har naam na chetio tin jooaai janam sabh haar ||
verses.translation: One who does not remember the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, shall totally lose this life in the gamble.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur tuThai har chetaiaa har naamaa har ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, one remembers the Lord, and enshrines the Lord's Name within the heart.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak te mukh ujale tit sachai dharabaar ||1||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, his face shall be radiant in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har keerat utam naam hai vich kalijug karanee saar ||
verses.translation: To chant the Lord's Praise and His Name is sublime and exalted. This is the most excellent deed in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

verses.original: ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mat gurmat keerat paieeaai har naamaa har ur haar ||
verses.translation: His Praises come through the Guru's Teachings and Instructions; wear the Necklace of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਉਪਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee jin har dhiaaiaa tin saupiaa har bha(n)ddaar ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Lord are very fortunate. They are entrusted with the Treasure of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਜਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਨਿਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin naavai j karam kamaavane nit haumai hoi khuaar ||
verses.translation: Without the Name, no matter what people may do, they continue to waste away in egotism.

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਹਸਤੀ ਮਲਿ ਨਾਵਾਲੀਐ ਸਿਰਿ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਛਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jal hasatee mal naavaaleeaai sir bhee fir paavai chhaar ||
verses.translation: Elephants can be washed and bathed in water, but they only throw dust on their heads again.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har melahu satigur dhiaa kar man vasai eka(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: O Kind and Compassionate True Guru, please unite me with the Lord, that the One Creator of the Universe may abide within my mind.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin gurmukh sun har ma(n)niaa jan naanak tin jaikaar ||2||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who listen to the Lord and believe in Him - servant Nanak salutes them. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਹੈ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam vakhar hai uootam har naik purakh hamaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the most sublime and precious merchandise. The Primal Lord God is my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਕੀਆ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: har khel keeaa har aape varatai sabh jagat keeaa vanajaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord has staged His Play, and He Himself permeates it. The whole world deals in this merchandise.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਜੋਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jot teree jotee vich karate sabh sach teraa paasaaraa ||
verses.translation: Your Light is the light in all beings, O Creator. All Your Expanse is True.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਫਲ ਸੇ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: sabh dhiaaveh tudh safal se gaaveh gurmatee har nira(n)kaaraa ||
verses.translation: All those who meditate on You become prosperous; through the Guru's Teachings, they sing Your Praises, O Formless Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਚਵਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੋ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਵਜਲ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sabh chavahu mukhahu jaga(n)naath jaga(n)naath jagajeevano jit bhavajal paar utaaraa ||4||
verses.translation: Let everyone chant the Lord, the Lord of the World, the Lord of the Universe, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮਰੀ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਏਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: hamaree jihabaa ek prabh har ke gun agam athaeh ||
verses.translation: I have only one tongue, and the Glorious Virtues of the Lord God are Unapproachable and Unfathomable.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਜਪਹ ਇਆਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: ham kiau kar japeh iaaniaa har tum vadd agam agaeh ||
verses.translation: I am ignorant - how can I meditate on You, Lord? You are Great, Unapproachable and Immeasurable.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਪਗਿ ਪਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: har dheh prabhoo mat uootamaa gur satigur kai pag paeh ||
verses.translation: O Lord God, please bless me with that sublime wisdom, that I may fall at the Feet of the Guru, the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat har mel prabh ham paapee sa(n)g taraeh ||
verses.translation: O Lord God, please lead me to the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where even a sinner like myself may be saved.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau har bakhas laih har tuThai mel milaeh ||
verses.translation: O Lord, please bless and forgive servant Nanak; please unite him in Your Union.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਿਰਮ ਤਰਾਹ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har kirapaa kar sun benatee ham paapee kiram taraeh ||1||
verses.translation: O Lord, please be merciful and hear my prayer; I am a sinner and a worm - please save me! ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: har karahu kirapaa jagajeevanaa gur satigur mel dhiaal ||
verses.translation: O Lord, Life of the World, please bless me with Your Grace, and lead me to meet the Guru, the Merciful True Guru.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਭਾਈਆ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa har ham bhaieeaa har hoaa har kirapaal ||
verses.translation: I am happy to serve the Guru; the Lord has become merciful to me.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਵਿਸਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਆਲ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh aasaa manasaa visaree man chookaa aal ja(n)jaal ||
verses.translation: All my hopes and desires have been forgotten; my mind is rid of its worldly entanglements.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur tuThai naam dhiraRaiaa ham ke'ee sabadh nihaal ||
verses.translation: The Guru, in His Mercy, implanted the Naam within me; I am enraptured with the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਅਤੁਟੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak atuT dhan paiaa har naamaa har dhan maal ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has obtained the inexhaustible wealth; the Lord's Name is his wealth and property. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤੁਮੑ ਵਡ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੌਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: har tum(h) vadd vadde vadde vadd uooche sabh uoopar vadde vaddauanaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord, You are the Greatest of the Great, the Greatest of the Great, the Most Lofty and Exalted of all, the Greatest of the Great.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰੇ ਤੇ ਹੋਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo dhiaaveh har apara(n)par har har har dhiaai hare te honaa ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Infinite Lord, who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har, are rejuvenated.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਾਟੇ ਪਾਪ ਕਟੋਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo gaaveh suneh teraa jas suaamee tin kaaTe paap kaTonaa ||
verses.translation: Those who sing and listen to Your Praises, O my Lord and Master, have millions of sins destroyed.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਜਾਨੇ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਵਡ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਵਡੋਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: tum jaise har purakh jaane mat gurmat mukh vadd vadd bhaag vaddonaa ||
verses.translation: I know that those divine beings who follow the Guru's Teachings are just like You, Lord. They are the greatest of the great, so very fortunate.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਆਦਿ ਸਤੇ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਸਤੇ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਸਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਸੋਨਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: sabh dhiaavahu aadh sate jugaadh sate paratakh sate sadhaa sadhaa sate jan naanak dhaas dhasonaa ||5||
verses.translation: Let everyone meditate on the Lord, who was True in the primal beginning, and True throughout the ages; He is revealed as True here and now, and He shall be True forever and ever. Servant Nanak is the slave of His slaves. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: hamare har jagajeevanaa har japio har gur ma(n)t ||
verses.translation: I meditate on my Lord, the Life of the World, the Lord, chanting the Guru's Mantra.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ਅਚਿੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: har agam agochar agam har har miliaa aai achi(n)t ||
verses.translation: The Lord is Unapproachable, Inaccessible and Unfathomable; the Lord, Har, Har, has spontaneously come to meet me.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਬਿਅੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: har aape ghaT ghaT varatadhaa har aape aap bia(n)t ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is pervading each and every heart; the Lord Himself is Endless.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਵਲਾ ਕੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: har aape sabh ras bhogadhaa har aape kavalaa ka(n)t ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself enjoys all pleasures; the Lord Himself is the Husband of Maya.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਸਭ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: har aape bhikhiaa paidhaa sabh sisaT upaiee jeea ja(n)t ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself gives in charity to the whole world, and all the beings and creatures which He created.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਂਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: har dhevahu dhaan dhiaal prabh har maa(n)geh har jan sa(n)t ||
verses.translation: O Merciful Lord God, please bless me with Your Bountiful Gifts; the humble Saints of the Lord beg for them.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਹਮ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਛੰਤ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ke prabh aai mil ham gaaveh har gun chha(n)t ||1||
verses.translation: O God of servant Nanak, please come and meet me; I sing the Songs of the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh sajan naam har mai man tan naam sareer ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord God is my Best Friend. My mind and body are drenched with the Naam.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਆਸਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਧੀਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: sabh aasaa gurmukh pooreeaa jan naanak sun har dheer ||2||
verses.translation: All the hopes of the Gurmukh are fulfilled; servant Nanak is comforted, hearing the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਮਉਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: har uootam hariaa naam hai har purakh nira(n)jan maulaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Sublime Name is energizing and rejuvenating. The Immaculate Lord, the Primal Being, blossoms forth.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਪਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਸੇਵੇ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਤ ਕਉਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jo japadhe har har dhinas raat tin seve charan nit kaulaa ||
verses.translation: Maya serves at the feet of those who chant and meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, day and night.

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਸਭ ਜਉਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: nit saar sam(h)aale sabh jeea ja(n)t har vasai nikaT sabh jaulaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord always looks after and cares for all His beings and creatures; He is with all, near and far.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇਸੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਉਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: so boojhai jis aap bujhaisee jis satigur purakh prabh saulaa ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Lord inspires to understand, understand; the True Guru, God, the Primal Being, is pleased with them.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰੇ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਉਲਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sabh gaavahu gun govi(n)dh hare govi(n)dh hare govi(n)dh hare gun gaavat gunee samaulaa ||6||
verses.translation: Let everyone sing the Praise of the Lord of the Universe, the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, the Lord, the Lord of the Universe; singing the Praise of the Lord, one is absorbed in His Glorious Virtues. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੇਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sutiaa har prabh chet man har sahaj samaadh samai ||
verses.translation: O mind, even in sleep, remember the Lord God; let yourself be intuitively absorbed into the Celestial State of Samaadhi.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har har chaau man gur tuThaa mele mai ||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak's mind longs for the Lord, Har, Har. As the Guru pleases, he is absorbed into the Lord, O mother. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਸੁ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਮੇਰੈ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: har ikas setee pirahaRee har iko merai chit ||
verses.translation: I am in love with the One and Only Lord; the One Lord fills my consciousness.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਇਕਸ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਤਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ik adhaar har prabh ikas te gat pat ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak takes the Support of the One Lord God; through the One, he obtains honor and salvation. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਪੰਚੇ ਸਬਦ ਵਜੇ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਅਨਹਦੁ ਵਜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)che sabadh vaje mat gurmat vaddabhaagee anahadh vajiaa ||
verses.translation: The Panch Shabad, the Five Primal Sounds, vibrate with the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings; by great good fortune, the Unstruck Melody resonates and resounds.

verses.original: ਆਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗਜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aanadh mool raam sabh dhekhiaa gur sabadhee govidh gajiaa ||
verses.translation: I see the Lord, the Source of Bliss, everywhere; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord of the Universe is revealed.

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਵੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: aadh jugaadh ves har eko mat gurmat har prabh bhajiaa ||
verses.translation: From the primal beginning, and throughout the ages, the Lord has One Form. Through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, I vibrate and meditate on the Lord God.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਨ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਲਜਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har dhevahu dhaan dhiaal prabh jan raakhahu har prabh lajiaa ||
verses.translation: O Merciful Lord God, please bless me with Your Bounty; O Lord God, please preserve and protect the honor of Your humble servant.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਧੰਨੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਪੜਦਾ ਕਜਿਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: sabh dha(n)n kahahu gur satiguroo gur satiguroo jit mil har paRadhaa kajiaa ||7||
verses.translation: Let everyone proclaim: Blessed is the Guru, the True Guru, the Guru, the True Guru; meeting Him, the Lord covers their faults and deficiencies. ||7||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਸਰੋਵਰੁ ਉਛਲੈ ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰੇ ਵਹੰਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat sarovar uchhalai subhar bhare vaha(n)n ||
verses.translation: The sacred pool of devotional worship is filled to the brim and overflowing in torrents.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਲਹੰਨਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jinaa satigur ma(n)niaa jan naanak vadd bhaag laha(n)n ||1||
verses.translation: Those who obey the True Guru, O servant Nanak, are very fortunate - they find it. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਅਸੰਖ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam asa(n)kh har har ke gun kathan na jaeh ||
verses.translation: The Names of the Lord, Har, Har, are countless. The Glorious Virtues of the Lord, Har, Har, cannot be described.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: har har agam agaadh har jan kit bidh mileh milaeh ||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is Inaccessible and Unfathomable; how can the humble servants of the Lord be united in His Union?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਜਪੰਤ ਜਨ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har har jas japat japa(n)t jan ik til nahee keemat pai ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings meditate and chant the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, but they do not attain even a tiny bit of His Worth.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har agam prabh har mel laih laR lai ||2||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, the Lord God is Inaccessible; the Lord has attached me to His Robe, and united me in His Union. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਿਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: har agam agochar agam har kiau kar har dharasan pikhaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is Inaccessible and Unfathomable. How will I see the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan?

verses.original: ਕਿਛੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਵਰਨੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰਿਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: kichh vakhar hoi su varaneeaai tis roop na rikhaa ||
verses.translation: If He were a material object, then I could describe Him, but He has no form or feature.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਬੁਝਾਇ ਦੇਇ ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਦਿਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis bujhaae aap bujhai dhei soiee jan dhikhaa ||
verses.translation: Understanding comes only when the Lord Himself gives understanding; only such a humble being sees it.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਟਸਾਲ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਸਿਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat satigur chaTasaal hai jit har gun sikhaa ||
verses.translation: The Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the True Guru, is the school of the soul, where the Glorious Virtues of the Lord are studied.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਰਸਨਾ ਧੰਨੁ ਕਰ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਪਾਧਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਲਿਖਾ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: dhan dha(n)nu su rasanaa dha(n)n kar dha(n)nu su paadhaa satiguroo jit mil har lekhaa likhaa ||8||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the tongue, blessed is the hand, and blessed is the Teacher, the True Guru; meeting Him, the Account of the Lord is written. ||8||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam a(n)mrit hai har japeeaai satigur bhai ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar. Meditate on the Lord, with love for the True Guru.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam pavit hai har japat sunat dhukh jai ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har is Sacred and Pure. Chanting it and listening to it, pain is taken away.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੀ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har naam tinee aaraadhiaa jin masatak likhiaa dhur pai ||
verses.translation: They alone worship and adore the Lord's Name, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is written.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਨ ਪੈਨਾਈਅਨਿ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: har dharageh jan painaieean jin har man vasiaa aai ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings are honored in the Court of the Lord; the Lord comes to abide in their minds.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak te mukh ujale jin har suniaa man bhai ||1||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, their faces are radiant. They listen to the Lord; their minds are filled with love. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam nidhaan hai gurmukh paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the greatest treasure. The Gurmukhs obtain it.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin dhur masatak likhiaa tin satigur miliaa aai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru comes to meet those who have such pre-ordained destiny written upon their foreheads.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਵਸੀ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: tan man seetal hoiaa saa(n)t vasee man aai ||
verses.translation: Their bodies and minds are cooled and soothed; peace and tranquility come to dwell in their minds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਉਦਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak har har chaudhiaa sabh dhaaladh dhukh leh jai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, all poverty and pain is dispelled. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ ॥
