verses.translit: hau vaariaa tin kau sadhaa sadhaa jinaa satigur meraa piaaraa dhekhiaa ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, forever and ever, to those who have seen my Beloved True Guru.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: tin kau miliaa meraa satiguroo jin kau dhur masatak lekhiaa ||
verses.translation: They alone meet my True Guru, who have such pre-ordaind destiny written upon their foreheads.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰੇਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har agam dhiaaiaa gurmatee tis roop nahee prabh rekhiaa ||
verses.translation: I meditate on the Inaccessible Lord, according to the Guru's Teachings; God has no form or feature.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਅਗਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸੇਵਕ ਰਲਿ ਏਕਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur bachan dhiaaiaa jinaa agam har te Thaakur sevak ral ekiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who follow the Guru's Teachings and meditate on the Inaccessible Lord, merge with their Lord and Master and become one with Him.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਨਰ ਨਰਹਰੇ ਨਰ ਨਰਹਰੇ ਨਰ ਨਰਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਿਸੇਖਿਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: sabh kahahu mukhahu nar narahare nar narahare nar narahare har laahaa har bhagat visekhiaa ||9||
verses.translation: Let everyone proclaim out loud, the Name of the Lord, the Lord, the Lord; the profit of devotional worship of the Lord is blessed and sublime. ||9||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਮੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹੇ ਰਮੁ ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਮੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam ram rav rahe ram raamo raam rameet ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is permeating and pervading all. Repeat the Name of the Lord, Raam, Raam.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਓ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT aatam raam hai prabh khel keeo ra(n)g reet ||
verses.translation: The Lord is in the home of each and every soul. God created this play with its various colors and forms.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਕੀਓ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: har nikaT vasai jagajeevanaa paragaas keeo gur meet ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Life of the World, dwells near at hand. The Guru, my Friend, has made this clear.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: har suaamee har prabh tin mile jin likhiaa dhur har preet ||
verses.translation: They alone meet the Lord, the Lord God, their Lord and Master, whose love for the Lord is pre-ordained.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਤਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa gur bachan japio man cheet ||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, chant it consciously with your mind. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਲੋੜਿ ਲਹੁ ਭਾਗਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh sajan loR lahu bhaag vasai vaddabhaag ||
verses.translation: Seek the Lord God, your Best Friend; by great good fortune, He comes to dwell with the very fortunate ones.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur poorai dhekhaaliaa naanak har liv laag ||2||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, He is revealed, O Nanak, and one is lovingly attuned to the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਫਲ ਘੜੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan suhaavee safal ghaRee jit har sevaa man bhaanee ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed, beauteous and fruitful is that moment, when service to the Lord becomes pleasing to the mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: har kathaa sunaavahu mere gursikhahu mere har prabh akath kahaanee ||
verses.translation: So proclaim the story of the Lord, O my GurSikhs; speak the Unspoken Speech of my Lord God.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਿਉ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: kiau paieeaai kiau dhekheeaai meraa har prabh sughaR sujaanee ||
verses.translation: How can I attain Him? How can I see Him? My Lord God is All-knowing and All-seeing.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: har mel dhikhaae aap har gur bachanee naam samaanee ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, the Lord reveals Himself; we merge in absorption in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਜੋ ਜਪਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: tin viTahu naanak vaariaa jo japadhe har nirabaanee ||10||
verses.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice unto those who meditate on the Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||10||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਤੇ ਲੋਇਣਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh rate loinaa giaan a(n)jan gur dhei ||
verses.translation: One's eyes are anointed by the Lord God, when the Guru bestows the ointment of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਜਣੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੇਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mai prabh sajan paiaa jan naanak sahaj milei ||1||
verses.translation: I have found God, my Best Friend; servant Nanak is intuitively absorbed into the Lord. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh a(n)tar saa(n)t hai man tan naam samai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is filled with peace and tranquility deep within. His mind and body are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਨਾਮੋ ਪੜੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam chitavai naamo paRai naam rahai liv lai ||
verses.translation: He thinks of the Naam, and reads the Naam; he remains lovingly attuned to the Naam.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਈ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naam padhaarath paieeaai chi(n)taa giee bilai ||
verses.translation: He obtains the Treasure of the Naam, and is rid of anxiety.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai naam uoopajai tirasanaa bhukh sabh jai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, the Naam wells up, and all hunger and thirst depart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak naame ratiaa naamo palai pai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one who is imbued with the Naam, gathers the Naam in his lap. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape jagat upai kai tudh aape vasagat keetaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself control it.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਰਾਇਅਨੁ ਇਕਨਾ ਮੇਲਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਤਿਨਾ ਜੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: eik manmukh kar haaraian ikanaa mel guroo tinaa jeetaa ||
verses.translation: Some are self-willed manmukhs - they lose. Others are united with the Guru - they win.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਸਭਾਗੈ ਲੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: har uootam har prabh naam hai gur bachan sabhaagai leetaa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, the Lord God is Sublime. The fortunate ones chant it, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਸਭੋ ਲਹਿ ਗਇਆ ਜਾਂ ਨਾਉ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh dhaaladh sabho leh giaa jaa(n) naau guroo har dheetaa ||
verses.translation: All pain and poverty are taken away, when the Guru bestows the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਨੋ ਮਨਮੋਹਨੋ ਜਗਮੋਹਨੋ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਸਭੋ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: sabh sevahu mohano manmohano jagamohano jin jagat upai sabho vas keetaa ||11||
verses.translation: Let everyone serve the Enticing Enticer of the Mind, the Enticer of the World, who created the world, and controls it all. ||11||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਰਜਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: man a(n)tar haumai rog hai bhram bhoole manmukh dhurajanaa ||
verses.translation: The disease of egotism is deep within the mind; the self-willed manmukhs and the evil beings are deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੋਗੁ ਵਞਾਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak rog van(j)ai mil satigur saadhoo sajanaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the disease is cured only by meeting with the True Guru, the Holy Friend. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤਾਮਿ ਸਗਾਰਵਾ ਜਾਂ ਦੇਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਨੈਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan taam sagaaravaa jaa(n) dhekhaa har naine ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are embellished and exalted, when I behold the Lord with my eyes.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੈ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਉ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਦੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak so prabh mai milai hau jeevaa sadh sune ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, meeting with that God, I live, hearing His Voice. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸਰ ਕਰਤੇ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaga(n)naath jagadheesar karate apara(n)par purakh atol ||
verses.translation: The Creator is the Lord of the World, the Master of the Universe, the Infinite Primal Immeasurable Being.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: har naam dhiaavahu mere gursikhahu har uootam har naam amol ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord's Name, O my GurSikhs; the Lord is Sublime, the Lord's Name is Invaluable.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਤੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin dhiaaiaa hiradhai dhinas raat te mile nahee har rol ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on Him in their hearts, day and night, merge with the Lord - there is no doubt about it.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਬੋਲੁ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee sa(n)gat milai gur satigur pooraa bol ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, they join the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, and speak the Word of the Guru, the Perfect True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਨਰ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੋ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੋ ਜਿਤੁ ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਝਗੜੁ ਝਗੋਲੁ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: sabh dhiaavahu nar naaraino naaraino jit chookaa jam jhagaR jhagol ||12||
verses.translation: Let everyone meditate on the Lord, the Lord, the All-pervading Lord, by which all disputes and conflicts with Death are ended. ||12||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਉਦਿਆ ਸਰੁ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: har jan har har chaudhiaa sar sa(n)dhiaa gaavaar ||
verses.translation: The humble servant of the Lord chants the Name, Har, Har. The foolish idiot shoots arrows at him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਉਬਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak har jan har liv ubare jin sa(n)dhiaa tis fir maar ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the humble servant of the Lord is saved by the Love of the Lord. The arrow is turned around, and kills the one who shot it. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਖੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਕਸਾਈਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਖੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: akhee prem kasaieeaa har har naam pikha(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: The eyes which are attracted by the Lord's Love behold the Lord through the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਦੇਖਦੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਢਿ ਦਿਚੰਨਿੑ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: je kar dhoojaa dhekhadhe jan naanak kadd dhicha(n)ni(h) ||2||
verses.translation: If they gaze upon something else, O servant Nanak, they ought to be gouged out. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਪੂਰਨੋ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jal thal maheeal poorano apara(n)par soiee ||
verses.translation: The Infinite Lord totally permeates the water, the land and the sky.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਦਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t pratipaaladhaa jo kare su hoiee ||
verses.translation: He cherishes and sustains all beings and creatures; whatever He does comes to pass.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਭ੍ਰਾਤ ਮੀਤ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa sut bhraat meet tis bin nahee koiee ||
verses.translation: Without Him, we have no mother, father, children, sibling or friend.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜਪਿਅਹੁ ਜਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar rav rahiaa japiahu jan koiee ||
verses.translation: He is permeating and pervading deep within each and every heart; let everyone meditate on Him.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਜਪਹੁ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੁਨ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸਭ ਲੋਈ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit: sagal japahu gopaal gun paragaT sabh loiee ||13||
verses.translation: Let all chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World, who is manifest all over the world. ||13||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਿ ਸਜਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਇਆ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh mile s sajanaa har prabh paiaa ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: Those Gurmukhs who meet as friends are blessed with the Lord God's Love.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਤੂ ਲੁਡਿ ਲੁਡਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਵੰਞੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam salaeh too ludd ludd dharageh va(n)n(j) ||1||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, praise the Naam, the Name of the Lord; you shall go to His court in joyous high spirits. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har toohai dhaataa sabhas dhaa sabh jeea tum(h)aare ||
verses.translation: Lord, You are the Great Giver of all; all beings are Yours.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੈ ਨੋ ਆਰਾਧਦੇ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh tudhai no aaraadhadhe dhaan dheh piaare ||
verses.translation: They all worship You in adoration; You bless them with Your Bounty, O Beloved.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਦਾਤਾਰਿ ਹਥੁ ਕਢਿਆ ਮੀਹੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਸੈਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har dhaatai dhaataar hath kaddiaa meeh vuThaa saisaare ||
verses.translation: The Generous Lord, the Great Giver reaches out with His Hands, and the rain pours down on the world.

verses.original: ਅੰਨੁ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਖੇਤੀ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)n ja(n)miaa khetee bhaau kar har naam sam(h)aare ||
verses.translation: The corn germinates in the fields; contemplate the Lord's Name with love.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ma(n)gai dhaan prabh har naam adhaare ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak begs for the Gift of the Support of the Name of his Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਇਛਾ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀਐ ਜਪੀਐ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eichhaa man kee pooreeaai japeeaai sukh saagar ||
verses.translation: The desires of the mind are satisfied, meditating on the Ocean of Peace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਅਰਾਧੀਅਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: har ke charan araadhe'eeh gur sabadh ratanaagar ||
verses.translation: Worship and adore the Feet of the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the jewel mine.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਫਾਟੈ ਜਮ ਕਾਗਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: mil saadhoo sa(n)g udhaar hoi faaTai jam kaagar ||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved, and the Decree of Death is torn up.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੀਤੀਐ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath jeeteeaai jap har bairaagar ||
verses.translation: The treasure of this human life is won, meditating on the Lord of Detachment.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਪਵਹੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਗਰੁ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: sabh pavahu saran satiguroo kee binasai dhukh dhaagar ||14||
verses.translation: Let everyone seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru; let the black spot of pain, the scar of suffering, be erased. ||14||

verses.original: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉ ਢੂੰਢੇਂਦੀ ਸਜਣਾ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੈਡੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: hau ddoo(n)dde(n)dhee sajanaa sajan maiddai naal ||
verses.translation: I was seeking, searching for my Friend, but my Friend is right here with me.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਲਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak alakh na lakheeaai gurmukh dheh dhikhaal ||1||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, the Unseen is not seen, but the Gurmukh is given to see Him. ||1||

verses.translit: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਚੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak preet laiee tin sachai tis bin rahan na jaiee ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am in love with the True Lord; I cannot survive without Him.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta pooraa paieeaai har ras rasan rasaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, the Perfect Lord is found, and the tongue savors His Sublime Essence. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: pauRee ||
verses.translation: Pauree:

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਗਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕੋ ਉਚਰਿ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: koiee gaavai ko sunai ko uchar sunaavai ||
verses.translation: Some sing, some listen, and some speek and preach.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam kee mal utarai man chi(n)dhiaa paavai ||
verses.translation: The filth and pollution of countless lifetimes is washed away, and the wishes of the mind are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਟੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaanaa meTeeaai har ke gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: Coming and going in reincarnation ceases, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਸੰਗੀ ਤਰਾਹਿ ਸਭ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਤਰਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aap tareh sa(n)gee taraeh sabh kuTa(n)b taraavai ||
verses.translation: They save themselves, and save their companions; they save all their generations as well.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜੋ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧੫॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak tis balihaaranai jo mere har prabh bhaavai ||15||1|| sudh ||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak is a sacrifice to those who are pleasing to my Lord God. ||15||1|| Sudh||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਕਾਨੜਾ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ
verses.translit: raag kaanaRaa baanee naamadhev jeeau kee
verses.translation: Raag Kaanraa, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: aaiso raam rai a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: Such is the Sovereign Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of Hearts;

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਦਰਪਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਦਨ ਪਰਵਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaise dharapan maeh badhan paravaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He sees everything as clearly as one's face reflected in a mirror. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਸੈ ਘਟਾ ਘਟ ਲੀਪ ਨ ਛੀਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: basai ghaTaa ghaT leep na chheepai ||
verses.translation: He dwells in each and every heart; no stain or stigma sticks to Him.

verses.original: ਬੰਧਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਜਾਤੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ba(n)dhan mukataa jaat na dheesai ||1||
verses.translation: He is liberated from bondage; He does not belong to any social class. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਾਨੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਜੈਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: paanee maeh dhekh mukh jaisaa ||
verses.translation: As one's face is reflected in the water,

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਐਸਾ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: naame ko suaamee beeThal aaisaa ||2||1||
verses.translation: so does Naam Dayv's Beloved Lord and Master appear. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪
verses.translit: raag kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa
verses.translation: Raag Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satinaam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਰਾਮਾ ਰਮ ਰਾਮੈ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: raamaa ram raamai a(n)t na paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Beauteous Lord - no one has found His limits.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਤੂ ਬਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ham baarik pratipaare tumare too badd purakh pitaa meraa maiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a child - You cherish and sustain me. You are the Great Primal Being, my Mother and Father. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਗਮ ਹਹਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam asa(n)kh agam heh agam agam har raiaa ||
verses.translation: The Names of the Lord are Countless and Unfathomable. My Sovereign Lord is Unfathomable and Incomprehensible.

verses.original: ਗੁਣੀ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gunee giaanee surat bahu keenee ik til nahee keemat paiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The virtuous and the spiritual teachers have given it great thought, but they have not found even an iota of His Value. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਸਦ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gobidh gun gobidh sadh gaaveh gun gobidh a(n)t na paiaa ||
verses.translation: They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe forever. They sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, but they do not find His limits.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਮਿਤਿ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਹੁ ਜਪੀਐ ਥਾਹ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: too amit atol apara(n)par suaamee bahu japeeaai thaeh na paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: You are Immeasurable, Unweighable, and Infinite, O Lord and Master; no matter how much one may meditate on You, Your Depth cannot be fathomed. ||2||

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਜਨ ਮਾਧੌ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ausatat kareh tumaree jan maadhau gun gaaveh har raiaa ||
verses.translation: Lord, Your humble servants praise You, singing Your Glorious Praises, O Sovereign Lord.

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਮ ਮੀਨੇ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tum(h) jal nidh ham meene tumare teraa a(n)t na katahoo paiaa ||3||
verses.translation: You are the ocean of water, and I am Your fish. No one has ever found Your limits. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਧਸੂਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jan kau kirapaa karahu madhasoodhan har dhevahu naam japaiaa ||
verses.translation: Please be Kind to Your humble servant, Lord; please bless me with the meditation of Your Name.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: mai moorakh a(n)dhule naam Tek hai jan naanak gurmukh paiaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: I am a blind fool; Your Name is my only Support. Servant Nanak, as Gurmukh, has found it. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਹਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: har jan gun gaavat hasiaa ||
verses.translation: The humble servant of the Lord sings the Lord's Praise, and blossoms forth.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har bhagat banee mat gurmat dhur masatak prabh likhiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My intellect is embellished with devotion to the Lord, Har, Har, through the Guru's Teachings. This is the destiny which God has recorded on my forehead. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਪਗ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur ke pag simarau dhin raatee man har har har basiaa ||
verses.translation: I meditate in remembrance on the Guru's Feet, day and night. The Lord, Har, Har, Har, comes to dwell in my mind.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਜਗਿ ਸਾਰੀ ਘਸਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਘਸਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har har har keerat jag saaree ghas cha(n)dhan jas ghasiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The Praise of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, is Excellent and Sublime in this world. His Praise is the sandalwood paste which I rub. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਖੋਜਿ ਪਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har jan har har har liv laiee sabh saakat khoj piaa ||
verses.translation: The humble servant of the Lord is lovingly attuned to the Lord, Har, Har, Har; all the faithless cynics pursue him.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਕਿਰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਚਲਿਓ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਪਗੁ ਨਾਗਨਿ ਛੁਹਿ ਜਲਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau kirat sa(n)jog chalio nar ni(n)dhak pag naagan chhuh jaliaa ||2||
verses.translation: The slanderous person acts in accordance with the record of his past deeds; his foot trips over the snake, and he is stung by its bite. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜਨ ਰਖਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jan ke tum(h) har raakhe suaamee tum(h) jug jug jan rakhiaa ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, You are the Saving Grace, the Protector of Your humble servants. You protect them, age after age.

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਆ ਦੈਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਸਭ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਝਰਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahaa bhiaa dhait karee bakheelee sabh kar kar jhar pariaa ||3||
verses.translation: What does it matter, if a demon speaks evil? By doing so, he only gets frustrated. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਏ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jete jeea ja(n)t prabh ke'ee sabh kaalai mukh grasiaa ||
verses.translation: All the beings and creatures created by God are caught in the mouth of Death.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: har jan har har har prabh raakhe jan naanak saran piaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: The humble servants of the Lord are protected by the Lord God, Har, Har, Har; servant Nanak seeks His Sanctuary. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man jap jap jaga(n)naathe ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant and meditate on the Master of the Universe.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur upadhes har naam dhiaaio sabh kilabikh dhukh laathe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, meditate on the Lord's Name, and be rid of all the painful past sins. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਰਸਨਾ ਏਕ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਬਹੁ ਰਸੁਨਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: rasanaa ek jas gai na saakai bahu keejai bahu rasunathe ||
verses.translation: I have only one tongue - I cannot sing His Praises. Please bless me with many, many tongues.

verses.original: ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲ ਸਭਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਨ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਨਥੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: baar baar khin pal sabh gaaveh gun keh na sakeh prabh tumanathe ||1||
verses.translation: Again and again, each and every instant, with all of them, I would sing His Glorious Praises; but even then, I would not be able to sing all of Your Praises, God. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਲੋਚਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਿਖਨਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: ham bahu preet lagee prabh suaamee ham locheh prabh dhikhanathe ||
verses.translation: I am so deeply in love with God, my Lord and Master; I long to see God's Vision.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਬਡ ਦਾਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੇ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਬਿਰਥੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tum badd dhaate jeea jeean ke tum jaanahu ham birathe ||2||
verses.translation: You are the Great Giver of all beings and creatures; only You know our inner pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਕਹੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਿਆ ਦਿਨਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: koiee maarag pa(n)th bataavai prabh kaa kahu tin kau kiaa dhinathe ||
verses.translation: If only someone would show me the Way, the Path of God. Tell me - what could I give him?

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਉ ਅਰਪਿ ਅਰਾਪਉ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਥੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh tan man arapau arap araapau koiee melai prabh milathe ||3||
verses.translation: I would surrender, offer and dedicate all my body and mind to him; if only someone would unite me in God's Union! ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਹੁਤ ਬਹੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਮ ਤੁਛ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਰਨਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: har ke gun bahut bahut bahu sobhaa ham tuchh kar kar baranathe ||
verses.translation: The Glorious Praises of the Lord are so many and numerous; I can describe only a tiny bit of them.

verses.original: ਹਮਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਮਰਥੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: hamaree mat vasagat prabh tumarai jan naanak ke prabh samarathe ||4||3||
verses.translation: My intellect is under Your control, God; You are the All-powerful Lord God of servant Nanak. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਅਕਥ ਸੁਨਥਈ ॥
verses.translit: mere man jap har gun akath sunathiee ||
verses.translation: O my mind, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, which are said to be inexpressible.

verses.original: ਧਰਮੁ ਅਰਥੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਾਮੁ ਮੋਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਨ ਪੀਛੈ ਲਗਿ ਫਿਰਥਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharam arath sabh kaam mokh hai jan peechhai lag firathiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Rightousness and Dharmic faith, success and prosperity, pleasure, the fulfillment of desires and liberation - all follow the humble servant of the Lord like a shadow. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਡਭਾਗ ਮਥਈ ॥
verses.translit: so har har naam dhiaavai har jan jis baddabhaag mathiee ||
verses.translation: That humble servant of the Lord who has such good fortune written on his forehead meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਤਹ ਛੁਟੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਥਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeh dharageh prabh lekhaa maagai teh chhuTai naam dhiaaithiee ||1||
verses.translation: In that Court, where God calls for the accounts, there, you shall be saved only by meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੇ ਦੋਖ ਬਹੁ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਗਥਈ ॥
verses.translit: hamare dhokh bahu janam janam ke dhukh haumai mail lagathiee ||
verses.translation: I am stained with the filth of the mistakes of countless lifetimes, the pain and pollution of egotism.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਨਾਵਾਏ ਸਭ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਗਥਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur dhaar kirapaa har jal naavaae sabh kilabikh paap gathiee ||2||
verses.translation: Showering His Mercy, the Guru bathed me in the Water of the Lord, and all my sins and mistakes were taken away. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੈ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਭਜਥਈ ॥
verses.translit: jan kai ridh a(n)tar prabh suaamee jan har har naam bhajathiee ||
verses.translation: God, our Lord and Master, is deep within the hearts of His humble servants. They vibrate the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਅੰਤੀ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਆਇ ਬਨਤੁ ਹੈ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਥਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jeh a(n)tee aausar aai banat hai teh raakhai naam saathiee ||3||
verses.translation: And when that very last moment comes, then the Naam is our Best Friend and Protector. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਜਗੰਨਥਈ ॥
verses.translit: jan teraa jas gaaveh har har prabh har japio jaga(n)nathiee ||
verses.translation: Your humble servants sing Your Praises, O Lord, Har, Har; they chant and meditate on the Lord God, the Master of the Universe.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਰਖੁ ਬੁਡਥਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ke prabh raakhe suaamee ham paathar rakh buddathiee ||4||4||
verses.translation: O God, my Saving Grace, Lord and Master of servant Nanak, please save me, the sinking stone. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮਰੀ ਚਿਤਵਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: hamaree chitavanee har prabh jaanai ||
verses.translation: Only the Lord God knows my innermost thoughts.

verses.original: ਅਉਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaur koiee ni(n)dh karai har jan kee prabh taa kaa kahiaa ik til nahee maanai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: If someone slanders the humble servant of the Lord, God does not believe even a tiny bit of what he says. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਉਰ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ ਅਚੁਤ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਗਵਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: aaur sabh tiaag sevaa kar achut jo sabh te uooch Thaakur bhagavaanai ||
verses.translation: So give up everything else, and serve the Imperishable; The Lord God, our Lord and Master, is the Highest of all.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਲੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਚਰਨੀ ਆਇ ਪਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har sevaa te kaal joh na saakai charanee aai pavai har jaanai ||1||
verses.translation: When you serve the Lord, Death cannot even see you. It comes and falls at the feet of those who know the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਪੈ ਕਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau raakh lei meraa suaamee taa kau sumat dhei pai kaanai ||
verses.translation: Those whom my Lord and Master protects - a balanced wisdom comes to their ears.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕੋਈ ਅਪਰਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa kau koiee apar na saakai jaa kee bhagat meraa prabh maanai ||2||
verses.translation: No one can equal them; their devotional worship is accepted by my God. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਨ ਦੇਖੁ ਜਨ ਜੋ ਖੋਟਾ ਖਰਾ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: har ke choj viddaan dhekh jan jo khoTaa kharaa ik nimakh pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: So behold the Wondrous and Amazing Play of the Lord. In an instant, He distinguishes the genuine from the counterfeit.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਰਿਦ ਸੁਧ ਮਿਲੇ ਖੋਟੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਨੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taa te jan kau anadh bhiaa hai ridh sudh mile khoTe pachhutaanai ||3||
verses.translation: And that is why His humble servant is in bliss. Those of pure heart meet together, while the evil ones regret and repent. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤੇ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਕੁ ਮਾਗਉ ਤੁਝ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: tum har dhaate samarath suaamee ik maagau tujh paasahu har dhaanai ||
verses.translation: Lord, You are the Great Giver, our All-powerful Lord and Master; O Lord, I beg for only one gift from You.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਸਦ ਬਸਹਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਾਨੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kau har kirapaa kar dheejai sadh baseh ridhai moh har charaanai ||4||5||
verses.translation: Lord, please bless servant Nanak with Your Grace, that Your Feet may abide forever within my heart. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਜੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh keejai kirapaa nidhaan ham har gun gaavahage ||
verses.translation: O God, Treasure of Mercy, please bless me, that I may sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕਰਉ ਨਿਤ ਆਸ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੋਹਿ ਕਬ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau tumaree karau nit aas prabh moh kab gal laavahige ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I always place my hopes in You; O God, when will you take me in Your Embrace? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਮੁਗਧ ਇਆਨ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: ham baarik mugadh iaan pitaa samajhaavahige ||
verses.translation: I am a foolish and ignorant child; Father, please teach me!

verses.original: ਸੁਤੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭੂਲਿ ਬਿਗਾਰਿ ਜਗਤ ਪਿਤ ਭਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sut khin khin bhool bigaar jagat pit bhaavahige ||1||
verses.translation: Your child makes mistakes again and again, but still, You are pleased with him, O Father of the Universe. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਮ ਪਾਵਹਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo har suaamee tum dheh soiee ham paavahage ||
verses.translation: Whatever You give me, O my Lord and Master - that is what I receive.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਠਉਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਹਮ ਜਾਵਹਗੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: moh dhoojee naahee Thaur jis peh ham jaavahage ||2||
verses.translation: There is no other place where I can go. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਭਗਤ ਤਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: jo har bhaaveh bhagat tinaa har bhaavahige ||
verses.translation: Those devotees who are pleasing to the Lord - the Lord is pleasing to them.

verses.original: ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਰਲਿ ਜਾਵਹਗੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jotee jot milai jot ral jaavahage ||3||
verses.translation: Their light merges into the Light; the lights are merged and blended together. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਆਪਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: har aape hoi kirapaal aap liv laavahige ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself has shown mercy; He lovingly attunes me to Himself.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak saran dhuaar har laaj rakhaavahige ||4||6||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Door of the Lord, who protects his honor. ||4||6||

verses.original: ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: chhakaa 1 ||
verses.translation: First Set of Six||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਭੋਪਾਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪
verses.translit: kaliaan bhopaalee mahalaa chauthhaa
verses.translation: Kalyaan Bhopaalee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰਣੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham paramesur suaamee dhookh nivaaran naaraine ||
verses.translation: O Supreme Lord God, Transcendent Lord and Master, Destroyer of pain, Transcendental Lord God.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਭਗਤ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਰਣ ਹਰਿ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal bhagat jaacheh sukh saagar bhav nidh taran har chi(n)taamane ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: All Your devotees beg of You. Ocean of peace, carry us across the terrifying world-ocean; You are the Wish-fulfilling Jewel. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੇ ॥
verses.translit: dheen dhiaal jagadhees dhamodhar har a(n)tarajaamee gobi(n)dhe ||
verses.translation: Merciful to the meek and poor, Lord of the world, Support of the earth, Inner-knower, Searcher of hearts, Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਿਨ ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਕੰਦੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: te nirabhau jin sreeraam dhiaaiaa gurmat muraar har muka(n)dhe ||1||
verses.translation: Those who meditate on the Supreme Lord become fearless. Through the Wisdom of the Guru's Teachings, they meditate on the Lord, the Liberator Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਗਦੀਸੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਜੋ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: jagadheesur charan saran jo aae te jan bhav nidh paar pare ||
verses.translation: Those who come to Sanctuary at the Feet of the Lord of the Universe - those humble beings cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kee paij har raakhai jan naanak aap har kirapaa kare ||2||1||7||
verses.translation: The Lord preserves the honor of His humble devotees; O servant Nanak, the Lord Himself showers them with His Grace. ||2||1||7||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag kaliaan mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Kalyaan, Fifth Mehla, First House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਮਾਰੈ ਏਹ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: hamaarai eh kirapaa keejai ||
verses.translation: Please grant me this blessing:

verses.original: ਅਲਿ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਫੇਰਿ ਫੇਰਿ ਰੀਝੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: al makara(n)dh charan kamal siau man fer fer reejhai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: May the bumble-bee of my mind be immersed again and again in the Honey of Your Lotus Feet. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਨ ਜਲਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਾਜੁ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਕਉ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aan jalaa siau kaaj na kachhooaai har boo(n)dh chaatirak kau dheejai ||1||
verses.translation: I am not concerned with any other water; please bless this songbird with a Drop of Your Water, Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਿਲਬੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੰਤੋਖਾ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਜੈ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin milabe naahee sa(n)tokhaa pekh dharasan naanak jeejai ||2||1||
verses.translation: Unless I meet my Lord, I am not satisfied. Nanak lives, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||2||1||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾਚਿਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਾਚੈ ਜਾਚੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaachik naam jaachai jaachai ||
verses.translation: This beggar begs and begs for Your Name, Lord.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਧਾਰ ਸਰਬ ਕੇ ਨਾਇਕ ਸੁਖ ਸਮੂਹ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarab dhaar sarab ke naik sukh samooh ke dhaate ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: You are the Support of all, the Master of all, the Giver of absolute peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੇਤੀ ਕੇਤੀ ਮਾਂਗਨਿ ਮਾਗੈ ਭਾਵਨੀਆ ਸੋ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ketee ketee maa(n)gan maagai bhaavaneeaa so paieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: So many, so very many, beg for charity at Your Door; they receive only what You are pleased to give. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸੁ ਰੇ ਪਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: safal safal safal dharas re paras paras gun gaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Fruitful, fruitful, fruitful is the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; touching His Touch, I sing His Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰੁ ਬਿਧਾਈਐ ॥੨॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak tat tat siau mileeaai heerai heer bidhaieeaai ||2||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, one's essence is blended into the Essence; the diamond of the mind is pierced through by the Diamond of the Lord. ||2||2||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਲਾਲਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere laalan kee sobhaa ||
verses.translation: O, the Wondrous Glory of my Beloved!

verses.original: ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨ ਮਨ ਰੰਗੀ ਸੋਭਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadh navatan man ra(n)gee sobhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind is rejuvenated forever by His Wondrous Love. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਿਧ ਮੁਨਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਮੰਗੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: braham mahes sidh mun i(n)dhraa bhagat dhaan jas ma(n)gee ||1||
verses.translation: Brahma, Shiva, the Siddhas, the silent sages and Indra beg for the charity of His Praise and devotion to Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋਗ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸੇਖਨਾਗੈ ਸਗਲ ਜਪਹਿ ਤਰੰਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: jog giaan dhiaan sekhanaagai sagal japeh tara(n)gee ||
verses.translation: Yogis, spiritual teachers, meditators and the thousand-headed serpent all meditate on the Waves of God.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸਦ ਸੰਗੀ ॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak sa(n)tan balihaarai jo prabh ke sadh sa(n)gee ||2||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Saints, who are the Eternal Companions of God. ||2||3||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehla, Second House:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: terai maan har har maan ||
verses.translation: Belief in You, Lord, brings honor.

verses.original: ਨੈਨ ਬੈਨ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨੀਐ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗੇ ਸੁਖ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nain bain sravan suneeaai a(n)g a(n)ge sukh praan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: To see with my eyes, and hear with my ears - every limb and fiber of my being, and my breath of life are in bliss. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਤ ਉਤ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਰਵਿਓ ਮੇਰ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eit ut dheh dhis ravio mer tineh samaan ||1||
verses.translation: Here and there, and in the ten directions You are pervading, in the mountain and the blade of grass. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਤ ਕਤਾ ਤਤ ਪੇਖੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਤਿ ਪਰਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jat kataa tat pekheeaai har purakh pat paradhaan ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see the Lord, the Supreme Lord, the Primal Being.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਮਿਟੇ ਕਥੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨ ॥੨॥੧॥੪॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g bhram bhai miTe kathe naanak braham giaan ||2||1||4||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, doubt and fear are dispelled. Nanak speaks the Wisdom of God. ||2||1||4||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਨਾਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨੰਦ ਬੇਦ ॥
verses.translit: gun naadh dhun ana(n)dh bedh ||
verses.translation: The Glory of God is the Sound-current of the Naad, the Celestial Music of Bliss, and the Wisdom of the Vedas.

verses.original: ਕਥਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kathat sunat mun janaa mil sa(n)t ma(n)ddalee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Speaking and listening, the silent sages and humble beings join together, in the Realm of the Saints. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਮਨ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਤਹ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਲੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: giaan dhiaan maan dhaan man rasik rasan naam japat teh paap kha(n)ddalee ||1||
verses.translation: Spiritual wisdom, meditation, faith and charity are there; their minds savor the Taste of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Chanting it, sins are destroyed. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦ ਤਤ ਬੇਤੇ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਅਖੰਡਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: jog jugat giaan bhugat surat sabadh tat bete jap tap akha(n)ddalee ||
verses.translation: This is the technology of Yoga, spiritual wisdom, devotion, intuitive knowledge of the Shabad, certain knowledge of the Essence of Reality, chanting and unbroken intensive meditation.

verses.original: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਛੂ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਡੰਡਲੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੫॥
verses.translit: ot pot mil jot naanak kachhoo dhukh na dda(n)ddalee ||2||2||5||
verses.translation: Through and through, O Nanak, merging into the Light, you shall never again suffer pain and punishment. ||2||2||5||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਉਨੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaun bidh taa kee kahaa karau ||
verses.translation: What should I do, and how should I do it?

verses.original: ਧਰਤ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਸਤ੍ਰਗਿਆ ਅਜਰ ਪਦੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਜਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dharat dhiaan giaan sasatragiaa ajar padh kaise jarau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Should I center myself in meditation, or study the spiritual wisdom of the Shaastras? How can I endure this unendurable state? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਸਨ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਿਧ ਮੁਨਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bisan mahes sidh mun i(n)dhraa kai dhar saran parau ||1||
verses.translation: Vishnu, Shiva, the Siddhas, the silent sages and Indra - at whose door should I seek sanctuary? ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਹੂ ਪਹਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਹਿ ਸੁਰਗਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਹਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaahoo peh raaj kaahoo peh suragaa koT madhe mukat kahau ||
verses.translation: Some have power and influence, and some are blessed with heavenly paradise, but out of millions, will anyone find liberation?

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਗਹਉ ॥੨॥੩॥੬॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak naam ras paieeaai saadhoo charan gahau ||2||3||6||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have attained the Sublime Essence of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I touch the feet of the Holy. ||2||3||6||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: praanapat dhiaal purakh prabh sakhe ||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Breath of Life, the Merciful Primal Lord God, is my Friend.

verses.original: ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲ ਜਾਲ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਾਸਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਖੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: garabh jon kal kaal jaal dhukh binaasan har rakhe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord saves us from the womb of reincarnation and the noose of death in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; He takes away our pain. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: naam dhaaree saran teree ||
verses.translation: I enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within; I seek Your Sanctuary, Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਲ ਟੇਕ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: prabh dhiaal Tek meree ||1||
verses.translation: O Merciful Lord God, You are my only Support. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਨਾਥ ਦੀਨ ਆਸਵੰਤ ॥
verses.translit: anaath dheen aasava(n)t ||
verses.translation: You are the only Hope of the helpless, the meek and the poor.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਨਹਿ ਮੰਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam suaamee maneh ma(n)t ||2||
verses.translation: Your Name, O my Lord and Master, is the Mantra of the mind. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨੂ ॥
verses.translit: tujh binaa prabh kichhoo na jaanoo ||
verses.translation: I know of nothing except You, God.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਪਛਾਨੂ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sarab jug meh tum pachhaanoo ||3||
verses.translation: Throughout all the ages, I realize You. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੇ ਨਿਸਿ ਬਾਸਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: har man base nis baasaro ||
verses.translation: O Lord, You dwell in my mind night and day.

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਸਰੋ ॥੪॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh naanak aasaro ||4||4||7||
verses.translation: The Lord of the Universe is Nanak's only Support. ||4||4||7||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਪੀਐ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: man tan jaapeeaai bhagavaan ||
verses.translation: Within my mind and body I meditate on the Lord God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਭਏ ਸਦਾ ਸੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore suprasa(n)n bhe sadhaa sookh kaliaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru is pleased and satisfied; I am blessed with eternal peace and happiness. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਏ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਨ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: sarab kaaraj sidh bhe gai gun gupaal ||
verses.translation: All affairs are successfuly resolved, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਿਮਰੇ ਨਾਠਿਆ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mil saadhasa(n)gat prabhoo simare naaThiaa dhukh kaal ||1||
verses.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I dwell upon God, and the pain of death is taken away. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਕਰਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa prabh meriaa karau dhin rain sev ||
verses.translation: Please take pity on me, O my God, that I may serve You day and night.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੇਵ ॥੨॥੫॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak dhaas saranaagatee har purakh pooran dhev ||2||5||8||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Perfect, Divine Primal Being. ||2||5||8||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: prabh meraa a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||
verses.translation: My God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of Hearts.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa pooran paramesar nihachal sach sabadh neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Take pity on me, O Perfect Transcendent Lord; bless me with the True Eternal Insignia of the Shabad, the Word of God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: har bin aan na koiee samarath teree aas teraa man taan ||
verses.translation: O Lord, other than You, no one is all-powerful. You are the Hope and the Strength of my mind.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਪਹਿਰਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sarab ghaTaa ke dhaate suaamee dheh su pahiran khaan ||1||
verses.translation: You are the Giver to the hearts of all beings, O Lord and Master. I eat and wear whatever You give me. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਸੋਭਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: surat mat chaturaiee sobhaa roop ra(n)g dhan maan ||
verses.translation: Intuitive understanding, wisdom and cleverness, glory and beauty, pleasure, wealth and honor,

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਲਿਆਣੁ ॥੨॥੬॥੯॥
verses.translit: sarab sookh aana(n)dh naanak jap raam naam kaliaan ||2||6||9||
verses.translation: all comforts, bliss, happiness and salvation, O Nanak, come by chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||6||9||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa panjavaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਕਲਿਆਨ ਕਰਨ ॥
verses.translit: har charan saran kaliaan karan ||
verses.translation: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet bring salvation.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: prabh naam patit paavano ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: God's Name is the Purifier of sinners. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਖਾਵਨੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g jap nisa(n)g jamakaal tis na khaavano ||1||
verses.translation: Whoever chants and meditates in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, shall undoubtedly escape being consumed by the Messenger of Death. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੂਖ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: mukat jugat anik sookh har bhagat lavai na laavano ||
verses.translation: Liberation, the key to success, and all sorts of comforts do not equal loving devotional worship of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਲੁਬਧ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਧਾਵਨੋ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: prabh dharas lubadh dhaas naanak bahuR jon na dhaavano ||2||7||10||
verses.translation: Slave Nanak longs for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; he shall never again wander in reincarnation. ||2||||7||10||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa asaTapadheeaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਮਾ ਰਮ ਰਾਮੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: raamaa ram raamo sun man bheejai ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Name of the Lord, the All-pervading Lord, my mind is drenched with joy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam a(n)mrit ras meeThaa gurmat sahaje peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar, the most Sweet and Sublime Essence; through the Guru's Teachings, drink it in with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਸਟ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਹੈ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਮਥਿ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਕਢੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaasaT meh jiau hai baisa(n)tar math sa(n)jam kaadd kaddeejai ||
verses.translation: The potential energy of fire is within the wood; it is released if you know how to rub it and generate friction.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਤਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਈਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam hai jot sabaiee tat gurmat kaadd lieejai ||1||
verses.translation: In just the same way, the Lord's Name is the Light within all; the Essence is extracted by following the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜ ਨਵੇ ਦਰ ਫੀਕੇ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦਸਵੇ ਚੁਈਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: nau dharavaaj nave dhar feeke ras a(n)mrit dhasave chuieejai ||
verses.translation: There are nine doors, but the taste of these nine doors is bland and insipid. The Essence of Ambrosial Nectar trickles down through the Tenth Door.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kirapaa kirapaa kar piaare gur sabadhee har ras peejai ||2||
verses.translation: Please take pity on me - be kind and compassionate, O my Beloved, that I may drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੁ ਨਗਰੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੋ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaiaa nagar nagar hai neeko vich saudhaa har ras keejai ||
verses.translation: The body-village is the most sublime and exalted village, in which the merchandise of the Lord's Sublime Essence is traded.

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਅਮੋਲ ਅਮੋਲਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ratan laal amol amolak satigur sevaa leejai ||3||
verses.translation: The most precious and priceless gems and jewels are obtained by serving the True Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਰਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur agam agam hai Thaakur bhar saagar bhagat kareejai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru is Inaccessible; Inaccessible is our Lord and Master. He is the overflowing Ocean of bliss - worship Him with loving devotion.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਮ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kirapaa kar dheen ham saari(n)g ik boo(n)dh naam mukh dheejai ||4||
verses.translation: Please take pity on me, and be Merciful to this meek song-bird; please pour a drop of Your Name into my mouth. ||4||

verses.original: ਲਾਲਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਰੰਗਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: laalan laal laal hai ra(n)gan man ra(n)gan kau gur dheejai ||
verses.translation: O Beloved Lord, please color my mind with the Deep Crimson Color of Your Love; I have surrendered my mind to the Guru.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਗਟਕ ਨਿਤ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: raam raam raam ra(n)g raate ras rasik gaTak nit peejai ||5||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, continually drink in this essence in big gulps, savoring its sweet taste. ||5||

verses.original: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਹੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਢਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: basudhaa sapat dheep hai saagar kadd ka(n)chan kaadd dhareejai ||
verses.translation: If all the gold of the seven continents and the oceans was taken out and placed before them,

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਇਨਹੁ ਨ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: mere Thaakur ke jan inahu na baachheh har maageh har ras dheejai ||6||
verses.translation: the humble servants of my Lord and Master would not even want it. They beg for the Lord to bless them with the Lord's Sublime Essence. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਸਦ ਭੂਖੇ ਨਿਤ ਭੂਖਨ ਭੂਖ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: saakat nar praanee sadh bhookhe nit bhookhan bhookh kareejai ||
verses.translation: The faithless cynics and mortal beings remain hungry forever; they continually cry out in hunger.

verses.original: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਧਾਇ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਖ ਕੋਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਿਥਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: dhaavat dhai dhaaveh preet maiaa lakh kosan kau bith dheejai ||7||
verses.translation: They hurry and run, and wander all around, caught in the love of Maya; they cover hundreds of thousands of miles in their wanderings. ||7||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਕਿਆ ਉਪਮਾ ਤਿਨੑ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: har har har har har jan uootam kiaa upamaa tin(h) dheejai ||
verses.translation: The humble servants of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, are sublime and exalted. What praise can we bestow upon them?

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਤੁਲਿ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam tul aaur na upamaa jan naanak kirapaa kareejai ||8||1||
verses.translation: Nothing else can equal the Glory of the Lord's Name; please bless servant Nanak with Your Grace. ||8||1||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: raam gur paaras paras kareejai ||
verses.translation: O Lord, please bless me with the Touch of the Guru, the Philosopher's Stone.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੀ ਮਨੂਰ ਅਤਿ ਫੀਕੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ham niragunee manoor at feeke mil satigur paaras keejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I was unworthy, utterly useless, rusty slag; meeting with the True Guru, I was transformed by the Philosopher's Stone. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਰਗ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਸਭਿ ਬਾਂਛਹਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਆਸਾ ਆਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: surag mukat baiku(n)Th sabh baa(n)chheh nit aasaa aas kareejai ||
verses.translation: Everyone longs for paradise, liberation and heaven; all place their hopes in them.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਮਾਂਗਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har dharasan ke jan mukat na maa(n)geh mil dharasan tirapat man dheejai ||1||
verses.translation: The humble long for the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; they do not ask for liberation. Their minds are satisfied and comforted by His Darshan. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਬਲੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਰੀ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਾਲਖ ਦਾਗ ਲਗੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa moh sabal hai bhaaree moh kaalakh dhaag lageejai ||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment to Maya is very powerful; this attachment is a black stain which sticks.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਅਲਿਪਤ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਜਿਉ ਮੁਰਗਾਈ ਪੰਕੁ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: mere Thaakur ke jan alipat hai mukate jiau muragaiee pa(n)k na bheejai ||2||
verses.translation: The humble servants of my Lord and Master are unattached and liberated. They are like ducks, whose feathers do not get wet. ||2||

verses.original: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਭੁਇਅੰਗਮ ਵੇੜੀ ਕਿਵ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dhan vaas bhuia(n)gam veRee kiv mileeaai cha(n)dhan leejai ||
verses.translation: The fragrant sandalwood tree is encircled by snakes; how can anyone get to the sandalwood?

verses.original: ਕਾਢਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਾਰਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਛੇਦਿ ਛੇਦਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: kaadd khaRag gur giaan karaaraa bikh chhedh chhedh ras peejai ||3||
verses.translation: Drawing out the Mighty Sword of the Guru's Spiritual Wisdom, I slaughter and kill the poisonous snakes, and drink in the Sweet Nectar. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਸਮਧਾ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਪਲੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰ ਭਸਮ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: aan aan samadhaa bahu keenee pal baisa(n)tar bhasam kareejai ||
verses.translation: You may gather wood and stack it in a pile, but in an instant, fire reduces it to ashes.

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਉਗ੍ਰ ਪਾਪ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਕੀਨੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਲੂਕੀ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: mahaa ugr paap saakat nar keene mil saadhoo lookee dheejai ||4||
verses.translation: The faithless cynic gathers the most horrendous sins, but meeting with the Holy Saint, they are placed in the fire. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo saadh saadh jan neeke jin a(n)tar naam dhareejai ||
verses.translation: The Holy, Saintly devotees are sublime and exalted. They enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, deep within.

verses.original: ਪਰਸ ਨਿਪਰਸੁ ਭਏ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ਦਿਖੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: paras niparas bhe saadhoo jan jan har bhagavaan dhikheejai ||5||
verses.translation: By the touch of the Holy and the humble servants of the Lord, the Lord God is seen. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਸੂਤੁ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਰਝੀ ਭਰਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਨੁ ਤਨੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: saakat soot bahu gurajhee bhariaa kiau kar taan taneejai ||
verses.translation: The thread of the faithless cynic is totally knotted and tangled; how can anything be woven with it?

verses.original: ਤੰਤੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਾਕਤ ਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ta(n)t soot kichh nikasai naahee saakat sa(n)g na keejai ||6||
verses.translation: This thread cannot be woven into yarn; do not associate with those faithless cynics. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: satigur saadhasa(n)gat hai neekee mil sa(n)gat raam raveejai ||
verses.translation: The True Guru and the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are exalted and sublime. Joining the Congregation, meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar ratan javehar maanak gur kirapaa te leejai ||7||
verses.translation: The gems, jewels and precious stones are deep within; by Guru's Grace, they are found. ||7||

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: meraa Thaakur vaddaa vaddaa hai suaamee ham kiau kar mileh mileejai ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is Glorious and Great. How can I be united in His Union?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak mel milaae gur pooraa jan kau pooran dheejai ||8||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Perfect Guru unites His humble servant in His Union, and blesses him with perfection. ||8||2||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮਾ ਰਮ ਰਾਮੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: raamaa ram raamo raam raveejai ||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord, the Lord, the All-pervading Lord.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo saadh saadh jan neeke mil saadhoo har ra(n)g keejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Holy, the humble and Holy, are noble and sublime. Meeting with the Holy, I joyfully love the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਡੋਲਤ ਡੋਲ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh jag hai jetaa man ddolat ddol kareejai ||
verses.translation: The minds of all the beings and creatures of the world waver unsteadily.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਥੰਮਨ ਕਉ ਥੰਮੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kirapaa kirapaa kar saadh milaavahu jag tha(n)man kau tha(n)m dheejai ||1||
verses.translation: Please take pity on them, be merciful to them, and unite them with the Holy; establish this support to support the world. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਤਲੈ ਤਲੈ ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਰੁਲੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: basudhaa talai talai sabh uoopar mil saadhoo charan ruleejai ||
verses.translation: The earth is beneath us, and yet its dust falls down on all; let yourself be covered by the dust of the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਅਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਅਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਸਭ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਚਰਨ ਤਲ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: at uootam at uootam hovahu sabh sisaT charan tal dheejai ||2||
verses.translation: You shall be utterly exalted, the most noble and sublime of all; the whole world will place itself at your feet. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਭਲੀ ਸਿਵ ਨੀਕੀ ਆਨਿ ਪਾਨੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh jot bhalee siv neekee aan paanee sakat bhareejai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are blessed with the Divine Light of the Lord; Maya comes to serve them.

verses.original: ਮੈਨਦੰਤ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਸਾਰੁ ਚਬਿ ਚਬਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mainadha(n)t nikase gur bachanee saar chab chab har ras peejai ||3||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, they bite with teeth of wax and chew iron, drinking in the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੁਰਖ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam anugrahu bahu keeaa gur saadhoo purakh mileejai ||
verses.translation: The Lord has shown great mercy, and bestowed His Name; I have met with the Holy Guru, the Primal Being.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਸਥੀਰਨ ਕੀਏ ਹਰਿ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਜਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: gun raam naam bisatheeran ke'ee har sagal bhavan jas dheejai ||4||
verses.translation: The Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name have spread out everywhere; the Lord bestows fame all over the world. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo saadh saadh man preetam bin dhekhe reh na sakeejai ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Lord is within the minds of the Holy, the Holy Saadhus; without seeing Him, they cannot survive.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਜਲੰ ਜਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਫੂਟਿ ਮਰੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jiau jal meen jala(n) jal preet hai khin jal bin fooT mareejai ||5||
verses.translation: The fish in the water loves only the water. Without water, it bursts and dies in an instant. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਹਾ ਅਭਾਗ ਅਭਾਗ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਨ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: mahaa abhaag abhaag hai jin ke tin saadhoo dhoor na peejai ||
verses.translation: Those who have terrible luck and bad fortune do not drink in the water which washes the dust of the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਤਿਨਾ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਜਲਤ ਨਹੀ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਡੰਡੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: tinaa tisanaa jalat jalat nahee boojheh dda(n)dd dharam rai kaa dheejai ||6||
verses.translation: The burning fire of their desires is not extinguished; they are beaten and punished by the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਬਰਤ ਜਗੵ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀਏ ਹਿਵੈ ਗਾਲਿ ਗਾਲਿ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh teerath barat jagaye pu(n)n ke'ee hivai gaal gaal tan chheejai ||
verses.translation: You may visit all the sacred shrines, observe fasts and sacred feasts, give generously in charity and waste away the body, melting it in the snow.

verses.original: ਅਤੁਲਾ ਤੋਲੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੋ ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਤੋਲ ਤੁਲੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: atulaa tol raam naam hai gurmat ko pujai na tol tuleejai ||7||
verses.translation: The weight of the Lord's Name is unweighable, according to the Guru's Teachings; nothing can equal its weight. ||7||

verses.original: ਤਵ ਗੁਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਤੂ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: tav gun braham braham too jaaneh jan naanak saran pareejai ||
verses.translation: O God, You alone know Your Glorious Virtues. Servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਮੀਨ ਹਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਖੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੩॥
verses.translit: too jal nidh meen ham tere kar kirapaa sa(n)g rakheejai ||8||3||
verses.translation: You are the Ocean of water, and I am Your fish. Please be kind, and keep me always with You. ||8||3||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮਾ ਰਮ ਰਾਮੋ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: raamaa ram raamo pooj kareejai ||
verses.translation: I worship and adore the Lord, the All-pervading Lord.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਉ ਸਭੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਸੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man tan arap dharau sabh aagai ras gurmat giaan dhiraReejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I surrender my mind and body, and place everything before Him; following the Guru's Teachings, spiritual wisdom is implanted within me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਖ ਤਰੋਵਰ ਨਿਤ ਚੁਨਿ ਚੁਨਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: braham naam gun saakh tarovar nit chun chun pooj kareejai ||
verses.translation: God's Name is the tree, and His Glorious Virtues are the branches. Picking and gathering up the fruit, I worship Him.

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਦੇਉ ਦੇਉ ਹੈ ਆਤਮੁ ਰਸਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪੂਜ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aatam dheau dheau hai aatam ras laagai pooj kareejai ||1||
verses.translation: The soul is divine; divine is the soul. Worship Him with love. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਿਚਰਿ ਬਿਚਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: bibek budh sabh jag meh niramal bichar bichar ras peejai ||
verses.translation: One of keen intellect and precise understanding is immaculate in all this world. In thoughtful consideration, he drinks in the sublime essence.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadh padhaarath paiaa satigur kau ih man dheejai ||2||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the treasure is found; dedicate this mind to the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਅਤਿ ਹੀਰੋ ਨੀਕੋ ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰੁ ਬਿਧੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: niramolak at heero neeko heerai heer bidheejai ||
verses.translation: Priceless and utterly sublime is the Diamond of the Lord. This Diamond pierces the diamond of the mind.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਸਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਪਰਖਿ ਲਈਜੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man motee saal hai gur sabadhee jit heeraa parakh lieejai ||3||
verses.translation: The mind becomes the jeweller, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; it appraises the Diamond of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਗਿ ਊਚੇ ਜਿਉ ਪੀਪ ਪਲਾਸ ਖਾਇ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)gat sa(n)t sa(n)g lag uooche jiau peep palaas khai leejai ||
verses.translation: Attaching oneself to the Society of the Saints, one is exalted and uplifted, as the palaas tree is absorbed by the peepal tree.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਨਰ ਮਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਊਤਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: sabh nar meh praanee uootam hovai raam naamai baas baseejai ||4||
verses.translation: That mortal being is supreme among all people, who is perfumed by the fragrance of the Lord's Name. ||4||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਮ ਬਹੁ ਕੀਨੇ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਖਾ ਹਰੀ ਜੜੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: niramal niramal karam bahu keene nit saakhaa haree jaReejai ||
verses.translation: One who continually acts in goodness and immaculate purity, sprouts green branches in great abundance.

verses.original: ਧਰਮੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਬਹਕਾਰ ਬਾਸੁ ਜਗਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: dharam ful fal gur giaan dhiraRaiaa bahakaar baas jag dheejai ||5||
verses.translation: The Guru has taught me that Dharmic faith is the flower, and spiritual wisdom is the fruit; this fragrance permeates the world. ||5||

verses.original: ਏਕ ਜੋਤਿ ਏਕੋ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਭ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਇਕੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: ek jot eko man vasiaa sabh braham dhirasaT ik keejai ||
verses.translation: The One, the Light of the One, abides within my mind; God, the One, is seen in all.

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਭ ਏਕੈ ਹੈ ਪਸਰੇ ਸਭ ਚਰਨ ਤਲੇ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aatam raam sabh ekai hai pasare sabh charan tale sir dheejai ||6||
verses.translation: The One Lord, the Supreme Soul, is spread out everywhere; all place their heads beneath His Feet. ||6||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਕਟੇ ਨਰ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਤਿਨ ਘਸਿ ਘਸਿ ਨਾਕ ਵਢੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam binaa nakaTe nar dhekhahu tin ghas ghas naak vaddeejai ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, people look like criminals with their noses cut off; bit by bit, their noses are cut off.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: saakat nar aha(n)kaaree kahe'eeh bin naavai dhirag jeeveejai ||7||
verses.translation: The faithless cynics are called egotistical; without the Name, their lives are cursed. ||7||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਸਾਸੁ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਤੁ ਬੇਗਲ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag saas saas man a(n)tar tat begal saran pareejai ||
verses.translation: As long as the breath breathes through the mind deep within, hurry and seek God's Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਪਖੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak kirapaa kirapaa kar dhaarahu mai saadhoo charan pakheejai ||8||4||
verses.translation: Please shower Your Kind Mercy and take pity upon Nanak, that he may wash the feet of the Holy. ||8||4||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮਾ ਮੈ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਧੁਵੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: raamaa mai saadhoo charan dhuveejai ||
verses.translation: O Lord, I wash the feet of the Holy.

verses.original: ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦਹਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਖਿਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kilabikh dhahan hoh khin a(n)tar mere Thaakur kirapaa keejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: May my sins be burnt away in an instant; O my Lord and Master, please bless me with Your Mercy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਦੀਨ ਖਰੇ ਦਰਿ ਠਾਢੇ ਅਤਿ ਤਰਸਨ ਕਉ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)gat jan dheen khare dhar Thaadde at tarasan kau dhaan dheejai ||
verses.translation: The meek and humble beggars stand begging at Your Door. Please be generous and give to those who are yearning.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਾਹਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਏ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: traeh traeh saran prabh aae mo kau gurmat naam dhiraReejai ||1||
verses.translation: Save me, save me, O God - I have come to Your Sanctuary. Please implant the Guru's Teachings, and the Naam within me. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਲਾ ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਜੂਝੁ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh nagar meh sabalaa nit uTh uTh joojh kareejai ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire and anger are very powerful in the body-village; I rise up to fight the battle against them.

verses.original: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਾਢਿ ਕਢੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)geekaar karahu rakh levahu gur pooraa kaadd kaddeejai ||2||
verses.translation: Please make me Your Own and save me; through the Perfect Guru, I drive them out. ||2||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਬਲ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਹਿਵ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar agan sabal at bikhiaa hiv seetal sabadh gur dheejai ||
verses.translation: The powerful fire of corruption is raging violently within; the Word of the Guru's Shabad is the ice water which cools and soothes.

verses.original: ਤਨਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਸੂਖਿ ਸਵੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tan man saa(n)t hoi adhikaiee rog kaaTai sookh saveejai ||3||
verses.translation: My mind and body are calm and tranquil; the disease has been cured, and now I sleep in peace. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਸਭ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਵੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau sooraj kiran raviaa sarab Thaiee sabh ghaT ghaT raam raveejai ||
verses.translation: As the rays of the sun spread out everywhere, the Lord pervades each and every heart.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਮਿਲੇ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਤਤੁ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਠਿਆ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: saadhoo saadh mile ras paavai tat nij ghar baiThiaa peejai ||4||
verses.translation: Meeting the Holy Saint, one drinks in the Sublime Essence of the Lord; sitting in the home of your own inner being, drink in the essence. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਿਉ ਚਕਵੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੂਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: jan kau preet lagee gur setee jiau chakavee dhekh sooreejai ||
verses.translation: The humble being is in love with the Guru, like the chakvi bird which loves to see the sun.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਖਤ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਭ ਨਿਰਖੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਢੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: nirakhat nirakhat rain sabh nirakhee mukh kaaddai a(n)mrit peejai ||5||
verses.translation: She watches, and keeps on watching all through the night; and when the sun shows its face, she drinks in the Amrit. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਸੁਆਨ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਲੋਭੀ ਬਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: saakat suaan kahe'eeh bahu lobhee bahu dhuramat mail bhareejai ||
verses.translation: The faithless cynic is said to be very greedy - he is a dog. He is overflowing with the filth and pollution of evil-mindedness.

verses.original: ਆਪਨ ਸੁਆਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤਾ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਵਿਸਾਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: aapan suaai kareh bahu baataa tinaa kaa visaahu kiaa keejai ||6||
verses.translation: He talks excessively about his own interests. How can he be trusted? ||6||

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸਾਧ ਸਰਨਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਕਢੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo saadh saran mil sa(n)gat jit har ras kaadd kaddeejai ||
verses.translation: I have sought the Sanctuary of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I have found the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਗੁਣੀਆ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: paraupakaar boleh bahu guneeaa mukh sa(n)t bhagat har dheejai ||7||
verses.translation: They do good deeds for others, and speak of the Lord's many Glorious Virtues; please bless me to meet these Saints, these devotees of the Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਇਆ ਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭ ਦਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: too agam dhiaal dhiaa pat dhaataa sabh dhiaa dhaar rakh leejai ||
