verses.translation: You are the Inaccessible Lord, Kind and Compassionate, the Great Giver; please shower us with Your Mercy, and save us.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਅ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੫॥
verses.translit: sarab jeea jagajeevan eko naanak pratipaal kareejai ||8||5||
verses.translation: You are the Life of all the beings of the world; please cherish and sustain Nanak. ||8||5||

verses.original: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
verses.translit: kaliaan mahalaa chauthhaa ||
verses.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮਾ ਹਮ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: raamaa ham dhaasan dhaas kareejai ||
verses.translation: O Lord, please make me the slave of Your slaves.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗਿ ਸਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਪਿਵੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag saas hoi man a(n)tar saadhoo dhoor piveejai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As long as there is breath deep within my mind, let me drink in the dust of the Holy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਕਰੁ ਨਾਰਦੁ ਸੇਖਨਾਗ ਮੁਨਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੀ ਲੋਚੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)kar naaradh sekhanaag mun dhoor saadhoo kee locheejai ||
verses.translation: Shiva, Naarad, the thousand-headed cobra king and the silent sages long for the dust of the Holy.

verses.original: ਭਵਨ ਭਵਨ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਜਹ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhavan bhavan pavit hoh sabh jeh saadhoo charan dhareejai ||1||
verses.translation: All the worlds and realms where the Holy place their feet are sanctified. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਜੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਹੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: taj laaj aha(n)kaar sabh tajeeaai mil saadhoo sa(n)g raheejai ||
verses.translation: So let go of your shame and renounce all your egotism; join with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and remain there.

verses.original: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਕਾਨਿ ਚੁਕਾਵੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਡੁਬਦਾ ਕਾਢਿ ਕਢੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dharam rai kee kaan chukaavai bikh ddubadhaa kaadd kaddeejai ||2||
verses.translation: Give up your fear of the Righteous Judge of Dharma, and you shall be lifted up and saved from drowning in the sea of poison. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਰਮਿ ਸੂਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਉਭਿ ਸੁਕ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: bharam sooke bahu ubh suk kahe'eeh mil saadhoo sa(n)g hareejai ||
verses.translation: Some are standing, parched and shrivelled up by their doubts; joining the Saadh Sangat, they are rejuvenated.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਲਮੁ ਪਲੁ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਨਿ ਲਗੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taa te bilam pal ddil na keejai jai saadhoo charan lageejai ||3||
verses.translation: So do not delay, even for an instant - go and fall at the feet of the Holy. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀਰਤਨ ਰਤਨ ਵਥੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪਾਸਿ ਰਖੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam keeratan ratan vath har saadhoo paas rakheejai ||
verses.translation: The Kirtan of the Praise of the Lord's Name is a priceless jewel. The Lord has given it for the Holy to keep.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਬਚਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਾਢਿ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jo bachan gur sat sat kar maanai tis aagai kaadd dhareejai ||4||
verses.translation: Whoever accepts and follows the Word of the Guru's Teachings as True - this Jewel is taken out and given to him. ||4||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢੀ ਬਾਹ ਕੁਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu sunahu sunahu jan bhaiee gur kaaddee baeh kukeejai ||
verses.translation: Listen, O Saints; listen, humble Siblings of Destiny: the Guru raises His Arms and sends out the call.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਆਤਮ ਕਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਿਤ ਲੋੜਹੁ ਤਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਵੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: je aatam kau sukh sukh nit loRahu taa(n) satigur saran paveejai ||5||
verses.translation: If you long for everlasting peace and comfort for your soul, then enter the Sanctuary of the True Guru. ||5||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਤਿ ਨੀਕਾ ਤਾਂ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: je vadd bhaag hoi at neekaa taa(n) gurmat naam dhiraReejai ||
verses.translation: If you have great good fortune and are very noble, then implant the Guru's Teachings and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਜਗੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sabh maiaa moh bikham jag tareeaai sahaje har ras peejai ||6||
verses.translation: Emotional attachment to Maya is totally treacherous; drinking in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, you shall easily, intuitively cross over the world-ocean. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਪਚੈ ਪਚੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa maiaa ke jo adhikaiee vich maiaa pachai pacheejai ||
verses.translation: Those who are totally in love with Maya, Maya, shall rot away in Maya.

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ਲਦਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: agiaan a(n)dher mahaa pa(n)th bikhaRaa aha(n)kaar bhaar ladh leejai ||7||
verses.translation: The path of ignorance and darkness is utterly treacherous; they are loaded down with the crushing load of egotism. ||7||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਾਮ ਰਮ ਰਮੁ ਰਮ ਰਮ ਰਾਮੈ ਤੇ ਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: naanak raam ram ram ram ram raamai te gat keejai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, chanting the Name of the Lord, the All-pervading Lord, one is emancipated.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਲੈ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥੮॥੬॥
verses.translit: satigur milai taa naam dhiraRaae raam naamai ralai mileejai ||8||6||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, the Naam is implanted within; we are united and blended with the Lord's Name. ||8||6||

verses.original: ਛਕਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: chhakaa 1 ||
verses.translation: First Set of Six||

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar satinaam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਪਰਭਾਤੀ ਬਿਭਾਸ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: raag parabhaatee bibhaas mahalaa pehilaa chaupadhe ghar pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Raag Parbhaatee Bibhaas, First Mehla, Chau-Padhay, First House:

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਤਰਣਾ ਨਾਇ ਪਤਿ ਪੂਜ ॥
verses.translit: nai terai taranaa nai pat pooj ||
verses.translation: Your Name carries us across; Your Name brings respect and worship.

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ਮਤਿ ਮਕਸੂਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: naau teraa gahanaa mat makasoodh ||
verses.translation: Your Name embellishes us; it is the object of the awakened mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਉ ਮੰਨੇ ਸਭ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: nai terai naau ma(n)ne sabh koi ||
verses.translation: Your Name brings honor to everyone's name.

verses.original: ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪਤਿ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: vin naavai pat kabahu na hoi ||1||
verses.translation: Without Your Name, no one is ever respected. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸਗਲੀ ਪਾਜੁ ॥
verses.translit: avar siaanap sagalee paaj ||
verses.translation: All other clever tricks are just for show.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਬਖਸੇ ਤੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਾਜੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jai bakhase tai pooraa kaaj ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whoever the Lord blesses with forgiveness - his affairs are perfectly resolved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਨਾਉ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: naau teraa taan naau dheebaan ||
verses.translation: Your Name is my strength; Your Name is my support.

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਲਸਕਰੁ ਨਾਉ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: naau teraa lasakar naau sulataan ||
verses.translation: Your Name is my army; Your Name is my king.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਾਣੁ ਮਹਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: nai terai maan mahat paravaan ||
verses.translation: Your Name brings honor, glory and approval.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਵੈ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: teree nadharee karam pavai neesaan ||2||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, one is blessed with the banner and the insignia of Your Mercy. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਹਜੁ ਨਾਇ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
verses.translit: nai terai sahaj nai saalaeh ||
verses.translation: Your Name brings intuitive peace and poise; Your Name brings praise.

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਿਖੁ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naau teraa a(n)mrit bikh uTh jai ||
verses.translation: Your Name is the Ambrosial Nectar which cleans out the poison.

verses.original: ਨਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਵਸਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: nai terai sabh sukh vaseh man aai ||
verses.translation: Through Your Name, all peace and comfort comes to abide in the mind.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਧੀ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin naavai baadhee jam pur jai ||3||
verses.translation: Without the Name, they are bound and gagged, and dragged off to the City of Death. ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਰੀ ਬੇਰੀ ਘਰ ਦਰ ਦੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: naaree beree ghar dhar dhes ||
verses.translation: Man is involved with his wife, hearth and home, land and country,

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੀਆ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਕੀਚਹਿ ਵੇਸ ॥
verses.translit: man keeaa khuseeaa keecheh ves ||
verses.translation: the pleasures of the mind and fine clothes;

verses.original: ਜਾਂ ਸਦੇ ਤਾਂ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa(n) sadhe taa(n) ddil na pai ||
verses.translation: but when the call comes, he cannot delay.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜੋ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak kooR kooRo hoi jai ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in the end, the false turn out to be false. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਤਿਥੈ ਲੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: teraa naam ratan karam chaanan surat tithai loi ||
verses.translation: Your Name is the Jewel, and Your Grace is the Light. In awareness, there is Your Light.

verses.original: ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਅੰਧੀ ਵਾਪਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਲੀਜੈ ਖੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)dher a(n)dhee vaaparai sagal leejai khoi ||1||
verses.translation: Darkness fills the dark, and then everything is lost. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: eih sa(n)saar sagal bikaar ||
verses.translation: This whole world is corrupt.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਾਸਤਿ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: teraa naam dhaaroo avar naasat karanahaar apaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your Name is the only cure; nothing else works, O Infinite Creator Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਾਤਾਲ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਏਕ ਭਾਰ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋੜਿ ॥
verses.translit: paataal pureeaa ek bhaar hoveh laakh karoR ||
verses.translation: One side of the scale holds tens of thousands, millions of nether regions and realms.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਲਾਲ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਤਾ ਪਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਸਿਰੈ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਹੋਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tere laal keemat taa pavai jaa(n) sirai hoveh hor ||2||
verses.translation: O my Beloved, Your Worth could only be estimated if something else could be placed on the other side of the scale. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੂਖਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖ ਊਪਜਹਿ ਸੂਖੀ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦੂਖ ॥
verses.translit: dhookhaa te sukh uoopajeh sookhee hoveh dhookh ||
verses.translation: Out of pain, pleasure is produced, and out of pleasure comes pain.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਤੂ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਅਹਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਕੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jit mukh too saalaahe'eeh tit mukh kaisee bhookh ||3||
verses.translation: That mouth which praises You - what hunger could that mouth ever suffer? ||3||

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਅਵਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਸੈਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak moorakh ek too avar bhalaa saisaar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, you alone are foolish; all the rest of the world is good.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਊਪਜੈ ਸੇ ਤਨ ਹੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਰ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: jit tan naam na uoopajai se tan hoh khuaar ||4||2||
verses.translation: That body in which the Naam does not well up - that body becomes miserable. ||4||2||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਬੇਦ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੈ ਉਚਰੇ ਸੰਕਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jai kaaran bedh brahamai uchare sa(n)kar chhoddee maiaa ||
verses.translation: For His sake, Brahma uttered the Vedas, and Shiva renounced Maya.

verses.original: ਜੈ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਸਿਧ ਭਏ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਦੇਵੀ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jai kaaran sidh bhe udhaasee dhevee maram na paiaa ||1||
verses.translation: For His sake, the Siddhas became hermits and renunciates; even the gods have not realized His Mystery. ||1||

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਤਰੀਐ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa man saachaa mukh saachaa kaheeaai tareeaai saachaa hoiee ||
verses.translation: O Baba, keep the True Lord in your mind, and utter the Name of the True Lord with your mouth; the True Lord will carry you across.

verses.original: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhusaman dhookh na aavai neRai har mat paavai koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Enemies and pain shall not even approach you; only a rare few realize the Wisdom of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿੰਬ ਪਵਣੈ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੀਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: agan bi(n)b pavanai kee baanee teen naam ke dhaasaa ||
verses.translation: Fire, water and air make up the world; these three are the slaves of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤੇ ਤਸਕਰ ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵਹਿ ਵਾਸਹਿ ਕੋਟ ਪੰਚਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: te tasakar jo naam na leveh vaaseh koT pa(n)chaasaa ||2||
verses.translation: One who does not chant the Naam is a thief, dwelling in the fortress of the five thieves. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਏਕ ਕਰੈ ਚੰਗਿਆਈ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਫਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: je ko ek karai cha(n)giaaiee man chit bahut bafaavai ||
verses.translation: If someone does a good deed for someone else, he totally puffs himself up in his conscious mind.

verses.original: ਏਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਏਤੀਆ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ete gun eteeaa cha(n)giaaieeaa dhei na pachhotaavai ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord bestows so many virtues and so much goodness; He does not ever regret it. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: tudh saalaahan tin dhan palai naanak kaa dhan soiee ||
verses.translation: Those who praise You gather the wealth in their laps; this is Nanak's wealth.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਜੀਉ ਕਹੈ ਓਨਾ ਕਉ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਤਲਬ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: je ko jeeau kahai onaa kau jam kee talab na hoiee ||4||3||
verses.translation: Whoever shows respect to them is not summoned by the Messenger of Death. ||4||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਮੁਖੁ ਮਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai roop naahee jaat naahee naahee mukh maasaa ||
verses.translation: One who has no beauty, no social status, no mouth, no flesh

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਹੈ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur mile nira(n)jan paiaa terai naam hai nivaasaa ||1||
verses.translation: - meeting with the True Guru, he finds the Immaculate Lord, and dwells in Your Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਉਧੂ ਸਹਜੇ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: aaudhoo sahaje tat beechaar ||
verses.translation: O detached Yogi, contemplate the essence of reality,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੁ ਸੈਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa te fir na aavahu saisaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and you shall never again come to be born into the world. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕਰਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਧਰਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਚਿ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai karam naahee dharam naahee naahee such maalaa ||
verses.translation: One who does not have good karma or Dharmic faith, sacred rosary or mala

verses.original: ਸਿਵ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੰਨਹੁ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: siv jot ka(n)nahu budh paiee satiguroo rakhavaalaa ||2||
verses.translation: - through the Light of God, wisdom is bestowed; the True Guru is our Protector. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਬਰਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨੇਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਬਕਬਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai barat naahee nem naahee naahee bakabaiee ||
verses.translation: One who does not observe any fasts, make religious vows or chant

verses.original: ਗਤਿ ਅਵਗਤਿ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gat avagat kee chi(n)t naahee satiguroo furamaiee ||3||
verses.translation: - he does not have to worry about good luck or bad, if he obeys the Command of the True Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਆਸ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿਤਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai aas naahee niraas naahee chit surat samajhaiee ||
verses.translation: One who is not hopeful, nor hopeless, who has trained his intuitive consciousness

verses.original: ਤੰਤ ਕਉ ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: ta(n)t kau param ta(n)t miliaa naanakaa budh paiee ||4||4||
verses.translation: - his being blends with the Supreme Being. O Nanak, his awareness is awakened. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਦਰਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: taa kaa kahiaa dhar paravaan ||
verses.translation: What he says is approved in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bikh a(n)mrit dhui sam kar jaan ||1||
verses.translation: He looks upon poison and nectar as one and the same. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਰਬੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa kaheeaai sarabe rahiaa samai ||
verses.translation: What can I say? You are permeating and pervading all.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh varatai sabh teree rajai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever happens, is all by Your Will. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਗਟੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਚੂਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: pragaTee jot chookaa abhimaan ||
verses.translation: The Divine Light shines radiantly, and egotistical pride is dispelled.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur dheeaa a(n)mirat naam ||2||
verses.translation: The True Guru bestows the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: kal meh aaiaa so jan jaan ||
verses.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, one's birth is approved,

verses.original: ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saachee dharageh paavai maan ||3||
verses.translation: if one is honored in the True Court. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਣਾ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਅਕਥ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: kahanaa sunanaa akath ghar jai ||
verses.translation: Speaking and listening, one goes to the Celestial Home of the Indescribable Lord.

verses.original: ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: kathanee badhanee naanak jal jai ||4||5||
verses.translation: Mere words of mouth, O Nanak, are burnt away. ||4||5||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
verses.translit: prabhaatee mahalaa pehilaa ||
verses.translation: Prabhaatee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਗਿਆਨਿ ਮਨ ਮਜਨੁ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੰਗਿ ਗਹੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit neer giaan man majan aThasaTh teerath sa(n)g gahe ||
verses.translation: One who bathes in the Ambrosial Water of spiritual wisdom takes with him the virtues of the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਜਵਾਹਰ ਮਾਣਕ ਸੇਵੇ ਸਿਖੁ ਸੋੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur upadhes javaahar maanak seve sikh suo khoj lahai ||1||
verses.translation: The Guru's Teachings are the gems and jewels; the Sikh who serves Him searches and finds them. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur samaan teerath nahee koi ||
verses.translation: There is no sacred shrine equal to the Guru.

verses.original: ਸਰੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sar sa(n)tokh taas gur hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Guru encompasses the ocean of contentment. ||1||Pause||
